quests.title: ...for the Good of the Chosen
objectivesKo: 라이트키퍼에게 보고하기
quests.content:
...for the Good of the Chosen is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You want to see the whole picture, but you forget that you're still just a tool. To learn more, you'll have to rise above the situation and forget about the sides of the conflict you're familiar with. Are you sure you're ready for that? Then listen carefully to your next assignment. You must follow the instructions precisely. First, retrieve the object from Container 14 in the Ultra parking garage. To do that, restore power at the power station, then go up to Burger Spot and find the hidden panel in the restroom. Use the card marked #11SR on the panel, then go down to the TerraGroup safe room in the parking garage. It's next to the escalator from OLI and the breach in the parking garage wall. There's a lever inside that will open Container 14. The container itself is in the parking garage beneath IDEA, by the exit toward the power station. Look for the green container marked TerraGroup. Once you've retrieved the suitcase, head downtown. Make your way to the restaurant on the third floor of the Pinewood Hotel. Leave the suitcase on the balcony. After that, send a yellow signal flare near the tram that collapsed underground. And remember: there must be no witnesses. Conduct the operation at night and leave no one alive who could have seen you. When everything is done, return to me.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Report back to Lightkeeper

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
If I had told you what was inside, you wouldn't have agreed to this job. But don't worry, there's neither a virus nor radiation inside. You were right about one thing. Black Division has assignments beyond clearing facilities. There are still samples in Tarkov that TerraGroup's closest competitors would need at least ten years to obtain. I won't tell you what they are or what they do. Some things are worth more than the entire city and everyone living in it. People may die, but the gifts must survive into the new world. After Black Division's operation in Tarkov, there will be nothing left to stand in the way of the plan.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 전체적인 그림을 보고 싶어 하면서도, 당신이 아직 도구에 불과하다는 사실은 잊고 있군. 더 알고 싶다면 지금까지 익숙했던 분쟁의 편에서 벗어나 상황을 내려다봐야 해. 정말 준비됐나? 그렇다면 다음 임무를 잘 들어. 지시를 정확히 따라야 한다. 먼저 울트라 주차장의 14번 컨테이너에서 물건을 회수해. 발전소에서 전력을 복구한 다음 버거 스폿으로 올라가 화장실에 숨겨진 패널을 찾아. 패널에 #11SR 카드키를 사용하고, 주차장에 있는 테라그룹 안전실로 내려가. OLI에서 내려오는 에스컬레이터와 주차장 벽의 파손된 틈 옆에 있어. 안에 있는 레버를 당기면 14번 컨테이너가 열린다. 컨테이너는 IDEA 아래 주차장, 발전소 방향 출구 근처에 있어. 테라그룹 표시가 있는 초록색 컨테이너를 찾아. 여행 가방을 회수하면 시내로 이동해. 파인우드 호텔 3층 식당으로 가서 발코니에 가방을 두고 와. 그다음 지하로 무너져 내린 트램 근처에서 노란 신호탄을 쏴. 목격자는 없어야 한다는 것도 잊지 마. 야간에 작전을 수행하고, 널 봤을 만한 사람은 모두 제거해. 모든 일이 끝나면 내게 돌아와.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: 시즌 모드로 플레이 중이어야 합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 라이트키퍼에게 보고하기

안에 뭐가 들었는지 말했더라면 이 일을 맡지 않았겠지. 하지만 걱정하지 마. 바이러스도 방사능도 없어. 네 말이 맞았어. 블랙 디비전의 임무는 시설을 정리하는 데서 끝나지 않아. 테라그룹의 가장 가까운 경쟁자들이 확보하려면 적어도 10년은 걸릴 샘플이 타르코프에 아직 남아 있지. 그게 무엇이고 어떤 용도인지는 말해주지 않겠다. 어떤 것들은 도시 전체와 그 안에 사는 사람 모두보다 가치가 있으니까. 사람들이 죽더라도 그 선물은 새로운 세상까지 살아남아야 해. 블랙 디비전이 타르코프에서 작전을 마치고 나면 계획을 가로막을 것은 아무것도 남지 않을 거야.

quests.title: A Big Loss
objectivesKo: 인터체인지에서 OLI 화물 운송 경로 서류 찾기 및 확보하기
서류를 레그맨에게 전달하기
quests.content:
A Big Loss is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, brother! I was looking through some of the Ultra shipment records recently and noticed that a major shipment went missing somewhere along the way. According to the manifest, it was carrying batteries. Pretty useful stuff in our situation, if you catch my drift. The logistics department usually handles this kind of thing. Can you head to their office, dig around for the shipment routes and its current status? I won't forget the favor! The office was probably locked up. No idea where the key ended up, but you're a smart guy. I believe in you.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the OLI cargo route documents on Interchange
Hand over the documents to Ragman

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Got it? Good! Now let's see where that truck disappeared to.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to obtain the OLI cargo route documents from the OLI logistics department office on the first floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange. A OLI logistics department office key is required to enter it.

Office location marked on map
Entrance to the OLI front offices
Door to the wanted office
Documents on the left side shelf

== See also ==
Inventory Files - The BEAR counterpart quest

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 형제, 잘 지냈어? 최근 울트라 화물 기록을 살펴보다가 운송 중 큰 화물이 사라진 걸 발견했어. 운송장에는 배터리가 실려 있었다고 하더군. 무슨 말인지 알겠지? 지금 우리 상황에 꽤 쓸모 있는 물건이야. 이런 일은 보통 물류 부서에서 처리해. 사무실에 가서 운송 경로와 현재 상태를 좀 알아봐 줄 수 있어? 이 은혜는 잊지 않을게! 사무실은 아마 잠겨 있을 거야. 열쇠가 어디로 갔는지는 모르겠지만, 넌 똑똑하잖아. 잘 해낼 거라 믿어.

quests.content:
A Bitter Victory is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, well the smugglers managed to get their commander out, though not without losses. I'm heading over to talk things through and ask about you as well. But you get it, right now they need to both celebrate the win and properly remember the ones they lost. So I can't show up empty-handed. You gonna help set the table?

== Objectives ==
Hand over 2 Bottles of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to the BTR Driver
(Optional) Obtain 2 Bottles of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Hand over 4 Rye croutons to the BTR Driver
(Optional) Obtain 4 Rye croutons
Hand over 4 Bottles of Tarkovskaya vodka to the BTR Driver
(Optional) Obtain 4 Bottles of Tarkovskaya vodka
Hand over 2 Salty Dog beef sausages to the BTR Driver
(Optional) Obtain 2 Salty Dog beef sausages
Talk to the BTR Driver
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
That's a decent haul of grub you brought. With stuff like this, the conversation will go a lot easier. By the next time we meet, I should have something for you about your request.

== Guide ==

All items have to be collected and in your inventory before any can be handed over. If you want to hand over items obtained before accepting the quest, you have to move them to a different inventory slot for the game to register them.

quests.content:
A Difficult Choice is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Young man, wait. I knew that Jaeger would ask you to kill Sanitar, but you don't have to do it. I understand Jaeger's point of view, that he's just some kind of monster in the flesh, but he is not. I'm sure Sanitar is just trying to help the locals. Given the current circumstances, he performs the most complex surgeries and it is not surprising that they often end badly. He is a doctor with the most valuable knowledge that can save many more lives. A doctor with access to a warehouse of medicines that are extremely important to us. And he has already entered into negotiations with me and will soon begin to cooperate. But for this, I need something that will interest him and I think I know what will: the Laboratory. Access keys and samples of military stimulants, I think they are the basis on which he conducts his experiments. Can you find them for me? You can get the access keycards however you want, but the stimulants must be sealed, so you need to find them yourself.

== Objectives ==
Do not kill Sanitar
Find 10 TerraGroup Labs access keycards in raid
Hand over the keycards
Find AHF1-M stimulant injector in raid
Hand over the injector
Find 3-(b-TG) stimulant injector in raid
Hand over the injector

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× T H I C C item case
Thank you. I knew you would understand how important Sanitar and his... medication are right now. He has already shown a great interest in keycards and stimulants and sent the first batch of goods. Here, this is your share.

== Failure Penalty ==
It is a pity that you listened to this Jaeger instead of the voice of reason. Sanitar with his knowledge and medicines could've helped us in many ways. He wasn't a saint, but surely everyone has a chance to atone for their sins, but you have took away that chance. I am very displeased with you.

== Guide ==
By completing The Huntsman Path - Sadist, you fail and will lose access to this quest.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 젊은이, 잠깐. 예거가 위생병을 죽이라고 할 줄 알았어. 하지만 꼭 그럴 필요는 없어. 위생병을 괴물 같은 인간이라고 보는 예거의 입장은 이해해. 하지만 그는 그런 사람이 아니야. 분명 지역 주민을 도우려는 것뿐일 거야. 지금 같은 상황에서 그는 가장 복잡한 수술을 집도하고 있고, 수술이 잘못되는 경우가 많은 것도 놀랄 일은 아니지. 많은 생명을 구할 수 있는 귀중한 지식을 가진 의사야. 우리에게 절실한 의약품 창고에 접근할 수 있는 의사이기도 하고. 이미 나와 협상을 시작했으며 곧 협력할 거야. 그러려면 그의 관심을 끌 만한 것이 필요한데, 뭔지 알 것 같아. 연구소 말이야. 출입 카드와 군용 자극제가 그가 실험하는 데 필요한 재료인 것 같아. 찾아다 줄 수 있겠어? 출입 카드는 어떤 방법으로든 구해도 되지만, 자극제는 밀봉된 채로 발견해야 하니 직접 찾아야 해.

고맙다. 지금 위생병과 그의… 약이 얼마나 중요한지 네가 이해해줄 줄 알았어. 그는 출입 카드와 자극제에 큰 관심을 보였고, 이미 첫 물량을 보냈어. 여기, 네 몫이야.

sectionsKo.title: Failure Penalty
sectionsKo.text: 이성의 목소리 대신 예거의 말을 들었다니 안타깝군. 위생병은 지식과 의약품으로 우리에게 많은 도움을 줄 수 있었어. 성자는 아니지만 누구든 죄를 씻을 기회는 있는 법인데, 네가 그 기회를 빼앗았어. 정말 실망스럽군.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: ‘사냥꾼의 길 - 새디스트’를 완료하면 실패 처리되어 이 퀘스트를 더는 진행할 수 없습니다.

quests.title: A Familiar Face...
objectivesKo: 키라사-N 또는 NFM THOR CRV 방탄복을 착용하고 라이트하우스에서 장갑 열차를 이용해 탈출하기
quests.content:
A Familiar Face... is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, mate! Heard yet that the smugglers kicked the Rogues out of their base at the treatment plant? If you ask me, that sounds pretty fucking bad. I've been at odds with those muppets ever since that whole thing with Peacekeeper, and I don't want to see them getting any stronger. This victory of theirs already says a fucking lot... Don't know yet how to put the squeeze on 'em effectively. But we still need to gather intel. Think you can get in good with them, find out what's what at the train station? Y'know, the place they launched their assault on the treatment plant from. Don't need to do anything fancy! Just throw on some basic gear and keep an eye on 'em.

== Objectives ==
Extract from Lighthouse through the Armored Train while wearing a Kirasa-N or NFM THOR CRV body armor

== Rewards ==
+15,000 EXP
1,800 Euros
1,890 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,070 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× CENS ProFlex DX5 tactical earplug
Judging by your intel, the smugglers spent a shitload themselves in that scrap with the Rogues. Well, at least there's that, eh. But we still can't let our guard down. They'll sure as hell try to dig in there. We need to keep tabs on 'em.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 그래, 친구! 밀수꾼들이 수처리 시설 기지에서 로그들을 몰아냈다는 소식 들었어? 내 생각엔 꽤 좆같은 상황이야. 피스키퍼와 그 일로 틀어진 뒤로 저 얼간이들과 계속 대립해왔는데, 놈들이 더 강해지는 꼴은 보고 싶지 않아. 이번 승리만 봐도 얼마나 위험한지 알겠지… 아직 어떻게 제대로 압박해야 할지는 모르겠어. 그래도 정보는 모아야 해. 그들과 친해져서 기차역에서 무슨 일이 있었는지 알아봐 줄 수 있겠어? 수처리 시설을 공격할 때 출발했던 곳 말이야. 거창한 일은 필요 없어! 기본 장비만 걸치고 놈들을 살펴봐.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 키라사-N 또는 NFM THOR CRV 방탄복을 착용하고 라이트하우스에서 장갑 열차를 이용해 탈출하기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text:
+15,000 경험치
1,800 유로
정보 센터 1레벨일 때 1,890 유로
정보 센터 2레벨일 때 2,070 유로
CENS ProFlex DX5 전술 이어플러그 2개

네가 가져온 정보로 보면 밀수꾼들은 로그들과 싸우면서 자기들도 상당한 손해를 봤어. 그나마 다행이군. 그래도 경계를 늦춰선 안 돼. 놈들은 분명 그곳에 자리를 잡으려 할 테니 계속 감시해야 해.

quests.title: A Fuel Matter
objectivesKo: 리저브에서 첫 번째 연료 탱크 무리에 MS2000 마커 설치하기
리저브에서 두 번째 연료 탱크 무리에 MS2000 마커 설치하기
quests.content:
A Fuel Matter is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there! I'm gathering my guys to search the reserve base for fuel. They say there are stationary fuel tanks and tank cars, but I don't know where they are exactly, so I don't wanna send my guys to search for them while they're getting shot at by snipers and shit, so why not you go there yourself and quietly mark the fuel tanks with beacons? Look for the big groups of fuel cisterns.

== Objectives ==
Mark the first group of fuel tanks with an MS2000 Marker on Reserve
Mark the second group of fuel tanks with an MS2000 Marker on Reserve

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Big thanks. Now we know where they are so we don't have to take any chances. Here's the reward for a job well done, brother.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find and mark 2 groups of fuel tanks on Reserve.

Fuel tanks marked on map
First group of tanks next to the "Sewer Manhole" extraction
Second group of tanks next to the train depot

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕! 예비 기지에서 연료를 찾으려고 부하들을 모으는 중이야. 고정식 연료 탱크와 탱크 차량이 있다는데 정확히 어디 있는지 모르겠어. 저격수에게 총 맞아가며 찾게 할 수는 없잖아. 네가 직접 가서 연료 탱크에 표식을 붙여주면 어때? 큰 연료 탱크 무리를 찾아봐.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
리저브에서 첫 번째 연료 탱크 무리에 MS2000 마커 설치하기
리저브에서 두 번째 연료 탱크 무리에 MS2000 마커 설치하기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text:
+28,000 경험치
레그맨 평판 +0.75
275,000 루블
정보 센터 1레벨일 때 288,750 루블
정보 센터 2레벨일 때 316,250 루블

정말 고마워. 이제 위치를 알았으니 위험을 감수하지 않아도 되겠군. 일을 잘 마친 보상이야, 형제.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text:
리저브에서 연료 탱크 무리 2곳을 찾아 마커를 설치해야 합니다.

지도에 표시된 연료 탱크 위치
하수구 맨홀 탈출 지점 옆 첫 번째 탱크 무리
열차 정비소 옆 두 번째 탱크 무리

sectionsKo.title: Trivia
sectionsKo.text:
필요하다면 프라포르나 레그맨에게 MS2000 마커를 구매할 수 있습니다.
MS2000 마커를 잃지 않도록 특수 슬롯이나 파우치에 보관하는 것을 권장합니다.
열쇠와 마찬가지로, 필요할 때 인벤토리 안의 MS2000 마커가 자동으로 사용됩니다.

quests.title: A Healthy Alternative
objectivesKo: 실험실 일지 건네기
quests.content:
A Healthy Alternative is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I understand that you were tasked with finding the laboratory log from the polychemical plant. Apparently, TerraGroup is willing to pay handsomely for the extraction of their documents. I urge you to reconsider. If the corporation cares so much about this material, it must be hiding something valuable! Obviously, I mean valuable to the city and its citizens. Just leave the journal in my care.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the lab journal

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
1× Lucky Scav Junk box
You picked the right side! This journal will be very useful to my acquaintance in his experiments.... I mean, research! This way we can alleviate the suffering of the Tarkov citizens who are still in the city.

== Failure Dialogue ==
You've decided to return the journal to the corp? You don't seem to care much for the people of this town. I'm disappointed in your choice.

== Guide ==
By completing One Less Loose End, you will lose access to this quest.

The journal can be found in the laboratory on the second floor of Factory. There are multiple spawns throughout both rooms.

Laboratory location marked on map
Entrance to the laboratory
Spawn #1: In the first room on the trolley
Spawn #2: In the first room on the chest of drawers next to the glass cabinet
Spawn #3: In the second room in the bottom compartment of the right industrial shelf
Spawn #4: In the second room in the small fridge on the floor
Spawn #5: In the second room on the right desk

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 폴리켐 공장의 실험실 일지를 찾으라는 의뢰를 받으셨다고 들었습니다. 테라그룹은 서류를 회수해주면 후하게 보상할 모양이더군요. 다시 생각해보시길 권합니다. 회사가 그 자료를 그토록 원한다면 뭔가 가치 있는 것을 숨기고 있는 게 분명합니다! 물론 도시와 시민들에게 가치 있는 것을 말하는 겁니다. 그 일지를 제게 맡겨주세요.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 실험실 일지 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text:
+3,000 경험치
럭키 스캐브 정크박스 1개

올바른 편을 선택하셨군요! 이 일지는 제 지인의 실험에 아주 유용할 겁니다… 연구라고 해야겠네요! 아직 도시에 남아 있는 타르코프 시민들의 고통을 덜어줄 수 있을 겁니다.

sectionsKo.title: Failure Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 일지를 회사에 돌려주기로 했나요? 이 마을 사람들에게는 별 관심이 없어 보이는군요. 그런 선택을 하시다니 실망입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text:
‘남은 흔적 하나’를 완료하면 이 퀘스트를 더는 진행할 수 없습니다.

일지는 공장 2층 실험실에서 찾을 수 있으며, 두 방 곳곳에 여러 생성 위치가 있습니다.

지도에 표시된 실험실 위치
실험실 입구
생성 위치 1: 첫 번째 방의 손수레 위
생성 위치 2: 첫 번째 방, 유리 진열장 옆 서랍장 위

quests.title: A Helping Hand
quests.unlocks: Shipping Delay - Part 1Shipping Delay - Part 2Hot Wheels
objectivesKo: 우즈에서 프라포르의 화물 찾기 및 확보하기
지역에서 생존 후 탈출하기
‘배송 지연 - 파트 1’ 퀘스트 완료하기
quests.content:
A Helping Hand is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I figure you've already seen the BTR that's been driving around Tarkov. The driver used to offer his services to PMCs like you, but lately he has started working with Skier as well. The driver came to me when he was restoring the BTR. It was an quite an interesting challenge, let me tell you. But that's beside the point. He hasn't been in touch for quite some time, and now he's suddenly asked for help. Apparently, something serious has happened. Can you check in with him and find out what's going on? There aren't many men of wit and ambition left in Tarkov. People like us should stick together.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain Prapor's package on Woods
Survive and extract from the location
Complete the task Shipping Delay - Part 1

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× "The Eye" mortar strike signaling device
I told him it was dangerous to become part of Skier's gang... Granted, it does have its privileges, but you can hardly stay independent in such a big business. I wonder who could have turned against Skier? After all, the BTR should be under his protection...

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Prapor's package on Woods. It can be found in 1 of 2 locations in the northwest building of the train depot. The depot can only be accessed via the BTR Driver's taxi service. After collecting the package, you have to hand it over to Prapor in his quest Shipping Delay - Part 1, afterwards you can complete this quest.

Building marked on map
The wanted building
First spawn under the table next to the bed
Second spawn on the desk in the back office

It is also possible to leave the depot through walking on top of the western train. When walking on top of the train it is important to stick to the center to not get hit by snipers or mines.

Way to the train
The train

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 타르코프를 돌아다니는 BTR은 이미 보셨겠죠. 운전기사는 원래 당신 같은 PMC에게 서비스를 제공했지만, 최근에는 스키어와도 일하기 시작했습니다. BTR을 복구하던 때 운전기사가 제게 찾아왔죠. 꽤 흥미로운 작업이었습니다. 물론 그 얘기를 하려던 건 아닙니다. 한동안 연락이 없더니 갑자기 도움을 요청했습니다. 심각한 일이 생긴 모양이에요. 찾아가서 무슨 일인지 알아봐 주시겠어요? 타르코프에는 재치와 야망을 갖춘 사람이 얼마 남지 않았습니다. 우리 같은 사람끼리 뭉쳐야죠.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
우즈에서 프라포르의 화물 찾기 및 확보하기
지역에서 생존 후 탈출하기
‘배송 지연 - 파트 1’ 퀘스트 완료하기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text:
+10,000 경험치
165,000 루블
정보 센터 1레벨일 때 173,250 루블
정보 센터 2레벨일 때 189,750 루블
‘더 아이’ 박격포 공격 신호 장치 1개

스키어 패거리에 들어가는 건 위험하다고 말했는데… 물론 이점도 있겠지만, 그렇게 큰 사업에 들어가면 독립성을 유지하기 어렵지. 누가 스키어를 배신했을까? BTR은 그의 보호를 받고 있어야 할 텐데…

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text:
우즈에서 프라포르의 화물을 찾아야 합니다. 화물은 열차 정비소 북서쪽 건물 안의 두 장소 중 한 곳에 생성됩니다. 정비소에는 BTR 운전기사의 택시 서비스를 이용해야 들어갈 수 있습니다. 화물을 회수한 뒤 프라포르의 ‘배송 지연 - 파트 1’ 퀘스트에서 건네면 이 퀘스트를 완료할 수 있습니다.

지도에 표시된 건물
목표 건물
생성 위치 1: 침대 옆 탁자 아래
생성 위치 2: 안쪽 사무실 책상 위

서쪽 열차 위를 걸어서 정비소를 빠져나갈 수도 있습니다. 저격수나 지뢰에 맞지 않도록 열차 위를 걸을 때는 중앙을 따라가세요.

열차로 가는 길
열차

quests.title: A Life Lesson
objectivesKo: 타르코프스카야 보드카 12병 건네기
댄 재키얼 위스키 20병 건네기
피어스 해츨링 문샤인 20병 건네기
quests.content:
A Life Lesson is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Wha-- Oh, it's you. Come in, don't just stand there... We've lost our dividends, it seems... Luka's not getting in touch, the fucking bastard! We can't even check what's going on outside the cordon... I don't have any eyes there. What if there was no USEC base in the first place? Maybe this fucker Luka doesn't even have a squad... And look at us, we didn't suspect a goddamn thing. And you, fucking eagle eye... Fuck's sake. Okay... There's no fucking way we're gonna get these cocksuckers from here. Until I'm pissed and then sober again, don't count on a new plan. What, you want to help? Bring some more booze, then...

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the item: 12 Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka
Hand over the item: 20 Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey
Hand over the item: 20 Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine

== Rewards ==
+1 Endurance skill level
+1 Strength skill level
+1 Metabolism skill level
+1 Charisma skill level
+1 Intellect skill level
+1 Hideout Management skill level
+1 Crafting skill level
+1 Mag Drills skill level
+1 Troubleshooting skill level
This way... Fucking this way, you dumb fuck! Come sit by if you want to take a swig too. I'll tell you the shit I've been through in my life... Perhaps it'll save you from the same fucking miserable fate.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 뭐—아, 자네였군. 들어와, 거기 서 있지만 말고… 배당금을 날린 모양이야… 루카가 연락을 안 해. 그 빌어먹을 자식! 봉쇄 구역 밖에서 무슨 일이 벌어지는지 확인조차 못 하고 있어… 그쪽을 살펴볼 사람이 하나도 없다고. 애초에 USEC 기지가 없었던 건 아닐까? 루카 그 자식에게 분대가 있기는 한 걸까? 그런데 우린 아무것도 눈치채지 못했어. 자네는 눈썰미가 좋잖아… 젠장. 좋아… 여기서 저 망할 놈들을 잡을 방법은 없어. 술에 취했다가 정신 차릴 때까지 새 계획은 기대하지 마. 뭐, 돕고 싶다고? 그럼 술이나 더 가져와…

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: BEAR PMC로만 수락할 수 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
타르코프스카야 보드카 12병 건네기
댄 재키얼 위스키 20병 건네기
피어스 해츨링 문샤인 20병 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text:
지구력 스킬 레벨 +1
근력 스킬 레벨 +1
신진대사 스킬 레벨 +1

탄창 조작 스킬 레벨 +1
무기 문제 해결 스킬 레벨 +1

이쪽이야… 이쪽이라고, 이 멍청아! 한 잔 더 하고 싶으면 여기 앉아. 내가 살아온 얘기를 들려줄게… 어쩌면 자네가 나처럼 비참하게 살지 않도록 도움이 될지도 모르지.

quests.title: A Wedge Between Us
objectivesKo: 웨지 분대원 4명 찾아 무력화하기
웨지에게서 전리품 챙기기
획득한 물품 건네기
quests.content:
A Wedge Between Us is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Sit down kid, got something to talk about. Partisan spotted helicopters over the bay, no markings on them. They were heading straight for some ship out there, definitely not toward the city. Those were combat birds, not belonging to the UNTAR troops or any PMC, that's for certain. He said he's only seen something like that once before, and that wasn't even in Tarkov. If this is some kind of special unit, nothing good will come from it. Most likely they're pulling in veterans from elite forces, could be SAS, Mossad, or God knows who else these days. I asked Mechanic if he knows anything about them. He's been listening in on that frequency range, managed to catch the callsign of their leader, though barely. "Wedge”... Listen, we can't let people like that dig in, not on the ship, and definitely not in the city. I'm counting on you here. Best meet fire with fire, like they say.

== Requirements ==
Hand over the hard drives from compartment C-1 on Icebreaker to Mechanic in the Boreas story chapter.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize 4 members of The Wedge's squad
Claim a trophy from The Wedge
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+52,000 EXP
450,000 Roubles
472,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
517,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle
3× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)
3× AI AXMC .338 LM 10-round magazine
Good thing I trusted my instincts. We need to keep Tarkov safe from fighters like this. If they get a foothold, they'll take control of the whole city, and nobody will be able to stop them after that. If you see those black-clad soldiers again, don't let them slip away. Our survival might depend on it.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 앉아, 꼬마야. 할 얘기가 있어. 파르티잔이 만 위쪽에서 표식 없는 헬리콥터를 봤대. 저 멀리 있는 배를 향해 곧장 날아갔고, 도시로 향하는 건 아니었다더군. 전투용 헬기였고 UN타르 병력이나 PMC 소속은 확실히 아니었어. 그런 걸 타르코프가 아닌 다른 곳에서 딱 한 번 본 적이 있다고 하더군. 특수 부대라면 좋은 일은 없을 거야. 정예 부대 출신 베테랑들을 모으는 중일 가능성이 커. SAS나 모사드일 수도 있고, 요즘은 또 누가 있는지 모르겠군. 정비사에게 아는 게 있는지 물어봤어. 그가 해당 주파수 대역을 듣고 있었는데, 간신히 지휘관의 콜사인을 알아냈대. ‘웨지’… 저런 자들이 배에, 더구나 도시에 자리 잡게 둘 순 없어. 네게 맡기겠다. 불에는 불로 맞서야지.

sectionsKo.text: 보레아스 스토리 챕터에서 아이스브레이커 C-1 구획의 하드 드라이브를 찾아 정비사에게 건네야 합니다.

.338 라푸아 매그넘 FMJ 탄약 묶음(20발) 3개
AI AXMC .338 LM 10발 탄창 3개

내 직감을 믿길 잘했어. 저런 전투원들이 타르코프에 발붙이지 못하게 해야 해. 놈들이 거점을 확보하면 도시 전체를 장악할 테고, 그 뒤엔 아무도 막을 수 없어. 검은 옷을 입은 병사들을 다시 보면 놓치지 마. 우리 생존이 달린 문제일 수도 있어.

quests.content:
Abandoned Cargo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon. I have recently received information regarding a suspicious TerraGroup shipment. Based on its description, it may still contain important records, and perhaps even biological samples.\n\nShipments of this nature were supposed to be evacuated as a matter of highest priority, yet for some reason this one was left behind near the customs terminal. We need to determine what is inside, but first we have to locate the cargo.\n\nCould I ask for your assistance? You'll recognize the correct shipment by the boxes bearing the TerraGroup logo.

== Objectives ==
Mark any of the special TerraGroup cargo boxes with an MS2000 Marker on Customs
(Optional) Locate the first special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
(Optional) Locate the second special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
(Optional) Locate the third special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
(Optional) Locate the fourth special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
(Optional) Locate the fifth special TerraGroup cargo on Customs
(Optional) Locate the sixth special TerraGroup cargo on Customs

== Rewards ==

Therapist Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Excellent! You didn't open any of the containers, did you? Good. It's best if they are examined by people properly qualified to do so.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to mark 1 of 7 cargo pallets on Customs with a MS2000 Marker.

It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.

이런 화물은 최우선으로 대피시켰어야 하는데, 어떤 이유에선지 세관 터미널 근처에 남겨졌습니다. 안에 무엇이 들었는지 알아내야 하지만 우선 화물부터 찾아야 합니다.

objectivesKo: 식품급의 10가지 항목 건네기
quests.content:
Acquaintance is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well, hello there! I could use your help right now. We're still barely acquainted, so I won't ask you to handle anything too serious just yet. I'm a solitary man, as you've probably already noticed. I try to live by my own principles and keep Tarkov clean. That takes time and effort, and sometimes my supplies run out. Usually when I least expect it. Could you find me some provisions? I don't need anything special, anything will do. The only requirement is that it's edible.

== Objectives ==
Hand over any 10 items from the Food category

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
I appreciate it. You helped me out. Now I can focus on what truly matters without being distracted by little things.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요! 지금 당장 여러분의 도움이 필요해요. 우리는 아직 거의 안보니까 아직 너무 심각한 일을 처리하라고 요청하지 않을 겁니다. 저는 외로운 사람이고, 아마 이미 알아챘을 겁니다. 저는 제 원칙에 따라 살려 타르코프를 깨끗하게 유지하려고 노력합니다. 그것은 시간과 노력이 필요하고, 때로는 물품이 부족합니다. 보통 제가 가장 잘 기대하지 않을 때.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 식품급의 10가지 항목 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards

== Dialogue ==
Recently, an interesting guy reached out to me, name Ragman. I'm sure you've heard of him. We worked out a little deal… he needs his product advertised. Sounds like something anyone could handle, but that's bullshit. Who's going to buy armor off some guy who got iced in the first gunfight? That's right, no one. That's why I need you, with your survivability. The task is boringly simple: use the Hexgrid.

== Objectives ==
Win 3 matches while wearing the Hexgrid armor in CheckPoint mode

== Rewards ==
+12,000 EXP
Ref Rep +0.01
93,300 Roubles
15 GP coins
Unlocks BlackRock chest rig (Gray) in the Armory

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 최근에 레그맨라는 흥미로운 남자가 제게 연락을 했습니다. 아마 그 사람을 들어보셨을 겁니다. 우리는 작은 거래를 해냈어요. 그는 그의 제품을 광고해야 합니다. 그것은 누구나 처리할 수 있는 것 같지만, 그건 헛소리입니다. 누가 첫 총격에서 얼음으로 쓰러진 남자를 장갑을 사려고 할까요?

Ragman still can't get enough of those sales after you've been running around the Arena in his gear. He even wanted to reach out to you directly, but that's not how business is done. That's between me and him anyway. Your part's simple: just wear the shit we tell you to wear. Show up in the winners' circle in a TV-110. That's all there is to it. Ragman will pay, don't worry.

quests.content:
Against the Conscience - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I hear you're working for Ref now. I've been keeping tabs on you for a while. I used to know a man who got tangled up just like you. He was Ref's previous champion for a while and then all of a sudden he disappeared. And I know for sure this had nothing to do with Kaban and Kollontay. If you don't want to vanish the same way this guy did, look for the last champion's apartment. I believe there's something of interest left there. The champion used to hang out with the smugglers in Dorms on Customs. Maybe you'll find some clues on how to get into the apartment.

== Requirements ==

== Objectives ==
Locate the old champion's room on Customs
(Optional) Locate and obtain the key at the smugglers' base on Shoreline
Find out what happened to the champion
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+11,700 EXP
50,000 Roubles
52,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
57,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× CQC Osprey MK4A plate carrier (Assault, MTP)
1× HK 416A5 5.56x45 assault rifle
3× AR-15 5.56x45 HK Steel Maritime STANAG 30-round magazine
3× 5.56x45mm MK 318 Mod 0 (SOST) ammo pack (50 pcs)
1× Armband (ARENA)
You want to ask Ref yourself? Well, it was nice knowing you.

== Guide ==

The champion's room is located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building on Customs, between the rooms 209 and 211. A Dorm overseer key is required to enter it. You must approach the puddle of blood on the floor next to the wardrobe to complete the objective.

quests.content:
Airmail is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, friend! You know how even small changes affect our isolated Tarkov world. Take, for example, the arrival of the humanitarian aid that's being dropped from airplanes. Even I couldn't get some of the components for my work before. But now you can find real treasures in these crates! By the way, I'd like to arrange for a new package. To do this, I need to make sure that the pilots work as instructed, give a drop right after the launch of the red flare. Can you help me with that?

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

== Objectives ==
Launch a red signal flare at the old sawmill on Woods

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× NcSTAR Tactical Blue Laser
2× Zenit Klesch-2IKS IR illuminator with laser
It worked, right? Thanks, friend. Our airmail comes in so handy!

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to shoot a red flare into the sky while being in the center of the old sawmill in the east of Woods. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 red flare provided by Mechanic via in-game mail or a 26x75mm red flare cartridge which can be bought at Ref LL3, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 red flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

Flare area marked on map

== Trivia ==
The quest dialogue is referencing the unannounced implementation, and surprise activation of airdrops on December 30, 2021.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 친구! 작은 변화도 우리 고립된 타르코프 세계에 얼마나 영향을 미치는지 아세요. 예를 들어, 비행기에서 내려오는 인도적 지원의 도착을 생각해 보세요. 전에도 제 작업에 필요한 부품들을 구할 수 없었습니다. 하지만 이제 이 상자 안에 진짜 보물을 찾을 수 있습니다. 그건 그렇고, 저는 새로운 패키지를 준비하고 싶습니다. 이것을 하기 위해 조종사가 지시대로 작동하는지 확인해야 합니다. 빨간 화사 발사 직후 drop를 드리세요. 그 일을 도와줄 수 있나요?

Akimbo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good to see you, brother! I've got a job, and it's one only a master like you can handle. Some Scavs recently intercepted a shipment of plate carriers I had near the lighthouse. Nothing too fancy in there, but those fuckers need to pay for stealing my goods! Only, we're gonna do this one a little differently. I want to see how plate carriers in this price range hold up against different calibers, and now we've got a bunch of idiots walking around wearing them! So we might as well make this test as close to real combat as possible. Take two different caliber rifles on the job and do your part. Just don't shoot 'em in the head, okay? I'm interested in how well the armor holds up! Don't bring the carriers back to me. Once you're done, I'll send my guys to collect the "samples".

== Objectives ==

sectionsKo.text: 당신을 보고 기쁩니다! 형제! 나는 일을 가지고 있습니다. 그리고 당신이 같은 마스터만이 처리 할 수 있습니다. 어떤 스캐브은 최근에 라이트하우스 근처에 내가 가지고 있던 판자 운반자 배포를 가로막았습니다. 거기엔 너무 화려한 것은 없습니다. 하지만 그 망할 사람들은 내 물건을 훔치기 위해 돈을 지불해야합니다! 단지, 우리는 조금 다른 방식으로 이 일을 할 것입니다. 나는 이 가격 범위의 판자 운반자들이 다른 칼리버에 대해 어떻게 견딜 수 있는지보고 싶습니다. 그리고 이제 우리는 바보들이 그들을 착용하는 무리를 가지고 돌아다니는 것입니다! 그래서 우리는 이 테스트를 가능한 한 실제 전투에 가깝게 할 수 있습니다. 작업에 두 가지 다른 칼리버 총을 가져와 당신의 역할을 수행하십시오. 그냥 머리에서 그들을 쏘지 마십시오. 알았어요? 나는 갑옷을 어떻게 잘 유지하는지 관심이 있습니다! 나는 다시 머리를 운반자 가져 오지 않습니다. "내가 완료하면, 당신은 내 사람들을 수집할 것입니다".

Judging by the description of the liquid inside, it doesn't look like any of the emulsions declared in the official documents. I think the substance in the tank could be hazardous, so I'm asking you to get me a sample as soon as possible. This is the only way we can be sure of our assessment of chemical safety in Tarkov.

quests.content:
Anesthesia is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oh, you're just in time. Maybe you have already heard that a new doctor has shown up? But this one is not some good-willed Aesculapius - he helps some people but cripples others. They say he sells medicine and does surgeries right on the street. They call him Sanitar, can you imagine? He settled on the Shoreline and interestingly enough, the local punks are very happy with him, and it's clear why: he patches them up, and even sells them drugs and first-aid kits of all sorts. This means that he has quite an inventory with him. Find out about this Sanitar, but quietly. For now, just find out where this scum hangs out. I think that he does both the selling and healing at the same spots. You interested?

== Objectives ==
Mark the first trading post with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the second trading post with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the third trading post with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

So you're saying there's quite a lot of supplies? Guess he found himself a fresh unopened medical warehouse and is now selling everything out from it. If only I could find that warehouse... well, that's not your problem anyway. For now.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to mark Sanitar's 3 treatment locations ("trading posts") with MS2000 Marker on Shoreline. The markers can be placed in any order over any number of raids.

Locations marked on map
1: Next to the ambulance at the resort
2: In the backyard of the locked cottage
3: In front of the office building at the pier

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, brother! You say the BTR driver wants to leave Skier's gang? You know, that kind of transport would be good for my trade. But you do realize Skier won't appreciate such a move, and it's a risk to my business. Anyway, it's a lot to think about and weigh. Though, you can make the driver's offer more convincing. I got some urgent business to take care of. I lost contact with one of my crews. The guys were running a delivery and they were supposed to be back by now. Return to me if you find any sign of them.

165,000 Roubles

Someone's iced the couriers, huh? This means I have to switch routes, I've got three more trips planned! Man, I can't stop the trade, I need new routes. Maybe your driver friend could give some tips? Go ask him where I can move the goods safely. Pretty please.

Audiophile is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I have another detective job for you. I have a client, a very good guy. A rocker. I used to sell their band all sorts of stuff when they were playing in our town! The guy was in Tarkov when it all started, rehearsing at someone's crib. And then the evacuation started and all that bullshit. So the guy lost his guitar pick... Yeah, man, you're gonna go looking for a plectrum. Why are you so surprised? He got that pick from either Hetfield or that hairy, what's-his-name... The hairy one, you should know! Too-doo-doo, too-doo-doo-doo-doo... Oh, man, they won't take you to Guess the Tune. Anyway, find the plectrum, it's got the AG initials on it, you won't mistake it. You have no idea how much a dude is willing to pay for that plastic shit. An address? If he could remember the address, I'd go to the address myself!

== Objectives ==

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
How the fuck did you find one tiny guitar pick in a huge city?! Better than Sherlock, I swear. All right, give me the plectrum, because the client's all pissed off right now, can't find a muse or something. Tell me, do you have any idea why this plastic thing can cost so much?

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the musician gathering spot and a guitar pick on Streets of Tarkov. The gathering spot is the music room in apartment no. 10 on the fourth floor of the Primorsky 48 apartment building. A Primorsky 46-48 skybridge key is required to enter it via the skybridge from the adjoining Primorsky 46 staircase. The guitar pick has multiple spawns throughout the music room and the adjacent bedroom. It is highly recommended to bring a flashlight with you, since the item is small and the location dark. The apartment 10 entrance door can be breached from the inside to leave.

sectionsKo.text: 또 다른 탐정직이 있어. 고객도 있고, 아주 좋은 남자요. 로커요. 우리 마을에서 연주하던 시절 밴드들을 매매하는 일이 있었어요. 그 남자가 타르코프에 있었는데, 모든 일이 시작되면서 누군가의 침대에 연습하고 있었습니다. 그리고 대피가 시작되었고, 그 모든 거물들이요. 그래서 그 남자가 기타를 뺏어갔어요. 그래, 친구, 당신은 펠크트럼을 찾아갈 겁니다. 왜 그렇게 놀랐을까요? 그는 헤트필드나 털이 있는 그 사람, 그의 이름 뭐죠. 털이 있는 그 사람, 당신은 알아야 합니다. 너무도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도도

quests.content:
Audit is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You know, you look like someone who'd help clean out a bank! Why are you so uptight, bro, that's not what I'm talking about, I'm an honest businessman! But sometimes you watch a heist movie and get so many ideas in your head... Anyway, to the point. I have information that a man from a financial institution that controls the banking sector of Tarkov kept a journal, you know, for when everything goes to shit... The data he kept was from classified official reports. So anyway, as you know, everything did go to shit, but he couldn't manage to pass the info on. Do you have any idea what kind of juice there might be in his doodles? Search the place, find me that journal.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the financial records on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the journal to Ragman

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Interesting doodles, encrypted too. The guy was smart, he knew that if he was dead, no one would understand whatever the hell he wrote in there.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to obtain the accountant's notes in the "ФИНАНС" ("FINANCE") building on Streets of Tarkov. They can be found on the second floor, in the first office to the right. A diary with the notes is tucked in a red file folder on the floor.

Building marked on map
The building
Staircase to the second floor
The wanted office
The wanted file folder
Diary inside the file folder

sectionsKo.text: 왜 이렇게 긴장해 있는 거야? 내가 말하는 게 아니지, 난 정직한 사업가야! 하지만 가끔은 도둑 영화 보고 너무 많은 아이디어를 내세워... 어쨌든, 사실까지. 타르코프의 은행을 통제하는 금융 기관의 한 사람이 일기록을 가지고 있다는 정보를 알고 있어요. 모든 것이 망가졌을 때...

objectivesKo: 리저브의 비밀 지하 벙커 출구 찾기

quests.content:
Back Door is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Word reached me that there's some kind of underground exit at the Reserve military base. Doesn't sound all that unusual on its own, except it has to be activated from the outside. From where exactly? That's what I need you to figure out. That extraction would be extremely useful to me. Reserve is full of military equipment that could come in handy for my work. I'd rather not send my own people - they're not as well prepared as you are. Find out how the extraction works, then come back and tell me. Your payment will be waiting.

== Objectives ==
Locate the secret underground bunker exit on Reserve
(Optional) Locate the switch that activates the exit
Survive and extract from the location through the secret exit

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
You managed to activate the door? Excellent. Here's your payment, just as promised.

== Guide ==
This quest requires you to extract with the "D-2" extraction on Reserve.

First, turn on the power with a lever in the command part of the underground bunker system. Be aware, activating the lever has the chance to spawn Scav Raiders in the command part of the bunker. Then, press the button on the wall next to the sliding door at the extraction. You need to exit the raid with the "Survived" status to get the quest completion. The "Run Through" status will not complete the quest. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.

D-2 extraction and power lever marked on map
D-2 power lever and the wall button at the extraction
D-2 extraction with the button on the wall

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 리저브 군사 기지에 지하 출구가 있다는 소식이 전해졌습니다. 외부에서 활성화해야 할 것 외에는 그 이상은 들리지 않습니다. 정확히 어디서부터? 그것이 당신이 알아내는 것이 필요합니다. 그 추출은 저에게 매우 유용합니다. 리저브는 제 작업에 유용하게 사용할 수있는 군사 장비로 가득합니다. 나는 내 사람들을 보내지 않는 것을 더 좋아합니다. 그들은 당신이 준비한 것처럼 잘 준비되지 않습니다. 추출이 어떻게 작동하는지 알아보고 다시 와서 말해주세요. 지불은 기다리고 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구는 리저브에서 "D-2" 추출을 통해 추출을 요구합니다. 먼저 지하 벙커 시스템의 명령 부분에서 레버로 전력을 켜십시오. 레버를 활성화하면 벙커의 명령 부분에서 스캐브 레이더를 낳을 수 있습니다. 그 다음 추출에서 슬라이딩 문 옆에 있는 벽에 있는 버튼을 누르십시오. 탐색 완료를 위해 "살아난 사람" 상태에서 탈락해야합니다. "Run Through" 상태는 탐사를 완료하지 않습니다. "Run Through" 상태를 피하기 위해, 습격에서 적어도 200 EXP를 얻으십시오 (탈탈탈 또는 탈취를 통해) 또는 추출하기 전에 적어도 7 분 동안 들어보세요. D-2 추출 및 전력 도출 지도에 표시 된 D-2 힘 레버와 추출 버튼 D-2 추출 버튼에 표시 된 D-2 힘

quests.title: Background Check
objectivesKo: 커스텀의 동금 주머니 시계는 찾아 확보하기
(선택) 연료 탱크 트럭의 열쇠 찾아 확보하기
발견된 항목 건네기
quests.content:
Background Check is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
How's it going, warrior? I have an errand for you. My comrade Arseny worked at the factory as a tanker driver. His family left during the evacuation while he stayed behind to make some extra money, and perished here. He lived in a three-story dormitory near Polikhim, I don't remember the room. Anyway, he had a chain watch, a family heirloom. Bragged about it to everyone. Find that watch and bring it to me, I want to send it to his kid. I want the kid to have something to remember his old man by. The watch must be either in his room or in the tanker truck somewhere at the construction site. Arseny always kept the keys in his jacket. Anyway, do the job. So long!

== Objectives ==
Obtain the bronze pocket watch on Customs
(Optional) Obtain the key to the fuel tanker truck
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
You know what? I didn't think you'd find it. But big thanks to you regardless. This was, you might say, a personal matter. Anyway, here's the reward.

== Guide ==

Head into the map Customs. The Machinery key is required to access the bronze pocket watch. So if you do not have one, head to room 205 located on the second floor of the three-story dorms building in the south.

Dorms location marked on map

To enter the room you'll need to jump on top of debris blocking the hallway and crouch to get inside the doorway of the room. The Machinery key can be found within the blue jackets beside the wardrobe.

Room 205
The jackets with the key

After obtaining the key, head north to the fuel tanker truck that is located at the construction site. The driver side door of the cabin can be unlocked with the Machinery key.

Tanker truck location marked on map
The tanker truck

Inside, the Bronze pocket watch can be found laying on the floor in front of the seat. Be careful of the sniper Scav overlooking the truck from the roof of the nearby boiler building.

The pocket watch

After picking up the pocket watch, it will be placed in your quest items inventory. You must successfully extract with the pocket watch to hand it in. If you die before extraction, you will have to retrieve it again. Hand the pocket watch over to Prapor to complete the quest.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 어떻게 되는지 전사님? 제가 여러분에게 한 명 부탁드립니다. 제 동료 아르센이 팩토리에서 탱커 운전자로 일했습니다. 그는 이вакуа션 중에 남아서 약간의 돈을 벌기 위해 가족들이 떠났고, 여기 사망했습니다. 그는 폴리히임 근처의 3층 기숙사에서 살았고, 그 방을 기억하지 않습니다. 어쨌든, 그는 체인 시계를 가지고 있었습니다. 가족 유산. 모든 사람들에게 자랑했습니다. 그 시계를 찾아내서 내게 가져와라. 나는 그 아이를 보내고 싶습니다. 나는 그 아이가 그의 아버지를 위해 무언가를 가지고 싶어합니다. 시계는 그의 방이나 건설 현장의 탱커 트럭 어딘가에 있어야 합니다. 아르센이 항상 그의 재킷에 열쇠를 보관했습니다. 어쨌든, 일을 해 보세요. 너무 오래!

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
커스텀의 동금 주머니 시계는 찾아 확보하기
(선택) 연료 탱크 트럭의 열쇠 찾아 확보하기
발견된 항목 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +3,000 EXP 프라포르 평판 +0.1 80,000 루블 84,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 92,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text:
지도 커스텀에 들어가십시오. 동금 주머니 시계를 이용하려면 기계 열쇠가 필요합니다. 만약 당신이 그것을 가지고 있지 않다면, 남쪽의 3층 기숙사 건물의 2층에 위치한 205 방으로 이동하십시오. 지도에 표시된 기숙사 위치로 들어가려면 통로를 차단하는 잔해 위에 뛰어들어 방을 안으로 들어가야 합니다. 장갑 옆의 파란 재킷 안에 기계 열쇠가 있습니다. 열쇠를 가진 재킷은 열쇠를 얻은 후 북쪽으로 이동합니다. 건설 현장에서 위치한 연료 트럭에 위치합니다. 차관 옆 문은 기계 열쇠로 잠겨있을 수 있습니다. 지도에 표시된 탱커 트럭 위치에 표시된 탱커 트럭, 동금자리 트럭의 바닥에 위치하고 있습니다. 방 방 방 옆의 청동 재킷 안에 위치하고 있습니다. 방 내부에서 타자 트럭의 샷을 볼 수 있습니다.
주머니 시계를 가져온 후, 그것은 당신의 탐구 항목 인벤토리에 배치됩니다. 당신은 성공적으로 주머니 시계를 통해 그것을 전달해야합니다. 당신이 추출 전에 죽으면, 당신은 다시 그것을 가져야 합니다. 탐구를 완료하기 위해 주머니 시계를 프라포르에 넘겨.

objectivesKo: 레이드에서 15 말보로, 윌스턴, 스트라이크 담배 찾기

quests.content:
Bad Habit is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, come here a minute. I need to lay the wiring today, and plan for high power capacity, especially considering the continuous load on the grid. But that’s not the issue now, bring me some cigarettes. I want to work it hard until it’s done, and don't want to get distracted with searching. I know, smoking’s going to kill me. But is it really important though? Well, anyway, I need around 20 packs, preferably different ones. Oh, and make sure you get the new sealed ones, so look for them yourself. Was good seeing you.

== Objectives ==
Find 15 Malboro, Wilston or Strike cigarettes in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Great, now I've got something to smoke in my free time. Thank you, mercenary.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Wilston cigarettes at Nutrition Unit level 1.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 잠깐만요. 오늘 전선을 놓고, 높은 전력 용량을 계획해야 합니다. 특히 네트워크의 지속적인 부하를 고려하면요. 하지만 그게 문제가 아닙니다. 이제 담배를 가져오세요. 제가 열심히 일을 하고, 검색에 방해를 받지 않으려 합니다. 담배가 날 죽일 것이라는 것을 알고 있습니다. 하지만 정말 중요한가요? 어쨌든, 저는 20개의 패키지가 필요합니다.

objectivesKo: 커스텀의 한 방에서 폴더 0031를 안전하게 보관합니다 찾아 확보하기
(선택) 팩토리의 3층 사무실 통로에 있는 잠금된 방으로 접근할 수 있습니다

quests.content:
Bad Rep Evidence is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day to you, warrior. Step inside. There’s a job to do if you’re interested. Need to find one piece of crap, and I’m at my wits’ end how. Briefly - one of the foremen who worked on that fucking Polikhim has just in time laid his hands on some pretty important documents. You know, of course, how hard is everyone still gunning for any evidence on TerraGroup and its associates? Exactly. But the folks who tried to get the info out of that foreman happened to be more edgy than smart. The dude’s ticker stopped ticking before his tongue started wagging. Can you imagine? What dimwits! How do you do business with the likes of them? Okay, back to the point. So he grabbed the docs and stashed them somewhere. Asked around a bit, those who worked with him before. In general, chances don’t look too good, but who knows how lucky you can get? In a word, that foreman worked in the chemo shop. The shitmost shit, see. And somewhere on the Customs premises he and his homies had their bunkhouses. Eating there, chilling, most certainly inviting girl over, well, you get it. I figure it’s holed up there somewhere, most likely. If it’s not there, then we won’t find crap at all. So, I want you to search the shacks on Customs and bring me these documents. I think it's best to search for the locked ones.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain Secure Folder 0031 in one of the bunkhouses on Customs
(Optional) Gain access to the locked room in the office hallway on the third floor on Factory
(Optional) Obtain the Portable bunkhouse key
Hand over the folder
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
Some luck with you there, warrior! Such a treasure to get hold of. That’s worthy of a hefty reward. And a little extra for not leaking it on the side - and my goodwill, which is over any money.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to obtain secure folder 0031 from a bunkhouse on Customs. Even though the bunkhouse is locked, the item can be grabbed through the window, not requiring its key.

좋은 날, 전사. 들어가세요. 관심 있는 사람이라면 할 일이 있습니다. 똥구리를 찾아야 합니다. 그리고 저는 어떻게 할 수 있는지에 대해 제 지각이 있습니다. 간단히 말해서, 그 망할 폴리히마에서 일했던 수장 중 한 명이 꽤 중요한 서류를 손에 넣었습니다. 물론, 모든 사람들이 테라그룹와 그 동료들에 대한 증거를 찾기 위해 얼마나 열심히 노력하고 있는지 알고 있습니다. 정확히요. 하지만 그 수장으로부터 정보를 얻으려고 노력한 사람들은 똑똑한 사람들보다 더 똑똑했습니다. 그 사람이 혀가 튀기 전에 틱을 멈추었습니다. 상상해 보세요. 어떤 수장들이 있는지요. 어떻게 그들을 좋아하는 사람들을 어떻게 처리합니까? 좋습니다, 다시 요점으로 돌아가십시오. 그래서 그는 질문자를 잡아서 비밀리에 어 넣었습니다.
젠장, 그 젠장, 커스텀의 어딘가에 그는 그의 친구들과 함께 그들의 침실집을 가지고 있었다. 거기 먹고, 냉각, 확실히 소녀를 초대, 음, 당신은 그것을 이해. 나는 그것이 어딘가에 숨어있는 것 같습니다.

quests.content:
Balancing - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You did a great job on my assignments. I also ran you through my databases... Just a precaution. You don't hire just anybody, you know what I mean, brother? I'm promoting you to a tester! You're gonna be testing equipment for the Arena. I've just received a good batch of bullpups for a delicious price. Go ahead and try them out on some hobos. After that, I'll decide if these rifles will go to my cleanup guys or the gladiators.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Scavs while using a Steyr AUG on any location

== Rewards ==
+5,100 EXP
Ref Rep +0.03
45 GP coins
47 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
52 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Steyr AUG A1 5.56x45 assault rifle
3× Steyr AUG 5.56x45 30-round magazine
3× 5.56x45mm M856 ammo pack (50 pcs)
1× Death Shadow mask
1× Escape from Tarkov: Arena 3-day trial  Note: Activates upon quest completion.
Not a bad gun, eh? Truth be told, I have a soft spot for bullpups. The AUG is obviously difficult to maintain, it has a weird trigger mechanism, hard to get used to, plus it's easy to forget about the ejection port side. Certainly not an amateur's gun. But it feels so good though! I'd rather not give it to the cleanup crew. Anyway, here's your reward.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs on any location with a Steyr AUG assault rifle. Both the AUG A1 and the AUG A3 can be used.

quests.content:
Ballet Lover is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Listen, brother, can you help me find proper info on a guy? He's already left the city. Why can't I find him myself? Because his fucking name is Ivan Ivanov. Seriously, I'm not kidding. There are two hundred thousand of them all over the country with that name. If we could find his former address in Tarkov, we might be able to run him through the database. Let me see what I can find on him. I think he used to run a bar, right. I don't know the name of the bar though... Listen, I don't know how you're gonna know which bar is his. Oh, that reminds me, he was into ballet. No kidding. He went to the Mariinsky every season. Even tried to host something at our local theater, but people weren't really crazy about chicks in tutus. More specific? Brother, I'm already fucking specific! I believe in you, use your intuition.

== Objectives ==
Locate the balletmeister's apartment on Streets of Tarkov
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Found both the bar and the guy's address? Here, write it down for me. You're better than those psychics on TV finding missing people. Wanna be a detective when all this is over, bro? I'll fix you up with a Poirot hat, I promise.

== Guide ==

In this quest, you have to find the balletmeister's apartment on Streets of Tarkov. The wanted apartment is apartment no. 10 on the fourth floor of the Primorsky 48 apartment building. A Primorsky 46-48 skybridge key is required to enter it via the skybridge from the adjoining Primorsky 46 staircase. The apartment 10 entrance door can be breached from the inside to leave.

No complaints against you, obviously. I don't even have any spare batteries now, and electronics can go to shit at any moment. quests.title: Belka and Strelka
objectivesKo: 세관(Customs)에서 Railroad Passage (Flare)를 통해 탈출하기
quests.content:
Belka and Strelka is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, soldier! I've got a new reconnaissance mission for ya. I was able to arrange a deal with the fellas who control the railroad at the old customs gas station, but I haven't sent any of my couriers that way yet. We gotta check it out first. The plan is simple: you fire the green flare and extract. It's like a job Belka did... or was it Strelka? Ah, whatever, you know what I'm trying to say. I'll pay you for risking your skin, but make sure you don't get whacked before even getting to that place, and take your time on the exit itself. I've heard enough tales of mercs who shoot the flare and run to the exit immediately before the flare even lights up properly... On a completely unrelated note, may I interest you in a cheap new helmet with bullet hole vents?

== Objectives ==
Survive and extract from Customs through Railroad Passage (Flare)

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
There, I told you it was a simple job! You can trust me, I'd never send an untrained soldier into harm's way.

== Initial equipment ==

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to extract from Customs via the "Railroad Passage" extraction with the "survived" status. For the extraction to open, you have to shoot a green flare into the sky while being inside the signal flare area. Upon entering the signal flare area, a notifcation will pop up in the bottom right corner of the screen:  If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up:  You can use either the handheld RSP-30 green flare provided by Prapor via in-game mail or a 26x75mm green flare cartridge fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 green flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If you need additional flares you can buy them from Jaeger. To avoid the "run through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.

== Trivia ==
Belka and Strelka are names of the first two dogs who went to the Earth's orbit and returned alive.

Good afternoon. I have received information that somewhere under the city there is an abandoned entrance to the Laboratory. Apparently, TerraGroup has converted one of the old bomb shelters into an emergency exit from their lab. This presents us with a unique opportunity to acquire all the precious equipment we need with minimal risk! However, I cannot send my people out without reconnaissance, it would be too dangerous. It's better to have someone experienced check this passage first and make sure the areas of interest are secure. Will you help us?

There's got to be more information in the journal about Ref, some dirt on him. Do that if you want to stop being expendable in the Arena. And one more thing: if you bring me any info on Ref that'll be worthy of my time, I'll pay you well.

quests.content:
Biochemistry is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
This icebreaker you've found is a real discovery! If it is located that far out, there could still be medical equipment on board that survived the blast in the city center… We will not get a second opportunity like this. In conditions of isolation and the inability to provide full hospital care, we usually rely on specialized biochemical analyzers. They allow us to perform a wide range of tests quickly and with the necessary accuracy. However, most of the reserve units in Tarkov were taken by emergency services during the evacuation. But on the icebreaker there could still be analyzers in working condition. Especially if it is connected to TerraGroup. Search for them for me, preferably several. The ship likely had its own medical section where they could have been installed.

== Objectives ==
Find 3 Aceso Xpress semi-automatic biochemical analyzers in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+32,000 EXP
360,000 Roubles
378,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
414,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks barter for Money case at Therapist LL1
You found the Aceso? That is probably the best news of the day. Given the shortages in Tarkov, they will be a very valuable asset… But of course, I will only consider parting with them in cases of extreme necessity. For now, they will go straight into operation and greatly ease the workload of my staff and patients.

== Guide ==

My people recently uncovered those responsible for manipulating the clean water supply at a time when the city needed it most. Under different circumstances, we would have settled this through the proper legal channels. Unfortunately, those are no longer available to us. The gang that profited from the water crisis operates out of the customs territory. They need to be reminded that the well-being of others should come before personal gain. Regrettably, force is the only language they're likely to understand. Teach them that lesson, so no one else comes to believe this is an acceptable way to do business in Tarkov.

quests.content:
Break the Chain is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Back to our operation. I've located the sources of the radio transmissions. Those signal points weren't there before, and their placement suggests someone has built an entire network of relay stations to provide full coverage across a large area. I haven't seen these relays with my own eyes, but I'm convinced they're part of Black Division's infrastructure. They use them to coordinate operations and maintain complete situational awareness across their squads. In Tarkov, that gives them a massive advantage, and it's one we can take away. Will you help? Check the high ground and pay special attention to the tallest structures: antennas, towers, smokestacks, anything like that. Somewhere up there, Black Division has mounted their relay stations. Bring a scope with you and keep an eye out for two radios mounted together as a single unit. Once you find them, take them out.

== Requirements ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 다시 우리의 작전에. 우리는 라디오 전송의 원천을 찾아냈습니다. 그 신호 포인트는 이전에 존재하지 않았으며, 그들의 배치는 누군가가 넓은 영역에 대한 완전한 커버리를 제공하기 위해 전용 방송국 네트워크를 구축한 것을 암시합니다. 나는 이 реле를 직접 보지 않았지만, 나는 확신합니다. 그들은 블랙 디비전의 인프라의 일부입니다. 그들은 운영을 조정하고 그들의 부대 전체의 상황 인식을 유지하기 위해 사용 합니다. 타르코프에서, 그것은 그들에게 엄청난 이점을 제공합니다. 그리고 그것은 우리가 취할 수 있습니다. 당신은 도움이 될 수 있습니까? 높은 지형을 확인하고 가장 높은 구조물: 안테나, 타워, 스모크, 그 같은 것을 특별히 주의하십시오. 어딘가에 위에, 블랙 디비전는 그들의 방송국을 장착했습니다. 당신은 두 개의 전파 단위를 가지고 함께 관찰하고 두 개의 레이디오를 가지고, 당신은 그들을 한 번 꺼내면, 그들을 발견 할 수 있습니다.

quests.content:
Break the Deal is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Yo, you doing good? You will never believe what I'm going to tell you right now. I have a job for you! Alright, jokes aside, the Reshala guy wants to jump head first into a new business. And believe me, I don't want this fucker in there. I found out this punk's planning a meeting with one of my partners with ties to the big land. Thing is, we only know the meeting spot, but we don't know when they're gonna sort their shit out. So I hired a trustworthy sniper to crash the meeting when it happens. Except that now he's in his position out there all the fucking time, can't even go down to take a piss. What's more, the stash I set up for him at the lookout spot was found by the Scavs, and they looted everything clean. You think you can drop off the rest of the gear? It's at the plant with three large pipes in the middle of the industrial zone. It's got some metal scaffolding or something around it... Hide it all over that scaffolding, alright? Shit, man, of fucking course I'll pay you for it. Work hard, and you'll earn hard, hehe.

Stash a DVL-10 sniper rifle at the specified spot on Customs
Stash a DVL-10 magazine at the specified spot on Customs

So, you seen my gunslinger? Of course not, he's a real specialist! Now, my guys will give him the signal, and he'll pick up everything from the designated points. Here, a little thank you for the hard work.

== Initial Equipment ==

In this quest you have to stash the 4 specified items on the scaffolding of the southern industrial plant building on Customs. It is possible to completely disassemble the DVL-10 rifle since it doesn't need to be functional to be stashed.

Note: If you have a DVL-10 equipped as primary or secondary weapon, it will be used up as first for the stashing.

sectionsKo.text: 이봐, 잘 해? 지금 내가 너에게 말할 걸 절대 믿지 않을거야. 내가 너에게 일을 해 줄거야! 농담을 빼면, 레샤라 남자가 먼저 새로운 사업에 뛰어들고 싶어한다. 그리고 믿어줘, 난 이 망할 놈을 안고 싶어. 이 망할 놈은 내 파트너 중 한 명과 큰 땅과 연관이 있는 회의를 계획하고 있다는 걸 알아냈어요. 문제는 우리가 회의 장소를만 알고 있지만, 그들이 그 일을 언제 해결할지 모릅니다. 그래서 나는 회의가 일어날 때 신뢰받는狙击기를 고용했습니다. 그러나 그는 지금 그의 위치에 항상 밖으로 뛰어들고, piss 할 수 없습니다. 더 나아가, 내가 그를 위해 배경에 세운 스탠드 ZXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOXOX

quests.content:
Building Foundations is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You know, you've been helping me out for a while now, and I haven't even brought you up to speed with this whole situation. So, I'm working with Skier now. I deliver his goods, and sometimes I'm involved in his operations. At first it was a nice lucrative gig, but now this asshole won't let me off the hook for even a second. He thinks I'm his personal fucking mule now! He seems to have found out somehow that I'm tired of all this, and now he's brought his punks to my base to teach me a lesson. I'm not gonna put up with this shit anymore. I'd leave him a long time ago, but I do need protection and guarantees, you know. And since you're in contact with other traders, you could put in a good word for me. Can you help a friend out?

== Objectives ==
Sell any 50 items to Ragman
Sell any 50 items to Prapor
Sell any 50 items to Peacekeeper

== Rewards ==
+14,500 EXP
BTR Driver Rep +0.01
126,000 Roubles
1× Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Yeah, well, I was kinda expecting that. But the key is that we've made a start. Now I have a real chance of getting away from this shithead.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to sell any 50 items to Ragman, Prapor and Peacekeeper each, with the exception of ammunition and Balaclava (White).

Note: Sometimes the sales count doesn't update right away. To force an update, you can ready up for a raid and immediately cancel it, or restart the game to refresh your profile.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 넌 지금부터 나를 도와주고 있어, 난 이 모든 상황을 알려주지 않았어. 그래서, 난 지금 스키어와 일하고 있어. 나는 그의 물건을 배달하고, 가끔은 그의 운영에 관여한다. 처음에는 좋은 수익성 있는 공연이었지만, 지금은 이 멍청이 한초도 날 해제하지 않을거야. 그는 내가 그의 개인적인 망할 이라고 생각하죠. 그는 어떻게든 내가 이 모든 것에 지쳤다는 것을 알아냈고, 이제 그는 그의 을 내 기지로 데려왔어, 나에게 교훈을 가르쳐 줄 것입니다. 나는 더 이상 이 쓰레기를 견딜 수 없습니다. 나는 그를 오래 전에 떠나지 않을 것입니다. 하지만 나는 보호와 보증이 필요해요. 당신은 다른 상인과 함께 있기 때문에, 당신은 나를 위해 좋은 말을 할 수 있습니다. 당신은 도움이 될 수 있습니까?

quests.content:
Bullshit is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I found myself a little rat in my own circle. Muppet was leaking info about my hideouts and supply routes. My lads put a bit of pressure on him and found out he'd been snitching to some gang. I want to feed them some fake intel about a shipment. They'll be waiting at the agreed spot and get thinned out a bit. Need you to slip the fake info in quietly, like you belong there, you get me? Take the flash drive and stash it near the lighthouse along with the AXMC sniper rifle and a Roler watch. That's the arrangement. Just make sure not to mess with any of the Rogues or their leaders, got it?

== Objectives ==
Stash an AXMC sniper rifle in the trash bags at the chalet tennis court on Lighthouse
Stash a Roler Submariner gold wrist watch in the trash bags at the chalet tennis court on Lighthouse
Stash a Military flash drive in the trash bags at the chalet tennis court on Lighthouse
You must not kill any Rogues or The Goons while the task is active

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Stress resistance skill levels
+4 Search skill levels
Skier Rep +1.5
2,400 Euros
2,520 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,760 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun
2× 12/70 flechette ammo pack (25 pcs)
Unlocks barter for Saiga-12K 12ga automatic shotgun at Skier LL4
Seems like it went smoothly. My lads are already in position, so I reckon these idiots are in for a nasty surprise.

== Failure Dialogue ==
What the fuck, you muppet?! Why'd you go and shoot at them? They won't let us within a mile of 'em now! How the bloody hell are we supposed to plant the fake intel, eh? Sod off!

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to stash the 3 specified items in trash bags at the tennis court on Lighthouse. You must not kill any Rogues or The Goons while the task is active. It is possible to completely disassemble the AXMC rifle since it doesn't need to be functional to be stashed.

Looking for a job, you say? I have a little thing to take care of... I got a buddy who drives people around in his SUV from the city center, where that blue boom happened. For cash, obviously! You have to whisper something in his ear, but do it during your trip, so that no scum can overhear you. I won't trust you with anything very secret, don't even dream of it, but I don't want any rumors to spread. Job's easy enough, I'll even give you the money for the ride. You up for it?

objectivesKo: 100m 이상 떨어진 곳에서 20명의 PMC 요원을 제거하라
quests.content:
Calibration is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Ah, hey there, come on in. Listen, I want to ask you for something. You've already got accustomed to shooting at long-range distances, right? I need to calibrate some weapons, the zeroing is extremely important for every gun. I want you to grab your favorite rifle and shoot at enemies from at least 100 meters away. The shots have to be lethal and the targets have to be seriously trained. Write down all your results into a notebook, I'll process the data after. I'll be waiting for the results.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 20 PMC operatives from over 100 meters away

== Rewards ==

+2 Intellect skill levels
400,000 Roubles

Great, that's all the results I needed, hand me the notebook. Thanks, mercenary.

sectionsKo.text: 오, 들어와요. 들어봐요, 제가 여러분께 부탁드릴 게 있어요. 여러분은 이미 장거리에서 촬영하는 것에 익숙해졌어요. 그렇죠? 저는 몇 가지 무기를 캘리버링해야 합니다. 모든 총에 대해 제로링이 매우 중요합니다. 여러분들이 좋아하는 총을 잡고 최소 100m에서 적들을 향해 총을 쏘는 것을 바랍니다. 총은 치명적이어야 하고, 목표물이 진지하게 훈련되어야 합니다. 모든 결과를 노트북에 적어 보세요. 그 후에 데이터를 처리하겠습니다. 결과를 기다리고 있을 것입니다.

Come on in, brother! I've got a new little business venture here, and I'm looking for someone who can help me out. I was recently contacted by someone from across the border. Turns out there's a demand over there for stuff taken out of Tarkov. I don't really get who'd be into that, but money's money. Especially when it comes to luxury goods with a bit of history from the city. Yeah, that's exactly how the guy put it. I've got the manpower and plenty of motivation to make some serious cash. But most importantly, I've got experience faking luxury goods. I'm thinking of setting up a workshop to put together some Louise Pitton accessories. Go collect some useful stuff around Tarkov from this list, and I'll make it worth your while.

Hey there, warrior. Listen, I have a mission for you. The other day I was informed that PMCs have captured several Scav bases in the region, and they say there are tons of goods there. Can you help the old soldier? Kill those PMCs so that my dogs could grab the loot without any issues. There are three bases in total: the big fortified construction site building on Customs, the former EMERCOM medical unit in Priozersky forest, and the Azure Coast health resort. Clear the places out and let me know when it's done.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, young man. I need help for a good cause. As you have long guessed, I collect food, medicine, and other necessities in order to evacuate the people. I don't want to deceive you, this is true. And now they have enough reserves for the road. And most importantly, I’ve managed to negotiate through my channels that these people would be met and let through to the other side. Can you imagine? But only the civilian population, no men under 60. Therefore, the first wave will mostly be children with mothers and a few elderly people. Almost everything is ready, except for one little detail - we need transportation. We have several vehicles, just enough to carry everyone from the first wave, but they are not running. As I was told, they have been idle for too long and need batteries and spark plugs. Even fuel is not necessary. I will make a proper list of the items we need. Can you bring them?

== Objectives ==
Find 4 Car batteries in raid
Find 8 Spark plugs in raid
Hand over the 4 batteries to Therapist
Hand over the 8 spark plugs to Therapist

+28,000 EXP

275,000 Roubles

You have no idea what exactly you’ve accomplished for these people.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 젊은 사람. 좋은 일에 도움이 필요해요. 오랫동안 짐작했듯이, 사람들을 탈출시키기 위해 음식, 약품, 기타 필요한 것들을 수집합니다. 속이고 싶지 않습니다. 이것은 사실입니다. 그리고 이제 그들은 도로에 충분한 예비량을 가지고 있습니다. 그리고 가장 중요한 것은, 저는 제 채널을 통해 이 사람들을 만나고 다른 쪽으로 보내도록 협상할 수 있었습니다. 상상할 수 있습니까? 그러나 민간인만, 60 세 미만의 남성들만. 따라서, 첫 번째 파도는 대부분 어머니와 몇 명의 노인들로 구성됩니다. 거의 모든 것이 준비되어 있습니다. 작은 세부 사항은 제외하고는 - 우리는 운송이 필요합니다. 우리는 여러 차량을 가지고 있습니다. 첫 번째 파도에서 모든 사람들을 운반하기에 충분합니다. 그러나 그들은 실행하지 않습니다. 나에게 알려졌듯이, 그들은 너무 오랫동안 비동하고 배터리와 플러그를 필요로 합니다. 필요 없습니다. 그래서 나는 적절한 항목 목록을 만들 수 있습니다. 당신은 그들을 가져오실 수 있습니까?

We have established a solid presence in Tarkov. You have helped us tremendously, mercenary. The Blue Helmets are now working closely with the locals in all areas. But as you say, time for business. You've most likely already visited the collapsed tunnel on the shore. TerraGroup attempted to move a certain shipment through there. They failed, and it is currently being held in storage temporarily, but its location is unknown. The company's temporary operational coordination headquarters was moved to the Resort. There is no one there anymore. However, they definitely did not manage to remove everything. We may be able to recover valuable information. The computer coordination center was located somewhere on the third floor of the east wing of the Resort. Find any information you can.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, time to gather some intel on these cocksuckers. You haven't run into them yourself out in the field, have you? Ah, never mind. You probably wouldn't have much to tell me anyway. What I do know is they aren't BEARs or USECs, and they're mainly interested in TerraGroup sites. But I need to verify all of it. Can you set up surveillance along the routes these guys are likely using? From what I've heard, they avoid open areas, so head into the city first. You've got a better chance of finding something there. And check the shore too. Those bastards managed to ambush my team there somehow...

== Dialogue ==
I'm stumped today, warrior. There are good people who need to escape the city. The closest they can get is through Avenue of Death, but there are snipers overlooking the whole area. One kid told me that if you shoot a signal flare there, the snipers should let you pass through, in that particular spot. But who knows if the kid was lying? Maybe he's trying to lead us to death. How do we find out if it's true that the snipers will stop firing after the signal... I got a couple flares lying around, why don't you go check it out, eh?

== Objectives ==
Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov through Klimov Street

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
So he was correct, it is the cease fire condition, I'll keep that in mind. You really put your head on the line, didn't you? I respect that.

== Initial equipment ==

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to extract from Streets of Tarkov via the "Klimov Street" extraction with the "survived" status. For the extraction to open, you have to shoot a green flare into the sky while being inside the signal flare area. Upon entering the signal flare area, a notifcation will pop up in the bottom right corner of the screen:  If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the extraction won't open. If the flare was fired correctly, a new notification pops up:  You can use either the handheld RSP-30 green flare provided by Jaeger via in-game mail or a 26x75mm green flare cartridge fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 green flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. If you need additional flares you can buy them from Jaeger. To avoid the "run through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.

Charity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Young man, I have a task for you. By now, you've likely realized that I continue to support the civilians who were unable to make it beyond the cordon. Unlike many of your colleagues who come to see me, you haven't lost your humanity yet. That is why I would like to ask for your help. I need adrenaline injectors, strictly for medical purposes. I have no intention of selling it to anyone. I took an oath, and I will continue helping people for as long as I live. I've been informed that a large number of syringes have been spotted in vehicles around the city, but my people haven't been able to reach them. Please obtain at least a few for me.

== Objectives ==
Find the 5 item in raid: Adrenaline injector
Hand over the 5 items

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
I thank you from the bottom of my heart. I won’t even explain how much and at the same time how little it is, in our conditions. Most people would keep it for themselves, but you shared it with those who needed it. Thank you.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 젊은 사람, 난 당신에게 임무가 있다. 이제까지, 당신은 아마도 내가 코든 너머로 갈 수 없었던 민간인들을 계속 지원한다는 것을 깨달았을 것이다. 나를 방문하기 위해 온 많은 동료들과 달리, 당신은 아직 당신의 인성을 잃지 않았다. 그래서 나는 당신의 도움을 요청하고 싶습니다. 나는 아드레날린 주입제를 필요로 합니다. 엄격히 의료 목적으로. 나는 그것을 누구에게도 팔려고 하지 않습니다. 나는 맹세를 했습니다. 내가 살아있을 때까지 사람들을 도울 것입니다. 나는 많은 수의 주사기가 도시 주변의 차량에서 발견되었다는 것을 알렸다, 그러나 내 사람들은 그들을 도달 할 수 없었다. 적어도 몇 개를 얻으십시오.

Chemical - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, Sherlock, you want a riddle? You’re our pro on these headcrackers, right? Here, look. One lame hobo came around here. Either nuts of just demented, hell if I knew. All in rags, dirty head to toe, and the stench! A walking chemical weapon. Launched one on some vector, and where he goes, everything dies off. Hehe. Oh, damn, laughter through tears. But I digress. Just wanted to dispose of him, a bit farther away so the stink wouldn’t reach us, but one of our boys recognized his former homie in that pile of turd. Imagine that! Horrid things are going on, turning people from normal beings to such rubbish, and all for nothing! But that's not the point. The dude that recognized this heap of rags, said that he was not just a regular prick, but a Deputy Head of Security for two special sensitive zones on the Polikhim! Just imagine what kind of source could he become if he could at least remember his name, not just chew snots and mumble while slapping lips like a madman. What a shame! I don't know what got to him, but here's what I think. All this time that bagger lived somewhere, sleeping on some pissed-through mattresses, right? Right! You should look for that place. Need a hazmat suit? Haha, kidding. But if it comes to it, the hazmat’s on me, and not only it.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain any information about the Deputy Chief's past life on Customs
(Optional) Locate the sleeping place of the former Deputy Chief of Security on Customs
Hand over the information to Skier
Locate and obtain any item that could help with the investigation
Hand over the items to Skier

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× MSA ACH TC-2002 MICH Series helmet (Olive Drab)
1× 7.62x54mm R SP BT gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x54mm R SP BT at Skier LL1
How long I live and wonder still. How was he surviving all this time? He can’t put two words together! Whatever. Let's first disinfect all this and wash it with cologne, and then open it and have a look.

== Guide ==

This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it.

In this quest you have to pick up a secure folder and hand over a Dorm room 220 key. The wanted folder can be found in a train car on the western side of Customs. There are multiple spawns throughout the train car. After obtaining the folder, you must successfully extract from the location.
