== Dialogue ==
Okay, next job. NATO has carefully studied the conflict even before the Blue Helmets force surge and sent several drones to recon. But local air defense was apparently against democratic eyes. Two drones were shot down over the coast, now that getting to them has become possible, we can try to pull out the memory block from these. They should contain information about all movements at the beginning of the conflict. This information can make a good deal with my partners. Find their impact locations and bring me the memory disks. We have information about the estimated crash areas: the first one has to be somewhere near the local weather station near the port zone, the other one is near the bunker in the northwest.

== Objectives ==
Locate the first UAV crash site on Shoreline
Obtain the SAS disk from the first crashed drone
Hand over the first SAS disk  to Peacekeeper
Locate the second UAV crash site on Shoreline
Obtain the SAS disk from the second crashed drone
Hand over the second SAS disk  to Peacekeeper

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
Your promptness is amazing, great job! Hand in both the disks, please. Marvelous, here's your reward.

== Guide ==

Drones marked on map

The second UAV is located east of the swamp village
The SAS disks can be found behind the side panels of the UAVs. Open up the panels to retrieve the disks
Opened panel with disk

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 다음 작업은 좋아요. 나토는 블루헬멧의 군대가 급증하기 전에도 분쟁을 신중하게 연구하고 여러 드론을 발송했습니다. 하지만 지역 공방은 민주적인 눈과 맞지 않았습니다. 해안에서 두 개의 드론이 격추되었습니다. 이제 그 곳에 도달 할 수 있게 된 것입니다. 우리는 이것으로부터 메모리 블록을 뽑을 수 있습니다. 그들은 분쟁의 시작에 모든 움직임에 대한 정보를 포함해야합니다. 이 정보는 제 파트너와 좋은 거래를 할 수 있습니다. 그들의 충돌 위치를 찾아내서 메모리 디스크를 가져오십시오. 우리는 추산 충돌 지역에 대한 정보를 가지고 있습니다. 첫번째는 항구 구역 근처의 지역 기상역 근처 어딘가에 있어야 합니다. 다른 하나는 북서부에서 벙커 근처에 있습니다.

== Dialogue ==
Good day. You're certainly aware of what's happening around the lighthouse. The ex-USEC personnel had to abandon their old positions higher up in the mountains. According to my information, they left in quite a hurry. But they were stationed there for too long to move all their supplies to the chalets within a couple of days. This means there should be stashes somewhere between the treatment plant and the chalets, where the Rogues hid cargo they didn't have time to move to the chalets. If you can help us locate these stashes and mark them with beacons, you will be of great assistance to our mission.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first Rogue stash at the abandoned island village with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Locate and mark the second Rogue stash at the abandoned island village with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse

Well done! Now we'll be able to, ahem, evacuate quite a lot of valuable materials and electronics before the Rogues return to these stashes.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, soldier. Got an assignment for you, and I'd advise against putting it off.You know the water treatment plant out on the coast? No, not the one by the resort. The one out on the cape. There's a military MI-8 sitting somewhere on the grounds. From what I've heard, it might even still be operational. If things ever go completely to hell in this city, you could probably try using it to get out of here. But that's not why I'm interested in it. According to my sources, there's enough valuable gear around that bird to make your head spin. Take this marker, tag the helicopter, then clear the area so my boys can move in safely.

== Objectives ==
Locate the helicopter at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Mark the helicopter with an MS2000 Marker
Eliminate any 10 targets around the helicopter area

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2]
So, you made it back alive? Good, good. Here's your reward.

== Guide ==

The helicopter is located in one of the basins at the water treatment plant in the north.

Helicopter marked on map
The wanted helicopter

Additionally, in this quest you have to kill 10 Rogues, Scavs, or PMC's in a specific area of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse. Any kills outside of the marked area do not count towards the objective.

Quest kill area marked on map

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.

sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 군인님. 여러분께 주어진 임무가 있습니다. 제가 그것을 연기하지 않는 것을 조언합니다. 해안의 물 처리 시설을 아십니까? 아뇨, 리조트 근처에 있는 건 아녜요. 지상에 있는 건 아닙니다. 군 MI-8가 어딘가에 앉아 있습니다. 제가 들은 것에서, 그것은 여전히 작동할 수도 있습니다. 이 도시에서 일이 완전히 망가질 경우, 당신은 아마도 그것을 사용하여 여기서 탈출을 시도 할 수 있습니다. 하지만 그것이 내가 그것에 관심이 있는 이유 아닙니다. 내 소식통에 따르면, 그 새 주위에 충분한 귀중한 장비가 있습니다. 머리를 돌릴 수 있습니다. 이 표시기를 가져와 헬리콥터를 태그, 그리고 그 지역을 깨끗하게 해소합니다. 그래서 내 소년들이 안전하게 이동할 수 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Rewards

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 헬리콥터는 북쪽의 물 처리 시설의 한 저수역에 위치하고 있습니다. 지도에 표시된 헬리콥터 수색 헬리콥터 이 탐구에서 또한, 당신은 로그, 스캐브, 또는 PMC의 10 라이트하우스의 물 처리 시설의 특정 지역에서 죽여야 합니다. 표시된 영역 이외의 모든 사망은 목표에 계산되지 않습니다. 지도에 표시된 탐구 살해 지역

sectionsKo.text: 필요하다면 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 MS2000 마커를 구입할 수 있습니다. 플레이어는 MS2000 마커를 특수 슬롯 또는 가방에 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 따라서 사망의 경우 손실되지 않습니다. MS2000 마커는 필요하면 자동으로 플레이어의 인벤토리에서 사용됩니다. 키가 작동하는 것과 비슷합니다.

objectivesKo: 스캐브 기지에 있는 주거실에 Bison vs Undertaker 포스터를 심어 커스텀에
quests.content:
Easy Money - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Sup mate. Got a job for ya. An old pal of mine is looking for the right people for his business. I don't know the ins and outs, just the first stage of recruitment, so to speak. I see you're interested. You heard anything about the Arena yet? You gotta put up flyers around Tarkov. Like "come and check it out", shit like that, you know. Hey, serious people always start small! I've got a couple of posters ready for ya, but if you lose them, it's your own bloody problem, got it? Bring them to the Scav stronghold at the customs terminal. Off you go then.

== Objectives ==
Plant the Bison vs Undertaker poster in the living quarters at the Scav base on Customs

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
517 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks Ref as trader
All done? I'll pass it on then. Here are some goodies in the meantime.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to stash an Arena advertisement poster in the living quarters of the Scav base (ZB-1013 extraction) building with the numerous mounted weapons on Customs.

3 posters are provided by Skier via in-game mail. While a poster can't be put directly in secure containers, it can be put into a Document case or S I C C organizational pouch to prevent losing it upon death.

The poster has to be stashed at one of five beds on the first floor.

Scav base marked on map
The Scav base

quests.content:
Easy Money - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, champion! A friend of mine gave you a little tryout assignment. Now I've decided to meet you in person. People call me Ref. Hosting the Arena and the big bucks, ha! Clearly you don't mind making money, and I'm in desperate need of new staff. Business is booming, and I'm short-handed. We're expanding! We got another fight planned soon. As they used to say in ancient Rome, "the people demand bread and circuses." The latter is fine, but the bread is running late. A little supply disruption, don't worry about it. Just get me some food and booze for the audience.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 5 found in raid items from the Drinks category
Hand over 5 found in raid items from the Food category

== Rewards ==
+2,900 EXP
Ref Rep +0.02
52 GP coins
55 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
60 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
Everything you brought has already been sent to the seats. Well done.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue

Energy Crisis is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey friend, I could use some help. It takes an incredible amount of energy to sustain my current activities, especially considering my farm, the one you helped me with resources for. I usually order fuel from other sources, but unfortunately, there is no way to contact the supplier at the moment. Do you think there are still unexhausted fuel tanks left somewhere? I think there should have been something left in the cape area. Can you check it out, mercenary?

== Objectives ==
Find and mark the group of fuel tanks with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Find and mark the first tanker truck with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Find and mark the second tanker truck with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Find and mark the third tanker truck with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Great, mercenary. This information opens up many possibilities for me. I'll gather people to collect the fuel. Thank you very much, friend.

== Guide ==

For this quest you have to find and mark a group of fuel tanks and three tanker trucks on Lighthouse.

Locations marked on map
The tanks are located in the northeast of the northern freight yard
The first truck is located in the east of the northern freight yard, next to the rails
The second truck is located at the eastern wall of the water treatment plant
The third truck is located next to the southern entrance of the water treatment plant

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요 친구, 조금의 도움이 필요할까요. 현재 활동을 유지하기 위해서는 엄청난 에너지가 필요해요. 특히 당신이 자원을 제공해 준 농장을 고려하면요. 저는 보통 다른 소스에서 연료를 주문하지만, 불행히도, 현재 공급자와 연락할 방법이 없습니다. 아직 어딘가에 채무되지 않은 연료 탱크가 남아 있다고 생각하십니까? 저는 케이프 지역에서 뭔가 남아 있어야 한다고 생각합니다. 당신은 확인 할 수 있습니까, 용병?

Escort is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, warrior. Get over here, I've got a job for you. As you know, I deal in gear and supplies, and I've got my boys searching every corner of Tarkov for useful loot. Problem is, order are piling up, and sending them out without protection is asking for trouble. That's where you come in. Keep my boys safe along their route. Make those former PMC mercs think twice before taking a shot at them. I'll show you the route on the map. Got it? Good. Here's the catch: you've got to do it all in only a couple runs maximum. My boys won't sit around waiting if something happens to you. Don't let me down, soldier.

In this quest you have to kill 2 PMCs each on the specified locations in one run. Dying, disconnecting or going MIA is allowed once before the quest fails and resets.

quests.title: Every Hunter Knows This
objectivesKo: 팩토리에 있는 트립파이어 설치 장소 찾기

quests.content:
Every Hunter Knows This is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in. So, how's your tripwire business going? No luck? Figures. This isn't like mindlessly shooting everyone. You've got to have a sense of intuition and know where the prey's gonna be. If you were a hunter, you'd understand. Try watching where the bandits hang out. Think about where your wire would catch the bastard off guard and how to conceal it. Take your time, use your best judgment. Only then will your hunt be fruitful. Come back when you find at least a couple good spots. I wouldn't be so quick to set these tripwires around, otherwise you'll kill some of your teammates by accident.

== Objectives ==
Locate a good tripwire installation spot on Factory
Locate a good tripwire installation spot on Customs

== Rewards ==
+5,800 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.01
32,000 Roubles
33,600 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
36,800 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
Unlocks purchase of Tripwire installation kit at Jaeger LL1
Good job, you found some decent spots. Tripwires demand a specific approach, and now you're starting to get the hang of it. Come back if you need another tripwire kit. Be careful, though! You're not the only one who knows how to set a tripwire, which means every bush, every room, and every rock can kill you. Remember that well.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to locate tripwire installation spots on Factory and Customs. There are no Tripwire installation kits required.

== Factory tripwire spot ==
The spot is located in a room on the 3rd floor of the offices behind a door which must be breached.

Location marked on map
The door to the "breach room" where you find the spot
The spot

== Customs tripwire spot ==
The spot is located in the three-story dorms, on the stairs from the 1st to the 2nd floor at the inner staircase.

Location marked on map
The spot

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 그럼, 랩이드 사업은 어떻게 진행중? 행운이 없나요? 생각하세요. 이것은 모든 사람을 무감각적으로 총에 맞지는 것은 아닙니다. 당신은 직관감을 가지고 사냥꾼이라면, 당신은 이해해야 합니다. 강도들이 어디에 서 있는지 관찰하려고 노력하십시오. 당신의 케이블이 bastard을 경비하지 않고 어떻게 숨길 수 있는지 생각해보십시오. 시간을 가져와 최선의 판단을 사용하십시오. 그 다음만 사냥이 ಫಲಪ್ರದ 될 것입니다. 적어도 몇 가지 좋은 장소를 찾을 때 다시 오십시오.

sectionsKo.title: Rewards

Tripwire는 특정 접근 방식을 요구하고 이제 당신은 그것을 구하기 시작했습니다. 다른 Tripwire 키트를 필요로 할 경우 다시 와이어 키트를 사용하십시오. 조심하십시오. 당신은 여행을 설정하는 방법을 아는 유일한 사람이 아닙니다. 즉 모든 덤불, 모든 방, 그리고 모든 바위가 당신을 죽일 수 있습니다. 잘 기억하십시오.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 팩토리 및 커스텀에서 트립웨이 설치 장소를 찾아야 합니다. 트립웨이 설치 키트가 필요하지 않습니다.

quests.title: Exit Here
objectivesKo: 팩토리 주 출구로에서 생존 후 탈출하기
quests.content:
Exit Here is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, so I've noticed that more and more people are sneaking around at the chemical plant, it's getting a little crowded for my taste... That's why I need you to scout out a new exit route in case shit goes down, you know. If you do that, you can count on a magnificent reward, trust!

== Objectives ==
Survive and extract from Factory through the main exit

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.25
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2

In the backyard, huh? A lot of people tried to go through there before, but they got blown up by tripwires too often. But you're telling me there's not a single old mine left? Well that's good! Just don't talk about our new hidey hole too much, okay? By the time the suckers find out about this exit, we'll have looted the factory clean!

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to extract from Factory through the "Courtyard Gate" extraction with the "Survived" status. If you extract from the raid with the "Run Through" status, the quest will not count as being completed. To avoid the "Run Through" status, gain at least 200 EXP in raid (by killing or looting) or be in raid for at least 7 minutes before extracting.

Location marked on map
The extraction

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 그래서 화학 공장에 더 많은 사람들이 몰래 오를 것을 알아봤는데, 제 취향에 따라 좀 더 많은 사람들이 몰려들게 되는데... 그래서, 만약 일이 벌어질 경우 새로운 출구 경로를 찾아내야 합니다.

quests.title: Fair Price - Part 1
objectivesKo: 5만 EUR 건네기
quests.content:
Fair Price - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello mate. People say you're looking for something, and that you and Mechanic desperately need this fuckin' piece of junk. What, thought I wouldn't find out? I've ran through your little project, so you two aren't gonna bullshit me with the price. If you really want it, you'll have to pay the proper price. Twenty... No, fifty grand! And no bargaining. Your little handguard is already locked up in a safe place, you won't find it on your own. So, ready to pay for your project or not?

== Objectives ==
Hand over 50,000 EUR

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Fucking splendid! Mechanic's a fucking gun nut, I get it, but I sure didn't expect YOU to pay that kind of money for some bloody handguard. Whatever, I don't care. If you two want it, you can go play in your little workshop. This oversized rubbish won't even fit any AK! I'll tell my boys, they'll drop your part off at the transfer point.

== Guide ==

Euros can be purchased from Skier with Roubles.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 사람들이 당신이 뭔가를 찾고 있다고 말하고, 그리고 당신이 정비사와이 망할 쓰레기를 절실히 필요로한다고 생각했어요. 내가 알아낼 수 없다고 생각했나요? 나는 당신의 작은 프로젝트를 통해 실행했습니다. 그래서 당신은 두 가지가 나를 위해 가격에 bullshit하지 않을 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 5만 EUR 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +10,000 EXP 젠장 멋지다! 정비사는 총알이 망할거예요, 하지만 난 당신이 저렇게 많은 돈을 지불할 거라고 예상하지 못했어요.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 스키어에서 루블로 유로를 구매할 수 있습니다.

quests.title: Fair Price - Part 2
objectivesKo: ‘Hobby Club’ 퀘스트 완료하기
(선택) 저장소 찾기
(선택) AK-50 손보호는 우즈의 오래된 사우장에서 찾아 확보하기
quests.content:
Fair Price - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Don't regret your investment yet? Let me give you an advice, nerds like Mechanic are the ones who pull off the most rotten schemes! He'll get his profit, and you won't even realise you've been screwed. All right, quit bitching! I'm telling you the honest bloody truth. If you're still confident about this "project", you can collect the handguard at the abandoned sawmill near the village in the nature reserve, there's a UN post not far from there. The lads have already dropped it off. But I wouldn't stay there too long, who knows what other scum's there. If someone steals it before you, don't come to me with any claims!

== Objectives ==
Complete the task Hobby Club
(Optional) Locate the stash spot
(Optional) Locate and obtain the AK-50 handguard at the old sawmill on Woods

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
What, you got it already? Well done mate, you're a good little mule. When you get tired of playing gunsmith with Mechanic, you know who to go to. Oh, and, uh, if you can get the part back, that'd be sweet. Maybe we'll make some business with it, because I think I found really valuable info on this overseas AK...

== Guide ==

The handguard can be found inside a barn at the old sawmill in the east of Woods. There are multiple spawns throughout the barn. The handguard is required for the quest Hobby Club.

Barn location marked on map
The wanted barn
Spawn #1 in the blue locker on the first floor
Spawn #2 on the bench vice in the shelf on the second floor
Spawn #3 on the desk with the radio equipment on the second floor

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 아직 투자에 후회하지 마세요? 자, 제가 조언을 해드릴게요. 정비사 같은 괴짜들이 가장 부패한 계획을 세운 사람들입니다. 그는 이익을 얻을 것이고, 당신은 당신이 망쳤다는 것을 깨닫지 못할 것입니다. 좋습니다, 엿먹는 것을 그만 두십시오! 저는 솔직하게 진술을 말씀드리고 있습니다. 이 "프로젝트"에 대해 여전히 확신한다면, 당신은 자연의 마을 근처에 있는 리저브에 버려진 사우장에서 손보호를 수 있습니다. 거기 근처에 UN 포스트가 있습니다. 소년들은 이미 그것을 내려놓았습니다. 하지만 나는 오래 머물지 않을 것입니다. 누가 다른 쓰레기있는 것을 알고 있습니다. 당신이 전에 그것을 훔친다면, 나에게 어떤 주장도 가지고 오지 마십시오!

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
‘Hobby Club’ 퀘스트 완료하기
(선택) 저장소 찾기
(선택) AK-50 손보호는 우즈의 오래된 사우장에서 찾아 확보하기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: 28000 엑스프 뭐, 이미 안 돼? 잘했어, 친구, 넌 좋은 소마귀야. 정비사에 총기꾼을 놀아도 피곤하면, 누구를 찾아갈지 알잖아. 오, 그리고, , 이 부분을 돌려받을 수 있다면, 그건 사랑이야. 어쩌면 우리는 그것에 대해 약간의 사업을 할 수 있을거야, 왜냐하면 나는 이 해외 AK에 대한 정말 귀중한 정보를 찾았다고 생각하기 때문에...

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 손보호는 우즈 동쪽에 있는 오래된 사우 공장 소장 안에 발견된다. 소장 전체에 여러 개의 스파운이 있습니다. 손보호는 호비 클럽 탐정에 필요합니다. 도장 위치 지도에 표시된 원원 소장 소장 소장 1층의 파란색 로커에 있는 1층 소장 2층의 벤치 비스 2층 소장 2층 소장 3층 소장 2층의 책상에서 라디오 장비와 함께

quests.title: Fall Ailment
objectivesKo: 레이드에서 5 일회용 주사 찾기
항목 건네기
quests.content:
Fall Ailment is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, young man. Last fall, Tarkov experienced a severe influenza outbreak. I caught it twice myself. This year, however, I managed to arrange for an influenza vaccine to be delivered through the UN peacekeepers' supply channels... Though that isn't why I asked you here. I'm planning to organize a vaccination campaign this fall, but before that, I need to vaccinate myself and everyone working at my clinic. Unfortunately, sterile syringes are in short supply. Could you obtain five for me? Please make sure their packaging remains intact!

== Objectives ==
Find 5 Disposable syringes in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
2× Pile of meds
Were you able to find them? Excellent, I'll begin administering the vaccines tomorrow.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 젊은 사람. 지난 가을 타르코프는 심각한 인플루엔자 전염병을 경험했습니다. 저는 두 번이나 직접 감염되었습니다. 하지만 올해 저는 유엔 평화유지군 공급 채널을 통해 인플루엔자 백신을 공급하도록 배정했습니다. 하지만, 제가 당신을 여기 초대한 이유는 아니죠. 저는 이번 가을에 백신 캠페인을 조직할 계획입니다. 하지만 그 전에, 저는 저 자신과 제 클리닉에서 일하는 모든 사람들을 백신화시켜야 합니다. 불행히도, 비균형 주사료는 부족합니다. 당신은 나에게 다섯 개를 얻을 수 있습니까?

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
레이드에서 5 일회용 주사 찾기
항목 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards

quests.content:
Farming is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Before the conflict, I frequently ordered stuff online. Used to come regularly, I even put together a drone from parts once. The last order was 4 sets of computer components. Only 2 have made it to the city, and those are stuck somewhere in the Customs area. Now, as you can perceive, they would really come in handy. Try to search the seized goods warehouse, it's a big red hangar building. There was a big confusion there, so the cargo could still be there.

== Objectives ==
Locate the warehouse of seized goods on Customs
Obtain the package of graphics cards
Hand over the package of graphics cards to Mechanic

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Bundle of wires
Unlocks purchase of PP-19-01 Vityaz 9x19 submachine gun (variant Zenit) at Ref LL1
Unlocks barter for PP-19-01 Vityaz 9x19 submachine gun (variant Zenit) at Mechanic LL1
Just as expected - in chaos, valuables could be right under the nose and people will still overlook it.

== Guide ==

The package is located within the second room (the door must be breached) of the Tarcone Directors office in the red Paradigm warehouse on Customs. There are multiple spawn locations throughout the office. You must survive and extract with the package to complete the quest.

Behind the desk.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 분쟁 이전에는 인터넷에서 물건을 주문하는 경우가 많았습니다. 정기적으로 왔던 적이 있습니다. 저는 심지어 부품으로 드론을 한 번 만들기도 했습니다. 마지막 주문은 4 세트 컴퓨터 부품이었습니다. 두 개가만 도시에 도착했습니다. 그리고 그 중 2 개는 커스텀 지역에서 어딘가에 갇혀 있습니다. 이제, 여러분이 알 수 있듯이, 그들은 정말 유용합니다. 압수된 물품 창고를 검색하려고 시도하십시오. 그것은 큰 빨간색 앙거 건물입니다. 거기 큰 혼란이있었습니다. 그래서 화물은 여전히 거기에있을 수 있습니다.

quests.content:
Fertilizers is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there. See what’s going on? Bitcoin plunges into the abyss. I don’t know if that’s a conspiracy or a logical pattern. This whole business was shady from the start, but well, there’s nothing left to do but to salvage what we can. To cut the long story short, my farm is acting up lately - bugs, freezes, and everything. Fix me up with some wires and capacitors. I have a little idea on how to improve the system stability. And make sure it's all new and untouched!

== Objectives ==
Find the item in raid: 10 Bundle of wires
Find the item in raid: 6 Capacitors
Hand over the items
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Now we’re talking! I’ll grab a soldering iron and get to work. Perhaps the market's gonna stabilize already by that time.

== Guide ==
Wires and capacitors can most commonly be found in PC blocks, in tech stores on Interchange such as TechLight, Texho, or Rasmussen, they can also be crafted in the hideout.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는지 보세요. 비트코인은 애 abis에 빠져들어요. 그건 음모인지 논리적인 패턴인지 모르겠어요. 이 모든 사업은 처음부터 비관적이었지만, 우리가 할 수 있는 것을 구하기 외에는 할 일이 없습니다. 긴 이야기를 짧게 하기 위해, 최근 제 농장은 버그, 얼어붙는 것, 그리고 모든 것을 행동하고 있습니다. 몇 개의 전선과 가동기를 가지고 저를 고쳐주세요. 시스템 안정성을 개선하는 방법에 대한 작은 아이디어가 있습니다. 그리고 모든 것이 새롭고 무관하게 있는지 확인하십시오!

sectionsKo.text: 와이어와 컨디셔터는 PC 블록에서 가장 일반적으로 발견 될 수 있습니다. TechLight, Texho, 또는 Rasmussen와 같은 인터체인지에 있는 기술 매장에서, 그들은 또한 숨기기기 장소에서 제작 될 수 있습니다.

quests.title: Final Stretch
objectivesKo: 펜스의 타르코프 시내에 있는 노트북 찾아 확보하기
발견된 항목 건네기
quests.content:
Final Stretch is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good thing you didn't disappear. Even with your help, they somehow spotted my people. Every last one of them got killed on the way back while crossing part of their route through the center of downtown. But before that happened, my team reported finding a rugged laptop protected by some serious security. During the attack, my boys were supposed to stash it in one of the hidden caches there in the center. I've got no reason to doubt them, so the hardware should still be there. Check those stashes, find the laptop, and bring it to me. Whatever's stored on a sealed TerraGroup site like that will be worth a great deal, even if not directly.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the laptop from Fence's stash on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+35,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× RB-BK marked key
1× Briefcase with documents
Unlocks achievement Profit Over Principles
You didn't see my people's bodies near the stashes? Then they managed to draw those operators away before they went down. That's good. I'm not some cheap hustler. When I make a deal, I honor it. Your reward's already waiting. Go collect it.

== Failure Dialogue ==
Good thing I don't put my trust in outsiders. You had a rare chance to work with me, and you blew it over some naive bullshit Mechanic fed you. Should've seen that coming. Get lost, merc.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find and hand over a Laptop from an unknown facility to Fence. The laptop is located at a small ventilation chimney in an alley behind the diner on Nikitskaya Street on Streets of Tarkov.

Location of the laptop marked on map.
Enter the diner to access the alley behind it.
The ventilation chimney where the laptop spawns.
The laptop spawn.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 당신이 사라지지 않았다는 건 다행입니다. 당신의 도움에도 불구하고, 그들은 어떻게든 내 사람들을 발견했습니다. 그들 중 마지막 사람들은 도시 중심부로 가는 길의 일부를 건너가 돌아가는 동안 죽었습니다. 하지만 그 전에, 제 팀은 심각한 보안에 의해 보호되는 견고한 노트북을 발견했다고 보고했습니다. 공격 중에, 제 소년들은 중앙에 숨겨진 캐시 중 하나에 그것을 숨기어야했습니다. 나는 그들을 의심할 이유가 없습니다. 그래서 하드웨어는 여전히 거기에 있어야합니다. 그 저장소를 확인하고 노트북을 찾아내십시오. 그리고 그것을 내게 가져 오십시오. 그런 봉쇄된 테라그룹 사이트에서 저장된 모든 것은 매우 가치가 있습니다. 직접하지 않더라도.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: 시즌 모드로 플레이 중이어야 합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 당신은 펜스에 알려지지 않은 시설에서 노트북을 찾아서 넘겨야합니다. 노트북은 타르코프 시내에서 니키츠카야 거리에 식당 뒤에 있는 골목에 있는 작은 환기 소화관에 위치하고 있습니다. 노트북의 위치 지도에 표시되어 있습니다. 그 뒤에 있는 골목에 액세스하기 위해 식당에 들어가십시오. 노트북이 자란 환기 소화관이 있습니다. 노트북이 자란.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings. Here's the thing: you can see for yourself how far out in the wilderness I live. Things happen out here. Sometimes I find a good person clinging to life, and there's nothing I can do to help. I've had people breathe their last right in my arms. I want to put together a small medical kit, something with the essentials always close at hand. Will you help me?

3개 중 어떤 3개도 건네기
quests.content:
First in Line is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, young man. I need you to complete a quick assignment for me. Nothing too extraordinary yet, we have only just begun working together. There are still civilians in the city, and they're trying to get out. The best place to organize an evacuation would be the Emercom checkpoint: it should have both the vehicles and the necessary equipment. At least, I hope so. I haven't been to that part of the city very often, so I don't know exactly where the checkpoint is located. Find it for me. Once you do, I'll send my people to inspect the area. And one more thing. I'm in need of supplies for my medical duty. I can't exactly import them to Tarkov anymore, so we have to look for what we can find. It doesn't matter what you bring: consumables, medicine, stimulants. Anything useful will do. I'll be waiting.

== Objectives ==
Locate the Emercom station on Ground Zero
Hand over any 3 found in raid medicine items

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Mission accomplished? That's great news, thank you. I hope that our cooperation will be equally productive in the future.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to find the Emercom station on Ground Zero, and hand over any 3 found in raid meds or medical supplies to Therapist. Stimulants aren't accepted.

The Emercom station can be found in front of the "Unity Credit" bank.

Location marked on map
The Emercom station

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 젊은 사람. 제가 가진 빠른 임무를 완료해 주세요. 너무 특별한 일은 없습니다. 아직은 함께 일하기 시작한 것만은 아닙니다. 아직까지 도시에서 민간인들이 있습니다. 그들은 빠져나오려고 합니다. 탈출을 조직하는 가장 좋은 곳은 에머콤 체크포인트입니다. 차량과 필요한 장비 모두 있어야 합니다. 적어도, 그렇게 희망합니다. 저는 도시의 그 부분에 자주 가진 않았기 때문에 체크포인트가 어디에 있는지 모르겠습니다. 나를 위해 찾아보세요. 일단 그렇게 되면, 저는 제 사람들을 지역을 점검하도록 보낼 것입니다. 그리고 한 가지 더 있습니다. 의료 의무에 대한 물품이 필요합니다. 저는 정확히 그들을 타르코프에 수입할 수 없습니다. 그래서 우리가 찾을 수 있는 것을 찾아야 합니다. 그것은 우리가 무엇을 가져올 수 있는지 정확히 알지 못합니다. 소비자료, 자극제, 유용한 약물. 나는 더 이상 기다릴 것입니다.

Good day, mercenary. My name is Peacekeeper, and I was referred to you by Skier. Let us not waste time and get straight to business. I need to deliver certain equipment to certain people. I am going to provide you with everything required. Your task is to leave the goods in a designated location. On the coast, next to one of the... what is the Russian word?.. Ah! Breakwaters. objectivesKo: 레이드에서 2 테라그룹 연구소 액세스 키 카드 찾기

quests.content:
Fishing Place is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well hello there, warrior! How are you? Doing good? Listen, I've got an unusual task to do, Mechanic asked me to make one special thing for his home, and this \"thing\" is such a complicated one that it requires some advanced electronics. And there's no place in the city where these things could be found, damn it. However, there are rumors that somewhere around here is the TerraGroup laboratory. It might have the details we need. The Laboratory is too dangerous to send you there alone, but at least bring me the access cards. Will you help? And yes, the cards should be new, not the ones you could just buy from those shady traders.

== Objectives ==
Find 2 TerraGroup Labs access keycards in raid
Hand over 2 TerraGroup Labs access keycards to Jaeger

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
You got them? Good work, kid. Now we just have to figure out how to find this laboratory. Well, I'll deal with this matter myself, don't worry.

== Guide ==

One quick way to find TerraGroup Labs access keycards in raid is to kill and loot any Scav boss.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 전사님! 어떻게 지내세요? 잘 지내세요? 들어보세요, 제가 할 일이 특이한데, 정비사는 그의 집용으로 특별한 물건을 만들라고 부탁했습니다. 이 "물"은 너무 복잡해서 첨단 전자 장치가 필요합니다. 그리고 이 도시에서 이런 것들을 찾을 수 있는 곳은 없습니다. damn it. 그러나, 여기 어딘가에서 테라그룹 실험실이 있다는 소문이 있습니다. 우리가 필요로 하는 세부 사항이 있을지도 모릅니다. 실험실은 당신을 혼자 보내기에는 너무 위험하지만 적어도 액세스 카드를 가져오십시오. 당신은 도움이 될 수 있습니까? 그리고 예, 카드들은 새로운 것이어야 합니다. 당신은 단지 그 그림자 거래자들로부터 구입할 수 있는 것이 아니라.

quests.content:
Following the Bread Crumbs is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The message found its recipient. Rats on a sinking ship began to scurry. The customers gave orders to destroy all evidence of ongoing developments. Your mission is to infiltrate TerraGroup's lab, find the data carrier containing the data we need, and deliver it to me. What are you waiting for, a candy for good luck? Hurry up!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 20 targets in The Lab
Search the weapon testing area in The Lab
Search the human experiment room in The Lab
Obtain the secured tape inside the manager's office in The Lab
Bring the tape to Lightkeeper
Note: The "Search" objectives will appear after the "Eliminate" objective is completed.

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.04
1× Far-forward GPS Signal Amplifier Unit
1× Substation marked key
Unlocks barter for Far-forward GPS Signal Amplifier Unit at Mechanic LL4
Do you have the recorder? Perfect, give it to me. It will take time to complete the decoding. I'll let you know when we're done.

== Guide ==
Not all spawn locations for the quest item require this key. It is not entirely needed to complete the quest.

In this quest you first have to kill any 20 targets in The Lab. Then you have to visit the weapon testing area and the human experiment room in The Lab. A TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key and a TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black) are required to enter them. The last objective needs you to obtain a secured tape from the conference room in The Lab and bring it to Lightkeeper. A TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key is required to access 3 of the 8 possible spawns in the locked manager's area.

== Weapon testing area and experiment room location ==
The wanted locations are located on the first floor. You have to enter the glassed room inside the experiment area for the objective to complete.

Locations marked on map

The glassed room

== Conference room and secured tape location ==
The conference room is located on the second floor.

quests.title: Forbidden Knowledge
objectivesKo: 2 14-4 KORD SSD 찾아 확보하기
발견된 정보 건네기
quests.content:
Forbidden Knowledge is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I liked the documents you brought me. But there'll be a lot more intel on digital storage devices, and those are definitely getting evacuated along with those little folders. They might even be tagged or sealed somehow. For now, I'm not willing to risk my own people, so this job's yours. I don't think you've got much chance of finding their camps, so the plan stays the same: intercept them in the areas you already know, and hope for a good haul. Bring me every hard drive you find with data on it. Any questions?

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain 2 14-4 KORD SSDs
Hand over the found intel

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× Peltor TEP-300 tactical earplug (Coyote Brown)
That'll do for now. Makes you wonder if there's anything left at those TerraGroup sites after these operators finish raiding them. With this much data, it's obvious they already had detailed information on every TerraGroup facility: locations, access codes, and everything else. Things even I don't have. And those rumors about unknown facilities out in the region? They're not bullshit after all.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to obtain and hand over two 14-4 KORD SSDs to Fence. The SSDs can be found on Black Division.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 제가 가져온 서류는 마음에 들었습니다. 하지만 디지털 저장 장치에 대한 정보들은 더 많을 것입니다. 그리고 그 작은 폴더들과 함께 확실히 제거될 것입니다. 그들은 어떤 식으로든 태그되거나 봉쇄될 수도 있습니다. 현재는, 저는 제 사람들을 위험에 빠뜨릴 준비가 되지 않습니다. 그래서 이 일은 당신입니다. 당신은 그들의 캠프를 찾을 가능성이 거의 없다고 생각합니다. 그래서 계획은 동일합니다. 당신이 이미 알고 있는 지역에서 그들을 가로막고, 좋은 운송을 희망합니다. 그 데이터로 발견하는 모든 하드 드라이브를 가져오십시오. 어떤 질문도 있습니까?

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +30,000 EXP 300,000 루블 315,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 345,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 3× 펠터 TEP-300 전술 귀충 (코이오트 브라운) 이 지금에 충분합니다. 이러한 사업자가 습격을 마친 후 테라그룹 사이트에서 어떤 것이 남아 있는지 궁금합니다. 이 많은 데이터로, 그들은 이미 모든 테라그룹 시설에 대한 자세한 정보를 가지고 있었다는 것이 분명합니다. 위치, 액세스 코드, 그리고 다른 모든 것. 내가 가지고 있지 않은 것. 그리고 그 지역에서 알려지지 않은 시설에 대한 소문이? 그들은 결국은 헛소리 아닙니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 14-4 KORD SSD를 펜스에 가져와 넘겨야 합니다.

quests.content:
Forester's Duty is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I used to walk many a footpath myself, but time has bested me. The looters have cleaned out all the popular places, and now they're heading into the forests. I saw some of those Scavs the other day. They were dragging something through the swamp near Azure Coast. Even before the war, people used to call this place a death trap. Only I and my mushroom picker friend knew how to cross it in one piece and survive. Would you scare those bandits away? Make them know the forests are not for them to ravage. Make sure you cross that path I mentioned too, clean it for good.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Scavs on Lighthouse (In one raid)
Use the transit from Lighthouse to Shoreline (In one raid)
Eliminate 5 Scavs on Shoreline (In one raid)

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Shustrilo sealing foam
The forest likes quiet, we can't let them destroy such places. I don't know how they could have found out about this trail... My friend has never shown his paths to bad people.

== Guide ==
== Lighthouse to Shoreline ==
At the Path to Shoreline extraction. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 저도 종종 산책로를 걷곤 했지만 시간이 제 제치고 있습니다. 강탈자들은 모든 인기 있는 곳을 청소하고, 이제 숲으로 향하고 있습니다. 전날 저는 스캐브 중 일부를 보았습니다. 그들은 아저루 코스트 근처의 습지로 무언가를 끌고 있었습니다. 전쟁 이전에도 사람들은 이 곳을 죽음의 함정이라고 불렀습니다. 나와 나의 버섯 채집 친구만 그것을 한 조각으로 건너가 살아남을 방법을 알고 있었습니다. 당신은 그 강탈자들을 멀리 겁내겠습니까? 숲이 그들을 파괴하는 것이 아니라는 것을 알려주세요. 내가 언급한 길을 건너가십시오, 그것을 영원히 청소하십시오.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, warrior! You asked about the BTR driver, and in theory we could work together. I've already used the services of his BTR, but going against Skier is not cheap. That's why we need to solidify our intentions, so that no one slips up later! First, I need to get a package that came from outside the cordon. I'm told it's already here, somewhere in the Norvinsk port area.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain Prapor's cargo on Shoreline
Hand over the found cargo

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1

1× Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle
3× AK-74 5.45x39 6L26 45-round magazine
2× 5.45x39mm BP gs ammo pack (120 pcs)
Good work, soldier! I'll be in touch with you about working with the driver.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Prapor's cargo on Shoreline. It can be found in the office building at the pier. There are multiple spawns throughout the building.

quests.title: Fresh Stock
objectivesKo: 레이드에서 5 블랙 디비전 판통기 찾기
항목 건네기
quests.content:
Fresh Stock is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Howdy, ahper! I heard there's some serious commotion going on at some ship in the bay. Apparently some unknown group is operating there, definitely not one of your guys. You see where I'm going with this? If it's neither BEAR nor USEC, then their gear has to be something special. And special goods are the best goods, brother! If you can get to that ship and bring me back any captured armor or rigs, they'll fly off the shelves. And you'll get your cut too, you know me!

== Requirements ==
Hand over the hard drives from compartment C-1 on Icebreaker to Mechanic in the Boreas story chapter.

== Objectives ==
Find 5 Black Division plate carriers in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+25,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks barter for Rys-T assault helmet (Black) at Ragman LL1
Lemme take a look… With a bit of work, this could even pass as brand new! My guys have restored gear in worse condition than this. I never doubted you, brother, your share is already here. Come pick it up whenever it suits you, yeah?

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 아퍼! 저는 해프에서 어떤 배에서 심각한 혼란이 일어나고 있다고 들었습니다. 분명히 어떤 알려지지 않은 그룹이 그곳에 활동하고 있습니다. 확실히 당신들 중 한 명도 아닙니다. 이 말은 제가 어디로 가고 있는지 알 수 있습니까? 만약 BEAR 또는 USEC이 아니라면, 그들의 장비는 특별한 것이어야합니다. 그리고 특수 상품은 최고의 상품입니다. 형제! 당신이 그 배에 가서 잡힌 갑옷이나 기구를 가져오면, 그들은 래프에서 날아갑니다. 그리고 당신은 당신의 몫을 얻을 것입니다. 당신은 나를 알고 있습니다!

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: 아이스 브레이커 C-1 방에서 하드 드라이브를 Boreas 이야기 장의 정비사에 넘겨주십시오.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
레이드에서 5 블랙 디비전 판통기 찾기
항목 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +25,000 EXP 300,000 루블 315,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 345,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 Rys-T 공격 헬멧 (블랙) 을 잠금 해제합니다 레그맨 LL1 램마 좀 봐주세요... 약간의 작업으로, 이것은 완전히 새로운 것 처럼 보일 수도 있습니다! 제 사람들은 이보다 더 나쁜 상태로 장비를 복원했습니다. 나는 당신을 의심하지 않았습니다, 형제, 당신의 몫은 이미 여기에 있습니다.

quests.title: Friend Among Strangers
objectivesKo: PMC의 7명의 요원을 제거하고 스캐브, 스캐브 레이더, 로그 또는 보스를 죽이지 않고
quests.content:
Friend Among Strangers is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You've made a name for yourself, and I may have an assignment for someone like you. But before I do, I want to make sure you can tell who's an asset and who's a threat. It's simple, shoot the PMCs, but don't hurt my people. Understood?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 7 PMC operatives without killing Scavs, Scav Raiders, Rogues or Bosses

== Rewards ==
+25,600 EXP
Fence Rep +0.04
1,200 Euros
1,260 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,380 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Military flash drive
Here's your reward.

== Failure Dialogue ==
Doesn't seem like you're trying to keep my people safe. Turns out you're more of a liability than a benefit. If you want to work with me, you have to prove your worth.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 7 PMCs without killing any Scavs, Scav Raiders, Rogues or Bosses.

Note: Even after killing all PMCs, killing any of the above before you have left the raid and turned in the quest will result in a failure. You may die by any means and still complete the quest.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 당신처럼 이름을 알렸어, 당신 같은 사람에게는 제가 할 일이 있을지도 모르지만, 그러기 전에 누가 자산인지 누가 위협인지 알아낼 수 있는지 확인하고 싶어요.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: PMC의 7명의 요원을 제거하고 스캐브, 스캐브 레이더, 로그 또는 보스를 죽이지 않고

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +25,600 EXP 펜스 평판 +0.04 1,200 유로 1,260 유로 정보 센터 레벨 1 1,380 유로 정보 센터 레벨 2 2× 군사 플래시 드라이브 여기 당신의 보상이 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Failure Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 내 사람들을 안전하게 지키려고 하는 건 아니군, 복지보다는 책임이잖아

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐사에서는 스캐브, 스캐브 레이더, 로그 또는 보스를 죽이지 않고 7개의 PMC를 죽여야 합니다. 참고: 모든 PMC를 죽인 후에도, 탐사선을 떠나 탐사를 전개하기 전에 위의 어느 하나라도 죽이면 실패를 초래할 수 있습니다. 당신은 어떤 방법으로도 죽을 수 있습니다. 여전히 탐사를 완료합니다.

quests.title: Friend From the West
objectivesKo: 5개의 PMC를 제거하라
quests.content:
Friend From the West is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, ready for some serious work? Long story short, the tourists have started getting on my nerves. They're sticking their noses everywhere, taking ou my lads, messing with my supply routes. I don't like it one bit. I'll pay you nicely if you give them a proper shake-up.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMCs operatives

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.25
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Not bad. Here, take these little gifts. By the way, you took out one of their big shots. They’re properly shitting themselves now.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to eliminate 5 PMCs on any map.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 그래서, 진지한 일을 준비해? 짧은 이야기, 관광객들은 내 신경을 내기 시작했습니다. 그들은 모든 곳에 코를 찌르고, 내 친구들을 데리고, 내 공급 경로를 엉망에 넣고 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 5개의 PMC를 제거하라

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +10,000 EXP 스키어 평판 +0.25 1,000 유로 1,050 유로 정보 센터 레벨 1 1,150 유로 정보 센터 레벨 2 나쁘지 않습니다. 여기, 이 작은 선물을 가져. 그건 그렇고, 당신은 그들의 큰 촬영 한 장을 가져. 그들은 지금 제대로 자신을 똥.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐사에는 어떤 지도에서든 5개의 PMC를 제거해야 합니다.

quests.title: From Hand to Hand
objectivesKo: 라이트하우스에 있는 임시 실험실 안에 Virtex 프로그래밍 가능한 프로세서를 저장하세요

From Hand to Hand is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've got a little side job lined up, and your help would come in handy. Need you to gather a few bits and pieces and pass them on to someone who knows what they're doing. Not directly into his hands, obviously. Don't be daft. Just leave everything in the agreed spot.

== Objectives ==
Stash a Virtex programmable processor inside the makeshift lab on Lighthouse
Stash a Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter inside the makeshift lab on Lighthouse

== Guide ==

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to stash a Virtex programmable processor and a Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter in the hidden drug lab on Lighthouse. It is located inside a group of stacked shipping containers in the container area of the train yard in the north.

quests.title: Fuel Crisis
objectivesKo: 그리고 전력 발전소 근처의 모든 연료 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 인터체인지로 표시합니다 찾기
북부 지역에서 모든 연료 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 인터체인지로 표시하고 찾기
quests.content:
Fuel Crisis is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, brother! Mechanic stopped by recently. Grumpy and quiet as always, but I've gotten used to it. He's asking for fuel, and wouldn't you know it, I'm completely out! But I always know where to find more. I heard there are some tanker trucks near Ultra with German flags on them. Find them and mark them with beacons so my guys don't waste time searching.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark any fuel tank near the power station with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Locate and mark any fuel tank in the northern territory with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Perfect, the signal's already coming through! Here, this is for your work.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find and mark one fuel tanker truck near the power station and one in the northern territory on Interchange with MS2000 Markers. There are 2 trucks available for each objective.

Fuel tanker truck locations marked on map
Map marker 1: First power station truck behind the Goshan store
Map marker 3: Second power station truck at the power station
Map marker 2: First northern territory truck  west of the highway in the area near the "Path to River" extraction
Map marker 4: Second northern territory truck south of the trailer park

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 형제! 정비사는 최근에 방문했습니다. 항상처럼 거칠고 조용하지만, 나는 익숙해졌습니다. 그는 연료를 요구하고 있습니다. 그리고 당신은 그것을 알고 있지 않을까요, 나는 완전히 빠져 있습니다! 하지만 나는 항상 더 많은 것을 찾을 수 있습니다. 나는 울트라 근처에 독일 깃발을 가진 탱크 트럭이 있다고 들었습니다. 그들을 찾아보고 신호등으로 표시하십시오. 그래서 내 사람들이 검색 시간을 낭비하지 않습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
그리고 전력 발전소 근처의 모든 연료 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 인터체인지로 표시합니다 찾기
북부 지역에서 모든 연료 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 인터체인지로 표시하고 찾기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +3,000 EXP 레그맨 평판 +0.1 80,000 루블 84,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 92,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 완벽합니다, 신호가 이미 오고 있습니다! 여기, 이것은 당신의 작업에 대한 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 당신은 발전소 근처에서 연료 탱커 트럭 한 대를 찾아 표시하고 MS2000 마크를 가진 인터체인지에 북쪽 지역에서 한 대를 표시해야합니다. 각 목적에 2 대의 트럭이 있습니다. 지도 표기 1: 고산 매장 뒤에 첫 번째 발전소 트럭 표기 3: 발전소에서 두 번째 발전소 트럭 표기 2: "길에서 강" 추출 지역 근처의 고속도로 서쪽의 첫 번째 북쪽 지역 트럭 표기 4: 트레일러 공원 남쪽의 두 번째 북쪽 지역 트럭

sectionsKo.title: Trivia
sectionsKo.text: 필요하다면 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 MS2000 마커를 구입할 수 있습니다. 플레이어는 MS2000 마커를 특수 슬롯 또는 가방에 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 따라서 사망의 경우 손실되지 않습니다. MS2000 마커는 필요하면 자동으로 플레이어의 인벤토리에서 사용됩니다. 키가 작동하는 것과 비슷합니다.

quests.title: Fuel Shortage
objectivesKo: 5개의 항목은 '수색 중 발견'이라는 성격을 가진 가전용품 카테고리 건네기
5개의 항목은 발화성 물질 카테고리에서 발사 중 발견된 항목 건네기
quests.content:
Fuel Shortage is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Sometimes I think back to how the locals welcomed us when we first entered Tarkov. We thought the mission would be brief, but things did not go according to plan. We are currently facing shortages of supplies and fuel-related materials. Our deliveries have been disrupted, and the locals are no longer willing to assist us. We need your help, mercenary.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 5 items from the Household goods category with the Found in raid status
Hand over 5 items from the Flammable materials category with the Found in raid status

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
550 Dollars
578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
Everything collected? Splendid! Dziękuję, mercenary.

== Guide ==

If you want to find these items in raid, or search for them in raid while you're crafting them, these are some spawns for these items.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 가끔은 타르코프에 처음 들어갔을 때 현지인들이 우리를 어떻게 환영했는지 생각해 봅니다. 우리는 임무가 짧을 것이라고 생각했지만 계획대로 진행되지 않았습니다. 우리는 현재 물품이나 연료 관련 자료의 부족을 겪고 있습니다. 우리의 배달이 중단되어 왔고, 지역 주민들은 더 이상 우리를 도울 준비가되지 않습니다. 우리는 당신의 도움이 필요합니다. 용병.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:

quests.content:
General Wares is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello again. I have a temporary shortage of lasting foods in the form of canned meat. Can you help? I need a reserve of 15 cans of beef. And I know a couple of places where we could get them. From our Scav friends, of course. They used to have a storeroom at the gas station near the Factory - maybe there's still something left. Another food storage was somewhere in the dormitories, with more than canned goods there. But now I’m only interested in them, so you’re free to take the rest for yourself. Deal? I know that these two gangs are allied, but to prevent theft from the warehouses by their own people, their leaders have exchanged keys from each other's warehouses. So it should be pretty easy for you, I think.

== Objectives ==
Find 15 Cans of beef stew (Small) in raid
Hand over the 15 items

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Well, now we can add meat to our exquisite variety of meals. Thanks a lot, young man.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Can of beef stew (Small) at Nutrition Unit level 1.

== Guide ==
A high amount of cans of beef stew can be found inside the shopping mall on Interchange. Particularly, the "Goshan" (written "гошан" on its signs) supermarket stores a very large amount on its shelves. However, this is a hot-spot for players looking for provisions or to loot the registers, so it should be approached with care.
Can of beef stew (Small) is also commonly found in Ration supply crates near tanks on Reserve. However, like Goshan, Reserve is a highly populated map with many threats, so it should be approached with care.
Can of beef stew (Small) and other food items are also plentiful at the camp on Woods next to Scav bunker in Ration supply crates and as loose loot. Farther down south, the USEC camp is also a good spot to find food items.

Goshan Store
The location of a Ration supply crate next to a tank on Reserve

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요 다시. 저는 고기 접시에 있는 오래 지속 가능한 음식이 일시적으로 부족합니다. 도움이 되실까요? 15 캔의 쇠고기를 한 리저브가 필요합니다. 그리고 우리가 그것을 얻을 수 있는 몇 곳을 알고 있습니다. 물론 우리의 스캐브 친구들로부터. 그들은 팩토리 근처의 연료전지에서 저장실을 가지고 있었습니다. 아마도 여전히 무언가가 남아 있습니다. 다른 음식 저장소는 기숙사에서 있었고, 그 안에 접시에 있는 제품보다 더 많은 것들이 있습니다. 하지만 지금은 나는 단지 그들을 관심이 있습니다. 그래서 당신은 나머지는 스스로 가지고 자유롭게 할 수 있습니다. 거래? 이 두 집단은 동맹을 알고 있지만, 그들의 사람들이 창고에서 도둑질을 막기 위해, 그들의 지도자들은 다른 창고에서 열쇠를 교환했습니다. 그래서 그것은 당신에게 쉽게해야합니다. 나는 생각됩니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
레이드에서 15 쇠고기 튀김 캔 (소형) 찾기
15개의 항목 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +10,000 EXP 테라피스트 평판 +0.25 165,000 루블 173,250 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 189,750 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 이제 우리는 우리의 웅장한 다양한 식사에 육류를 추가 할 수 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Initial Equipment
sectionsKo.text: 영양 단위 1 수준에서 소고기 튀김 (소형) 캔을 위한 공예물 잠금을 풀습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 인터체인지 상점 내부에는 많은 양의 쇠고기 주머니가 발견된다. 특히, "고산" (그 표지판에 "고шан"가 쓰여있다) 슈퍼마켓은 매우 많은 양의 재료를 창고에 보관한다. 그러나, 이것은 공급을 찾고자 하는 플레이어 또는 레지스터를 약탈하기 위한 뜨거운 장소이기 때문에 신중하게 접근해야 한다. 쇠고기 주머니 (Small) 는 리저브 상대의 탱크 근처의 라션 공급 상자에서도 일반적으로 발견된다. 그러나, 고산과 마찬가지로, 리저브는 많은 위협을 가진 매우 인구가 많은 지도입니다. 따라서 신중하게 접근해야합니다.

quests.content:
Get a Foothold is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We've got some good fucking news on our business. Luka says they took the base and even interrogated one of those pricks. They attacked during the mortar attack in Tarkov, it went quickly. They didn't seem to have blown their cover in front of the military. Our lads found out that this group belongs to some young professional criminal, and it seems that he's going to try to take the base back. I don't think he's afraid of the military at all, he's definitely well-connected. If we don't want to lose our boys, we need to give them some medicine. Luka didn't ask for anything in particular, but it's in our interest to stock them well. So bring everything you've got. They had casualties after the assault, and they can't search through the whole base right now.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the item: 30 SJ6 TGLabs combat stimulant injector
Hand over the item: 30 Obdolbos 2 cocktail injector
Hand over the item: 30 Propital regenerative stimulant injector

== Rewards ==

+1 Vitality skill level
+1 Surgery skill level
+1 Health skill level
+1 Immunity skill level
+1 Crafting skill level
+1 Hideout Management skill level
+1 Perception skill level
+1 Attention skill level
+1 Search skill level

I don't know if I've ever seen such a pile of combat drugs before... Surely that's enough for Luka. I got you a little something. There's a bunch of medical books and manuals. My medics took a closer look, said the author of these scribblings is a real pro.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 우리 사업에 대한 좋은 소식이 있습니다. 루카는 그들이 기지를 점령하고 그 멍청한 중 한 명을 조사를 한다고 합니다. 타르코프에서 미사포 공격 때 공격했습니다. 그것은 빨리 진행되었습니다. 그들은 군 앞에서 그들의 커버를 터뜨린 것 같지 않았습니다. 우리 소년들은 이 그룹이 어떤 젊은 전문 범죄자의 소속임을 알게되었습니다. 그리고 그는 기지를 되찾으려 할 것 같습니다. 그는 군에 대해 전혀 두려워하지 않는다고 생각합니다. 그는 확실히 잘 연결됩니다. 우리가 우리 소년들을 잃지 않으려면, 우리는 그들에게 약을 줘야 합니다. 루카는 특별한 것을 요구하지 않았습니다. 하지만 그것은 우리의 이익에 있습니다. 그들을 잘 저장합니다. 그래서 당신이 가진 모든 것. 그들은 수색 이후 희생자를 가지고 있습니다. 그들은 모든 기지를 가져올 수 없습니다.

quests.content:
Gifts from Tarkov is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
My men discovered a TerraGroup shipment hidden inside a secret wall at the Resort, but it does not fully match the manifests in our possession. We have theories about where this shipment was delivered to the Resort from, but for now, this information is completely classified. Your task in this operation is to find evidence of a TerraGroup shipment on Cape Dalniy, near the sandy shore. I believe it would be best to begin your search from the tunnel side. Also, clear the areas of Reserve and Lighthouse using our equipment. Keep in touch, my friend.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the TerraGroup cargo with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Eliminate any 10 targets with an M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher on Lighthouse or Reserve

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.75
1,900 Dollars
1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
4× Power supply unit
The shipment was on the shore, where TerraGroup's transports used to dock? I see... So it was delivered directly from the gulf. Thank you for your work, mercenary.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlock barter for M203 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher at Peacekeeper LL3.
Unlock purchase of 40x46mm M386 (HE) grenade at Peacekeeper LL3.

== Guide ==

The wanted cargo is a wooden crate that is located next to a gray shipping container on the western shore of Lighthouse.

Cargo marked on map
The cargo next to the gray container

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 제 사람들은 리조트에서 비밀 벽 안에 숨겨진 테라그룹 배포를 발견했지만, 그것은 우리의 소유의 매니페스와 완전히 일치하지 않습니다. 이 배포가 리조트에 도착한 곳에 대한 이론이 있습니다. 하지만 현재, 이 정보는 완전히 비밀입니다. 이 작전에서 당신의 임무는 모래 해변 근처의 델니 케이프에서 테라그룹 배포의 증거를 찾는 것입니다. 나는 터널 측면에서 검색을 시작하는 것이 가장 좋을 것이라고 생각합니다. 또한, 우리의 장비를 사용하여 리저브 및 라이트하우스의 지역을 제거하십시오. 연락을 유지하십시오, 내 친구.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, soldier! I've got an urgent job for you. Back before all this, I had an old friend, name was Oleg. We lost touch somewhere along the way, though I know he stayed in Tarkov. Then the other night... I had a bad feeling. Call it a dream, call it a gut instinct. I need you to look for him downtown. Check his apartment and the place where he worked. I can't remember the exact addresses anymore, but you should be able to figure it out. Just look for anything with a Soviet touch. Oleg was a true patriot.

== Objectives ==
Locate the place of work of Prapor's friend on Streets of Tarkov
(Optional) Locate the apartment of Prapor's friend on Streets of Tarkov
Obtain any information on the fate of Prapor's friend
Hand over the found data

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Nothing at all? Not even a body, just this old book? Alright, I'll keep searching.

quests.title: Goals and Means
objectivesKo: 9x39급 무기를 사용하면서 50m 이상 떨어진 곳에서 20명의 PMC 요원을 제거하십시오
quests.content:
Goals and Means is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I used to believe that staying inside clear boundaries and doing the job by the book was the highest form of professionalism. When you can pick the right tool for any task and never step out of the top league. Working only with the best equipment. But Tarkov showed me that being just a professional isn’t enough. Here I learned that true mastery is forged under harsh conditions with limited resources, when the outcome can’t be predicted. You start relying more on your own experience and intuition, and if you’re good enough — you rise to the very top. Since the Contract Wars, I’ve held on to a small reserve of special weapons. But like in my line of work, they’re only tools. An ordinary professional doesn’t have the skills to unlock the full potential of such a piece. It takes a true master. And I’m starting to think you might be able to handle such a temperamental weapon. If you can prove that you can solve problems no matter what tools you’re given — I’ll open access to this special section of my arsenal.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 20 PMC operatives from over 50 meters away while using any 9x39 caliber weapon

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Weapon Maintenance skill levels
+4 Troubleshooting skill levels
Mechanic Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× AS VAL MOD.4 9x39 special assault rifle
Unlocks barter for AS VAL MOD.4 9x39 special assault rifle at Mechanic LL4
Managed it? Honestly, I wasn’t sure we’d ever come back to this conversation. But I’ll keep my word. Back during the Contract Wars, everyone feared this weapon. BEAR operatives who carried it were unbeatable. And for USECs, getting their hands on one was considered an incredible stroke of luck. Not because the weapon makes you immortal. But because its owner is a true master — someone nobody wants to face.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 저는 명확한 경계에 머물러서 책에 따라 일을 하는 것이 최고의 전문성이라고 믿었습니다. 어떤 작업에 적합한 도구를 선택하고 최고의 리그에서 절대 벗어나지 못할 때. 최고의 장비만 가지고 일한다는 것을 보여주었습니다. 하지만 타르코프는 단순히 전문가가 되는 것이 충분하지 않다는 것을 보여주었습니다. 여기서 저는 진정한 마스터십이 제한된 자원과 함께 어려운 조건에서 만들어지는 것을 배웠습니다. 그 결과는 예측할 수 없을 때. 당신은 자신의 경험과 직관에 더 의존하기 시작하며, 충분히 좋은 경우 당신은 매우 높은 곳으로 올라갑니다. 계약 전쟁 이후, 나는 특별한 무기 리저브의 작은 부문을 붙잡았습니다. 그러나 내 직무 분야와 마찬가지로, 그들은 단지. 평범한 전문가는 특별한 도구의 완전한 부분을 잠금 할 수있는 기술을 가지고 있지 않습니다. 그러한 종류의 잠재적 도구가 필요한 것은 어떤 마스터십이 될 것입니다. 그리고 이러한 잠재적인 문제를 해결하기 위해 당신은 진정한 무기들을 사용할 수 있다고 생각합니다.

sectionsKo.text: +65,000 EXP +4 무기 유지 관리 기술 수준 +4 문제 해결 기술 수준 정비사 평판 +1.5 400,000 루블 420,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 460,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 1× AS VAL MOD.4 9x39 특수 공격 총기 AS VAL MOD.4 9x39 특수 공격 총기 정비사 LL4에서 배팅을 해제했습니다. 솔직히, 우리는 이 대화에 다시 돌아올 수 있는지 확신하지 못했습니다. 하지만 나는 내 말을 지키겠습니다. 계약 전쟁 때, 모든 사람들이 이 무기를 두려워했습니다.

quests.content:
Golden Swag is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, you little criminal! I've got this one bloke who didn't like my terms and tried to get smart with me. I put him in his place once, but now he's gotten far too cocky. Time to teach him a lesson. Simple job. There's a group of Scavs holed up at the Factory. One of their top dogs is some bloke called Uruguay. What a bloody stupid nickname! Best put an end to his little adventure. But that's only half the job. He's got a supposedly lucky gold-plated Zibbo, he keeps fiddling with it all the time. Even came by my place, couldn't stop clicking the fucking thing. Bring it to me. Alright, rere's the plan... Stop by the dorms, get inside this fucker's room 303, grab the golden Zibbo and stash a regular Zibbo in its place. Got it? Write it down if you need to. Now get out there and get to work!

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the Golden Zibbo lighter from Dorm room 303 on Customs
Stash a regular Zibbo at Dorm room 303 on Customs
Hand over the Golden Zibbo lighter

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.1
450 Euros
473 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Pack of screws
Proper good job. Let's see what comes of it. You go get some rest, yeah?

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to find a golden Zibbo lighter on Customs. It can be found on a desk in room 303 on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 303 key is required to enter it. Afterwards a Zibbo lighter has to be stashed in the same location.

sectionsKo.text: 잘, 작은 범죄자! 내 조건이 마음에 들지 않고 날 똑똑하게 하려고 한 한 남자가 있다. 한 번 그를 그의 자리에 두었는데, 지금은 너무 자만해졌다. 그에게 교훈을 가르쳐야 할 시간이다. 간단한 일. 스캐브의 그룹이 팩토리에 숨어있다. 그들의 최고의 개 중 하나는 우루과이라는 남자가 있습니다. 얼마나 멍청한 별명! 그의 작은 모험을 끝내는 것이 좋습니다. 하지만 그건 단지 절반의 일입니다. 그는 운 좋다고 주장하는 황금으로 장식된 Zibbo를 가지고 있습니다. 그는 항상 그것을 가지고 놀고 있습니다. 심지어 제 집에서 왔고, 그 좆같은 것을 클릭하지 않을 수 없습니다. 그것을 가져오십시오. 잘, rere's 계획입니다.

== Dialogue ==
Salam. Listen, I'd like to send a care package to one dude. Get him fitted with some stuff, just so he knows that Arshavir remembers. He's is not the military, just a regular dude, but he loves to dress up like he's in the Matrix sometimes. Or as that hairy-chested spy, Austin or whatever, the dude in glasses. Leave the package at the pier in the Woods, right on the wooden docks. He will pick it up, I'll let him know. Just hide it someplace between the barrels, so that nobody sees it. Here's the list of what to stash, come back when you're done. Oh, the shemagh must be green, by the way!

sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 이봐요, 한 남자를 위해 관리 패키지를 보내고 싶습니다. 아쉬바이르가 기억하는 것을 알도록 몇 가지 물건을 장착해 주세요. 그는 군인이 아니라 평범한 사람이지만, 가끔은 매트릭스처럼 옷을 입는 것을 좋아합니다. 또는 털이 있는 가슴 스파이 오스틴이나 뭐든지, 유리를 입은 남자처럼. 우즈에 있는 항구에서 패키지를 남겨두고, 나무 항구에 놓으십시오. 그는 그것을 가져갈 것입니다. 나는 그에게 알릴 것입니다. 그냥 녹색 배럴 사이에 숨겨주세요. 아무도 보지 않도록. 여기 숨겨야 할 것이 무엇인지 목록입니다. 당신이 끝나면 다시 오세요. 오, 셰매그, 그 വഴി, 그 길을 가야합니다!

quests.content:
Green Corridor is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Those bloody westerners! All they want to do is shoot everybody! It's already been negotiated, we even paid them to let us through! But no, they want to spill more of our blood! All right, soldier, come here and listen. A convoy was passing through town. With important cargo. Very important. Even I don't know what's in it. Somebody took money for the convoy's safe passage, and then the convoy went dark. Think about it, such bastards! Find out what's going on and if anything could be saved. And find out where the shooting came from...

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate the cargo convoy on Streets of Tarkov
Determine the ambush spot
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
The convoy was swept clean, huh? So it was all planned from the beginning... But the main vehicle wasn't breached, that's the main thing. The shooting started from the car dealership? So it was Kaban... Oh, sorry, I'm just thinking out loud, I'll have to think it over. Thank you. Come back later.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to find the cargo convoy and the ambush spot on Streets of Tarkov. The convoy is located between the LexOs car dealership and the Pinewood hotel. The ambush spot is an area that reaches from the green container with the AGS-30 grenade launcher behind the car dealership to the northeastern part of the car dealership.

Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with Claymores.

quests.content:
Grenadier is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, warrior. How's life on the front lines? I've heard plenty about your skill with firearms, and I've tested you myself more than once. But when it comes to grenades, that's a different story. You need intuition, and you need brains, unless you want to catch your own shrapnel by accident. So show me what you can do with grenades and underbarrel launchers. Go make some noise in Tarkov.

== Objectives ==

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Good, limbs are still attached, and you certainly stirred things up. Looks like you'll be useful in this kind of work, soldier. Here's your reward, you've earned it.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

Standalone grenade launchers and rocket launchers can not be used.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue

objectivesKo: AK-105를 요구 사항에 맞게 개조하기

Gunsmith - AK-105 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Ah, it's you. Hello. I've got a job that suits you. One of my new clients needs a new weapon, but I'm currently tied up with other issues. Build me an AK-105 with a suppressor and a 60-round magazine. The requirements are: a sighting range above 800, ergonomics at or above 21, combined recoil below 500, and a weight of 4.8 kg or less. And don't forget about compactness - no more than 8 slots.

This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP

275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Finished? Excellent. Leave it by the exit, I'll take a look later. You've already proven your skills, so I'll pay you upfront.

21 or more ergonomics

Hello. I won't keep you tied up with a long explanation. I've got an order for an AKS-74N with Zenitco parts. I assume it's meant as a gift for some former Saint Petersburg resident.

== Rewards ==

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Right on time, as always. I've got a job for you. A fellow stopped by not long ago with a lightning bolt symbol tattooed across his face. Nervous type, kept looking over his shoulder. At first I thought he was bringing trouble to my doorstep, but it turned out to be nothing. That's just... the way he is. He asked me to modify a Remington Model 870 with a laser device, a Magpul MOE handguard, and a tactical foregrip. It needs ergonomics at or above 60 and combined recoil below 500. He practically begged me to hurry, said someone was after him. Think you can handle it?

objectivesKo: HK 416A5를 요구 사항에 맞게 개조하기
quests.content:
Gunsmith Master - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. A new order came in for an imported HK 416A5 rifle, the black variant. I spent some time thinking about who to assign it to, and realized you're the only one who can handle it right now. From now on, I'll be giving you more challenging jobs. The client wants the rifle built using tan or FDE-colored components: a SureFire SOCOM556-RC2 suppressor, Magpul RVG foregrip, EOTech EXPS3-0 holographic sight, Magpul MOE pistol grip, Magpul UBR GEN2 stock, an LA-5B/PEQ tactical device, and a magazine with a capacity of at least 30 rounds. It needs at least 50 ergonomics, no more than 310 total recoil, and must weigh under 4 kilograms. Just like something you'd see in the hands of some SOF guys, right? One more thing: try to find a rifle that hasn't been beaten to hell. Its durability must be at least 80%.

== Objectives ==
Modify an HK 416A5 to comply with the given specifications

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× AR-15 HK Ergo PSG-1 style pistol grip
1× AR-15 Strike Industries Advanced Receiver Extension
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 HK Ergo PSG-1 style pistol grip at Mechanic LL4
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Strike Industries Advanced Receiver Extension at Mechanic LL4
A real door kicker blaster! Thank you for the help, mercenary.

== Guide ==
HK 416A5 specifications:
80 Durability
50 or more ergonomics
310 or less recoil
4 kg or less in weight
300 or greater sighting range
A magazine with a capacity of at least 30
SureFire SOCOM556-RC2 5.56x45 sound suppressor
Magpul RVG foregrip (FDE)
EOTech EXPS3-0 holographic sight (Tan)
AR-15 Magpul UBR GEN2 stock (FDE)
AR-15 Magpul MOE pistol grip (FDE)
L3Harris LA-5B/PEQ tactical device

== Notes: ==
This build is based on a standard black HK 416A5 from Peacekeeper LL3. It can only be purchased after completing Weapons Circulation.

quests.content:
Gunsmith Master - Part 12 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Do you ever find yourself crossing paths with a classmate decades after high school and hardly recognizing them? Although, I'd likely shock some of the folks from my class myself. Recently, a certain guy from my school days reached out to me. After school, he went into the army, wanting to join the special forces... It was clear even then that he had a peculiar, uh, aptitude for that job. Somehow he found me here and asked me for a favor. He wants to remember his early years in basic training. I'm not a big fan of that sort of hospitality, plus I've got heaps of work to do. But let me put it this way: he was, um, very insistent. I don't need any more trouble, so I agreed to his deal, hoping you'd help me sort it all out. People say this kind of equipment used to be somewhat standard issue at his job: ORSIS T-5000, Vityaz and a Glock 17. All with the special mods, of course. The rifle was equipped with an ATACR 7-35x56 34mm scope, Harris bipod, and a suppressor, I can't recall which exact one... Well, probably doesn't matter. Just get any suitable silencer, that'll work. For Vityaz I need the Micro T-1 red dot with a spacer, Zenit RK-6 front grip and RK-3 pistol grip, PT-3 Klassika buttstock... I also need a PEQ-15, Klesch-2P flashlight, and, as you probably guessed, a suppressor, the standard Vityaz one. Ergonomics no less than 49, recoil sum no more than 400, and at least a 30-round magazine. The Glock is simple. You need to replace the barrel with the Double Diamond with their thread protector, add a Pachmayr Grip Glove, Klesch-2P flashlight, and a 21-round extendo mag. I think that's everything.

== Objectives ==
Modify a PP-19-01 to comply with the given specifications
Modify a T-5000M to comply with the given specifications
Modify a Glock 17 to comply with the given specifications

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1× TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black)
Unlocks barter for TerraGroup Labs keycard (Black) at Mechanic LL4
Alright, let me check the attachment list... Okay, my friend will be very pleased. It's amazing that there's still room for some nostalgia in all of us, even if the conditions around us burn out all other emotions.

sectionsKo.text:
안녕하세요. 고등학교를 졸업한 후 수십 년 동안 한 교도와 길을 건너가 거의 그들을 알아보지 못해 본 적이 있습니까? 비록, 저는 아마 제 수업에서 많은 사람들을 충격에 빠뜨리겠지만. 최근에, 제 학교 시절의 한 남자가 저에게 연락했습니다. 학교를 마친 후, 그는 군에 들어가 특수부대에 합류하고 싶어했습니다. 그 때에도 그 직업에 대한 특이한 능력이 분명했습니다. 어떻게든 그는 저를 찾아서 부탁했습니다. 그는 기본적인 훈련의 초기년을 기억하고 싶어합니다. 저는 그런 종류의 호ospitality의 큰 팬이 아닙니다. 더 나아가, 저는 많은 일을 해야합니다. 하지만 이렇게 말하자면: 그는, , 매우 고집했습니다. 더 이상 문제가 필요 없습니다. 그래서 저는 그의 거래를 동의했습니다. 당신은 모든 것을 나에게 제공하기를 희망했습니다. 사람들은 TRS와 같은 표준 장비 사용했습니다. 물론, 그의 GIS 17000에서 어떤 종류의 도움과 함께 TRS와 GIS, 물론, 어떤 종류의 도움은 있습니다.
총기는 ATACR 7-35x56 34mm 스펙트럼, 해리스 바이팟, 압축기를 탑재했다. 정확히 어느 쪽인지 기억할 수 없다... 그건 중요하지 않을 것 같습니다. 적절한 시뮬레이터만 구해 주세요. 비타자즈용은 미크로 T-1 빨간 점과 거리를, 제니트 RK-6 앞잡이와 RK-3 총기 잡기, PT-3 클래식 버스톡이 탑재되었습니다. PEQ-15와 Klesch-2P 램프, 그리고, 아마 당신이 예상했던 것처럼, 압축기를, 표준 비타자즈 하나를 사용해야 합니다. 에르고노믹은 49 미만의 것이 아닙니다. 후퇴 수치는 400 미만의 것이 아닙니다. 그리고 적어도 30 라운드 매거진은 간단합니다. Glocklight은 간단합니다. 당신은 두 개의 다이아몬드를 배로 교체해야 합니다.

Are you good at hiding? Not good enough for Sniper not to find you, I think. I don't envy the guy, what’s his name, Brendan I think. Interesting, all those heroes of the past who we admired so much, where have they all gone? Why has everybody become so empty? Why now, with this chaos around, such folk as Sniper became heroes for us? Why have we been ignoring such war dogs, and now we’re looking forward to being friends with them? What do you think? I have another order, for an R11 RSASS. With a sighting range of 1500 or above. Weight 6.7 kg or less. Also needs a silencer, ergonomics more than 17, and recoil sum less than 300.

quests.content:
Gunsmith Master - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Quite long ago, I once met the owner of KIBA Arms, we even went to a sauna together then, though I’m not particularly into it. He even broke his leg trying to jump-dive from the pier that day. Jolly fellow dreamt of setting up an airsoft field all the time. It seems his wish came true in Tarkov, the best and largest airsoft field in the world, with an only minor difference: here, you die and lose everything from a single stray bullet. Put together an AK-102, with a Ferfrans CRD Concussion Reduction Device, Magpul AFG OD tactical grip, Zenit Klesch-2U flashlight, RPK-16 buffer tube, and the Circle 10 magazine. Ergonomics should be over 53, recoil sum less than 300, sighting range 800 or more. Make sure it doesn’t take up more than 8 slots.

== Objectives ==
Modify an AK-102 to comply with the given specifications

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× AKM/AK-74 Hera Arms CQR47 pistol grip/buttstock
Unlocks purchase of AKM/AK-74 Hera Arms CQR47 pistol grip/buttstock at Mechanic LL4
Just don't turn on the flashlight unless you want to get blinded for days! Anyway, well done, leave it on that crate.

== Dialogue ==
I want to try teaching Lusya to tell if someone's lying, if the result will be at least 90% accurate, it will be interesting to listen to all those politicians and TerraGroup whales, who’ve been expatiating upon their ideals and noble goals just yesterday, assured of the benefits of our economic zone and a bright future ahead. How much of this was a concentrated lie? I think, all of it. There’s a request for a Magpul edition AKMN. I.e. the handguard, stock, and pistol grip have to be Magpul. All in black. Additionally, a Rotor 43 muzzle brake, black Magpul M-LOK AFG Tactical grip, and EOTech HHS-1 hybrid sight. objectivesKo: M4A1을 요구 사항에 맞춰 개조하기
quests.content:
Gunsmith Master - Part 9 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
What do you think, how much does human life cost? Not much, I guess. But what’s even more surprising for me, it’s the contemporary art market. The value of art pieces by renowned artists grows every year. They are definitely talented, but the more you look at it, the more it seems that anything can be art. It can be a Rothko painting, a displaced urinal, or a bunch of garbage. However, in my opinion, the most amazing pieces of art are weapons, starting from the melee - which is already universally recognized as such and can be found in many museums - to an old AK or M4, which are beautiful as they are. But a weapon only transcends to true art when it becomes unique, one-of-a-kind, in the hands of someone who knows how to use it, who modifies it for his own needs, creating a masterpiece worthy of being displayed in the best of museums. Bring me one such masterpiece, an M4A1 with a KAC QDSS NT-4 (FDE) silencer, Alexander Arms MK10 rifle-length handguard, REAP-IR thermal scope, and a 60-round magazine. Ergonomics should be not less than 40, the recoil sum less than 280, and the weight of 5 kg or less.

== Objectives ==
Modify an M4A1 to comply with the given specifications

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Magazine case
Makes me want to put it on a showcase display. Masterful work, it truly did turn out to be a masterpiece.

5 kg or less in weight
A magazine with a capacity of at least 60
KAC QDSS NT4 5.56x45 sound suppressor (FDE)
AR-15 Alexander Arms MK10 rifle length handguard
Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scope

Health Care Privacy - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day, young man. Many people have tried to escape the current predicament, and some of them behaved like they were not human beings anymore, but for us, medics, nothing has changed. Our job is to save lives, no matter what the circumstances could be. When the shoreline tunnel collapsed, quite several survivors were injured. The ambulances were immediately dispatched to a distress call, but, well, I assume you know what has broken out there. Long story short, that's where they stayed. I know that there were three or four vans, and the chances are high that most of the equipment and medicine is still inside... If you happen to find them, just mark them with beacons and my people will take care of the rest.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first ambulance with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Locate and mark the second ambulance with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Locate and mark the third ambulance with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Locate and mark the fourth ambulance with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline

+3,000 EXP
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Car first aid kit
Unlocks purchase of Car first aid kit at Therapist LL1
Unlocks barter for Bottle of OLOLO Multivitamins at Therapist LL1
So you're telling me that one of the ambulances was parked next to the health resort, hmm... Something is not right here. Well, I will send my people there, they will take care of the cars.

== Guide ==

Two of the wanted ambulances are located at the "Tunnel" extraction. The third one is located at the health resort near the helicopter. The fourth one is located next at the cottages.

Ambulance locations marked on map
Ambulance 1 at the "Tunnel" extraction

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work
