quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Thanks for your assistance with the vans. We were just in time, even those Scavs didn't have time to pull them apart. While researching the aftermath of the tunnel collapse, we’ve run across a TerraGroup executive's Geländewagen. It appears that part of the company’s top managers perished there while trying to evacuate. I’m aware that medical research was one of the top priorities for the company, and I'm almost sure that they had no time to evacuate its data and materials in time. Whatever they were doing, I think it can turn out to be very valuable, both for us and for medical science in general. It can earn us a ticket from Tarkov, even more than one. I’ve regularly met up with certain TerraGroup employees to discuss health care issues, so I'm pretty familiar with some of their works. One of my acquaintances, who, by the way, directly reported to that deceased Geländewagen management, used to live in the health resort building. Let me look it up... here it is, room 306. Search it for anything that could possibly be left behind.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain any info about TerraGroup's research in Health Resort west wing on Shoreline
Hand over the retrieved information
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Propital regenerative stimulant injector
Unlocks barter for Propital regenerative stimulant injector at Therapist LL2
Do you have the documents? Let me have a look... Indeed, the distinctive doctor’s handwriting. Thank you, young man.

== Guide ==

The Secure Folder 0060 can be found on Shoreline, in room 306 of the west wing at the Resort, located on a windowsill.

Folder location on the windowsill
The folder

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 밴에 대한 도움 감사합니다. 우리는 단지 시간에 있었다, 심지어 스캐브 그 분해할 시간도 없었다. 터널 붕괴 후 결과를 조사하는 동안 우리는 테라그룹 경영자의 Geländewagen에 을 어. 그것은 TARKOV에서 티켓을 얻을 수 있습니다. 나는 정기적으로 테라그룹에 대한 건강 관리 문제를보고하고 있습니다. 나는 거의 확신합니다. 그들은 시간 내에 데이터와 자료를 제거 할 시간이 없었다. 그들은 무엇을 하고 있었는지, 나는 매우 귀중한 것으로 나타낼 수 있습니다. 우리 모두에게 의학 과학 전반적으로. 그것은 우리에게 Tarkov에서 티켓을 얻을 수 있습니다. 나는 정기적으로 테라그룹에 대한 특정 리조트와 만나보았습니다. 그래서 나는 사망한 직원들이 직접적으로 그것을 사용 하기에, 그들의 작업실에 대해 논의 할 수 있습니다. 그래서, 그것은 아마도, 우리의 작업실에 있습니다.

objectivesKo: 헬스 리조트 의료 서비스 책임자의 밴 찾기

quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
While you were searching the room, have you found anything unusual? Two bodies? Such an atrocity... It can't be just a coincidence. No wonder, though, the documents that you've managed to find are dedicated to some serious research in the field of Immunology, and from what we can understand, they have made some significant progress in that direction. Judging by the signature on the documents, the research was supervised by the head of the Medical Service of the health resort. Quite an elderly person, I've met him a couple of times on Health Care Worker Day. Although he was a venerable scholar he preferred the repose of the countryside over the bustle of laboratories and often spent time in the Woods, driving around in a white minivan. Witnessing the success, I believe, could have motivated him to start experimenting on humans, the first one most likely being himself, according to medical tradition. Scientists are always like that. Find his vehicle, and, if you also happen to find his blood samples, that would be great.

== Objectives ==
Locate the van of the Health Resort medical services director on Woods
Take a sample of the blood
Hand over the blood sample

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Grizzly medical kit
Unlocks barter for Grizzly medical kit at Therapist LL2
It pains me to think we're following the blood trail here, but I'm sending it for analysis anyway. Thank you for your work.

== Guide ==

The wanted minivan is located at the shore on the eastern side of the lake on Woods. The blood sample needs to be taken from the right sliding door.

Minivan location marked on map
Minivan by the lake
Blood sample location

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 이 방에 검색하던 중, 이상한 것을 발견한 적이 있습니까? 두 개의 시체? 그러한 잔인함은 우연이 될 수 없습니다. 그러나, 당신이 발견하는 문서는 면역학 분야의 진지한 연구에 전념하고 있으며, 우리가 이해할 수 있는 것에서, 그들은 그 방향으로 상당한 발전을 이루었습니다. 문서에 대한 서명에 따르면, 연구는 건강 휴양지의 의료 서비스의 책임자가 감독했습니다. 아주 고령인, 나는 건강 노동자 날에서 그와 몇 번 만났다. 그는 존경받는 학자였지만, 그는 실험실의 번거림보다 농촌의 휴식을 선호하고 종종 ZXTERM061X minivan에서 운전하는 시간을 보냈습니다. 성공에 대한 증언을 통해, 나는 항상 백색 과학자들이 자신의 혈액 샘플을 실험하기 시작하도록 동원했을 것이라고 믿습니다. 그리고 가장 큰 증거는 자신의 혈액 샘플이 될 가능성이 있다고 생각합니다.

quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day, young man. The degree of your deftness never ceases to leave me in admiration, but you shouldn't stop there. You understand that training must be continuous, don't you? Especially when surviving in Tarkov. Physical exertion has never harmed anyone. Try pushing yourself to the peak of your abilities. You may record your times and results for me, but that is entirely optional.

== Objectives ==
Gain the Fatigue status effect and maintain it for 8 minutes

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× Aluminum splint
Unlocks purchase of Aluminum splint at Therapist LL3
Have you noticed that with each attempt, you are able to maintain peak performance for longer? Excellent.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to gain and maintain the  effect for 8 minutes. The effect is caused by constant use of stamina during the critical amount state (red bar) and can be stacked infinitely. One stack only lasts for 3 minutes, so continual use of stamina in the the critical amount state is required to get the effect for 8 minutes. The duration can be checked on the thorax in the health tab.

quests.title: Health Care Privacy - Part 5
objectivesKo: 밤 시간 팩토리의 출하점 찾기
3 팩의 총기염소 "Kite"를 지정된 곳에 보관하고 찾아 확보하기
quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Blood is a good source of information. Not as good as proper paperwork of course, but still good enough. It’s been a while since I did my last research. I was assisting an intern virologist with his thesis. Feels like it was yesterday, and at the same time so long ago. When the Internet was invented, it made it much easier to exchange information, even with colleagues from other countries. I miss this opportunity now to sift through the Scopus database, I am pretty sure that it has the answers to my questions, emerged after that blood sample research. Where could one possibly find access to the web now, you ask? To address this issue, I was advised to contact the one going by the name of Mechanic. As it turned out, he has access to the Internet, and it’s even relatively fast. I’ve asked him to look up the necessary articles for me. He asked for a small fee for his services, in the form of gunpowder, for whatever reason. It looks like he’s supplying someone with ammunition or something like that, but I am not really interested in that. Most importantly, he will provide the information we need. Find what he asks for, and leave it at the specified spot in the Factory. The place is swarmed with Scavs in the daytime, so it’s best to do it at night.

== Objectives ==
Locate the drop spot on night-time Factory
Obtain 3 packs of Gunpowder "Kite" and stash them in the designated spot

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× IFAK individual first aid kit
Unlocks purchase of IFAK individual first aid kit at Therapist LL3
Nicely done, Mechanic has received the propellant. Thank you.

== Guide ==

The required room is the "Breach Room" on Factory. Place 3x Gunpowder "Kite" while night time there.
The "Breach Room" is the room between the office and the locked room on the third floor. Each Gunpowder "Kite" takes 30 seconds to place, leading to a total placement time of 90 seconds. Closing the door to the breach room is recommended while placing them, as Scavs will wander down the hallway periodically. If you wish to complete this quest with little to no resistance it is recommended to bring a squad to defend you as you plant the items. You do not have to successfully extract to complete this quest.

Location marked on map
The door to the "breach" room where you plant the Gunpowder "Kite"

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text:
혈액은 좋은 정보원입니다. 제대로 된 서류 작업만큼은 아니지만 아직 충분히 좋습니다. 저는 지난 연구를 한 지 얼마 되지 않았습니다. 저는 인턴 바이러스학자에게 논문으로 도움을 주고 있었습니다. 그것은 어제와 같은 시간에 아주 오래 전이었습니다. 인터넷이 발명되었을 때, 다른 나라 동료들과도 정보를 교환하는 것이 훨씬 쉬웠습니다. 이제 스코푸스 데이터베이스를 검색할 기회를 놓치고 있습니다. 혈액 샘플 조사 후 내 질문에 대한 답이 나온 것으로 거의 확신합니다. 이제 웹에 액세스 할 수있는 곳을 어디서 찾을 수 있습니까?
그는 어떤 이유로든 총기 형태로 그의 서비스에 대해 작은 수수료를 요구했습니다. 그는 누군가에게 탄약이나 그 같은 것을 공급하고 있는 것처럼 보입니다. 하지만 저는 그것에 대해 정말로 관심이 없습니다. 가장 중요한 것은 그가 우리에게 필요한 정보를 제공 할 것입니다. 그가 원하는 것을 찾아서 팩토리의 지정된 장소에 남겨두고 있습니다. 장소는 낮에는 스캐브로 가득 차 있으므로 밤에하는 것이 좋습니다.

sectionsKo.text:

3 팩의 총기염소 "Kite"를 지정된 곳에 보관하고 찾아 확보하기

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 필요한 방은 팩토리의 "브레이크룸"입니다. 밤이 있을 때 3x 총기파우더 "키트"를 배치하십시오. "브레이크룸"는 사무실과 세 번째 층의 잠금한 방 사이의 방입니다. 각 총기파우더 "키트"의 배치에는 30 초가 소요되며 전체 배치 시간이 90 초가 소요됩니다. 스캐브는 주기적으로 경로로 돌아다니기 때문에, 브레이크룸의 문을 닫는 것이 좋습니다. 이 탐구를 거의 저항 없이 완료하려면 물건을 심는 동안 당신을 방어하는 스쿼드를 가져가 좋습니다. 이 탐구를 성공적으로 완료하려면 추출 할 필요가 없습니다. 지도에 표시된 위치

quests.content:
Health Care Privacy - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, young man. We have come a long way together following the trail of the residents who died under mysterious circumstances. I have received new information. The bodies of several workers were discovered at the factory. There were no signs of violent death. These could be our... patients, so to speak. We need to conduct an analysis of their blood samples. Also, please look for a LEDX device.

== Objectives ==
Locate the dead worker and take their blood sample on Factory
Hand over the found in raid item: LEDX Skin Transilluminator
Stash the blood sample in Sanitar's office in The Lab

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Medicine case
3× Morphine injector
3× Adrenaline injector
Unlocks purchase of Morphine injector at Therapist LL4
Unlocks purchase of Adrenaline injector at Therapist LL4
Did you collect the samples? Excellent, bring them here. Hmm, the texture of the blood differs from what I expected. It seems TerraGroup may somehow be involved in all of this.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to take a blood sample from the dead worker on Factory, which is located inside the "Med Tent Gate" extraction. A Factory emergency exit key is required to enter it.

Dead worker location marked on map
Sample taking location on the body

Then you have to stash the sample in Sanitar's room in The Lab. The room is located on the second floor, directly across from the laboratory block (G22) and requires a Keycard with a blue marking to enter.

Room location marked on map

== Dialogue ==
You know, I've thought it over again and I'm definitely positive there's a hidden layer to TerraGroup's connection with Knossos. Granted, we don't know what they were hiding yet, but that just means we haven't searched hard enough. We need to double-check everything again. Try to examine the Knossos facilities from the list again, you can also check out the adjacent buildings. Although last time my advice didn't lead you to a proper result... This time, you'd better trust your skills and intuition. Maybe we'll get lucky this way.

== Objectives ==

(Optional) Locate and obtain the Knossos LLC facility key

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle (FDE)
3× FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 20-round magazine (FDE)
4× 7.62x51mm M80 ammo pack (20 pcs)
Why didn't I think of that before? Knossos didn't purchase the whole territory of Azure Coast, but only the basements under it! That's why I thought this playground was our target. A door like this is unlikely to be accessed with a regular TerraGroup keycard. Considering they, meaning TerraGroup specifically, disguised that place as a Knossos facility, the keycard to access it should probably also have a suitable design. I'll try to find out more about these keycards and secure access to them, but it will take a considerable amount of time. If you don't wanna wait, try to find some other useful information, or better yet, the keycards themselves.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to locate, and open the door to the Knossos LLC facility, which means the transit to The Labyrinth. It is located in the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline. A Knossos LLC facility key is required to unlock the door. Transiting is not required.

It's better to discuss that with the Witnesses. They're willing to do anything to see the new world. Most will never rise to prominence under the new rules. But even the smallest actions and events will become the foundation humanity will rely upon after the transition. You probably won't understand the essence of the process you've already become a part of simply by being in Tarkov. Black Division has a special role to play, but even they aren't destined for rebirth. They'll pave the way, a path that only a select few will be permitted to walk. If you resist the inevitable, Black Division will come for you as well. It would be wiser to accept reality. The Witnesses report that a PMC group is interfering with Black Division's night-time operations. Put an end to it, and bring the dogtags of those you kill to the ritual sites as proof.

You're trying to oversimplify the situation. I've never met Thomas personally, but I understand how he sees the world. Years of service in the SAS have done their work, and after the incident that got him removed from active duty... Nothing surprises me. In Black Division, he works on operations to clear facilities and eliminate targets, and he likely wouldn't find a better use for himself anywhere else. Wedge became, or rather made himself into, a tool perfectly suited for specific tasks, but no longer useful for anything else. Of course, he doesn't believe in rebirth or the new order that will come afterward. But history has never depended on the faith or opinions of the people caught in its millstones.

quests.content:
Hobby Club is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Excellent, I've been waiting for you. I have a friend in the States, a very skilled weapons professional. He's obsessed with Russian firearms, and for several years now he's been working on his own project, called the AK-50. I don't think you've ever seen an AK that fires a .50 cal... The NATO one, I mean. So the project is finally finished, and he sent me a test sample. Such a heavy and specialized rifle is too risky to be imported in one piece, so we broke the package into several parts. Well guess what, things in Tarkov didn't go according to plan. Shocker, I know. The main body comes as one part, and it was seized in Atlantic waters. However I have the blueprint, so I need you to use it to build a new one for me. It certainly won't be easy in our circumstances. But at least you'll still have a copy of the blueprint for later use. The handguard comes with the gas tube, and it was somehow intercepted by Skier's thugs. This part took two years to assemble, fit, and test, and the cost of development and prototypes has already gone over a couple million. The dust cover was intercepted at one of the checkpoints already in Tarkov. I don't know which one, you'll have to search through all of them. But the barrel is definitely at the military base. Glukhar's personally organized an ambush on my convoy, and apparently knew about this shipment. You'll have to fight for it, or hope for some divine intervention. When you've collected all the parts, drop them off at the transmission tower shack near the gas station at the customs district. I'll ask my crew to deliver them from there, and after that I'll be able to manufacture the parts myself. And, of course, I won't forget your help.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the AK-50 barrel on Reserve
(Optional) Locate Glukhar's workshop on Reserve
Locate and obtain the AK-50 dust cover at one of Tarkov's security checkpoints
(Optional) Locate the checkpoint with seized cargo
Stash the AK-50 body at the specified spot on Customs
(Optional) Build the AK-50 body
Stash the AK-50 handguard at the specified spot on Customs
Stash the AK-50 barrel at the specified spot on Customs
Stash the AK-50 dust cover at the specified spot on Customs

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× TheAKGuy AK-50 .50 BMG anti-materiel rifle
2× M82A1 .50 BMG 10-round magazine
50× .50 BMG M33
Unlocks barter for AK-50 .50 BMG muzzle brake at Mechanic LL4
Unlocks barter for AK-50 M-LOK handguard with gas tube at Mechanic LL4
Unlocks barter for AK-50 dust cover at Mechanic LL4
Unlocks barter for AK-50 .50 BMG 24 inch barrel at Mechanic LL4
You got everything? This is definitely something to celebrate... There's no other rifle like it not just in Tarkov, but in the whole world! This is what happens when a man with skills takes his dream seriously. You already have the blueprint with the main rifle body, and you can get the missing parts from me in the future. And yes, drop by my place after you've tested this beast. I plan to send word to my friend and tell him what his creation can do in the field.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for stripped TheAKGuy AK-50 .50 BMG anti-materiel rifle at Workbench level 3.

== Guide ==

The body has to be crafted at the Workbench level 3 in the Hideout, and the handguard has to be obtained via the questline Fair Price which is available upon accepting this quest.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text:
훌륭합니다. 저는 여러분을 기다리고 있습니다. 미국에서 친구가 있습니다. 매우 숙련된 무기 전문가가 있습니다. 그는 러시아의 총기들에 집착하고 있습니다. 그리고 몇 년 동안 그는 자신의 프로젝트를 진행하고 있습니다. AK-50라고합니다. 나는 당신이 .50 칼로리를 발사하는 AK를 본 적이 없다고 생각합니다. NATO를 의미합니다. 그래서 프로젝트는 마침내 완료되었습니다. 그는 나에게 테스트 샘플을 보냈습니다. 그러한 무거운 전문적인 총기는 한 조각으로 수입되기에는 너무 위험합니다. 그래서 우리는 패키지를 여러 부분으로 나눴습니다. 잘 알고 있습니다. 타르코프에서 모든 것이 계획대로 진행되지 않았습니다. 충격적이죠. 나는 알고 있습니다. 주요 몸은 한 부분으로 제공됩니다. 그리고 대서양 물에서 압수되었습니다. 그러나 나는 플루프트를 가지고 있습니다. 그래서 당신은 그것을 사용하여 새로운 하나를 만들 필요가 있습니다. 그것은 확실히 나에게 새로운 경우에 사용할 수 없습니다. 그것은 확실히 쉬운 일이 아닙니다. 그러나 나중에 우리의 플루프트를 사용 할 것입니다. 하지만 당신은 적어도 우리의 플루프트를 사용할 것입니다.
손보호는 가스 파이프와 함께 제공되며 스키어의 강도들에 의해 어떻게든 차단되었습니다. 이 부분은 2 년 동안 조립, 적합 및 테스트를 수행했으며 개발 및 프로토타입 비용은 이미 2 백만 달러를 넘었습니다. 먼지 덮개는 이미 타르코프의 한 점 점 점검장에서 차단되었습니다. 어느 쪽인지 모르겠습니다. 당신은 그들 모두를 검색해야합니다. 그러나 배럴은 확실히 군사 기지에 있습니다. 글루카르는 개인적으로 내 운항에 대한 배격을 조직했습니다. 그리고 분명히 이 운송에 대해 알고있었습니다. 당신은 그것을 위해 싸워야 할 것입니다. 또는 어떤 신성한 개입을 희망합니다. 당신은 모든 부분을 수집하면, ZXTERM45XZ에 있는 가스 역 근처의 전송 탑 셰이크에 떨어집니다. 나는 확실히 당신의 부대에서 그 부분을 요청할 것입니다. 그리고 나는 그것을 만들 수 없습니다. 그리고 나는 물론, 당신의 직원을 도울 수 없습니다.

Alright, you made yourself noticed again. I won't lie, it was impressive. You even got the attention of some big players. Not without a little help from me, of course: you should've heard how I was hyping you up! Now, if you want to earn more cash, you've got to hold your spot at the top. Ha! You put on an amazing show! But those interested parties bailed. Who knows why. Maybe it was too bloody for their delicate eyes. Oh well, they're not the last. For now, here, this one's reserved just for you.

quests.content:
Hot Delivery is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, brother! You're an experienced fighter, you can stop by my place without a second thought. But my other clients aren't so lucky. One of them was found lying in a pool of blood at the gas station. Looks like someone had been watching him. Now the rest are spooked and don't want to be seen carrying cash. Seems like someone's keeping an eye on anyone who looks like they've got money. My clients don't want to expose themselves anymore, so they stay out of sight. Doesn't hurt business, though. If you don't come to the goods, the goods will come to you! Do me a favor, brother. Get the gear my guys need and stash it on Interchange. Leave one set consisting of a 6B47 helmet and a Peltor ComTac 2 headset in the trash at Avokado. Then stash one gray Gzhel armor in the trash near the outdoor stage, right across from Ultra's main entrance. I won't forget the favor, trust me.

== Objectives ==
Stash a ComTac II headset in the specified place on Interchange
Stash a 6B47 helmet (Olive Drab) in the specified place on Interchange
Stash a Gzhel-K body armor in the specified place on Interchange

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
The guys said they got the stuff, nicely done, brother. Told you, all smooth and quick. As promised, here's your reward.

== Guide ==

The headset and the helmet must be placed in a garbage pile in the "Avokado" store. The EMR cover and EMR Arctic cover variants of the 6B47 helmet can not be used.

Placement location for the headset and the helmet
Place the headset and the helmet here

The body armor must be placed outside the mall, in a garbage pile next to the stage in front of the "ULTRA" store. Armor plates can be removed to reduce weight.

Placement location for the armor

sectionsKo.text: 안녕, 형제! 당신은 경험이 풍부한 전투자입니다. 두 번도 생각하지 않고 제 집에 방문하실 수 있습니다. 하지만 다른 고객들은 그렇게 운이 좋지 않습니다. 한 명은 가스 스테이션에서 혈액의 웅덩이에 누워있는 것으로 발견되었습니다. 누군가가 그를 지켜보고있는 것처럼 보입니다. 이제 나머지는 겁에 질리고 현금을 들고있는 것을 보고 싶지 않습니다. 누군가가 돈을 가지고있는 것처럼 보이는 사람을 감시하는 것처럼 보입니다. 제 고객은 더 이상 자신을 노출시키고 싶어하지 않으므로 눈에 보이지 않습니다. 그러나 사업에 해를 끼치지 않습니다. 당신이 상품에 오지 않으면 상품이 당신에게 온다. 용의를 해 주십시오. 형제. 제 친구들이 필요로하는 장비를 가져와 인터체인지에 숨겨주세요. 6B47와 헬멧을 구성 한 세트를 Avadock 2에 남겨주세요. 그러면 나는 가시의 오른쪽 오른쪽에 있는 대외부에서 우트라메이트를 잊지 않을 것입니다.

quests.content:
Hot Wheels is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So I went to the depot... Those assholes ruined the place and took my spare parts. I mean, I can understand tools or equipment. But why the fuck would someone take the fucking wheels? You're not gonna build a second BTR like that. Anyway, I need a spare wheel, and the sooner the better. You gotta find where the proper wheels could be laying around. I don't know where to look exactly, but you're not a moron, you'll figure it out. You can start with the customs area, but I haven't been there for ages, so I can't promise they'll be there.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the spare BTR wheels with an MS2000 Marker
(Optional) Complete the main objective as soon as possible

== Rewards ==
+24,300 EXP
BTR Driver Rep +0.03
116,000 Roubles
1× Military power filter
Awesome! These will do, and you also did it quick. I commend that! Changing the wheels will take some time though, it's not a Lada after all.

== Failure Dialogue ==
This is a joke, right? These are fucking truck wheels, you idiot. I'm driving a BTR. B-T-R! Go mark fucking bicycle wheels next while you're at it.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find BTR wheels and mark them with a MS2000 Marker. The wheels can be found in the bigger of the two garage buildings at the repair center (white knight) on Reserve. Marking any truck wheels on Customs will cause failure of this quest.

Despite the objective suggesting it, there is no time limit for this quest.

Location marked on map
The garage
The wheels in the garage

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

quests.content:
House Arrest is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, my dear overseas employee. I've got a bit of a problem on my hands. Someone's been taking out my lads. Whole groups just disappearing. I started making some enquiries, and then I got a little note from Seva "Shket". Says he was being held in some kind of lockup, somewhere in the residential blocks. Back in the day, all sorts of businessmen used to stash their rivals there. Looks like someone else has taken over the place now. Shket was the only one from his group who managed to get out, but now he's keeping his head down and won't answer calls. Didn't even bother telling us where the rest of the boys are, the sniveling little rat. I took him in, gave him work, and the prick bailed the moment things got difficult. Find him and make him answer for everything he owes me. Oh, and find my lads while you're at it.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate where the missing group was held captive on Streets of Tarkov
Locate the debtor on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the item: Chekannaya 15 apartment key

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.25
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Fucking hell. Why would someone keep them there? I'd understand if they sent me a letter saying they'd kill my people if I didn't pay up and shit. A serial killer or something? Anyway, your reward.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you first to find the place where the missing group was held captive. The wanted place is prison cell no. 1 on the third floor of the Chekannaya 15 apartment building on Streets of Tarkov. It can only be accessed via the western staircase. An Iron gate key is required to enter the cell.

Humanitarian Supplies is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Our team always works for the good of the people, or at least we try to make it look so. The Blue Helmets peacefully deliver relief supplies to our region, but sometimes, attacks happen on us as well. That’s what happened to two Ural trucks that were carrying UN-marked crates. We wouldn't be upset if not for the delicacy of the cargo, this time crates contained a little help not only for the people but also for the USEC company. You understand that we cannot allow casting a shadow on the United Nations' reputation. Find and wear UN uniform (UNTAR helmet, MF-UNTAR body armor) and teach local scum a lesson. Also, locate the spot where trucks were attacked, mark them with beacons, and bring me several MRE ration packs so I could present them as evidence, just in case. From the intelligence, one of those trucks has to somewhere in the Health Resort area, but there is no info about the other one. I think it's best to look somewhere near the port area, possibly at the construction site.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first truck with an MS2000 Marker
(Optional) Locate the first truck that was holding the lost UN cargo on Shoreline
Locate and mark the second truck with an MS2000 Marker
(Optional) Locate the second truck that was holding the lost UN cargo on Shoreline
Obtain the item: 5 MRE ration packs
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Weapon parts
Unlocks purchase of 5.56x45mm Warmageddon at Peacekeeper LL2
Unlocks purchase of AK-74 Hexagon 5.45x39 sound suppressor at Skier LL2
I assume you don't need to be reminded that all this is only between us. If the Blue Helmets' reputation gets tarnished, you will have problems too, mercenary.

== Guide ==

Map with truck locations marked.
The first UN truck is located on the north side of the health resort, next to the tennis court.
The second UN truck is located at the construction site along the southern main road, near the crane.

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 우리 팀은 항상 국민의 이익을 위해 일하거나 적어도 그렇게 보이도록 노력합니다. 블루 헬멧은 평화적으로 우리 지역으로 구호품을 전달하지만 때로는 공격도 발생합니다. 이것이 UN-표준 상자를 운반하는 두 우랄 트럭에 일어난 일입니다. 화물의 섬세함이 아니라면 우리는 화가 나지 않을 것입니다. 이 시간 상자는 사람들에게뿐만 아니라 USEC 회사에 약간의 도움을 포함했습니다. 우리는 유엔의 명성에 그림자를 던질 수 없다는 것을 이해합니다. UNTAR 헬멧, MF-UNTAR 장갑) 의 유니폼을 찾아서 현지 스카우트를 가르칩니다. 또한 UN의 트럭이 공격된 곳을 찾아서, 그들을 비콘으로 표시하고, 여러 MRE 트럭을 살펴보고서, 나는 단지 그들을 가져갈 수 있습니다. 리조트 근처에서 가장 좋은 정보도 있습니다. 그러나 다른 곳에서는 리조트 지역에 대한 정보도 있습니다.

sectionsKo.text: 필요하다면 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 MS2000 마커를 구입할 수 있습니다. 플레이어는 MS2000 마커를 특수 슬롯 또는 가방에 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 따라서 사망의 경우 손실되지 않습니다. MS2000 마커는 필요하면 자동으로 플레이어의 인벤토리에서 사용됩니다. 키가 작동하는 것과 마찬가지로.

quests.content:
Hunting Trip is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come in, have a seat. Want some tea? Well, suit yourself. Listen, I've got a bit of a situation. I'll be having guests before long, and I can't exactly take them hunting with worn-out old rifles, can I? I've got a couple of fine foreign bolt-action rifles, but they still need to be sighted in. Then it occurred to me... why not kill two birds with one stone? Break in the rifles and thin out the ranks of those gang leaders at the same time. Don't worry kid, I'll make it worth your while.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize any 20 Bosses with a bolt-action rifle

+65,000 EXP
+4 Bolt-action Rifles skill levels
Jaeger Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles

460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks purchase of Accuracy International AXMC .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle at Jaeger LL4
Those rifles turned out real fine! Maybe I'll take up gunsmithing myself one day. I like this kind of work. Here's your reward, just as I promised.

== Initial Equipment ==

sectionsKo.text: 들어와서 차 좀 마시세요? 잘 되세요. 잠깐, 좀 문제가 있어요. 손님들이 곧 올 겁니다. 그리고 노후한 오래된 총을 가지고 사냥을 데려갈 수는 없죠.

quests.content:
Hypotheses Testing is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I was able to decipher the signal. It's old and very faint, apparently the bunker completely blocked it until you opened the doors. For some reason, the message is on loop, but this doesn't mean anything, the equipment inside could have been damaged for a while. Besides, we still don't know what the TerraGroup team was doing in there. The message says that the facility still contains materials and data that fall under the first priority of evacuation. Moreover, it mentions reports of experiments conducted at the site. This is astonishing, we couldn't have found a better time to discover something as valuable as this! Knowing more and more people are finding out about these cellars every day, it means that soon the traders and other PMCs will want to explore the area we've discovered. Perhaps even Lightkeeper will be interested... I need those documents mentioned in the signal. Whatever you can find, please bring them to me as soon as you can.

== Objectives ==
Locate the lab area with the prototype weapon inside The Labyrinth
Hand over 5 found in raid Labrys research notes

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1× Ballistic plate case
Well done. The data is fragmented, but still extremely useful. The health resort's basements have changed a lot since the disaster began, but at some point in time, they were definitely used as a testing ground for some kind of weapon... An experimental EW or hacking device, maybe. This remains to be determined. I can already see that some of the measurements and experiments will be very useful in their own right. So your labors were definitely not in vain. Thank you.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the prototype weapon area inside The Labyrinth and hand over 5 found in raid Labrys research notes.

Prototype weapon area marked on map

== Trivia ==
During The Labyrinth event, this quest unlocked the In Search of an Exit achievement.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 저는 신호를 해독할 수 있었습니다. 그것은 오래되고 매우 희미합니다. 문들을 열 때까지 방콕은 완전히 차단했습니다. 어떤 이유로, 메시지는 루프에 있습니다. 하지만 이것은 아무것도 의미하지 않습니다. 내부 장비는 잠시 동안 손상되었을 수 있습니다. 게다가, 우리는 여전히 테라그룹 팀이 거기에 무엇을 하고 있는지 모릅니다. 메시지는 시설은 여전히 대피의 첫 번째 우선 순위에 해당하는 자료와 데이터를 포함하고 있다고 말합니다. 게다가, 그것은 현장에서 수행된 실험에 대한 보고서를 언급합니다. 이것은 놀라운 일이지만, 우리는 이만큼의 귀중한 것을 발견할 수있는 더 나은 시간을 찾을 수 없었습니다. 매일 더 많은 사람들이 이 동굴에 대해 알고 있다는 것을 알고, 그것은 곧 상인과 다른 PMC가 우리가 발견한 지역을 탐험하기를 원합니다. 아마도 ZXTERM022Z ... 당신은 그 신호에 언급한 문서들을 찾을 수 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +28,000 EXP 1× 탄도판 케이스 잘 해졌습니다. 데이터는 분해되었지만 여전히 매우 유용합니다. 해변이 시작된 이후 헬스 리조트의 지하실은 많이 변했지만, 어느 시점에서, 그들은 확실히 어떤 종류의 무기의 시험장으로 사용되었습니다. 실험 EW 또는 해킹 장치, 아마도. 이것은 결정되지 않습니다. 이미 몇 가지 측정과 실험이 그들 자체로 매우 유용하게 될 것이라고 볼 수 있습니다. 그래서 당신의 노력은 확실히 헛되지 않았습니다. 감사합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐사선에서 미궁 내부의 원형 무기 영역을 찾아서 레이드 라브리 연구 논문에서 발견된 5개를 넘겨주어야 합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Trivia
sectionsKo.text: 미궁 이벤트에서 이 탐구는 출구의 탐구에서 성취를 해냈습니다.

quests.content:
I Need More Power is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
What can you even expect when things have gotten this bad, kurwa! Our local generators have failed. My men are experiencing interruptions with electricity, and that is not acceptable. After all, time is money. But I am already working on it. Many people were conducting their operations in the Resort before us. Search for functional generators. Most likely, they are inside locked rooms on the second floor of both wings. Once you find them, simply report the room numbers to me. We also need fuel cans so the generators can keep running. That should be much easier.

== Objectives ==
Locate the generators in the east wing of the Health Resort on Shoreline
Locate the generators in the west wing of the Health Resort on Shoreline
Hand over 3 found in raid Metal fuel tanks or Expeditionary fuel tanks

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Military flash drive
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Magpul PRS GEN3 stock (Black) at Peacekeeper LL3
Good work, my friend. I will pass this information on to my men. Now, if only we could move those generators to our base without drawing attention...

== Guide ==
Only one of the keys is required to complete the quest.

In this quest you have to locate generators in two rooms in the health resort on Shoreline.

== East wing generators location ==
The generators in the east wing are located in room 220 on the second floor. It is always unlocked.

220 east with generators

== West wing generators location ==
The generators in the west wing are located in room 219 on the second floor. You can complete the objective by getting into the room, which requires a Health Resort west wing room 219 key, or by looking into it from the joint balcony in room 220 which requires a Health Resort west wing room 220 key.

219 west with generators
Looking into 219 west from the joint balcony

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 이런 일이 이렇게 심해지면 어떻게 예상할 수 있겠죠? 우리 지역 발전기는 실패했습니다. 전기가 끊어지고 있는데, 그건 용납할 수 없습니다. 결국 시간도 돈입니다. 하지만, 저는 이미 그것에 대해 연구하고 있습니다. 많은 사람들이 리조트에서 그들의 운영을 진행하고 있었습니다. 기능적인 발전기를 찾으세요. 가장 큰 확률로, 그들은 두 날개의 두 번째 층에 잠금된 방 안에 있습니다. 일단 그들을 발견하면, 단지 방 번호를 나에게 보고하십시오. 우리는 또한 연료 캔이 필요합니다. 발전기가 계속 작동할 수 있도록. 그것은 훨씬 더 쉬울 것입니다.

quests.content:
I'm Something of a BTR Myself is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The Scavs at Lighthouse are getting a little too damn bold. They won't let me work in peace. They try to ambush my passengers at the stops, and they're even looting the stops themselves! Naturally, they do it when the BTR isn't around, so there's nobody there to teach them a lesson. Maybe you could help me out? We need to scare them off, or better yet, make it clear that the BTR is here on this stretch of coast for the long haul. I can't be here all the time myself. I've got business in Priozersk and in the city, but you could make it look like I'm still around! Just use the same caliber my coax gun does. Once you scare the shit out of them, they'll probably get used to how things work around here now.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 15 Scavs with any 7.62x54R caliber weapon on Lighthouse
Report back to the BTR Driver

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
2× VPX Flash Storage Module
2× Virtex programmable processor
2× Military flash drive
Well shit, you saved my ass, dude! My passengers are already asking where I got a second BTR from, since I'm somehow in two places at once... Here, take this. I found it recently at my old depot base. Pulled it out of the basement there.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 15 Scavs on Lighthouse using a 7.62x54mmR weapon.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 스캐브는 라이트하우스에서 너무 과감하게 움직이고 있습니다. 그들은 나를 평화롭게 일할 수 없게 합니다. 그들은 내 승객들을 정류장에서 잠복하려고 시도하고, 그들은 정류장에서 도난을 해치기도 합니다. 당연히, 그들은 BTR이 주변에 없을 때 그렇게합니다. 그래서 그들에게 교훈을 가르쳐 줄 사람이 없습니다. 어쩌면 당신은 나를 도울 수 있습니까? 우리는 그들을 겁내거나, 더 나은 것은, BTR이 긴 거리에 해안의 이 지점에서 있다는 것을 분명히 해줘야 합니다. 나는 항상 여기에있을 수 없습니다. 나는 프리오저스크와 도시에서 사업을 가지고 있지만, 당신은 내가 여전히 주변에있는 것처럼 보일 수 있습니다! 단지 같은 카엑스가 내 총을 사용합니까. 당신은 아마도 그들이 지금 어떻게 일을 할 수 있는지 분명히 해치기를 사용 할 것입니다.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, warrior. Still fighting? Good. There is this job, a cakewalk, really. Obviously, not of your caliber, it's gonna be a favor, so to say. I've received an order, they need some 60-rounders for 5.45 AKs. I know there definitely were some in bunkers near the sawmill, my guys stashed some goods there before. But they got driven out of there by those TerraGroup people, who then locked the bunkers with a key of some sort. Well, if you're going for the bunker, you'll need that key, I think it's hidden somewhere in dorms on Customs, people have seen some TerraGroup brass there a couple of times. Anyway, I don't care where you find them, but I need you to get them fresh and untouched by some traders. And hurry up, the order is urgent.

== Objectives ==
Find 3 AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazines in raid
(Optional) Obtain the key to the bunker in the TerraGroup employee's dorm room
(Optional) Locate the locked bunker on Woods
Hand over the items

+10,000 EXP

Well, they say money can't buy friendship, but I still owe you.

The locked section of the ZB-014 bunker on Woods mentioned by Prapor does not have a guaranteed chance for the wanted magazines, but they can be found there quite often. A ZB-014 key is required to enter it.

Immunity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well, you've proven you won't shoot indiscriminately. Recently, one of my men was poisoned on a mission and didn't even make it to the extraction point. We couldn't figure out what toxin caused his death. The guy went on a scouting trip to the white chalk circles. I need a more fresh sample and a tough employee who can survive the poisoning and make it back from the raid.

== Objectives ==
Extract from the location with the "Unknown toxin" status effect

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Fence Rep +0.02
1,150 Euros
1,208 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,323 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× XTG-12 antidote injector
You survived the poisoning? Now I'll try to get some information from your blood samples and get in touch with the right people. Either way, you've already earned your reward.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to extract from a raid while suffering from the  effect.

The effect is inflicted by being stabbed with a Cultist knife, by either a Cultist or another player. Barbed wire in The Labyrinth also has a chance to inflict the effect upon contact.

While being afflicted with the status effect, your health points will drain at a rate of 140/min. You can use a Propital injector to partially counteract the health drain for 5 minutes, or an ETG injector to fully nullify the damage for 60 seconds. It is highly recommended to bring multiple medkits.

quests.content:
In the Name of Humanity... is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You want to see the whole picture, but you forget that you're still just a tool. To learn more, you'll have to rise above the situation and forget about the sides of the conflict you're familiar with. Are you sure you're ready for that? Then listen carefully to your next assignment. You must follow the instructions precisely. First, retrieve the object from Container 14 in the Ultra parking garage. To do that, restore power at the power station, then go up to Burger Spot and find the hidden panel in the restroom. Use the card marked #11SR on the panel, then go down to the TerraGroup safe room in the parking garage. It's next to the escalator from OLI and the breach in the parking garage wall. There's a lever inside that will open Container 14. The container itself is in the parking garage beneath IDEA, by the exit toward the power station. Look for the green container marked TerraGroup. Once you've retrieved the suitcase, head downtown. Make your way to the restaurant on the third floor of the Pinewood Hotel. Leave the suitcase on the balcony. After that, send a yellow signal flare near the tram that collapsed underground. And remember: there must be no witnesses. Conduct the operation at night and leave no one alive who could have seen you. When everything is done, return to me.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 3 targets during 20:00-08:00 on Interchange (In one raid)
Locate the hidden keycard panel in the Burger Spot bathroom on Interchange (In one raid)
Locate the hidden TerraGroup saferoom on Interchange (In one raid)
Locate and access Container 14 on Interchange (In one raid)
Obtain the carbon fiber case from Container 14 on Interchange (In one raid)
Use the transit from Interchange to Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Eliminate any 3 targets during 20:00-08:00 on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Stash the carbon fiber case on the 3rd floor balcony of the Pinewood Hotel restaurant on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Launch a yellow signal flare at the tram that collapsed into the sewers on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)

== Rewards ==
+70,000 EXP
If I had told you what was inside, you wouldn't have agreed to this job. But don't worry, there's neither a virus nor radiation inside. You were right about one thing. Black Division has assignments beyond clearing facilities. There are still samples in Tarkov that TerraGroup's closest competitors would need at least ten years to obtain. I won't tell you what they are or what they do. Some things are worth more than the entire city and everyone living in it. People may die, but the gifts must survive into the new world. After Black Division's operation in Tarkov, there will be nothing left to stand in the way of the plan.

== Guide ==

All of the following has to be done in one raid, while also killing any 3 targets each on Interchange and Streets of Tarkov in the time period of 20:00-08:00.

You first have to obtain the carbon fiber case from the TerraGroup Object-14 container on Interchange. To access it, its power lever inside the "Saferoom Exfil" extraction in the parking garage section C has to be activated. To enter the extraction, power and Object #11SR keycard swipe in the "Burger spot" restaurant urinal are required. Note: Even when someone else has already activated the extraction, the urinal and the saferoom still have to be visited to complete the related objectives.

"Saferoom Exfil" location marked on map

The Object-14 container is located on the opposite side of parking garage section A. The case can be found under a metal shelf.

Object-14 location marked on map

In front of the Object-14 container
The case under the shelf

After obtaining the case you have to transit to Streets of Tarkov.

Transit location marked on map
The transit

Now the carbon fiber case has to be stashed at a balcony on the third floor of the Pinewood Hotel restaurant building on Streets of Tarkov.

As last step a yellow flare has to be fired into the sky while being next to the tram at the collpased sewers on Streets of Tarkov. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text:
전체 그림을 보고 싶지만, 여전히 도구라는 것을 잊습니다. 더 많은 것을 배우기 위해서는 상황을 뛰어넘고 익숙한 갈등 측면을 잊어야 합니다. 그 준비가 되는지 확실하십니까? 다음 임무에 대해 주의 깊게 들어보십시오. 다음 지침을 정확하게 따라야합니다. 먼저, 울트라 주차장 컨테이너 14에서 물체를 검색하십시오. 그렇게하려면, 전력 발전소에서 전력을 회복하고, 버거 스팟으로 올라가 화장실에서 숨겨진 패널을 찾아보세요. 패널에 있는 #11SR 표시 카드를 사용하여, 주차장에있는 테라그룹 방에 내려가십시오. 그것은 OLI에서 에스컬레이터와 주차장 벽에 있는 침전 옆에 있습니다. 콘테이너 14 아래에는 콘테이너 자체가 열립니다.
테라그룹라는 표시된 녹색 컨테이너를 찾아보세요. 가방이 들어온 후에는 시내로 이동하세요. 파인우드 호텔 3층의 레스토랑으로 이동하세요. 가방은 발코니에 남겨두세요. 그 후 지하에 붕괴된 트램 근처에 노란색 신호등을 보내세요. 그리고 기억하세요: 목격자가 없어야 합니다. 밤에는 작전을 수행하고, 당신을 볼 수 있는 사람이 살아 남지 마십시오. 모든 것이 끝나면, 내게 돌아가십시오.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: 시즌 모드로 플레이 중이어야 합니다.

sectionsKo.text:

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +70,000 EXP 만약 내가 당신에게 내부에 있는 것을 말했다면, 당신은 이 일을 동의하지 않았을 것입니다. 하지만 걱정하지 마세요, 내부에는 바이러스나 방사능이 없습니다. 한 가지에 대해 당신은 옳았습니다. 블랙 디비전는 클리어링 시설을 넘어서는 임무를 가지고 있습니다. 아직 타르코프에서 테라그룹의 가장 가까운 경쟁자들이 적어도 10 년이 필요할 수 있는 샘플이 있습니다. 그들이 무엇이며 무엇을 하는지 말하지 않을 것입니다. 어떤 것들은 도시 전체와 그 안에 사는 모든 사람들보다 더 가치 있습니다. 사람들은 죽을 수도 있지만 선물은 새로운 세계에 살아남아야 합니다. 타르코프에서 블랙 디비전의 운영 이후, 계획에 걸림돌이 아무것도 남지 않을 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text:
다음의 모든 작업은 한 번의 습격으로 이루어져야 하며, 인터체인지 및 타르코프 시내에서 각각 3 개의 목표물을 20:00-08:00 시간 내에 죽여야 합니다. 먼저 테라그룹 객체-14 컨테이너에서 탄소섬유 케이스를 가져야 합니다. 인터체인지에 액세스하려면 주차장 섹션 C에 있는 "사피룸 엑스필" 추출 내부의 파워 레버를 활성화해야합니다. 추출을 입력하려면, 파워 및 객체 #11SR 키를 "버거 스팟" 레스토랑 소변에 swipe해야합니다. 참고: 다른 사람이 이미 추출을 활성화 한 경우에도, 소변과 객체 14에 대한 연결을 완료해야합니다.
교통 장소 지도에 표시된 교통 장소 현재 탄소섬유 케이스는 타르코프 시내의 파인우드 호텔 레스토랑 건물의 3층 발코니에 숨겨져 있어야 합니다. 건물 위치 지도에 표시된 건물 입구 건물로 계단으로 가는 길, 3층으로 가는 길 발코니 문 발코니에 있는 위치 마지막 단계로 타르코프 시내의 램프 옆에 있는 동안 하늘로 노란색 플라어를 발사해야 합니다. 당신은 프라포르L1에서 구입할 수 있는 핸드 핸드 RSP-30 노란색 플라어를 사용하거나 예거1에서 구입할 수 있는 26x75mm 노란색 플라어 카트리지를 사용할 수 있습니다. 당신은 램프 뒤에 노란색 플라어를 겨냥하지만, 당신은 너무 많은 램프에 착륙하기 위해 표시 된 신호를 사용하여 RSP-30 총을 사용 할 수 있습니다.

objectivesKo: 그리고 미궁 내부의 "미노타우루"를 중화시켜 찾기

quests.content:
Indisputable Authority is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oi, operator! There's a job for you, I don't want no tosser for this. Everyone's been checking out the dungeons under the resort, you ought to know about it by now. They say there's a bogeyman sitting there, safeguarding the whole territory, yelling like a madman and chasing everyone outta there. Nobody can put him down! Some partners of mine have started asking questions, trying to drive down prices because of this situation. But let me tell you this: the key to authority is not to fuck up the opportunity. We need to act now, and we need to do it in a way that every little prick knows his place. So we gotta take this fucker down. If you do it in my name, so to speak, everyone will understand. You've got the skills, so this "Minotaur" idiot won't be a problem for you. But still, better be careful, this bastard is no joke either.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize the "Minotaur" inside The Labyrinth
Eliminate 6 of "Minotaur's" guards inside The Labyrinth

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1,650 Euros
1,733 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,898 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Tark Souls poster
3× AK CSS knurled charging handle
3× Zenit RK-1 tactical foregrip on B-25U mount
Unlocks purchase of AK CSS knurled charging handle at Skier LL3
Unlocks purchase of Zenit RK-1 tactical foregrip on B-25U mount at Skier LL4
I knew I bet on the right guy! So, all safe and sound, ye? Good for you, good for you... Word's already out about your feat, no one's gonna blabber any bullshit to me anymore. Surely a lasting impression. You helped my business today, so I won't disappoint you either. Here, all yours.

== Guide ==
In this quest you to have to kill Shadow of Tagilla and 6 Scavs inside The Labyrinth.

Shadow of Tagilla

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 오, 운영자! 당신에겐 직업이 있어, 이 일에 대해 바보가 필요 없어. 모두가 리조트 아래의 굴을 확인하고 있어, 이제야 알 수 있을거야. 그들은 거기 앉아 있는 괴짜가 있다고 말하며, 온 지역을 보호하고, 미친 사람처럼 소리치고, 모든 사람을 쫓아내고 있다고 말하며. 아무도 그를 내려놓지 못한다. 어떤 파트너는 이런 상황 때문에 가격을 낮추기 위해 질문을 던지기 시작했습니다. 하지만 내가 여러분에게 이것을 말하도록 해: 권력의 열쇠는 기회를 망치지는 않습니다. 우리는 지금 행동해야 합니다. 그리고 우리는 모든 작은 개자리가 자신의 위치를 알고 있는 방식으로 그것을 해야 합니다. 그래서 우리는 이 개자리를 내려야합니다. 당신이 내 이름으로 그것을하면, 그래서 모든 사람을 말해서, 이해합니다. 당신은 기술을 가지고 있습니다. 그래서 "미노타우르"이 바보는 문제가 될 수 없습니다. 하지만 당신은 여전히 더 나은 농담을 할 것입니다.

Now, let's begin. I have heard rumors that a certain group of people have decided to stick their noses into my business. I, as you can imagine, am not satisfied with that kind of activity. quests.content:
Informed Means Armed is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oh, Hey! Come here, lemme tell you something. Seems live I've settled into the region pretty well but I still can't shake this feeling you know? No confidence about what tomorrow's gonna bring. Ah forget it. Getting all gloomy for no reason... Anyway, I'd like to have a decent picture of  what's going on around here. Makes things a lot safer. I've got a couple of sketchy spots in mind where we should stick some smart cameras. Need you to watch two locations: put one camera near the pier by the sawmill in the woods. Place it right on the boards along the slope. Then set up the second one across from the entrance to Kiba. That's the shop in Ultra. You can probably get the cameras from Mechanic, I heard he was dealing them.

== Objectives ==
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the sawmill dock on Woods
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the Kiba Arms store entrance on Interchange

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.1
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
517 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
All this tech shit is clearly not for me, the picture is hazed and the signal is shit, but I've already spotted some "fat rats" while you were setting the last cams up. Thanks, huge help!

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks purchase of WI-FI Camera at Mechanic LL1.

== Guide ==

Placing each camera requires you to be stationary for 20 seconds, so be sure to secure the area first.

The first camera needs to be placed on top of a box in the "Brutal" store on Interchange.

Map with "Brutal" store camera location

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 오, 안녕하세요! 오, 여기 와서, 제가 여러분에게 한 가지 말씀드리겠습니다. 저는 이 지역에 꽤 잘 정착한 것 같습니다. 하지만 여전히 이 느낌을 떨칠 수 없습니다. 내일의 미래에 대한 확신이 없습니다. 아, 잊으세요. 이유 없이 모든 것을 어두워지고 있습니다. 어쨌든, 저는 여기 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는지에 대한 괜찮은 사진을 가지고 싶습니다. 그것은 훨씬 더 안전합니다. 저는 몇 가지 픽업 장소를 생각했습니다. 우리가 스마트 카메라를 붙여야 합니다. 당신은 두 곳을 관찰해야합니다. 우즈의 사우리 근처에 카메라 하나를 넣어 우즈에 있는 사우리 근처에. 슬라이드 따라 바로 보드 위에 배치. 그리고 두 번째를 설치합니다. 키바 입구 반대편에. 그것은 우트라 상점입니다. 당신은 아마도 ZTERM040XZ에서 카메라를 얻을 수 있습니다. 그는 그들을 거래하는 것을 들었습니다.

quests.content:
Intimidator is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings. There's quite a noticeable increase in the number of Scavs, have you noticed? Noticeable so much that my couriers can't even get through the previously safe areas, all get clapped indiscriminately can't even make a deal with them. We need to teach those bastards a lesson so that they piss their pants with any sound of gunshots in a kilometer radius. Shoot as many of those idiots as you can, and so that they know what's going on, get them in a manner they'll realize everything clearly. The shots all have to be in the head, I'll send some info on my channels so that people know who exactly sends the message.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 40 Scavs with headshots

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+2 Mag Drills skill levels
+4 Submachine Guns skill levels
Prapor Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× 7.62x39mm BP gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks craft for 7.62x39mm BP gzh at Workbench level 3

There you go, that's way better. Thank you, warrior. The guys are saying it's calmed down now, so looks like the morons understood your message.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 스캐브의 수가 상당히 증가하고 있습니다. 눈에 띄는 것은 너무도 눈에 띄는 것은, 이전까지 안전한 지역을 통과 할 수 없도록, 모든 사람들이 무차별적으로 박수를 받도록, 심지어 거래도 할 수 없습니다. 우리는 이 bastards에 교습을 가르쳐야 합니다. 그래서 그들은 1km 반경에 총 발의 소리와 바지를 비치도록합니다. 이 바보들 중 가능한 많은 사람들을 총에 맞게, 그리고 그들이 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는지 알 수 있도록, 그들을 모든 것을 명확하게 인식 할 수있는 방식으로 얻으십시오. 총은 모두 머리에 있어야 합니다. 나는 내 채널에 정보를 보내어 메시지를 보내는 사람을 정확히 알 수 있도록합니다.

quests.content:
Introduction is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Mercenary, come here, I've been waiting for you. Just a couple of hours ago, my old friend Jaeger got in touch with me and informed me that he had quite useful information for me. The package with the information I need is encrypted and is located in the Priozersk Natural Reserve area. Where exactly - Jaeger did not specify, but he left a clue: “Look where the hunter would wait for his prey. Where the iron bird has fallen”. Bring me this package and I'll introduce you to Jaeger, he'll definitely have work for you.

== Objectives ==
Find Jaeger's camp at the specified spot on Woods
Obtain Jaeger's encrypted message
Hand over the message to Mechanic

== Rewards ==
+4,500 EXP
30,000 Roubles
31,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
34,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks Jaeger as trader
Do you have it? Good job. Well, I think you're worthy to get in contact with Jaeger. He might have plenty of work for you.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Jaeger's encrypted message on Woods. The message is located under a hunting stand which is located in the eastern part of the location, near the crashed plane. Once you have obtained the message, you must extract from the location and hand it over to Mechanic.

quests.content:
Invasive Therapy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I ask that you not discuss this assignment with anyone. You may also keep any questions you have to yourself. Recently, one of my shipments of injectors was intercepted by the Rogues. It seems that after the battle at the treatment plant, they have started carrying out bolder and more aggressive raids in search of equipment and medical supplies. I would be more than happy to help the wounded, but these people are trying to obtain what they need behind my back! I'm sorry... In any case, I cannot allow them to conduct business this way, and I have no choice but to respond. This needs to be handled in such a way that they never try to take my goods without my knowledge again. They keep the medications taken from my group in their chalets. Replace some of them with experimental drugs produced by Sanitar.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 5 found in raid P22 (Product 22) stimulant injectors
(Optional) Find 5 P22 (Product 22) stimulant injectors in raid
Hand over 5 found in raid XTG-12 antidote injectors
(Optional) Find 5 xTG-12 antidote injectors in raid
Stash any Obdolbos cocktail injector in the med bay at the upper Rogue chalet on Lighthouse
Stash any Obdolbos cocktail injector in the guest hall supplies at the upper Rogue chalet on Lighthouse
Stash any Obdolbos cocktail injector in the ammo stockpile at the lower Rogue chalet on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Ophthalmoscope
I hope you haven't told anyone about our business. I think you understand how dangerous it is to show weakness in a place like Tarkov has become. After all, I pay you for your professionalism and impartiality in your work. Let's continue to uphold those standards.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to stash 3 Obdolbos injectors in the chalets on Lighthouse.

quests.content:
Inventory Files is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oh, hey, partner! I was just thinking: it’d be damn useful to have some intel on the shipments at Ultra. What was delivered, where it went, and in what quantities. You probably won't find stuff like that for the small stores, and honestly, that's not the kind of catch worth putting in all this effort for. I'm aiming bigger. Search Goshan, OLI, and IDEA for the records. They’re probably somewhere in the offices. Find them and bring them back.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the Goshan cargo manifests on Interchange
Hand over the Goshan cargo manifests to Ragman
Locate and obtain the OLI cargo manifests on Interchange
Hand over the OLI cargo manifests to Ragman
Locate and obtain the IDEA cargo manifests on Interchange
Hand over the IDEA cargo manifests to Ragman

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
You found the files from all three stores? Now that's just perfect!

== Guide ==

If retrieving the manifests on different raids, make sure to turn them in before entering another raid, as death will empty your quest inventory.

== IDEA Manifest ==
Head to the entrance of the IDEA office, on the left immediately after the main entrance. Once in there, look for a document on one of the center desks, perpendicular to the wall.

Locations marked on map
View of the entrance to the IDEA office, under the main entrance
The computer room where the manifest is located
The IDEA manifest is on a desk, in the IDEA computer room

== Goshan Manifest ==
Head to the small corridor north of Goshan (left, if entering the store from the front where the cash registers are). There, find the computer room and look for the manifest on the desk.

Locations marked on map
The Goshan manifest is on a desk, in the north Goshan computer room

== OLI Manifest ==
Turn right after entering Oli via the main entrance. Go to the back of the store and look for a cube-shaped desk. The desk is marked by a sign over it, the manifest will be laying on the desk.

Locations marked on map
Top of the escalator after the main entrance to the OLI store
View inside of the OLI store, where the cube-shaped desk is located
The OLI manifest is on a desk, in the information booth on the west part of the OLI

== See also ==
A Big Loss - The USEC counterpart quest

Ironclad Proof is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, tourist. How's life in Tarkov treating you? I figured your kind would be softer than this. Ah, never mind, let's get to business.

Everything's piling up on me at once. I'm out of grenades, and my clients are being a pain in the ass. I need your help. Show those idiots that the GP-25 underbarrel grenade launcher really gets the job done. And while you're at it, gather me some grenades. Our grenades, domestic Soviet ones.

This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Dialogue ==
I got word from my buddy that there's a special merchandise in town. You like movies? Then you'll certainly recognize this gun! There's only one little issue. The cargo went missing near the Ultra mall, I think somebody snatched it up. But man do I need these shotguns. It's a damn exclusive, you know what I'm saying? Anyway, why don't you take a little trip to Ultra and find this weapon crate there? If you get it, I'll pay you real good.

Well would you look at this. The customer is very pleased with the material. He even said that he himself would fit in well with the local culture with his blades and pistols. We really don't need any more katana lovers in leather suits around here... I hope his interest in Tarkov passes as quickly as it arose.

== Guide ==

Can be purchased from Mechanic LL1 after accepting the quest Informed Means Armed

In this quest you have to place 27 WI-FI cameras in different spots on Streets of Tarkov, Ground Zero, Lighthouse, Reserve, Customs, Factory, Woods and Shoreline.

== Trivia ==
The "outside contact" that is hinted at in the dialogue and success message, is the character "Deadpool" from the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
The "amphibian pizza lovers' hideout" is a reference to the "Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles" franchise.
The "burned girl's sickroom" is a reference to Alessa Gillespie, one of the main characters in the "Silent Hill" game series.
The "barbed wire body" is a reference to the game "Death Stranding".
The "really scary hole in the wall" is a reference to the game "Silent Hill 4: The Room".
The "high rise where one die-hard guy kicked ass" is a reference to the movie "Die Hard".
The "computer with a joke for programmers" is not a reference to anything in particular, but shows a folder with the name "gun porn", an opened text document with binary code that decodes to "there is no escape from Tarkov" as well as an ongoing "Minesweeper" game.
The "little chair surrounded by big black chairs" is a reference to the meme "Piper Perri Surrounded".
"Your friend Wilson" is a reference to the movie "Cast Away".
The "kindled rest place" is a reference to "Dark Souls" game series.
The "ominous welcome sign" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
The "megagenius scientist's seat" is a reference to the "Rick and Morty" sitcom series.
The "place where conscripts did a very important task" is a reference to soldiers cleaning their barracks for visits of higher-ups, even "painting the grass green" to make a good impression.
The "two chair riddle" is a reference to a Russian prison riddle/initiation ritual "There are two chairs. One has sharp knives sticking out. The other has erect penises. Which one do you sit on and which one do you have your mother sit on?"
"Every tank driver's first videogame" is a reference to the game "Battle City".
The "bucket-head villain" is a reference to the "Silent Hill" game series.
The "Anvil 3-4 crew member's execution site" is a reference to the game "Battlefield 3".
"Every indie developer's worst nightmare" is a reference to the game engine "Unity", which the game is made with. The developers have mentioned multiple times that the engine was not the best choice for the game.
The "room where the firefighter burned the books to become happy" is a reference to the novel "Fahrenheit 451".
The "place where some valve technicians couldn't finish their third project" is a reference to the unannounced game "Half-Life 3" from the developer Valve.
The "dangerous Russian chocolate beauty" is a reference to the chocolate brand "Alenka" and the "The Terminator" movie series.
The "conspiracy theorist's room" is a reference to the meme "Pepe Silvia".
"Where someone thought he'd get transported to the magic school" is a reference to the "Harry Potter" movie series.
The "mother of all strategy games" is a reference to the game "Minesweeper".
The "stairway to the skies" is a reference to the song "Stairway To Heaven" from Led Zeppelin.
The "bear who sat into a flaming car" is a reference to the Russian joke "Bear walks by the forest, sees a burning car. He sits inside and burns to ashes."
According to the developers, the room with the "upside-down chair" was originally planned to get a spooky atmosphere, but the idea was never finished.
The "not-so-lonely bathroom" is a reference to the meme "Versus Pooping".

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 정비사 LL1에서 구매할 수 있습니다. 퀘스트를 받아들인 후 정보화 수단 무장 이 퀘스트에서 당신은 타르코프 시내, 그라운드 제로, 라이트하우스, 리저브, 커스텀, 팩토리, 우즈 및 쇼어라인에 27 개의 와이파이 카메라를 다른 장소에 배치해야합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Streets of Tarkov
sectionsKo.text: 화상 소녀 병실 어린이 병원 2층. 벽에 정말 무서운 구멍 체카냐 13번 건물, 입문 후 오른쪽 화장실에서. 톱니바닥 몸 체카냐 13번 건물, 표시된 방 근처. 양수류 피자 애호가들의 은신처 "세워 리버" 추출 내부. 참고: 추출 구역에 위치한 대부분의 숨겨진 장소. 왼쪽 벽 근처에 머무르면 추출하지 않고 배치 할 수있는 작은 영역이 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Ground Zero
sectionsKo.text: 한 치열한 남자가 엉덩이를 치는 높은 상승 나카타니 건물의 수신 책상 뒤에. 프로그래머를 위한 농담을 가진 컴퓨터 Fusion 건물 남쪽 부분 내 1층에 위치한 Kyshperski 사무실에, 숲 벽화로 된 유리방에. 큰 검은 의자에 둘러싸인 작은 의자 Tarbank 건물의 세 번째 층 (라벨 5) 의 회의실에서.

sectionsKo.title: Lighthouse
sectionsKo.text: 악명 높은 환영 표지판은 주요 도로 일에서 북쪽에서 건설 노동자 객실 옆에 있습니다. 서쪽의 집 바로 해변에 위치하고 있는 서쪽의 휴식 장소. 당신의 친구 윌슨 바로 해변에 위치하고 있는 서쪽의 집 근처에 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Reserve
sectionsKo.text: 두 개의 의자 수수께끼 기차 저장소 근처의 경탑 옆에 모든 탱크 운전자의 첫 비디오 게임 의료 건물의 남쪽 벽에 (백 백교구). 병병들이 매우 중요한 작업을 수행하는 장소

sectionsKo.title: Customs
sectionsKo.text: 덤불 머신 악당 창고 #6, 남쪽 층의 욕실 내부. Anvil 3-4 승무원 집행 장소 창고 #6, 북쪽 층의 두 번째 층. 모든 인디 개발자의 최악의 악몽 3층 기숙사 2층, 212 방.

sectionsKo.title: Factory
sectionsKo.text: "게이트 3" 추출장 내부의 천문 계단. 음모 이론가의 방 사무실 부서의 3층의 잠금 방. 팩토리 응급 출구 열쇠가 필요했다. 소방관이 책을 태워서 행복해지기 위해 필요한 방. 사무실 부서의 1층에 있는 1층에 있는 1층에 있는 1층에 있는 1층에 있는 1층에 있는 1층에 있는 1층에 있는 1층에 있는 2층에 있는 2층에 있는 모든 전략 게임의 어머니.

sectionsKo.title: Woods
sectionsKo.text: 전력선 아래에서 북쪽의 폐허된 마을 남쪽에서 불타는 차에 앉아 있던 BEAR

sectionsKo.title: Shoreline
sectionsKo.text: 서쪽 마을 동쪽에 있는 1번 집 내부의 방에서 위쪽으로 내려오는 의자. 방 문은 깨질 필요가 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Trivia
sectionsKo.text:
대화와 성공 메시지에 암시되는 "외쪽 접촉"은 마블 영화 우주에서 등장하는 캐릭터 "죽은pool". "아피비아 피자 애호가들의 숨기는 곳"은 "청소년 돌연변이 닌자 거북" 시리즈에 대한 언급이다. "불태운 소녀의 병실"은 "시린트 힐" 게임 시리즈의 주요 캐릭터 중 하나인 앨레스 가릴스피에 대한 언급이다. "바른 철 몸"은 "죽음 스트랜딩" 게임에 대한 언급이다. "실제로 무서운 구멍 벽"은 "시린트 4: 더 룸" 게임에 대한 언급이다. "고속 한 남자가 엉덩이를 치는 높은 언덕"은 영화 "죽음의 거북"에 대한 언급이다. "프로그래머스에게 농담을 하는 컴퓨터"는 "XTER"에 대한 언급이 아니라, 코드 이름 "XTER"에 대한 언급이 있습니다. "XTER"는 "XTER"에 대한 문서입니다. "XTER"는 "XTER"에 대한 설명으로 "XTER"에 대한 설명이 있습니다.
"불타운 휴식 장소"는 "더크 소울스" 게임 시리즈에 대한 참조입니다. "악스러운 환영 표지판"은 "시런트힐" 게임 시리즈에 대한 참조입니다. "메가게니우스 과학자의 좌석"은 "리크 앤 모티" 시트콤 시리즈에 대한 참조입니다. "병병병들이 매우 중요한 작업을 수행한 장소"는 군인들이 높은 방문을 위해 바라크를 청소하는 것을 참조하고, 심지어 "초원을 녹색으로 칠하는 것"을 참조합니다. "두 개의 의자 수수께끼"는 러시아의 감옥 수수께끼 / 시작 의식에 대한 참조입니다. "두 개의 의자 있습니다. 하나는 날카로운 칼이 튀어나고 있습니다. 다른 하나는 페니스를 세우고 있습니다. 한쪽은 앉아있는 한쪽은 당신이 앉아있는 한쪽은 당신이 당신의 어머니 앉아있는 "모든 비디오 운전자의" 비디오 게임 상에 대한 참조입니다. "사일 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 게임" 시리즈의 "사일 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 빌 3"에 대한 참조입니다.
"모든 인디 개발자의 최악의 악몽"은 게임이 만들어지는 게임 엔진 "Unity"에 대한 언급입니다. 개발자들은 엔진이 게임에 가장 좋은 선택이 아니라는 것을 여러 번 언급했습니다. "방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방방
"BEAR가 불타는 차에 앉은"는 러시아의 농담을 참조한다. "BEAR는 숲 옆으로 걸어 다니고, 불타는 차를 보고, 안에 앉아 화상을 타는 것". 개발자들에 따르면, "반면 의자"의 방은 원래 공포스러운 분위기를 얻으려고 계획되었지만 아이디어는 끝나지 않았다. "너무 외로운 욕실"은 "버스스 푸핑"의 메미를 참조한다.

Jack of All Trades is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
We've already gone through the classes on my Arena, and I realized I never actually tested you on that knowledge. Forgot, you see? So come on, show me what you've learned. And don't you think this is pointless. This isn't freshman philosophy class! Anyone who can't switch tactics quickly over a few fights when needed will die. Or even worse, lose money.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 20 enemies as Assault
Eliminate 20 enemies as Enforcer
Eliminate 20 enemies as Scout
Eliminate 20 enemies as Marksman

+12,500 EXP

No shortage of patriots... I had a conversation with a group of BEARs the other day, we chatted about domestic weapons. Always nice to meet people who know their stuff!Just got a brand-new Kalashnikov in, and it needs a proper field test... Hmm, maybe somewhere with a mix of urban and open terrain? Yeah, that would be perfect. Here's the build. Go put it through its paces.

Only the AK-12 5.45x39 sound suppressor can be used. It's possible to use a compact reflex sight mounted on a canted rail instead of the Valday PS-320 1/6x scope to obtain the kills. The scope just needs to be installed to count towards the quest.

quests.content:
Keep Them in Line is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. I've received a contract that needs handling. I think you can guess who's behind it. Have you had any recent dealings with the Rogues' leaders? It seems they've had some sort of falling-out with Black Division operatives, or perhaps they've decided to turn against the Lighthouse altogether… They've been spotted wearing Black Division gear taken as trophies. Retaliation was only a matter of time. I've now been "asked" to find a suitable contractor and put an end to this. You were the first person who came to mind. If you don't think you can handle it, tell me now. This contract could cost me a couple of my deals with Lightkeeper. I'd rather not see all the groundwork I've put in go to waste because I hired an unreliable mercenary.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Knight (In one raid)
Locate and neutralize Big Pipe (In one raid)
Locate and neutralize Birdeye (In one raid)
Survive and extract from the location (In one raid)

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× Weapon case
5× TerraGroup Labs access keycard
1× Briefcase with documents
2× Black Division gear crate
Thank you for taking on this contract. I had a few backup candidates in mind for the job, but their chances of handling it properly were nowhere near as good as yours.

== Guide ==
All objectives have to be completed in a single raid, dying or extracting early fails the quest.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 용병. 내가 처리해야 하는 계약서를 받았습니다. 그 뒤에 누가 있는지 짐작할 수 있을 것 같습니다. 당신은 로그의 지도자들과 최근 거래를 해 보았습니까? 그들은 블랙 디비전의 요원들과 어떤 종류의 갈등을 겪었거나, 아니면 라이트하우스에 완전히 반발하기로 결정했을 것 같습니다. 그들은 블랙 디비전 장비를 입고 트로피로 취한 것을 발견했습니다. 복수하는 것은 단지 시간 문제였습니다. 이제 나는 적절한 계약자를 찾아서 이것을 끝내도록 요청되었습니다. 당신은 처음 생각되었습니다. 당신이 그것을 처리 할 수 없다고 생각하면, 지금 말해주세요. 이 계약은 라이트키퍼와 함께 한 몇 가지 거래를 할 수 있습니다. 나는 모든 용병을 고용한 것을 낭비하지 않았기 때문에 모든 재료를 낭비하지 않을 것이라고 생각합니다.

quests.content:
Keeper's Word is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I have a new job for you. Someone found a way into the cellars under the health resort. This is not a good set of circumstances for Tarkov. Excessive curiosity often ruins a man in peacetime, but in the present situation, the mistake of one will lead to the death of many. I know how to safeguard the bunker. You may not have yet met the wardens who watch the city at night. But they certainly have met you. And now I need you to leave a short message for them at the Knossos facility, with their instruments. However, just dropping these knives in the rubble won't be enough. You need places with meaning, so that the knife you stick in becomes a symbol of sorts. Which places should you choose? You'll figure it out on your own. And if you can't, why should I even work with you?

== Notes ==
You can't hand in this quest if you don't have a free special slot for the reward.

== Objectives ==
Stash a Cultist knife in the first special place inside The Labyrinth
Stash a Cultist knife in the second special place inside The Labyrinth
Stash a Cultist knife in the third special place inside The Labyrinth

== Rewards ==
+56,800 EXP
Lightkeeper Rep +0.03
4,200 Dollars
1× Virtex programmable processor
1× S I C C organizational pouch
1× Sacred Amulet
Perhaps now you've saved Tarkov from a new calamity that could have wiped the city off the face of the earth... before its time. Your reward is here. Oh, and one more thing. If I were you, I'd stop enquiring about those dungeons if you want to survive these troubled times.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to stash 3 Cultist knives in 3 specified locations inside The Labyrinth. One of the locations requires the Corpse room key.

Stashing locations marked on map
Location 1 at the Minotaur shrine.
Location 2 at the Minotaur shrine.
Location 3 in the corpse room. Corpse room key required.

== Trivia ==
During The Labyrinth event, this quest unlocked the Dungeon Master achievement.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 내가 당신에게 새로운 직업을 가지고 있다. 누군가 건강 휴양지 아래의 기저귀에 들어가는 길을 찾았어. 타르코프에게 좋은 상황은 아니다. 과도한 호기심이 평화시절에 사람을 망치게 하는 경우가 많지만, 현재 상황에서는 한 사람의 실수로 많은 사람들이 죽을 수 있다. 벙커를 어떻게 보호해야 하는지 알고 있다. 당신은 밤에는 도시를 지켜보는 경호자들을 아직 만나지 못했을 수도 있지만, 그들은 확실히 당신을 만나게 되었다. 그리고 이제 나는 당신이 그들에게 단편 메시지를 Knossos 시설에서 그들의 도구로 남겨주어야 할 것이다. 그러나, 단지 그 칼을 훼손하는 것만으로는 충분하지 않을 것이다. 당신은 의미있는 장소가 필요합니다. 그래서 당신이 붙이는 칼은 일종의 상징이 될 것입니다. 당신은 장소를 선택해야합니까? 당신은 그것을 스스로 알아낼 것입니다. 그리고 당신이 할 수 없다면, 나는 왜 당신과 함께 일해야합니까?

quests.content:
Key to the City is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
How's it going, brother? I heard the city's stirring up, collecting souvenirs, reminiscing over old times. And I just got a lead on something like this. They keep these things in museums. In the old days, each city had its own key, which the governor received at the time of establishment. I even saw one on a tour when I was a kid! They don't do that anymore, but Tarkov does have its own key, apparently! When the city was laid out, they made one for historical reference. And I know where to find it! If you bring it back, we'll make a fortune.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the souvenir key to the city on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
1× Item case
You got it? Nice! What do those numbers mean? Only the bright minds who know about Tarkov's history will understand that, probably.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the Tarkov City souvenir key in the museum on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building.

quests.content:
Key to Understanding is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I'm sure you've already heard about the new player in Tarkov's little conflict. I wouldn't offer this kind of job to just anyone, but this unit has my attention, and I want information straight from the source. That's where you come in. So far, my people haven't managed to intercept any of these fighters. It's as if they're always in the stronger position, and you can never catch them off guard... Which means the risks for you will be higher than usual. But I want to know more about their objectives and their plans, and unlike Prapor, there's no one who can tell me to back off. The first thing we need is to listen in on their communications. For that, I need fresh encryption keys the squad leaders carry on them. Think you can get them?

== Requirements ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 타르코프의 작은 갈등에서 새로운 플레이어에 대해 이미 들어보셨을 겁니다. 저는 이 종류의 직업을 누구에게나 제공하지 않을 겁니다. 하지만 이 단위는 내 관심을 가지고 있고, 정보도 바로 소스에서 얻고 있습니다. 여기서 당신이 들어갑니다. 지금까지, 제 사람들은 이 전투기 중 어느 하나를도 가로막지 못하고 있습니다. 마치 항상 더 강한 위치에 있고, 당신은 그들을 결코 경호하지 못할 것 같습니다. 즉, 위험은 평소보다 더 높을 것입니다. 하지만 그들의 목표와 계획에 대해 더 많은 것을 알고 싶습니다. 그리고 프라포르와 달리, 나를 뒤로 물러나라고 말할 수있는 사람은 없습니다. 우리가 필요로 하는 첫 번째 것은 그들의 통신을 듣습니다. 그 위해, 나는 암호 키가 필요합니다. 신선한 부대 지도자가 그들을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 그들을 얻을 수 있다고 생각하십니까?

Killer Argument is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Have you already heard that the driver has poached some of the traders over to his side? This kid's gotten a little far from his nest, so it's time to end it. I've made a deal with a certain someone to share some RPG ammo, enough to penetrate his BTR's armor. Now I need someone to deliver the package from the Scav house in Priozersk. Nobody knows about the delivery yet, so it should go smoothly. You gotta work fast, so that the driver doesn't find out what I'm preparing for him.

1,650 Euros

80× 6.8x51mm SIG FMJ

Very good! Now the BTR armor won't save the driver. Stay in touch, you'll be useful during the assault.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to pick up Lightkeeper's case from the Scav house on Woods. There are multiple spawns. The house can be found near the "Outskirts" extraction in the southwest of the location.

quests.content:
Know Your Enemy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Finally some good fucking news! Those assholes showed up on a couple of cameras in the city. Whole squad dressed in black, gear's definitely not Russian, but it doesn't look like USEC equipment either. That means someone got them across the border, and they sure as hell didn't come here with friendly intentions. We need to push back before they cut off all our routes. Can you bring me some of their gear? I've got a buddy who knows his way around this kind of stuff. Maybe he'll be able to tell us who we're about to go to war with. I'll need their body armor or rigs.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 3 any Black Division plate carriers

== Rewards ==
+11,000 EXP
180,000 Roubles
189,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
207,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× F-1 hand grenade
5× RGD-5 hand grenade
Excellent work. I don't think anyone but you could've taken down fighters like that right now. The sooner we find out where they train soldiers like these, and what bastard decided to send them into Tarkov, the better... Whoever's behind this has plenty of resources and even bigger ambitions.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 드디어 좋은 소식이 있어요! 이 멍청이들은 시내의 몇 카메라에 나타났습니다. 검은 옷을 입은 팀 전체가, 장비는 확실히 러시아가 아닙니다. 하지만 USEC 장비도 보이지 않습니다. 즉 누군가가 그들을 국경 건너게 한 것이고, 그들은 확실히 우호적인 의도로 여기 오지 않았다는 것입니다. 그들은 우리의 모든 경로를 끊기 전에 우리는 뒤로 밀어해야합니다. 당신은 그들의 장비 몇 가지 가져가 수 있습니까?

sectionsKo.text: 시즌 모드로 플레이 중이어야 합니다.

quests.content:
Know Your Place! is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Came here just when I needed you! I found a new delivery route across the city. Well, not exactly found it, per se. Someone moved a package from the city center to Ultra twice as fast as usual. These guys must have found a veteran guide who's been here before all the electronics were shut down... Maybe even someone like this crazy guerilla mushroom guy, you heard of him? He'd show up out of nowhere, even been taken captive. But he always found a way to get out and lose his pursuers. Either way, we need to take control of the route. Find the place where those smugglers emerge from, and show everyone that this is now Ragman's route! So yeah, go ahead and scare everyone off in the city and near Ultra.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 5 targets on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Use the transit from Streets of Tarkov to Interchange (In one raid)

I think we got the wrong guys, man. Someone came by and told me that this route is used by some very important people. Should've thought this through...

Southwest of the Concordia apartment complex. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 내가 당신을 필요로 할 때 바로 왔어요! 내가 도시를 가로지르는 새로운 배달 경로를 찾았어요. 그 자체로 정확히 발견하지 못했습니다. 누군가가 보통보다 두 배 더 빨리 도시 중심에서 울트라로 패키지를 옮겼습니다. 이 사람들은 전자기기가 종료되기 전에 이곳에 있던 참전용사 가이드를 찾았을 것입니다. 어쩌면 이 미친 게릴라 버섯 인 사람도, 당신은 그를 들어봤습니다. 그는 아무 곳에서도 나타나거나 포로로 잡혔습니다. 하지만 그는 항상 탈출하고 추격자를 잃는 방법을 찾았습니다. 어쨌든, 우리는 경로를 통제해야합니다. 그들이 밀수하는 사람들이 나오는 곳을 찾아서, 이것이 이제 레그맨의 경로가라는 것을 보여주십시오. 그래서 예, 모든 사람들을 가서 도시와 울트라 근처에서 모든 사람들을 겁에 빠뜨립니다.

quests.content:
Living High is Not a Crime is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Howdy, I've got a nice little job for you. A guy came to me recently, says he used to know Reshala. Real high roller dude. Nice suit, signet ring the size of a bottle cap. I ran into him once before during a business dispute, think he drove a black BMW. He says war is war, but he still wants to decorate his place... his hideout, to be exact. Bring me as much jewelry and as many fancy trinkets as you can. I'll pass them along to him. Golden horse statues, cats, lions, anything like that will do. And see if you can find a gold Roler watch too. That'll be a little bonus. Trust me, brother, it's better to stay on good terms with people like him. Don't let me down, or it'll be bad for both of us.

== Objectives ==
Find 2 Bronze lion figurines in raid
Find 2 Horse figurines in raid
Find 2 Golden rooster figurines in raid
Find 2 Cat figurines in raid
Find 2 Roler Submariner gold wrist watches in raid
Find 2 Golden eggs in raid

288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
