Thank you, brother. I'll pass everything along. Fine jewelry like this is always a welcome sight. I've got a feeling he's gonna like it.

== Guide ==

The statues/figurines can commonly be found in the furniture displays throughout the store IDEA on Interchange. Alternatively, they, along with the Roler Submariner gold wrist watch and Golden egg can be found in Safes. They can also be very rarely be found in other containers such as Drawers, Sport bags, Dead Scavs, and more.

Come here already. Alright, so along the entire coast of the cape, there is a road, you've probably seen it. My guys use this road to transport merchandise to and from me. Usually, they managed to avoid trouble or calm some particular morons down, but right now it's a damn rat nest there, probably found out about my convoys. They started attacking my guys with full power, can't get through them at all. Go there and lay those whack-jobs down, will you? I'll get something nice for you in return.

== Dialogue ==
Young man, I require your assistance. The other day, I sent a group of workers to collect supplies in the Cape Dalniy area, to the former USEC base of operations in the cottage area. I think you are more than familiar with this place, given the nature of your work. This mission is vital to getting supplies out of this zone. Unfortunately, the group has ceased all communication since yesterday. We suspect someone found out about our operation. Please, mercenary, find my people and, most importantly, their cargo.

quests.content:
Luxurious Life is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey! You did well on the first job, but it's not enough to make me happy. You're gonna have to do a little more legwork, soldier. I need to find a bottle of wine. I myself am more of a hard drinker, but I know a man who collects wine. And not just any kind, but the rarest kind! I want to give him a bottle as a gesture of goodwill. Nowadays in Tarkov, any connections with reputable people are worth their weight in gold, you know? There was a liquor store in the city center. They used to sell booze three times the price, for the elite folks. I'm sure there's some left. Go there and search the place and get me a good bottle of some French wine! And don't even try to slip me some fake shit.

== Objectives ==
Locate the liquor store on Ground Zero
Locate and obtain the wine bottle in the store
Hand over the wine bottle

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
O-ho, that's a beautiful bottle! The man is gonna love it. Here's your reward, well deserved.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a wine bottle in the liquor store on Ground Zero. The wanted store is called "ASAP winery" and located across the street from the TerraGroup building complex. There are multiple spawns throughout the store.

sectionsKo.text: 첫 번째 작업에서 잘했지, 하지만 나를 행복하게 해주는 건 충분하지 않아. 당신은 좀 더 많은 일을 해야 할군. 나는 와인 병을 찾아야 한다. 나는 더 열심히 마시는 사람이지만, 와인 수집하는 사람을 알고 있다. 그리고 어떤 종류의 것도 아니라, 가장 드문 종류의! 나는 그에게 좋은 의지를 표시하는 것으로 병을 주고 싶다. 요즘 타르코프에서, 명실있는 사람들과의 모든 연결은 금에 가치가 있습니다. 당신은 알고 있습니다. 도시의 중심에 술 가게가 있었다. 그들은 술을 세 배로 판매했습니다. 엘리트 사람들을 위해. 나는 확신합니다. 약간의 남아있다. 거기 가서 장소를 검색하고 나에게 좋은 병의 프랑스 와인 좀 가져와! 그리고 심지어 가짜 물건을 날 튀기 시도하지 마십시오.

quests.content:
Make Amends is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Lightkeeper said he's ready to accept you in again. But the old flash drive doesn't work anymore, so you'll have to find a new one, reflash the transmitter, and give it to me. I'll update your transmitter properly.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the V3 Flash drive on Lighthouse
Reflash the Radio transmitter
Hand over the flash drive to Mechanic
Visit the Lighthouse building

== Rewards ==
Mechanic Rep +0.01
Hope all this mess doesn't happen again.

== Guide ==
By killing Zryachiy you will fail and lose access to this quest.

There are multiple spawns for the V3 flash drive at the black (southern) chalet on Lighthouse. After obtaining it, you have to reflash the transmitter at the Intelligence Center level 2 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the Claymores and Zryachiy guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet Lightkeeper.

Note: If not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter, it will have the "blocked" state and the bridge can't be passed.

sectionsKo.text: Zryachiy를 죽이면 이 탐색에 대한 접근이 실패하고 손실됩니다. 라이트하우스의 검은 (남) 샤렛에서 V3 플래시 드라이브에 대한 여러 번의 스파운이 있습니다. 그것을 얻으면 은신처에서 정보 센터 레벨 2에서 송신기를 다시 켜야합니다. 전체 프로세스 동안 전기가 필요합니다. 그렇지 않으면 중단됩니다. 다시 켜지기가 완료되면 송신기가 완전히 기능적이며 클레이모레스와 Zryachiy를 건너뛰고 라이트하우스 반도까지의 다리를 지키고 라이트하우스 빌딩과 라이트키퍼를 방문 할 수 있습니다. 참고: 로비 그룹 구성원 모두가 콤프드된 송신기를 만나지 않으면, "블록"이 될 수 있습니다.

Make Amends - Buyout is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I hear you've pissed off Lightkeeper. Friend, I won't get involved in your personal affairs, but be very careful, okay? Stay out of trouble. You've seen for yourself what this man is capable of. Well, we can still make up for it. Remember the situation with the ransom and the extortion of the traders? I remember it well. I think we can at least bribe Lightkeeper.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Listen, mercenary, I've made arrangements with Lightkeeper for a test delivery of the supplies he needs from the list. I think I might be able to get close to him. That's what I wanted to talk to you about. There's a rumor going around that you two have trust issues. So let's help each other. You find me the supplies I need, and I'll handle the transportation. I'll put in a good word for you. Okay, he needs... Whoa. He needs sniper rifles, and lots of them.

== Dialogue ==
Mercenary, by spoiling relations with the Lightkeeper, you also obstruct me. It's one thing to feud with some looters, but you don't mess with Lightkeeper, believe me. I'll tell him you're willing to redeem yourself and do some work for him. For all I know, he's collecting data on movements inside the Lab right now. We'll set up a camera inside and send a signal to Lightkeeper. Deal?

== Objectives ==
Place a WI-FI Camera inside the quarantine zone in The Lab

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
Picture's clear, that's good. Let's not make any jokes with Lightkeeper this time, shall we, friend?

== Guide ==

Despite the quest objective suggesting to place a WI-FI Camera in the quarantine zone (Blue keycard), it actually has to be placed in the human experiment's area (Black keycard).

Experiment's area marked on map
Placement location

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 용병님, 라이트키퍼와의 관계를 망치고, 당신은 또한 저를 방해합니다. 그것은 일부 약탈자들과의 싸움이 한 가지 일이지만, 당신은 라이트키퍼와 을하지 않습니다, 나를 믿어요. 당신은 자신을 구출하고 그를 위해 약간의 일을 할 준비가 있다고 그에게 말할 것입니다. 내가 아는 것만큼, 그는 지금 연구소 내부의 움직임에 대한 데이터를 수집하고 있습니다. 우리는 카메라를 설치하고 라이트키퍼에 신호를 보낼 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: WI-FI 카메라를 연구소의 격리 구역 안에 배치

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: 라이트키퍼 Reps +0.01 그림이 명확해, 좋습니다. 이번에는 라이트키퍼에 대해 농담하지 않겠습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 위 와이-파이 카메라를 격리 구역에 배치하는 것을 제안하는 탐구 목표에도 불구하고 (블루 키 카드) 실제로는 인간 실험 영역에 배치되어야합니다 (블랙 키 카드).

quests.title: Make Amends - Security
objectivesKo: 라이트하우스에서 물 처리 시설에 접근하는 남쪽 다리의 노란색 버스에 와이파이 카메라를 배치하십시오.
WI-FI 카메라를 라이트하우스에 있는 물처리소의 남동부 부분에 있는 노란색 붐더저에 배치한다
라이트하우스에서 물 처리 시설의 서쪽 부분의 경찰 트럭에 와이파이 카메라를 설치하십시오
라이트하우스에 있는 물처리소의 북부지역의 산업 구역 근처에 군용 트럭에 WI-FI 카메라를 설치
quests.content:
Make Amends - Security is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
These are difficult times we live in, indeed. I can help you regain Lightkeeper's trust. I don't see the point in having a conflict. So, he wants wireless cameras placed around the perimeter of the Rogue base, apparently, for security purposes. Try to stay away from the base itself - I don't think Rogues know that you're acquainted with their friend.

== Requirements ==
Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the second time.

== Objectives ==
Place a WI-FI Camera at the yellow bus on the southern bridge approaching the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Place a WI-FI Camera at the yellow bulldozer in the south-eastern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Place a WI-FI Camera at the police truck in the western part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse
Place a WI-FI Camera at the army truck near the industrial zone in the northern part of the water treatment plant on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
The cameras are set up, the signal is coming through. Lightkeeper is happy, which is great news.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to place 4 WI-FI Cameras at different vehicles around the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

Vehicles marked on map
The bus
The bulldozer
The police truck
The army truck

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 이 시대는 정말 어려운 시대입니다. 라이트키퍼의 신뢰를 되찾는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 난 갈등을 갖는 것이 의미가 없다고 생각합니다. 그래서 그는 로그 기지의 주변을 무선 카메라가 배치하기를 원합니다. 분명히, 보안 목적으로. 기지에서 멀리 떨어져있는 것을 시도하십시오.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements

sectionsKo.text: 이 탐사에는 라이트하우스의 물 처리 시설 주변에서 4개의 WI-FI 카메라를 배치해야 합니다.

quests.title: Make Amends - Software
objectivesKo: 15개 보안 플래시 드라이브에 대한 침습 건네기
quests.content:
If you get your DSPT decoded a fourth time after finishing this questline, there is no way to get it encoded again!

Make Amends - Software is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I understand if you and Lightkeeper have disagreements, but solving them with violence is not the answer. It taints our entire ecosystem. Okay, listen, I'm running out of software from the corporate flash drives that I use to flash transponders for Lightkeeper. Help me with these flash drives, and I'll try to change Lightkeeper's mind about you.

== Requirements ==
Getting the Digital secure DSP radio transmitter decoded the third time.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 15 found in raid Secure Flash drives

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
Great, thank you. I'll take it from here.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 라이트키퍼와 의견이 분분할 수 있는 경우 이해하지만 폭력으로 해결하는 것은 해결책이 아닙니다. 그것은 우리 생태계를 오염시킵니다. 좋습니다, 들어보세요, 저는 라이트키퍼의 플래시 트랜스폰더를 사용하는 회사 플래시 드라이브의 소프트웨어가 부족합니다. 이 플래시 드라이브에 도움이 되십시오. 그리고 저는 라이트키퍼의 생각을 당신에 대해 바꾸려고 노력하겠습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: 디지털 보안 DSP 라디오 송신기를 세 번째 해독했습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 15개 보안 플래시 드라이브에 대한 침습 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: 라이트키퍼 Rep +0.01 좋아요, 감사합니다.

quests.title: Make Amends - Sweep Up
objectivesKo: 레이더에서 25 리저브를 제거하십시오.
quests.content:
Make Amends - Sweep Up is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Friend, now is not the time to spoil relations with influential people. Lightkeeper told me about your conflicts. He offers a deal - you help his allies with their personal problems, and he forgets old grudges. We need to eliminate a group of Raiders encroaching on Rogue territory. You'll have to sweep their ranks at the federal reserve base. Can you do that?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 25 Raiders on Reserve

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
Lightkeeper told me that you had completed the "request". Thank you.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 25 Scav Raiders on Reserve.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 친구, 이제 영향력 있는 사람들과의 관계를 망칠 때가 아닙니다. 라이트키퍼은 당신의 갈등에 대해 이야기했습니다. 그는 거래를 제안합니다. 당신은 자신의 동맹군에게 그들의 개인적인 문제들을 도와주고, 그는 오래된 적대함을 잊습니다. 우리는 레이더의 그룹을 제거해야합니다. 로그 영토에 침입. 당신은 연방 리저브 기지에서 그들의 순위를 휩쓸어야 할 것입니다. 당신은 할 수 있습니까?

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 레이더에서 25 리저브를 제거하십시오.

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: 라이트키퍼 Rep +0.01 라이트키퍼는 당신이 "소원을" 완료했다고 말했다. 감사합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐사선에서 스캐브 레이더에서 25명의 리저브를 죽여야 합니다.

quests.title: Make an Impression
objectivesKo: 필요한 볼트 액션 라이프 기술 레벨 10을 달성
200m 이상 떨어진 곳에서 10개의 사격기를 제거하십시오.
quests.content:
Make an Impression is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
It seems that before my marksman decides to take risks at your prepared positions, he needs proof of your skill as an experienced spotter. Which makes sense. Time allows, thankfully. Let's just say there are snipers in and around the city who are operating out of their positions. Improve your counter-sniper skills, and then my man will trust you. Go on then, seven feet under the keel.

== Objectives ==
Reach the required Bolt-action Rifles skill level of 10
Eliminate 10 Sniper Scavs from over 200 meters away

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.04
2× Phased array element
1× Substation marked key
1× Lighthouse island stash key
Unlocks the Lightkeeper service "Zryachiy support"
We've been watching you. My shooter gave the go-ahead. That's all for now. I'll let you know when the time comes.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 10 snipers from the Scavs faction from over 200 meters away, and reach level 10 in the bolt-action rifles skill. The Vortex Ranger 1500 rangefinder or the Wilcox RAPTAR ES Tactical Rangefinder can be used to determine the required distance.

Aside from regular sniper Scavs, the following enemies also count:
Shturman
Shturman's followers
Glukhar's scout followers
Kaban's snipers

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 제 총격자는 준비된 위치에서 위험을 감수하기 전에, 경험이 풍부한 탐사자로서의 능력을 증명해야 한다고 생각합니다. 그건 의미가 있습니다. 시간이 허락합니다. 다행히도.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
필요한 볼트 액션 라이프 기술 레벨 10을 달성
200m 이상 떨어진 곳에서 10개의 사격기를 제거하십시오.

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: 라이트키퍼 Rep +0.04 2× 단계열 요소 1× 하위 스테이션 표시 키 1× 라이트하우스 섬 저장 키 라이트키퍼 서비스를 잠금 해제 "Zryachiy 지원" 우리는 당신을 지켜보고 있습니다. 내 슈팅은 진행했다. 그것은 현재에 대한 전부입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐정에서 당신은 200m 이상에서 스캐브 단위에서 10명의狙击手들을 죽이고, 볼트 액션 총 기술에서 10위를 달성해야 한다. 원격을 결정하기 위해 Vortex Ranger 1500 랜저 또는 Wilcox RAPTAR ES 전술 랜지핑을 사용할 수 있다. 일반狙击手 스캐브 이외에도 다음 적들도 수 있습니다.

quests.title: Make ULTRA Great Again
objectivesKo: 인터체인지에 대한 10개의 목표물을 제거하십시오
quests.content:
Make ULTRA Great Again is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Back in the day, Ultra was always packed: moms with their kids, couples, random people just wandering around. I always liked that kind of energy! But now... Ah, forget the reminiscing. Time to get things done. I don't like how Scavs and everyone else stroll into Ultra like they own the place, hauling off anything that isn't nailed down. Head over there and remind them it isn't their territory. Once you've cleared things up, I'll send my boys in to bring a little life back to the place.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 targets on Interchange

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
My guys said it'll take them another week to clear out all the bodies. Good work!

== Guide ==
Scavs can commonly be found at the front of OLI, Goshan, IDEA. Another spawn is in the main center hall of the mall, near the Kiba gun store. You can find more at power station, and also the road that runs parallel to the mall on the opposite side of the parking lot.

== Trivia ==
The quest name is likely a reference to the slogan "Make America Great Again", which was used by several US presidential election candidates in their election campaigns.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 옛날엔 울트라가 항상 가득 차있었어요. 엄마와 자식, 커플, 무작위 사람들이 돌아다니는 것. 저는 항상 그런 에너지를 좋아했습니다. 하지만 이제... 기억을 잊어 버립니다. 일을 다 할 때가 됐습니다. 저는 스캐브와 다른 사람들이 울트라로 돌아다니는 것을 좋아하지 않습니다. 그들이 집을 소유하고 있는 것처럼, 못 박혀진 모든 것을 끌어내려요. 가서 그들에게 그것이 그들의 영토가 아니라는 것을 상기시켜주십시오. 일단 당신이 모든 것을 정리하면, 나는 내 소년들을 다시 이곳에 살도록 보낼 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 인터체인지에 대한 10개의 목표물을 제거하십시오

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +3,000 EXP 레그맨 평판 +0.1 80,000 루블 84,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 92,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 스캐브는 일반적으로 OLI, Goshan, IDEA의 전면에서 발견된다. 또 다른 스파운은 쇼핑몰의 주요 중심 홀, Kiba 총기 매장 근처에 있다. 당신은 발전소에서 더 많은 것을 찾을 수 있으며, 또한 주차장의 반대편에 쇼핑몰과 병행하는 도로에 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Trivia
sectionsKo.text: 퀘스트 이름은 아마도 여러 미국 대통령 선거 후보가 선거 캠페인에서 사용한 "미국을 다시 위대하게 만들어라"라는 슬로건을 참조하는 것입니다.

quests.title: Master Key
objectivesKo: 쇼어라인의 헬스 리조트의 폐쇄된 건물의 열쇠 찾아 확보하기
피스키퍼에게 열쇠 건네기
quests.content:
Master Key is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, how are you? I know, probably not exactly amazing. These are difficult times. My men have discovered several interesting rooms inside the Health Resort, but unfortunately they are locked. They used to be occupied by USEC soldiers. Their keys were kept at the checkpoint, inside the concrete bunker northwest of the Resort. They evacuated in a hurry, so they may have left something behind. Bring me the keys to those rooms.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the key to the closed premises of the Health Resort on Shoreline
Hand over the key to Peacekeeper

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
550 Dollars
578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× CPU fan
Unlocks purchase of HK MP5 9x19 submachine gun (Navy 3 Round Burst) at Peacekeeper LL2
Excellent, great work! So, a single key is used for all of the rooms...

== Guide ==

The Key to the closed premises of the Health Resort has to be picked up on Shoreline, laying on a chair in the bunker that is located north of the health resort. It only spawns while the quest is active. Once retrieved, you must extract and turn in the item to Peacekeeper. If you die after retrieving it and before turning it in, you will have to go and retrieve it again.

Bunker marked on map
The bunker north of the health resort
The key on the chair

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 안녕하세요. 저는 잘 모르겠어요. 이 시간들은 정말 어려운 시간일지도 모릅니다. 제 사람들은 헬스 리조트 내부에서 몇 개의 흥미로운 방을 발견했지만 불행히도 잠겨 있습니다. 그들은 USEC 군인들이 점령하고 있었습니다. 그들의 열쇠는 리조트 북서쪽 콘크리트 벙커 내부에서 체크포인트에 보관되어 있었습니다. 그들은 서둘러 탈출했습니다. 그래서 그들은 뒤에 무언가를 남겼을지도 모릅니다. 그 방의 열쇠를 가져오십시오.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
쇼어라인의 헬스 리조트의 폐쇄된 건물의 열쇠 찾아 확보하기
피스키퍼에게 열쇠 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +3,000 EXP 피스키퍼 평판 +0.1 550 달러 578 달러 정보 센터 레벨 1 632 달러 정보 센터 레벨 2 3 × CPU 팬 피스키퍼 LL2에서 HK MP5 9x19 소총 (해군 3 라운드 버스트) 구매를 해제합니다

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 건강 리조트의 폐쇄된 건물의 열쇠는 쇼어라인에서 가져와 건강 리조트 북쪽에 위치한 벙커의 의자 위에 놓여 있어야 합니다. 탐구가 활발하다가만 생기는 것입니다. 일단 검색하면 아이템을 피스키퍼에 추출하고 돌려야합니다. 당신이 그것을 검색하고 나서 죽으면, 그것을 돌려놓기 전에 다시 가져가야 합니다. 지도에 표시 된 벙커 건강 리조트 북쪽에 있는 벙커 의 열쇠

quests.title: Metal Birds
objectivesKo: 우즈의 모터 컨트롤러 찾아 확보하기
발견된 항목 건네기
우즈에 있는 단일축 광섬유 지로스코프 찾아 확보하기
발견된 항목 건네기
quests.content:
Metal Birds is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello again! Modern warfare is a really high-tech enterprise. My men have spotted drones operating in Tarkov. They were shot down, but we were unable to recover them. Search the Woods for them. If you find the controller or any other components, bring them to me. You will be well compensated.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the motor controller on Woods
Hand over the found item
Locate and obtain the single-axis fiber optic gyroscope on Woods
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
550 Dollars

quests.content:
Minibus is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oh, so glad to see you. Let’s go straight to business, I have to deliver stuff quite frequently, and carrying everything as a mule is hardly an option anymore. All vehicles are dead after some kind of EMP strike during the conflict. Nothing starts no matter how hard you try, even if you take them apart and put them back together, only cars that came from outside can still run. There are bound to be some minibusses at the parking lot at the Interchange, mark at least three of them with beacons. My mechanics will examine them in detail, maybe there is a chance of success if I procure some electronics from the outside. Just do it right, don't need no pieces of trash. Look for the yellow ones, you'll figure it out.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first yellow minibus with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Locate and mark the second yellow minibus with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Locate and mark the third yellow minibus with an MS2000 Marker on Interchange
Hand over 10 any found in raid items from the Tools category

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Phase control relay
1× MSA Sordin Supreme PRO-X/L headset
1× Walker's XCEL 500BT Digital headset
1× ANA Tactical Beta 2 Battle backpack (Olive Drab)
Welcome back. The signal is clear, all good, I'll send the guys to salvage the cars. Thank you, helped a brother out.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to mark 3 yellow minibuses with MS2000 Markers on Interchange and hand over 10 found in raid items from the tools category.

The first one is located southwest of the mall at the container lot.

Location marked on map
Minibus 1 in the container lot.

The other two are in the western parking garage.
One of them can be found at the transition from section B to section C, close to the blocked-off down-ramp.
The second one is located in section C, right next to the "Saferoom Exfil" extraction and the hole in the wall that connects the western with the eastern parking garage.

Locations marked on map
Minibus 2 close to the blocked-off down-ramp
Minibus 3 opposite of the "Saferoom Exfil"

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 오, 당신을 만나서 너무 기쁘네요. 직행으로 가자, 저는 물건을 꽤 자주 배달해야 합니다. 그리고 모든 것을 무얼처럼 운반하는 것은 더 이상 선택의 여지가 없습니다. 모든 차량은 어떤 종류의 EMP 파격 후 충돌 중에 죽습니다. 아무리 노력해도 아무것도 시작되지 않습니다. 아무리 해체하고 다시 함께 넣어도, 외부에서 온 자동차만이 여전히 실행할 수 있습니다. 인터체인지 주차장에서 몇 개의 미니버스가 있을 것입니다. 적어도 세 가지 버스를 신호등으로 표시하십시오. 내 기계는 자세히 살펴보고, 아마도 외부에서 전자 제품을 구입하면 성공할 가능성이 있습니다. 그냥 올바르게 수행하십시오. 쓰레기 조각이 필요하지 않습니다. 노란색을 찾아보십시오. 당신은 그것을 알아낼 것입니다.

== Dialogue ==
Sup, bandit! How's life? A little birdie told me there's a special magazine in the Ultra mall at the Interchange. They wrote about our Russian video game, which is recognized all over the world! I guess the guys really came up with a great concept!

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

== Guide ==

The magazine can be found on the second floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange, in a book store called "МУЗЕЙ ИСТОРИИ" ("Museum of History"). There are multiple spawns throughout the store.

quests.content:
Missing Cargo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, tactical, come on in! Do you remember that civilian helicopter that was shot down somewhere by the Lighthouse, according to rumors? So, the headache is that on that helicopter was a certain man with an inconspicuous folder, but it, in fact, was very much conspicuous - a lot of money was paid for it. Well, a birdie said the helicopter got shot down somewhere on the way to our meeting point. So here's your task: confirm the helicopter's whereabouts and that the rumors are true. Then find that folder for me, it's extremely important. I've got no idea who could've shot it down, honestly. Who's got the resources for that?.. USECs? I did hear that they took a liking to those cottages near the mountains, so it might be worth checking that area out. Hope those stray westerners didn't nick my goodie.

== Objectives ==
Locate the crashed helicopter on Lighthouse
Locate and obtain the informant's intelligence folder
Hand over the folder to Skier

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.75
1,650 Euros
1,732 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,897 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2

Opa, here's my goodie! So, it indeed was in the USEC cottages, you're saying? And the damn chopper was there too? Looks like the rumors were true. I knew it couldn't have gone far. Otherwise, there would've been a big uproar! The USECs had no reason to spread the info through, they were probably waiting for orders from the command, but, well, you know what happened. Alrighty, here's your reward.

== Guide ==

The crashed helicopter is located on a hill in the south-southeast of Lighthouse.

Helicopter marked on map
The wanted helicopter

The documents can be found on the first floor of the chalet that is located on the hill in the south-east of Lighthouse.

Chalet marked on map
The chalet
The documents are located in a black files folder on a desk to the right after you enter
Documents in the files folder

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 타크틱, 들어와! 소문에 따르면 라이트하우스가 어딘가에서 격추한 민간 헬리콥터를 기억하십니까? 그래서, 두통은 헬리콥터에 눈에 띄지 않는 폴더를 가진 특정 사람이 있었기에 있습니다. 하지만 실제로는 매우 눈에 띄었습니다. 많은 돈을 지불했습니다. 새가 헬리콥터가 우리 만남의 장소로 가는 길에 어딘가에서 격추되었다고 말했습니다. 그래서 여기 당신의 임무는: 헬리콥터의 위치를 확인하고 소문이 사실입니다. 그 폴더를 찾은 것은 나에게 매우 중요합니다. 솔직히 누가 격추했을 수 있는지 모르겠어요. 누가 그것을 가지고 있는지 모르겠어요. USECs? 나는 그들이 그 산 근처에 있는 동굴을 좋아했다고 들었습니다. 그래서 내 근처에 있는 동굴을 확인하는 것이 가치가 있습니다. 내 근처에 있는 동굴은 좋은 것이 아닐까봐요.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
라이트하우스에서 추락한 헬리콥터 찾기
정보주체의 정보 폴더 찾아 확보하기
스키어에게 폴더 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +28000 EXP 스키어 평판 +0.75 1,650 유로 1,732 유로 정보 센터 레벨 1 1,897 유로 정보 센터 레벨 2 Opa, 여기 내 좋은 친구! 그래서, 정말 USEC 집안에 있었다고, 당신은 말하고 있습니까? 그리고 저 망할 헬리콥터도 거기 있었다고? 소문이 사실처럼 보입니다. 나는 그것이 멀리 갈 수 없었을 것을 알고 있었다. 그렇지 않으면 큰 소란이 있었을 것입니다. USEC는 정보를 퍼뜨릴 이유가 없었을 것입니다. 그들은 아마도 지휘로부터 명령을 기다리고 있었겠지만, 잘, 당신은 무슨 일이 있었는지 알고 있습니다. 좋습니다, 여기 당신의 보상이 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 추락한 헬리콥터는 라이트하우스의 남남동쪽의 언덕에 위치하고 있습니다. 지도에 표시된 헬리콥터 수색된 헬리콥터 문서들은 라이트하우스의 남동쪽의 언덕에 위치한 차렛의 첫 층에 있습니다. 차렛은 지도에 표시되어 있습니다. 차렛 문서들은 파일에 있는 파일에 있는 검은 파일에 위치하고 있습니다.

The informant set up a meeting near the car dealership, at a hidden spot? So why the hell are you still here? If he gets busted while you're still here, look for a hidden hideout, a spare key for it must be somewhere in there too. Find everything he's dug up. Don't let me down.

It looks like the rumors have been confirmed after all. Someone really dared to start undermining me. These snakes are going to meet at the old federal reserve base, to transfer information. Come back later, while I figure out what to do about it.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to locate both of the informant's hideouts, and find his journal on Streets of Tarkov.

== First hideout ==
The first hideout is an electrical operation room behind the small cinema. Inside the room is a sports bag which has a guaranteed Backup hideout key spawn every raid.

== Second hideout and journal ==
The second hideout is located inside the stairs to the cinema. A Backup hideout key is required to enter it. The journal has multiple spawns throughout the hideout.

Your friends are still taking their time, and I'm already running low on supplies because of that depot attack. I'm gonna run out of fuel if I don't do something. I found a place to get fuel, but I need your help. You know the local smugglers? They got a base near the Azure Coast. That's where you gotta drop off some gas cans. quests.content:
Never Too Late To Learn is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, how's your training going? I didn't think you still had so much to learn about warfare. That old saying ain't bullshit, ye? Luka and his squad could use a lesson. He said they got burned on the far side, had to retreat. Now the buggers at the base know they got competition, and they've tightened their defenses. They won't be able to take the base by surprise. That's why Luka asked to throw them some proper weapons to kill the c***s for sure. Everything they need is on the list right here. The cache must be real tough if those pricks aren't scared of even the military. Perhaps they got protection watching over them from the big land. But that protection ain't gonna reach us.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the item: 15 HK 416A5 5.56x45 assault rifle
Hand over the item: 4,500 5.56x45mm MK 318 Mod 0 (SOST)
Hand over the item: 8 UVSR Taiga-1 survival machete

== Rewards ==
+1 Troubleshooting skill level
+1 Mag Drills skill level
+1 Crafting skill level
+1 Endurance skill level
+1 Strength skill level
+1 Metabolism skill level
+1 Charisma skill level
+1 Intellect skill level
Even got the knives, impressive. I've already found a trusty bloke on the cordon who's gonna handle our deliveries. He's not asking for anything yet, but he'll surely put a premium on it later. It's a hell of a lot of work to get supplies to the mainland, you know.

== Guide ==

Note: The green brown variant of the HK 416A5 5.56x45 assault rifle can not be used.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 그럼 훈련이 어떻게 진행되고 있어요? 저는 아직 전쟁에 대해 배울 게 별로 없다고 생각했어요. 그 오래된 말이 헛소리 아니죠? 루카와 그의 부대는 교훈을 사용할 수 있을 겁니다. 그는 멀리서 화상을 입었다고 말했습니다. 물러나야 했습니다. 이제 기지의 똥구리는 경쟁을 받았다는 것을 알고 있고, 방어력을 강화했습니다. 그들은 기지를 깜짝 놀라게 할 수 없을 것입니다. 그래서 루카는 그들에게 적절한 무기를 던질 것을 요청했습니다.

== Dialogue ==
Hello my brother! So how's it hanging? Not bored yet? I know what'll rev you up. The effect is out of this world! Hey, don't get the wrong idea, it's nothing that was illegal in our past lives. Long story short, there are some special people making lists of the realest alphas in Tarkov. And I happen to know these special people. Rarely do I get to meet such influential figures in my life, that's for sure. With guys like that, you gotta do business in an exceptional fashion, not a single fuck-up. You mess up, you lose your chance to live a happy life ever after, if you catch my drift. Okay, so I can see you're clearly interested in finding out what this chad list is for. Tell you what, I have no fucking clue. I sure wish they'd tell me though! Anyway, you yourself can make it on this list. All you gotta do is prove you're worthy. They gave me a mission checklist, here ya go.

New Paths is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. My partners urgently need to move something important through the city center. You know how isolated the districts have become and how dangerous the main roads are. We need you to scout a route from TerraGroup Headquarters to the Rodina Cinema. My men noticed that some bandits have found a shortcut between the districts. It would allow us to reach several different locations in a single raid. Make sure the route is safe.

== Objectives ==
Scout the intersection of Mira Ave and the overpass on Ground Zero (In one raid)
Locate the passage leading to Streets of Tarkov on Ground Zero (In one raid)
Use the transit from Ground Zero to Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)
Survive and extract from Streets of Tarkov (or transit to the next location)
(Optional) Scout the area around the Rodina cinema on Streets of Tarkov (In one raid)

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
550 Dollars
578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
Wonderful, you found it! This will make operating in central Tarkov much easier for both you and us.

quests.content:
Night Sweep is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Oi, come here, need to talk to you. Got a job for you, a dry one, if you ask me. My folks were looking for loot at night recently and ran into some hooded morons, and, well, shit went south. Naturally, my dudes managed to retreat in the end and even smoked some of those psychos, though we still lost around a dozen of ours. Eh, that's not the point. The guys found some kind of a dagger on one of those psychos, and apparently, some serious people are willing to pay a fortune for those. Anyway, I've got an order for those daggers. If you find any, bring'em here.

== Objectives ==
Obtain 12 unusual knives
Hand over 12 knives to Skier
Eliminate 5 hooded men

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Search skill levels
+4 Stress Resistance skill levels
Skier Rep +1.5
2,400 Euros
2,520 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,760 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× CMMG Mk47 Mutant 7.62x39 assault rifle
5× 7.62x39mm PP gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of CMMG Mk47 Mutant 7.62x39 assault rifle at Skier LL4
Unlocks purchase of Magpul MOE Carbine rubber buttpad at Skier LL4
Bloody hell... You got them all by yourself? You've got guts, that's for sure. Somethin' ain't right about those psychos, I'm tellin' you...

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find 12 Cultist knives and hand them over to Skier. They are carried by the Cultist priest and sometimes by his followers. You also have to kill 5 Cultists.

sectionsKo.text: 오, 와, 얘기해봐야 해. 너한테 일 좀 해줘요. 건조한 일, 물어봐도. 내 부모님들이 밤에 약물을 찾고 있었는데, 험담한 멍청이를 만나게 됐어요. 결국은 엉망이 됐어요. 당연히, 내 친구들이 물러나서서서 그 사이코드를 연연하기도 했습니다. 하지만 우리는 여전히 12명이나 잃었습니다. 그치만. 그치만. 그 중 한 명에게 어떤 칼을 찾았어요. 그리고 분명히, 몇몇 진지한 사람들은 그 칼에 대해 돈을 지불하고 싶어합니다. 어쨌든, 그 칼에 대한 주문이 있습니다.

quests.content:
No Place for Renegades is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, warrior. I've got a new assignment for you, regarding that military base, the one you were checking out for me some time ago. In short, I'm not happy that my boys got killed in vain in that bunker. That's just not right. I'd like to let those Raiders know the consequences of their actions. An eye, for an eye, you know? Return to that bunker and fuck up some of them in that command offices area you found. Just so they know who they're messing with and that they better stop.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Raiders in the command bunker on Reserve

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Good work out there. I hope they get what's going on now and that they can't just kill my people like that. Here's the reward.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 5 Scav Raiders in the underground bunker on Reserve. Scav Raiders have the chance to spawn there at the start of a raid, and additional ones may appear after the "D-2" extraction switch has been activated.

Quest area marked on underground map

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 전사님. 제가 여러분에게 새로운 임무가 있습니다. 군 기지를 두고요. 얼마 전 제가 위해 확인하고 있던 임무입니다. 단적으로, 제 아들들이 그 벙커에서 헛되이 죽었기에 저는 행복하지 않습니다. 그건 옳지 않습니다. 저는 레이더의 행동을 통해 어떤 결과를 초래할 것인지 알려드리고 싶습니다.

objectivesKo: 쇼어라인 또는 인터체인지에 있는 밀수자 기지에서 10개의 목표물을 제거
quests.content:
No Swiping is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Let's skip the small talk and get straight to business. My mates have set up shop at the coast and Interchange, moving all sorts of contraband. Useful lads. A couple of days back they had to clear out of their base and leave everything behind. No idea what happened, and we're not exactly close enough to share every little detail with each other. Anyway, now some randoms have started poking around those bases, taking whatever they can get their hands on. Go over there and explain to these newcomers that they shouldn't stick their noses where they weren't invited. Just clean up the area around the bases. They'll get the message.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 targets at the smuggler bases on Shoreline or Interchange

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.1
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
517 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Pack of screws
Yeah, yeah, I've heard all about those shits running away with tails between their legs. Here, your goodies.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill any 10 enemies in and around the smugglers base on Shoreline or Interchange.

Shoreline base location and kill area marked on map
Interchange base location and kill area marked on map

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 작은 이야기를 건너가 직행하자. 제 친구들이 해안과 인터체인지에서 매장을 세우고, 모든 종류의 밀수품을 옮기고 있습니다. 유용한 소년들. 며칠 전 그들은 그들의 기지를 떠나서 모든 것을 뒤로 남겨야 했습니다. 무슨 일이 일어났는지 알 수 없습니다. 그리고 우리는 서로 모든 세부 사항을 공유할 만큼 가까이 있지 않습니다. 어쨌든, 이제 일부 랜덤들은 그 기지를 돌고, 그들이 손에 넣을 수 있는 모든 것을 가져가고 있습니다. 거기에 가서 신입국자들에게 그들이 초청되지 않은 곳에 코를 붙이지 않아야 한다고 설명하십시오. 단지 기지를 둘러싼 지역을 청소하십시오. 그들은 메시지를 얻을 것입니다.

quests.title: Nostalgia
objectivesKo: 예거의 건강 리조트 방, 쇼어라인의 만을 바라보는 방 찾기
예거의 사진 앨범 찾아 확보하기
예거에게 사진 앨범 건네기
quests.content:
Nostalgia is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello there, come in. You know, at times, sitting by the campfire, I look back on how it all began. That time I've been on vacation in the health resort, it was in the evening, I remember that as if it was yesterday. I have just returned to the room after dinner, sat by the window to gaze at the bay. It looked marvelous. And then I hear trucks, not just a single one, a whole convoy. It was your colleagues, the USECs. They kicked everyone out of the resort, didn’t even let people pack their belongings. I don't care about my clothes as much as my photo album which remained there. Not as a service but as an act of friendship, please try to find it there. It is painfully dear to me as a memory of those calm days. My room was on the top floor of the health resort, in the west wing. The reward will be bountiful.

== Objectives ==
Locate Jaeger's Health Resort room with a view of the bay on Shoreline
Locate and obtain Jaeger's Photo album
Hand over the Photo album to Jaeger

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× KEKTAPE duct tape
There's no way you actually found it! Thank you so much! Wait. Here, take this. A few days ago I've picked up a badly wounded USEC in the forest. I bandaged him up, but the poor fella didn't make it. Before dying, he gave me a key, looks like it is from one of his stashes somewhere in the Health Resort area. I don't need it, but you might find it useful.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Jaeger's photo album in the health resort on Shoreline. It can be found in west wing room 303 on the third floor, located in the bottom drawer of a nightstand. The room is always unlocked.

Health resort west wing location marked on map
Door to west wing room 303
Photo album in the bottom drawer

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 들어와요. 가끔은 캠프불 옆에 앉아서, 모든 일이 어떻게 시작되었는지 되돌아보죠. 그 시간 동안 저는 휴가를 거쳤고, 저녁이었는데, 어제처럼 기억납니다. 저녁 식사 후 방으로 돌아왔고, 창문 옆에서 만물을 바라보며 앉아 있었습니다. 그것은 멋진 것 같았다. 그리고 나서 트럭을 듣습니다. 단 한 개뿐만 아니라, 전용 열차. 그것은 당신의 동료였습니다. USECs. 그들은 모든 사람들을 휴양지에서 쫓아냈고, 사람들이 물건을 포장 할 수 없게 했습니다. 나는 내 사진 앨범만큼이나 내 옷에 신경 쓰지 않습니다. 봉사로서가 아니라 우정의 행위로, 그것을 찾으려고 노력하십시오. 그것은 그 휴양지의 긴 휴양의 기억으로 고통스럽게 소중한 것입니다. 나의 건강방은 서쪽 날개에 있었고, 상봉은 부풀이 될 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
예거의 건강 리조트 방, 쇼어라인의 만을 바라보는 방 찾기
예거의 사진 앨범 찾아 확보하기
예거에게 사진 앨범 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +10,000 EXP 예거 평판 +0.25 165,000 루블 173,250 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 189,750 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 3× KEKTAPE 접착 테이프 실제로 발견 된 것은 없습니다! 너무 감사합니다! 기다려. 여기, 이것을 가져가십시오. 며칠 전에 숲에서 심각하게 부상당한 루블를 가져왔습니다. 나는 그를 붕대로, 그러나 그 사람은 그것을 못했습니다. 죽기 전에 그는 나에게 열쇠를 주었다. 그것은 건강 리조트 지역에서 어딘가에 그의 스카치 중 하나에서있는 것처럼 보입니다. 나는 그것을 필요로하지 않습니다, 하지만 당신은 유용하게 찾을 수 있습니다.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, brother. Kinda in a bad mood today, not gonna lie. I feel like I've been ripped off! I bought an apparently running SUV for 2,000 bucks. And everything seemed fine, they brought it to Shoreline, but the driver never contacted me back after that. It's not a lot of money, but still sucks. Can you go see if the car's actually there?

== Objectives ==
Locate Ragman's SUV on Shoreline
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1

It's in the fucking swamp? That explains the fucking price. It would cost more to get it out from there and clean it up! All right, here, that's for helping me out.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to find Ragman's lost SUV on Shoreline. It is located in the east of the swamp village, driven into a pond.

SUV location marked on map
The SUV in the pond

sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 형아. 오늘 기분 나쁘네요. 거짓말하지 않을 거예요. 내가 도난 당한 것 같네요. 2000달러에 달하는 SUV를 샀어요. 모든게 괜찮아 보였다. 그들은 쇼어라인에 가져왔지만 운전자는 다시 연락하지 않았습니다.

quests.title: Offensive Reconnaissance
quests.unlocks: Vacate the PremisesHypotheses TestingConfidential InfoIndisputable AuthorityThis Tape Sucks
objectivesKo: 쇼어라인의 헬스 리조트 벙커 문 뒤에 있는 것을 찾아내 찾기
(선택) 라브리의 액세스 키 카드 찾아 확보하기
quests.content:
Offensive Reconnaissance is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You got the keycard? Perfect. Judging by how much everyone's interested in these cellars, you and I are on a truly important trail. There could be a TerraGroup warehouse or another lab that's been sealed there ever since the evacuation! We don't have time to waste. First we need to search these premises and figure out what the purpose of the facility is. TerraGroup would not be so eager to hide it if what is going on inside corresponds to their company's public profile. Try to memorize everything you see: the structure of the premises, equipment, tools, markings or other symbols... Every detail counts. I'll wait for your return and set up my surveillance system to track any information about the health resort. If anyone finds more than we do, I'll see it.

== Objectives ==
Find out what is behind the Health Resort bunker door on Shoreline
(Optional) Obtain the Labrys access keycard

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
An old bunker? Yes, there was one mentioned in the archives, an old Soviet shelter. Thing is, it was closed down about twenty years ago due to some kind of technical failure. Looks like Knossos restored it to working order. But why would TerraGroup need an abandoned bomb shelter? Um, hang on. I'm picking up a signal from my interception network. An encrypted message that seems to be coming straight from these cellars... Give me a minute.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to transit from Shoreline to The Labyrinth. The transit is located in the basement of the health resort west wing and requires a Labrys access keycard. The door to the transit is locked and requires the Knossos LLC facility key. Surviving the raid is not required.

Health resort west wing location marked on map
Transit location marked on west wing basement map
Door to the transit
The transit

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 키카드가 있나요? 완벽해요. 이 기저장들이 얼마나 많은 관심을 가지고 있는지 판단하면, 당신과 저는 정말 중요한 길을 걷고 있습니다. 이 곳에는 진출 이후 봉쇄된 테라그룹 창고나 다른 실험실이 있을 수 있습니다. 낭비할 시간이 없습니다. 먼저 우리는 이 시설을 검색하고 시설의 목적이 무엇인지 알아내야 합니다. 테라그룹는 내부에서 일어나는 일이 회사의 공공 프로필에 해당하는 경우 숨기려고 그렇게 열망하지 않습니다. 당신이 보는 모든 것을 기억하려고 노력하십시오. 건물의 구조, 장비, 도구, 표시 또는 다른 상징... 모든 세부 사항은 중요합니다. 나는 당신의 귀환을 기다리고 건강에 대한 모든 정보를 추적하기 위해 감시 시스템을 설정합니다. 누가 더 많은 리조트를 발견하면, 우리는 그것을 볼 것입니다.

sectionsKo.text: +28,000 EXP 오래된 벙커? 예, 아카이브에서 언급된 오래된 소련 피난처가 있습니다. 문제는, 그것은 기술 오류로 인해 약 20 년 전에 폐쇄되었습니다. Knossos가 작동 상태를 회복한 것처럼 보입니다. 하지만 테라그룹는 버려진 폭탄 피난처가 필요한 이유는 무엇입니까? , 잠깐. 나는 내 수호 네트워크에서 신호를 수신하고 있습니다. 암호화된 메시지가 바로 이 기하급수에서 오는 것처럼 보입니다.

sectionsKo.text: 이 탐정에서 쇼어라인에서 미궁로 이동해야 합니다. 이 이동은 헬스 리조트 서쪽 날개의 지하에 위치하고 있으며, Labrys 액세스 키 카드가 필요합니다. 이 이동의 문은 잠겨 있으며, Knossos LLC 시설 키가 필요합니다. 이 침습에서 살아남는 것은 필요하지 않습니다. Health resort 서쪽 날개 위치 지도에 표시되어 있습니다. 서쪽 날개 지하에 표시된 교통 위치 지도에 표시됩니다. 이 이동의 문

quests.title: Oil Change
objectivesKo: 레이드에서 5 AMG-10 수압 액체 찾기
항목 건네기
quests.content:
Oil Change is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Heya there, warrior! Since you already know about my little helicopter secret, I've got a job for you. If you want my bird to keep picking you up from the ship, it needs regular maintenance. Remember that special lubricant you brought me? You won't find that stuff in Tarkov, but there should still be some supplies left on the Icebreaker. Go take a look, check the helipad and storage areas. Anything you find in cans, bring it back to me. You've got your own interest in this too, so you won't be doing it for nothing. And if you manage to pull together a decent stock, I'll even pay extra.

== Requirements ==
Hand over the hard drives from compartment C-1 on Icebreaker to Mechanic in the Boreas story chapter.

== Objectives ==
Find 5 AMG-10 hydraulic fluid in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+32,000 EXP
330,000 Roubles
346,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
379,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks barter for Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle at Prapor LL1
Alright, you handled that job well. I'll give you that. Maybe things between us will keep going smooth, just don't forget your reputation and don't even think about screwing me over. You're dismissed for now, soldier.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 해군님, 내 작은 헬리콥터 비밀은 이미 알고 있기 때문에, 제가 당신을 위해 일을 하고 있습니다. 만약 당신이 제 새가 배를 통해 당신을 계속 데려오기를 원한다면, 그것은 정기적인 유지보수가 필요합니다. 당신이 나에게 가져온 특수 윤활료를 기억하세요. 당신은 타르코프에서 그 물건을 찾을 수 없습니다. 하지만 여전히 얼음거울기에서 약간의 물품이 남아 있어야 합니다. 가서 체크하고 헬리콥터장과 저장장들을 확인하세요. 당신이 캔에서 발견하는 모든 것을 내게 가져오십시오. 당신은 또한 이것에 대해 당신의 자신의 관심을 가지고 있습니다. 그래서 당신은 아무것도 할 수 없습니다. 그리고 당신이 괜찮은 주식을 끌어낼 수 있다면, 나는 심지어 추가 지불 할 것입니다.

sectionsKo.text: 아이스 브레이커 C-1 방에서 하드 드라이브를 Boreas 이야기 장의 정비사에 넘겨주십시오.

quests.title: Oil Run
objectivesKo: 세관(Customs)에서 아무 유조차에 MS2000 마커 부착하기
quests.content:
Oil Run is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello there, drifter! Good timing. I've been scratching my head over a little problem. Word came in about a job: scout out an area where there might still be some fuel left. You know how valuable that stuff is. Not exactly something I'd trust just anyone with. Anyway, you've worked with strobe markers before, right? Couldn't be simpler. Stick it somewhere out of sight, press the button, and walk away. Got it? All that's left is to find one of the fuel tankers and mark it. Here, take a beacon. Think of it as a little bonus for working with me. Just don't lose it. If you need more, you'll be paying for them.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark any of the fuel tank trucks with an MS2000 Marker on Customs

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
1× Electric motor
Unlocks purchase of 9x21mm BT gzh at Prapor LL3
Good to see you again, Rambo! My boys are already on their way to the signal. Here's your cut.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to mark 1 of 4 fuel tanker trucks with a MS2000 Marker on Customs.
Prapor provides a MS2000 Marker via in-game mail.

Fuel tanker truck locations marked on map
Tanker truck #1 behind the new gas station
Tanker truck #2 at the construction site with the fuel tanks
Tanker truck #3 next to the "Old Gas Station" extraction
Tanker truck #4 behind the garages near the "Trailer Park" extraction

== Trivia ==
You can buy additional MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 방랑자! 좋은 시간. 작은 문제 때문에 머리를 긁고 있었습니다. 일에 대한 소식이 들어왔습니다. 연료가 남아있을 수있는 지역을 탐험합니다. 그 물건이 얼마나 가치있는지 알고 있습니다. 내가 누구에게나 신뢰 할 수있는 것이 아닙니다. 어쨌든, 당신은 이전에 스트로브 마크를 사용했습니다. 더 간단하지 않을 수 없습니다. 눈에 보이지 않는 곳에서 그것을 붙이고 버튼을 누르십시오. 그리고 걸어 가십시오. 알았어요. 남은 것은 연료 탱크 중 하나를 찾아서 표시하는 것입니다. 여기, 신호등을 가져가십시오. 나와 함께 일하는 작은 보너스로 생각하십시오. 그냥 그것을 잃지 마십시오. 더 많이 필요하면, 당신은 그들을 지불 할 것입니다.

quests.content:
One Less Loose End is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, dear friend. There's an important job just for someone like you. You need to pick up a journal from the TerraGroup field lab at the Polikhim factory and drop it off at a specified location. It's at an old sawmill in Priozersk nature reserve. Leave the package at the house with transformers. I don't want to upset my influential customer, so I can't trust a random person with the job.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the lab journal on Factory
Stash the journal at the old sawmill on Woods

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
550 Dollars
578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× CPU fan
Unlocks purchase of SIG MPX 9x19 submachine gun (variant Silenced) at Peacekeeper LL2
Great! You know the saying "What happens in Vegas, stays in Vegas"? Everyone has their secrets, and prying into those secrets might be too dangerous...

== Failure Dialogue ==
Are you sure you did the right thing, mercenary? My client won't stand for it, and I'd recommend you look over your shoulder more often from now on. Don't count on me for protection.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to locate and obtain a journal in Factory. Afterwards it has to be stashed on Woods.

== Factory journal location ==
The journal can be found in the laboratory on the second floor. There are multiple spawns throughout both rooms.

Laboratory location marked on map

Spawn #2: In the first room on the chest of drawers next to the glass cabinet
Spawn #3: In the second room in the bottom compartment of the right industrial shelf
Spawn #4: In the second room in the small fridge on the floor
Spawn #5: In the second room on the right desk

== Woods stashing location ==
The journal has to be stashed inside a house at the old sawmill in the east of the location.

objectivesKo: 팩토리에서 AUG를 사용하면서 15개의 목표물을 헤드샷으로 제거하십시오.
quests.content:
One-Way Ticket is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Things have been going very well between us. That is why I would like to involve you in one... complicated task. My men attempted to pass through the Factory, but they were not allowed through. They all died. Now I must fill out a great deal of paperwork and request reinforcements... And we must also punish those responsible. I do not know exactly who was responsible for the deaths of my men, so engage everyone you encounter. And make your shots count, headshots only. I want the enemy to understand that this was not a coincidence.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 15 targets with headshots while using an AUG on Factory

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
Good work. Here is your reward.

objectivesKo: 커스텀의 기숙사 중 한 방 안에 숨겨진 물 저장소 찾기

quests.content:
Operation Aquarius is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, young man. You came at just the right time. I have a job with a very generous payout. Interested? I'm sure you are aware that our region has a serious drinking water problem. It was recently discovered that the aquifers have been contaminated. But do not worry, my team and I are already working on a solution. I need you for something else. Certain people have decided to profit from everyone else's misfortune. I know one gang has stockpiled all the clean water they could get their hands on in the Dorms area. I'm sure you know where that is. Now they are selling it behind my back while innocent people suffer! Bring me that water.

== Objectives ==
Locate the water stockpile hidden inside one of the dorms rooms on Customs
Hand over 3 any found in raid drinking water items

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Excellent work! Share the profits with you..? Surely you don't think I'm going to sell the water. This is purely a humanitarian effort!

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the hidden water on Customs. It can be found in room 206 on the second floor of the two-story dorms building. A Dorm room 206 key is required to enter it. You also need to hand over 3 water drinking items found in raid to Therapist.

2 story dorms and room 206 marked on map
Room 206 in the two-story dorms
The hidden water

sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 젊은 사람. 당신은 정확히 적절한 시간에 왔습니다. 매우 관대한 돈을 지불하는 직업이 있습니다. 관심있는 분? 우리 지역이 심각한 음수 문제라는 것을 알고 있는지 확신합니다. 최근에는 수족관들이 오염되었다는 사실이 밝혀졌습니다. 하지만 걱정하지 마세요. 저와 제 팀은 이미 해결책을 연구하고 있습니다. 다른 일 위해 당신을 필요로합니다. 어떤 사람들은 다른 사람들의 불행에서 이익을 취하기로 결정했습니다. 저는 한 갱이 한 사람이 수족관 지역에 손에 넣을 수있는 깨끗한 물을 모두 저장했다고 알고 있습니다. 저는 당신이 그 위치를 알고 있다고 확신합니다. 이제 그들은 그것을 내 뒤에서 판매하고 있습니다. 무고한 사람들이 고통받는 동안! 그 물을 가져오십시오.

quests.content:
Order From Outside is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Surely you don't think I would be interested in petty local conflicts? I have much more important matters to attend to, and I am not going to help either of the parties. Speaking of which. I need to move an item from point A to point B. It is hidden at the electromechanical warehouse in the airspace control center at the military base. It's to be delivered to the Priozersk nature reserve. The landmark will be a small cemetery. You'll recognize it by the stretchers and the bodies around it -- not everyone has been buried in time. Since my cargo is very specific, some people may have a particular interest in it. That is why I need someone who can guarantee the safety of the cargo during transportation.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the electronic jammer at the electromechanical warehouse on Reserve
Stash the device at the specified location on Woods

== Rewards ==
+46,700 EXP
Lightkeeper Rep +0.02
4,000 Dollars
1× Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter
1× UHF RFID Reader
1× Virtex programmable processor
Perfect. I've already prepared the reward.

== Guide ==
Completing the quest Battery Change from the BTR Driver automatically fails this quest.

In this quest you first have to find a KOSA UAV electronic jamming device in the airspace control center (White King) on Reserve. There are multiple spawns. Afterwards you have to stash it on Woods, at a gravesite south of the dilapidated village in the north.

== Reserve Pickup location ==

objectivesKo: GP-25 대도 발사기로 10개의 로그를 제거한다
quests.content:
Our Own Land is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, comrade. Come on in, come on in. And lock the door behind you. Gonna have a serious talk... It's time to show everyone whose land we're standing on and who's the boss around here. Because there are already more of these tourists than us - everything that's left in Tarkov has been plundered. They turned Norvink region into some garbage lot. You agree, right? It's not even about the money, it's about driving those fuckers out from our own land! Although I will make it worth your while anyway, as always. Start by clearing the area near the Lighthouse, and then we will throw them out of our other territories. So, are you in?

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 Rogues with a GP-25 grenade launcher

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Military power filter
Unlocks purchase of 23x75mm Zvezda flashbang round at Prapor LL3
Unlocks barter for Korund-VM ballistic plates (Front) at Prapor LL3
Thank you, warrior. Our homeland won't forget this!

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks purchase of 40mm VOG-25 grenade at Prapor LL3
Unlocks barter of GP-25 Kostyor 40mm underbarrel grenade launcher at Prapor LL3

== See also ==
Ironclad Proof - The USEC counterpart quest

quests.title: Out of Curiosity
objectivesKo: 커스텀에 있는 화학물질의 운송 찾기
차량을 MS2000 마커로 표시
quests.content:
Out of Curiosity is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Young man, I cannot stand aside on this one. I'm aware that you are now working with this so-called Skier. This disreputable man pursues completely lucrative interests and that is a matter of great concern to me. Especially all this story with secret experiments on a substance that you call the yellow chemical. The substance is extremely dangerous, and I have a major request for you, could you give up the coordinates of the chemicals to me? Yes, I'm aware of all the details of your adventures with the Skier. I would come up with good payment for that. Again, this is all just for the sake of our people.

== Objectives ==
Locate the transport with the chemicals on Customs
Mark the vehicle with an MS2000 Marker

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1× Medicine case
1× Document case
2× Salewa first aid kit
1× Aluminum splint
1× CMS surgical kit
Wonderful! I can already see how that nasty grin fades from the Skier's face. He will definitely be unhappy with you, but you acted for the good of the civilian population, so there is no need to be upset. Let this reagent be under the control of competent people, I will take care of the transportation. Your share, as agreed. You made the right choice.

== Failure Dialogue ==
I have nothing to say. It scares me to think of who and why might need this chemical.

== Guide ==
By completing either Chemical - Part 4 or Big Customer, you will fail and lose access to this quest.

You can buy the MS2000 Marker from Prapor.
After placing the marker, the player must stay alive for 30 seconds or they will have to place another beacon in the van. You do not need to be near the van after the marker has been placed. Find a nearby hiding spot and wait until the timer is complete.

Warehouse marked on map
The warehouse with the vehicle inside.
The vehicle where the beacon is placed.

== Trivia ==
You can buy additional MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death. However, unlike most quests that require you to mark an object, this one does require that you survive after placement. In the event of death, you will need to acquire another and re-place.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 젊은 사람, 이 문제에 대해 저는 한 편을 지낼 수 없습니다. 당신은 지금 스키어라고 불리는 이 사람과 함께 일하고 있다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 이 불명예를 안은 사람은 완전히 수익성있는 이익을 추구하고 있고 그것은 저에게 큰 우려의 사항입니다. 특히 당신이 노란색 화학 물질이라고 부르는 물질에 대한 비밀 실험에 대한 이 모든 이야기. 물질은 매우 위험합니다. 그리고 나는 당신에게 큰 요청을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 화학 물질의 좌표를 나에게 줄 수 있습니까? 예, 나는 스키어와 함께 당신의 모험의 모든 세부 사항을 알고 있습니다. 나는 그것을 위해 좋은 돈을 줄 것입니다. 다시, 이것은 단지 우리 사람들의 이익을 위해 모든 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +10,000 EXP 1× 의학 케이스 1× 문서 케이스 2× 살레바 초상치료 키트 1× 알루미늄 스핀트 1× CMS 수술 키트 멋진! 나는 이미 스키어의 얼굴에서 그 불쾌한 미소가 어떻게 사라지는 것을 볼 수 있습니다. 그는 확실히 당신을 만족하지 않을 것입니다, 하지만 당신은 민간인 복을 위해 행동, 그래서 화가 필요 없습니다. 이 반응기가 적당한 사람들의 통제하에있을 수 있도록, 나는 운송을 돌볼 것입니다. 당신의 몫, 합의. 당신은 올바른 선택을 했다.

sectionsKo.title: Failure Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 누가 왜 이 화학 물질을 필요로 하는지 생각해봐도 겁이 나네요

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 화학 - 4부 또는 큰 고객으로 완료하면 이 탐구를 실패하고 액세스 할 수 없습니다. MS2000 마커에서 프라포르를 구입할 수 있습니다. 마커를 배치 한 후 플레이어는 30 초 동안 살아 있어야 합니다. 아니면 그들은 밴에 다른 라이크를 배치해야합니다. 마커가 배치 된 후 당신은 밴 근처에있을 필요가 없습니다. 근처에 숨어있는 곳을 찾아 타이머가 완료 될 때까지 기다립니다. 지도에 표시 된 저장소 차량 내부에 있는 차량. 라이크가 배치되는 차량.

sectionsKo.title: Trivia
sectionsKo.text: 필요하다면 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 추가 MS2000 마크를 구입할 수 있습니다. 플레이어는 MS2000 마크를 특별한 슬롯이나 가방에 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 그러나 사망의 경우 손실되지 않도록합니다. 그러나 객체를 표시해야하는 대부분의 퀘스트와 달리, 이 작업은 배치 후 생존을 요구합니다. 사망의 경우, 다른 하나를 획득하고 교체해야합니다. MS2000 마크는 필요하면 자동으로 플레이어의 인벤토리에서 사용됩니다. 키가 작동하는 것과 비슷합니다.

quests.content:
Overpopulation is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Mercenary, I have a job for you. At the former USEC base belonging to your associates in the chalet area at Cape Dalniy, a large amount of valuable equipment and information was left behind after the conflict. This could help fund our operations. But there is one problem: the entire area is currently under enemy control. We need to eliminate them permanently, or at least temporarily remove the threat. While you are there, search the location for documents and bring them to me. That is your task, my friend. Naturally, everything you have heard will remain between us. I await your report.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 targets around the chalets on Lighthouse
Hand over 5 Topographic survey maps, Intelligence folder, or TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials marked with the Found in raid status

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.75
1,900 Dollars
1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
My observers have already informed me of your work, mercenary. I believe you have earned a generous reward.

== Guide ==

For this quest you have to kill 10 targets around and between the cottages on Lighthouse and then hand over 5 of any of the following items: Topographic survey maps or Intelligence folder orTerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials

Approximate quest area marked

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 용병님, 제가 여러분에게 일하셔야 합니다. 대두 이후, 대두의 레 지역에 있는 USEC의 전직 기지에서 많은 귀중한 장비와 정보가 남겨졌습니다. 하지만 한 가지 문제도 있습니다. 전 지역은 현재 적의 통제권에 있습니다. 우리는 그들을 영구적으로 제거하거나 적어도 일시적으로 위협을 제거해야합니다. 당신이 거기 있을 동안, 문서들을 찾아서 내게 가져오십시오. 그것은 당신의 임무입니다. 내 친구.

quests.title: Paramedic
objectivesKo: 타르코프 시내에 있는 구급자 스마트폰 찾아 확보하기
타르코프 시내에서 추출된 이산물
스마트폰 건네기
quests.content:
Paramedic is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Young man, I have a task that suits your area of expertise. A friend of mine, a paramedic still early in his career, recently told me a disturbing story. Just before the catastrophe, he was transporting patients with unexplained symptoms, almost as if there had been an outbreak of a new disease. At the hospitals, unfamiliar individuals would take them away and transfer them to private wards. The young man managed to photograph their observation logs while they were collecting another patient. However, in the midst of the catastrophe, he dropped his smartphone containing all the data. He says they were on their way to pick up another patient near the Concordia residential complex. For everyone's sake, please find this phone for me. The paramedic will be waiting for you under the protection of my people, inside an SUV on Primorsky Avenue, and he will confirm its authenticity. I sincerely hope I can count on you, young man.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the ambulance paramedic's smartphone on Streets of Tarkov
Extract from Streets of Tarkov through Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex
Hand over the smartphone

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Yes, I've heard the report, this is what we've been looking for. My men will begin retrieving the information immediately. And you, young man, are free to go. Thank you for your help.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the ambulance paramedic's smartphone on Streets of Tarkov and extract with it through the "Primorsky Ave Taxi V-Ex" extraction while it is in your in-raid quest inventory. The taxi extraction with the phone does not need to be done in the same raid that you found the phone. The phone can be located at one of eight ambulances across the location.

Ambulance locations marked on the map.

== First spawn ==
In the passenger side footwell of the ambulance south of the cardinal apartment complex, under the "President restaurant" signs.

== Second spawn ==
In the passenger side footwell of the ambulance at Klimova street 18, near the "Basement Descent" Scav extraction.

== Third spawn ==
On the ground behind the ambulance south of the Pinewood hotel.

== Fourth spawn ==
On the passenger seat of the ambulance at Chekannaya street 15, opposite the Sparja store.

== Fifth spawn ==
In the passenger side footwell of the ambulance at Primorsky avenue, opposite the LexOs car dealership.

== Sixth spawn ==
On the ground at the right side of the ambulance on the playground of the Concordia apartment complex.

== Seventh spawn ==
On the ground just outside the passenger door of the ambulance at the "Crash Site" extraction. Note: The phone is located in the extraction zone.

== Eighth spawn ==
In the back of the ambulance at the loading area, to the south of Razvedchikov street.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 젊은 사람, 나는 당신의 전문 분야에 맞는 작업을 가지고 있습니다. 내 친구, 그의 경력의 초기 단계에 있는 산하 의료진이 최근에 나에게 불안한 이야기를 들려주었습니다. 재앙이 일어나기 직전에 그는 설명되지 않는 증상을 가진 환자를 운송하고 있었습니다. 거의 새로운 질병이 발병했을 것 처럼요. 병원에서 낯선 사람들이 그들을 데려가서 사단으로 옮겼습니다. 젊은 사람은 다른 환자를 수집하는 동안 그들의 관찰 기록을 사진으로 촬영 할 수 있었습니다. 그러나 재앙의 한가운데 모든 데이터를 포함하는 스마트 폰을 떨어뜨렸습니다. 그는 그들이 콘코르디아 주거 단지 근처에서 다른 환자를 데려가는 길에 있다고 말합니다. 모든 사람들의 이익을 위해, 이 전화를 찾아주세요. 산하 의료진은 진심으로 당신을 기다리고 있습니다. 내 사람들의 보호 아래에서, 프라이모르스키 에뉴에 있는 SUV에 있는 젊은 남성, 그리고 그는 그 진실성을 확인 할 수 있기를 바랍니다.

quests.content:
Passion for Ergonomics is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Do you know the feeling when you change the layout of your instrument in a seemingly insignificant way and it fundamentally changes the working comfort? The Pareto principle, right. I had a friend who was the epitome of that concept. He was always tweaking something, filing, sanding a part to win a few millimeters.... His experience made me realize how important ergonomics is in any job. I have not heard from him in a while, but I know one of his outlets, it was either a sort of car service or a workshop, right in the garage complex. He always loved cars, especially the American ones. Can you come and check the place out? He probably moved somewhere else a long time ago, but his garage might still contain some of his tools or blueprints.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the customized tool set at the garage complex on Customs
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Hmm... He would never let his car burn down willingly. Something must have happened there. A car mechanic's death would be just an imperceptible blip in the death toll on the Tarkov scale. But hopefully he was able to make it out and find safety. Maybe we'll see each other again.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the customized tool set at the garage complex Customs. It can be found in garage #11. There are multiple spawns throughout the garage.

Garage #11 location marked on map
The garage
First spawn under the car
Second spawn on the ground below the shelf

Fourth spawn on the ground at the front of the car

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 당신은 당신의 악기의 레이아웃을 겉으로 보기에 중요하지 않은 방식으로 변경하고 작업 편안함을 근본적으로 변화시키는 느낌은 알고 있습니까? 파레토 원칙, 맞습니다. 그 개념의 대표적인 친구였습니다. 그는 항상 무언가를 조정하고, 파일을 작성하고, 몇 밀리미터를 획득하기 위해 부분을 닦아주었습니다. 그의 경험은 어떤 직장에서든 에르고노미가 얼마나 중요한지 깨닫게 해 주었습니다. 나는 잠시 동안 그에게 소식을 듣지 않았지만, 그의 출구 중 하나는 차 서비스 또는 차고 단지에 있는 작업장이었을 것을 알고 있습니다. 그는 항상 자동차를 좋아했습니다. 특히 미국 자동차. 당신은 장소를 확인 할 수 있습니까? 그는 아마도 다른 곳으로 오래 전에 이사했습니다. 그러나 그의 차고에는 여전히 그의 도구 또는 플루프린이 포함될 수 있습니다.

quests.content:
Pay the Fare! is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Sup, brother! Heard you've started taking boat rides somewhere with the smugglers. You planning to get out of Tarkov by water or something? Hope you know about the naval blockade... And I hope you're not counting on the smugglers' boats being in perfect condition. If you really need to travel by water on their boats, you won't get far without the right tools. I'm telling you that straight, unlike those guys. But you're in luck, ahper! My guys recently cracked open one of the railcars headed either to the port or the Norvinsky pier, and what do you know, it was packed with special repair kits for watercraft! All kinds of patches, sealants, and other stuff. I think you know where I'm going with this, huh? Let's help each other out, and we'll both come out ahead. I could really use some of the tools that aren't included in those kits.

== Requirements ==

== Rewards ==

Now that's the kind of deal I like. As long as people have something to trade, guys like you and me will always come out on top! Here are your kits. And if you need more, you know who to come to.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue

quests.content:
Payback is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well, the situation became plain enough. This group of hotshots is, as it turns out, run by Glukhar, an ex-marine who settled at the Reserve base with his crew. That's where he took the documents you planted. Who'd have thought he'd have the nerve to undermine me? Well, he signed his own sentence. Hunt them down and settle the matter. When it's done, give a signal with a flare rocket from high ground, and I'll send men to their lair to sort out their junk. We need to find out what else they've been digging up. As soon as you've fired the signal, you take the shortest possible route straight to me.

== Objectives ==
Locate and neutralize Glukhar or his guards for 4 kills total on Reserve (In one raid)
(Optional) Bring a yellow signal flare into raid
Shoot a yellow signal flare at the radar station on Reserve (In one raid)
Survive and extract from Reserve through Cliff Descent (In one raid)
Note: The "Flare" objective will appear after the "Neutralize" objective is completed.

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.03
1× Microcontroller board
3× LEDX Skin Transilluminator
1× Substation marked key
Unlocks purchase of DevTac Ronin Respirator at Ragman LL4
Saw the signal, great job. I advise you not to go to the base while my men are out there working.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to kill Glukhar or his guards for 4 kills total. Next, you have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being at the radar station area on Reserve. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you. Finally, you have to extract via the "Cliff Descent" extraction. To use it, a Red Rebel ice pick and Paracord are required and you must not wear any Armor vest.

quests.title: Peaceful Atom
objectivesKo: 아이스 브레이커의 핵발전 단위 제어 로그 찾아 확보하기
발견된 항목 건네기
quests.content:
Peaceful Atom is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings. I have an urgent assignment for you. You are not yet aware of the situation, so I will need to provide some context. However, everything I am about to disclose is top secret, understood? There is a secured facility within the blockade perimeter that is of interest to my contacts in the nuclear energy sector. The issue is that it is an icebreaker ship, currently stranded in the bay. To access it, you will need to acquire suitable transport, and it is preferable to do so quietly. No one must know that the vessel is present in Tarkov's waters at all! Once you secure transport, you are to retrieve operational documentation from the ship. Search the engineering sections, there should be a logbook for the nuclear power unit control system. Do not, under any circumstances, disclose this task to anyone.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the nuclear power unit control log on Icebreaker
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+24,000 EXP
3,600 Dollars
3,780 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
4,140 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× HK G28 7.62x51 marksman rifle
5× 7.62x51mm M80A1 ammo pack (20 pcs)
3× HK417/G28 7.62x51 20-round magazine
You have the logbook? I trust you avoided drawing attention on your way back. I will arrange your reward through my associates. One more thing: I strongly advise against returning to the Icebreaker. According to my sources, it has already come under the control of some special unit. You would not survive an engagement with them.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the Nuclear power unit control log on Icebreaker. It can be found either in the central control station room, in the overseeing cabin in the engine room, or in the automation room under the engine room.

== Central control station room - Level 0 ==

Room location marked on map
The log on one of the tables

== Overseeing cabin in the engine room - Level -2 ==

Cabin location marked on map
The cabin
The log on the shelf

== Automation room under the engine room - Level -3 ==
This room requires a code to be entered. The code can be found in a nearby overseeing cabin on a pinboard. The code changes every raid.

Room location marked on map
The cabin with the code
The code on the pinboard
The stairs to the room from the engine room
The log on top of monitoring equipment

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 저는 여러분께 긴급한 임무가 있습니다. 당신은 아직 상황을 알지 못하기 때문에 어떤 맥락을 제시해야 합니다. 하지만 제가 공개하고자 하는 모든 것은 비밀입니다. 이해가 되었나요? 봉쇄 주변에는 핵 에너지 분야의 제 연락처들에게 관심 있는 보안 시설이 있습니다. 문제는 이 해안에 갇혀 있는 빙해함이라는 것입니다. 접근하기 위해서는 적절한 운송을 취해야 하며, 조용히 하는 것이 좋습니다. 아무도 배가 타르코프의 물속에 있다는 것을 알 수 없도록 합니다. 운송을 확보한 후에는 배에서 운영 문서를 가져오셔야 합니다. 엔지니어링 섹션에 검색하면 핵 에너지 제어 시스템에 대한 로그북이 있어야 합니다. 어떤 상황에서도 이 작업을 누구에게도 공개하지 마십시오.

quests.content:
Peacekeeping Mission is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Have you seen the news? Recently, media have been pushing the agenda that \"the Blue Helmets are not doing their job in Tarkov, do not follow the procedures\" and so forth... Those damn bastards, kurwa! I hate these journalist scumbags. We are one step away from losing financing, which, my friend, is the opposite of profitable for us. So, we need to convince the public that the helmets are actually doing what they promised to do. You must address the issue of eliminating the illegal bandit group activities but do so under the UN flag. I’ll give you the initial set of equipment you'll need, but if you lose it, don't come asking for more.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 12 Scavs while using UNTAR helmet and armor, and 5.56x45 UN weapons on Woods or Reserve
Eliminate 12 Scavs while using UNTAR helmet and armor, and 5.56x45 UN weapons on Customs or Lighthouse
Eliminate 12 Scavs while using UNTAR helmet and armor, and 5.56x45 UN weapons on Shoreline or Streets of Tarkov
Eliminate 12 Scavs while using UNTAR helmet and armor, and 5.56x45 UN weapons on Ground Zero or Interchange

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+2 Aim Drills skill levels
Peacekeeper Rep +1.5
2,750 Dollars
2,888 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
3,163 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle
1× Armband (UNTAR)
Unlocks purchase of Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks barter for Cult Locust ballistic plate at Skier LL4
Ah, is that you? My superiors are pleased with the results! There are now fewer Scavs in the area, and attacks from the media died down a bit! Plus, we've made some nice photos for the newspapers. Good work, my friend!

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

The specified UNTAR helmet and armor need to be worn while making the Scav kills with any of the following weapons:

quests.content:
Pest Control is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come in, have a seat. You know how angry the local scum makes me, especially the damn looters, I can't stand them. Somebody steals from others to survive, but some do it for profit, and there are especially plenty of the latter ones in Tarkov. Take the military base, for example. I've been there before this whole conflict, it was such a beautiful sight: everything is clean, in order, the ground is almost glittering under the sun. And now the whole place is filled with all sorts of scum and marauders. I have a request for you: go there and let those looters know that you have to stay human in any situation.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 Scavs around the main barracks on Reserve

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Is it done? The air almost seems fresher now. It's a pity we couldn't get those looters' heads on straight in another way.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 10 Scavs around of the black and white pawn barrack buildings. Getting tagged and cursed on purpose can help with getting Scavs in the quest area.

Kill area marked on map

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 들어와 앉으세요. 지역 쓰레기가 저를 얼마나 화나게 하는지 아시죠. 특히 저 망할 강도들은, 저는 그들을 참을 수 없습니다. 누군가는 살아남기 위해 다른 사람들로부터 훔치고 있지만, 일부는 이익을 위해 그렇게 하고 있습니다. 특히 타르코프에 있는 후자의 기지는 많습니다. 예를 들어, 군 기지를 보세요. 이 모든 갈등이 일어나기 전에 저는 그곳에 있었습니다. 그것은 매우 아름다운 풍경이었습니다. 모든 것이 깨끗하고, 질서있게, 땅은 거의 태양 아래에서 빛나는 것입니다. 그리고 이제 모든 장소는 모든 종류의 쓰레기와 강도들로 가득합니다. 저는 여러분께 부탁을 드리겠습니다. 거기 가서 그 강도들에게 어떤 상황에서도 인간으로 남아 있어야 한다는 것을 알려주세요.

quests.content:
Pets Won't Need It is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
In these difficult times, finding the necessary chemicals has become extremely challenging. For a long time now, I've been taking whatever I can find without being selective, but even with that approach, our options are becoming more and more limited. I recently sent my people into the city to check several locations where supplies might still remain, but they weren't able to reach them. You, however... I believe you're capable of handling this task. Head downtown and search several locations: pharmacies, the vet clinic, and the workplace of a radiologist. There may still be something left there. Bring whatever you find back to me, and I'll purchase it from you. And remember, by doing this, you're helping the civilians who have suffered so much.

== Objectives ==
Locate and scout the vet clinic on Streets of Tarkov
Locate and scout the x-ray technician's room on Streets of Tarkov
Locate the first pharmacy on Primorsky Ave on Streets of Tarkov
Locate the second pharmacy on Primorsky Ave on Streets of Tarkov
Locate the third pharmacy at Cardinal apartment complex on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over any 5 found in raid medicine items

quests.content:
Pharmacist is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I want to ask you for a service. Don't put up that look, of course, it's not for free! In a small dorm, yes, the one inhabited by those bandits, somewhere on the first floor used to live a young paramedic from the factory. Unfortunately, I do not know the room number - when my colleagues and I were his guests on the Medical Worker Day, it was already dark, and in the middle of a party, you see. Well, he was a young specialist, still an intern, but very enthusiastic. Planned to enroll in the Military Medical Academy in St. Petersburg. And in his safe, right there in the room, he kept a case with the particular new medical device. Issued to him by the employer. He tried to get out of town on his blue VAZ 2109 with St. Petersburg plates. I don't know if he managed to get out or not, but as far as I have heard, he either got stuck near the gas station or apprehended by the military. In any case, I could really put that tool to good use. Come the darkest hour, and you might need it as well. Not that I wish for that to happen, don’t get me wrong, but... I assume you understand everything better than I. I need you to find it. Oh yes, I almost forgot, we have common interests with Arshavir in this matter. He has a good product for you. After you complete the task, of course.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the suitcase with the device on Customs
(Optional) Locate the paramedic's car on Customs
(Optional) Find a way inside the two-story dorm room 114 on Customs
Hand over the suitcase

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Pleasure doing business with you, young man. I will let Arshavir know about your success. Here's your reward.

== Guide ==
