sectionsKo.text:
저는 여러분께 부탁드립니다. 그런 모습을 하지 마세요. 물론 무료는 아닙니다. 작은 숙소에서, 네, 그 강도들이 거주하던 숙소에서, 제1층 어딘가에 팩토리의 젊은 의병원이 살고 있었습니다. 불행히도, 저는 객실 번호를 모릅니다. 제 동료들과 제가 의료 노동자 날에 그의 손님이었을 때, 이미 어두웠고, 파티 중이었습니다. 그는 젊은 전문가가였지만 여전히 인턴이지만 매우 열정적이었습니다. 상트페테르부르크의 군사 의학 아카데미에 등록할 계획이었습니다. 그리고 그의 안전보장 안에, 바로 그 방에, 그는 특정 새로운 의료 장치와 함께 한 케이스를 보관했습니다. 그에게 발행되었습니다. 그는 세인트페테르부르크의 파란색 VAZ 2109로 마을 밖으로 나가려고 시도했습니다. 그는 세인트페테르부르크의 파란색 판을 가지고 있습니다. 그는 멀리 떨어져 있거나 가스 스테이션 근처에 갇혀있는지 모르지만, 나는 알지 못합니다.
어쨌든, 저는 그 도구를 잘 사용할 수 있습니다. 가장 어두운 시간으로 오시면, 여러분도 필요할 수도 있습니다. 그런 일이 일어나기를 바라지는 않지만, 오해하지 마세요. 하지만... 당신은 나보다 모든 것을 잘 이해한다고 가정합니다.

quests.content:
Playing the Market is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Someone decided to crash the market recently. Dumped a massive batch of bitcoins, enough for TARGox to start filling orders at ten times below the usual market price. You could watch the order queue disappearing in real time. I barely managed to grab a couple hundred coins before it was over. And today the price is back where it was before. If the market is going to stay this heavily manipulated, we need to move fast while the opportunity is still there. There are control panels in the Polikhim factory, marked by red emergency lights. Take a couple of toolkits and repair the panels while I deal with the cooling system. Do that, and you'll get a share of the profits.

== Objectives ==
Fix the first control board with a Toolset on Factory
Fix the second control board with a Toolset on Factory

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1

Unlocks purchase of Ammunition case at Mechanic LL2
You're quicker than I expected. Nicely done. I'm almost finished with the cooling system on my end.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to repair 2 control boards with 2 Toolsets in Factory. They can be recognized by blinking red lights. It is recommended to repair them in separate raids, carrying the toolsets in your secure container. If you have a Secure container Epsilon or a Secure container Theta, you can safely place 2 per raid.

TARGox가 일반적인 시가격보다 10배 낮은 가격으로 주문을 채우기 시작할 만큼 충분했습니다. 실시간으로 주문 줄을 사라지는 것을 볼 수 있었습니다. 그것은 끝나기 전에 몇 백 개의 동전을 거의 잡을 수 없었습니다. 그리고 오늘날 가격은 이전과 같은 위치에 있습니다. 시장이 이렇게 고도로 조작되어있을 경우, 우리는 기회가 여전히있는 동안 빠르게 움직여야 합니다. 폴리히미 팩토리에는 빨간 비상등으로 표시된 제어판이 있습니다. 몇 가지 도구 키트를 가져다가 냉각 시스템을 처리하는 동안 패널을 수리하십시오. 그렇게하십시오. 그리고 당신은 수익의 일부를 얻을 것입니다.

== Dialogue ==
The bum from Polikhim? What am I, the bloody king of every stray in Tarkov now?! Alright, I know who you're talking about, same as everyone else who's lived here. He wasn't a bad bloke, but he lost the plot when all this mess kicked off. You're looking for him, are you? I can help you out, but not out of the goodness of my heart. The Scavs have been getting under my feet lately, making things difficult. Go give them a proper scare, and then I'll tell you what I know. Here's the list of places that need clearing.

Your bum was staying by the train tracks, in a wagon near the boiler building. There's a bunker nearby as well, right by the tracks. My lads used to see him in that carriage all the time.

quests.content:
Population Census is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, mercenary. You're just in time, I have an errand for you. I need to determine how many people have gone missing in the city. To do this, I need a list of all the residents of the city and subtract the already evacuated, the dead, and those who found shelter in the hospital. Your task is to find that list of residents. Bring me the journal from Primorsky District's Housing Department.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the journal containing resident details on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the journal

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
36,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
40,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

Mercenary, you know firsthand how many lives are lost in war. But you have no idea how many die not from a bullet or a knife, but by going missing. Some are buried in the concrete in their own home after the bombing. Someone died in their basement from exhaustion because they couldn't find food. Someone was swallowed by infection because they didn't have the necessary medicine and couldn't get to a hospital because of constant shelling... And there are at least fifteen percent of people like that in this journal.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a journal in the housing department building on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building.

objectivesKo: 팩토리의 헬리콥터 로그북 찾아 확보하기
발견된 정보 건네기
quests.content:
Possessor is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, warrior! You've probably seen a crashed chopper at the factory before, yeah? I wonder when and how it ended up there. But I know one thing for sure: they never sent helis to Tarkov to pick up anyone, neither before nor now. We should find out who was on that helicopter and what was their mission. You should go scout that heli. There's gotta be a logbook or something.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the helicopter logbook on Factory
Hand over the found information

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Haha! I knew you were the right merc for the job. The helicopter doesn't appear to be Russian, but that's only at first glance. It looks like our undercover operatives infiltrated the USECs and captured one of them! If there are no bodies near the helicopter, it means that the boys managed to escape, and the task was accomplished.

== Guide ==

The logbook is located in the cockpit of the crashed helicopter under the roof on Factory, below the pilot seat.

Helicopter location marked on map
Helicopter as seen from the ground, emitting a red light
The helicopter in the rafters
The logbook under the pilot seat

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 전사님, 팩토리에서 헬기가 추락한 걸 본 적 있으신가요? 언제 어떻게 그 헬기가 그 곳에 도착했는지 궁금합니다. 하지만 한 가지 확실한 것은, 전이나 지금 타르코프로 사람을 데려갈 사람을 보내지 않았다는 것입니다. 우리는 헬리콥터에 누가 있었고 그들의 임무가 무엇인지 알아내야 합니다. 당신은 헬리콥터를 탐구해야 합니다. 일기록이 있어야 합니다.

quests.title: Postman Pat - Part 1
objectivesKo: 죽은 사신과 팩토리에 그의 편지를 얻으십시오 찾기
위치에서 생존 후 탈출하기
테라피스트에게 편지 건네기
quests.content:
Postman Pat - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in, make yourself at home. How's the life of constant battle? No extra preternatural holes in your hide? Jolly good. No freaking use for them, eh? I’m in a bit of a tight unpleasant spot here. Will you help me out? My messenger vanished. I entrusted a job for this local waste of skin, he played so tough. In short, I’ve sent a little note to Therapist with some proposals for a mutually beneficial cooperation. Nothing special, but nothing outsiders should know either. And so this meat sack went missing, and a little bird told me that this postman got whacked somewhere in the Factory. Why the heck would he go there, that moron? Told him to take the straight path. So anyway, find the body and check it, my scribbles might still be there. And if by some miracle they are, hand them to that medic woman, will ya?

== Objectives ==
Locate the dead messenger and obtain his letter on Factory
Survive and extract from the location
Hand over the letter to Therapist

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Now that’s what it means to work with proven man! Said, done!

== Guide ==

The dead messenger is located in a bunker on the main floor of Factory. For orientation, the number "1986" can be seen painted above the bunker on the wall. The letter can be found next to his body on the ground.

The letter must be handed over to Therapist for her quest Postman Pat - Part 2 before this quest can be completed.

Bunker location marked on map
The wanted bunker, "1986" on the wall above it
The letter on the ground

== Trivia ==
The quest name is a reference to the British children's TV show "Postman Pat."

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 들어와서, 집에 있는 것처럼 느껴보세요. 끊임없는 전투의 삶은 어떠세요? 피부에 초자연적인 구멍이 없나요? 너무 좋네요. 그 들의 쓸모가 없죠. 아뇨? 저는 여기 좀 좁은 불쾌한 곳에 있습니다. 도와줄래요? 내 사신 사라졌습니다. 이 지역 피부 쓰레기 위해 일 맡겼습니다. 그는 너무 강했습니다. 간단히 말해서, 저는 테라피스트에 상호 유익한 협력을 제안하는 작은 메모를 보냈습니다. 특별한 것은 없지만 외부인들도 알아야 할 것은 없습니다. 그리고 이 고기 가방이 사라졌습니다. 그리고 작은 새는 팩토리에서 어느 곳에서 우편관이 살해되었다고 말했어요. 어쨌든 왜 저 남자가 거기에 갈까요? 그 바보는 그에게 직접 손을 잡으라고 말했다. 그래서 제 몸을 확인하고, 그것을 확인하고, 그것이 여전히 기적이라고 할 수 있습니다. 그리고 여인이 그들을 발견할 수 있다면, 그들은 여전히 의학적 경로를 찾을 수 있습니다. 그리고 그들이 여전히 그들을 발견할 수 있습니다.

quests.content:
Preserve a Valuable Piece is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The Rogues' retreat to the chalets was the only correct move given the situation they found themselves in. And I'm quite satisfied with the new balance of power on my territory. But I know some people want to destroy the Rogues completely, removing one of the factions from the conflict. That cannot be allowed. So, if you're interested in strengthening your position at the lighthouse, you may take part in their defense. You don't need to enter the chalets themselves. The Rogues will shoot at you as well. But I'm willing to pay for eliminating PMC operatives in this part of the coast. Just don't work against me.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 7 PMC operatives on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+40,000 EXP
1× Substation marked key
It's good that you managed to avoid any surprises. Without your involvement, the Rogues would've had a much harder time surviving those first few weeks.

== Failure Dialogue ==
It's surprising that you decided to come here after the choice you made. If your disobedience had led to serious consequences, Zryachiy would've intercepted you by now. But I never intended to rely heavily on a mercenary like you in the first place. You needn't come unless there's an urgent reason. I'll entrust serious work to others.

== Guide ==
By completing Cut Down to the Root, you fail and will lose access to this quest.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 로그의 차렛으로 철수하는 것은 그들이 처한 상황을 고려해 볼 때 유일한 올바른 움직임이었습니다. 그리고 나는 내 영토의 새로운 힘 균형에 만족합니다. 하지만 나는 어떤 사람들이 로그를 완전히 파괴하고, 갈등에서 한 분파를 제거하고 싶어하는 것을 알고 있습니다. 이것은 허용되지 않습니다. 그래서, 당신이 라이트하우스에서 자신의 위치를 강화하는 데 관심이 있다면, 당신은 그들의 방어에 참여할 수 있습니다. 당신은 차렛 자체로 들어갈 필요가 없습니다. 로그은 당신을 총을 쏠 것입니다. 하지만 나는 해안이 이 부분에서 PMC 운영자를 제거하기 위해 돈을 지불 할 준비가되어 있습니다. 단지 나에게 반대하지 마십시오.

quests.content:
Price for Information is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
They aren't ordinary mercenaries. They play an important role in what's happening now and what will happen later. But I'm not going to tell you more than you need to know. You've already crossed paths with them. Obviously, you want to influence something. But you won't change anything this way. You'll only become another one of their targets. I propose a different arrangement. Correct your mistakes with your own hands, and perhaps I'll share the information you're looking for. First, we need to clear one route. Follow the route from the coast to the woods through the military base and eliminate any potential threats along the way. But if you see Black Division, do not engage them under any circumstances.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Use the transit from Shoreline to Lighthouse (In one raid)
Use the transit from Lighthouse to Reserve (In one raid)
Use the transit from Reserve to Woods (In one raid)
Eliminate any 10 targets except Black Division while completing the other objectives

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× RB-VO marked key
Do you really still not understand, or do you simply refuse to believe what you're seeing? USEC were a tool for TerraGroup from the very beginning. And like any tool, they lost their value once they had served their purpose. But unlike them, Black Division answer directly to those who shape the course of events in the world. And I'm not talking about TerraGroup's managers. The corporation's facilities in Tarkov no longer need protection. The city requires a more precise instrument to surgically remove everything that has no place here. And I wouldn't advise you to interfere with the operation.

== Guide ==
== Shoreline to Lighthouse ==
In front of the Path to Lighthouse extraction.

== Lighthouse to Reserve ==
On the road leading to the Road to Military Base V-Ex extraction.

== Reserve to Woods transit ==
At the map border northwest of the train yard.

sectionsKo.text: 그들은 평범한 용병이 아닙니다. 그들은 지금 일어나고 있는 것과 나중에 일어날 일에 중요한 역할을 합니다. 하지만, 당신이 알아야 할 것보다 더 많은 것을 말하지 않을 것입니다. 당신은 이미 그들과 길을 건너가 왔습니다. 분명히, 당신은 어떤 것을 영향을 주고 싶어합니다. 하지만 당신은 이런 식으로 아무것도 바꾸지 않을 것입니다. 당신은 단지 그들의 목표 중 한 명일 것입니다. 나는 다른 조정을 제안합니다. 당신의 잘못을 직접 수정하고, 아마도 당신이 찾고 있는 정보를 공유 할 것입니다. 먼저, 우리는 한 경로를 정해야합니다. 해안에서 우즈까지의 경로를 따라 군 기지를 통해 모든 잠재적 위협을 제거하십시오. 그러나 당신이 블랙 디비전를 볼 때, 어떤 상황에서도 그들을 참여하지 마십시오.

quests.content:
Private Club is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Opachki, would you look at this little character. You got any ibuprofen? My noggin's fucking killing me. What, something wrong, princess? Yes, I got hammered last night, so what? It was a major league game! They wouldn't let a twat like you anywhere near that table. Sometimes we get together to test our luck, but yesterday clearly wasn't my day. Not only did I lose a shitload of money, but also my fucking wallet. You're here for work, ye? Here, I'll give you a fucking job. Find my wallet. And don't even try any bullshit, I'd recognize mine with my eyes closed. We were at Warehouse 17 near the customs terminal, that's where I last seen it. Second floor, mate.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain Skier's wallet on Customs
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.1
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Proper good fucking job mate! I knew it couldn't just vanish into thin air like that. We have some kind of connection, you and I. This little baby is like a lucky charm for me. When I bought this wallet, things went booming for me. I've gotten it lost a thousand times since then, but it always comes back to me.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Skier's wallet on Customs. It can be found in a room on the second floor of Warehouse 17. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.

Warehouse 17 location marked on map
Warehouse 17 southern entrance
Way to the room on the second floor
Door to the room

First spawn on the floor under the shelf next to the door
Second spawn on the floor under the table
Third spawn on the table
Fourth spawn behind the TV on the desk

Luka and his boys repelled those thugs, he said it was a tough fight. And guess what, there's still no sign of the military, the thugs were definitely in on it with them. I guess you can find someone like our Prapor even beyond the cordon, huh? The only issues left are the good ones. They're ready to send a shipment from the other side, but it doesn't fit any of the old schemes. It's a wagonload of equipment! To get it all out, my mate demands a special fee, all in advance. The risks are too fucking high, so we have to pay. This bastard's got a bitcoin farm over there, I reckon.

sectionsKo.text: 루카와 그의 친구들이 거시들을 물리쳤고, 그는 그것이 힘든 싸움이라고 말했다. 그리고 무슨 일이 있었는지 짐작하세요, 아직 군대의 흔적이 없습니다. 거시들은 확실히 그들과 함께 있었다. 저는 우리 프라포르 같은 사람을 코든 너머에서도 찾을 수 있다고 생각합니다. 남은 문제들은 좋은 문제입니다. 그들은 다른 쪽에서 배포를 보낼 준비가되어 있지만, 그것은 오래된 계획들 중 어느 하나에 적합하지 않습니다. 그것은 장비의 바그런이 가득합니다! 모든 것을 꺼내기 위해, 내 친구는 미리 특별 요금을 요구합니다. 위험은 너무 높습니다, 그래서 우리는 지불해야합니다. 이 악당은 거기에 비트코인 농장을 가지고 있습니다.

objectivesKo: 15 트라이지콘 REAP-IR 열광역 건네기
quests.content:
Profitable Venture is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've got an opportunity on the table right now, and it could be seriously profitable. But I need a reliable partner, and you could be just the bloke for it. I got talking with one commander, his squad is made up entirely of veterans. But the lads were abroad when all this shit kicked off. They still want to work though, and they say they've got a lead on an abandoned USEC base somewhere in the region. The problem is, some bunch of nobodies have already taken over the place. If we do this properly, Luka and his lads will be able to keep supplying us with gear and other hard-to-find stuff on a regular basis. They want to go in for reconnaissance at night, so we don't cause a stir. You know how it is, those are quiet areas and there's too much attention we don't need. But the lads don't have any thermal optics, so they asked me to get some from here, that way nobody can trace it back to them. If you want in on this business, now's the time!

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 15 Trijicon REAP-IR thermal scopes

== Rewards ==
+1 Stress Resistance skill level
+1 Perception skill level
+1 Attention skill level
+1 Aim Drills skill level
+1 Light Vests skill level
+1 Heavy Vests skill level
+1 Weapon Maintenance skill level
+1 Troubleshooting skill level
Not a cheap investment, but you'll make it back later! The lads gave me the contact of a local special forces instructor. The bloke's retired, but he knows things they never taught you in your overseas training! Consider it a little bonus from our partnership.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.text: 지금 테이블 위에 있는 기회는 있고, 정말 수익성이 있을 수도 있습니다. 하지만, 믿을만한 파트너가 필요하고, 당신은 그 사람을 할 수 있습니다. 저는 한 장군과 이야기했습니다. 그의 부대는 전용으로 구성되어 있습니다. 하지만, 이 모든 일이 시작되었을 때, 아이들은 해외에 있었습니다. 그들은 여전히 일하고 싶어하고, 그리고 그들은 지역에서 버려진 USEC 기지에 대한 단서를 가지고 있다고 말합니다. 문제는, 어떤 무리가 이미 장소를 점령했습니다. 우리가 이것을 제대로 한다면, 루카와 그의 사람들은 정기적으로 장비와 다른 찾기 어려운 물건을 공급 할 수 있습니다. 그들은 밤에 탐사하러 가고 싶어, 그래서 우리는 혼란을 일으키지 않습니다. 당신은 알고 있습니다. 그것은 조용하고 너무 많은 관심과 우리가 필요로 하는 지역입니다. 하지만, 그들은 지금, 어떤 열 사업에서 그들을 추적 할 수 있습니다. 그러나, 그들은 지금, 어떤 시간 동안, 당신은 그들을 찾을 수 없습니다.

quests.content:
Proper Comeback is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're a good guy, I'll tell you that. I wouldn't trust another man to do this, but you're an experienced fellow, you understand what I'm saying. I heard that Prapor is now into modern technology, and he's got cameras everywhere, watching everything from his man cave. And recently he ruined one of my deals, started yelling like a damn rooster, something about the rules of trade and military order... We have to show him what a motherfucker he's become. Oops, sorry for the offensive language. Hope it doesn't disrespect your community guidelines.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

== Objectives ==
Stash a Golden rooster figurine at Prapor's WI-FI Camera on Woods
Stash a Golden rooster figurine at Prapor's WI-FI Camera on Shoreline
Stash a Golden rooster figurine at Prapor's WI-FI Camera on Factory

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
2,400 Euros
2,520 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,760 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Golden egg
2× Tetriz portable game console
Well done! They say that even the outside world found out about our little move, haha!

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to place 1 Golden rooster figurine each on Woods, Shoreline and Factory. The locations are the same as in the previous quest Viewer from Prapor.

(These are 40 second plant times.)

On Woods it has to be placed next to a tree at a rock ledge on the mountain.

Location marked on map
Placement location surroundings
Placement location

On Shoreline it has to be placed at the top of the lighthouse near the pier.

Lighthouse location marked on map
The lighthouse

On Factory it has to be placed at the top of the office area stairs that are on the "Gate 3" extraction side, opposite the door to the catwalk. Note: Can not be completed at night at the current time.

Placement location

== Trivia ==
The quest dialogue is a reference to a ban that was issued on the Battlestate Games Twitch channel after breaking the community guidelines by using "offensive language".

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 당신은 좋은 사람이고, 내가 말할게요. 다른 사람이 이런 일을 할 수 있다고 믿지 않을 겁니다. 하지만 당신은 경험이 많은 사람이고, 당신이 말하는 것을 이해합니다. 저는 프라포르가 현대 기술에 들어갔다고 들었습니다. 그는 모든 곳에서 카메라를 가지고 있습니다. 그는 그의 인간 동굴에서 모든 것을 지켜보고 있습니다. 그리고 최근에 그는 내 거래 중 하나를 망치고, 망할 개구리처럼 소리질 시작했습니다. 무역과 군사 질서 규칙에 대해 뭔가... 우리는 그에게 그가 얼마나 큰 망할자가 되었는지 보여야 합니다. 오프스, 공격적인 언어에 대해 미안합니다. 그것은 당신의 지역 사회 지침을 무시하지 않기를 바랍니다.

== Dialogue ==
Heyo, soldier! I've got a little job for you, easy as always. You probably know that TerraGroup acted honorably at first: they filed official requests, compiled documents, paid taxes, all this crap. It's only later that they went off the motherfucking rails. I have a feeling that the city's real estate fund may have kept records of the facilities bought or leased by those fucks. If you poke around, you might find something interesting. I'll bet it'll uncover a lot of hidden assets. You up for it?

== Objectives ==

Hand over the obtained information

== Rewards ==

165,000 Roubles

Did you find it? Nice work, now bring it here! And take your reward, you deserve it.

패키지 건네기
quests.content:
Protect the Sky is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You weren't being tailed, were you? Skier is definitely up to something. I'm even afraid to sleep in the BTR now! But I can't back down now. I've started setting up a new base, and this time I want to build a solid defense. Someone's willing to provide me with a decent electronic jamming system. We've already settled the payment, it's just a matter of delivering the package to me. They picked an unusual place for the transfer: a cemetery in the forest. It's not big, but you'll find it no problem. There's a stretcher and bodies lying around near it. Can you get the package from the stash? Oh, but don't go straight there from here. Go to your base, take a breather, and then go to the stash from there. Can't let anyone find out about my new purchase.

== Objectives ==
Locate the package in the specified spot on Woods
Hand over the package

== Rewards ==
+25,400 EXP
BTR Driver Rep +0.02
96,000 Roubles
4× .300 Blackout CBJ ammo pack (50 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of Aklys Defense Velociraptor .300 Blackout assault rifle at Mechanic LL4
Thank you! At least now I have a place to sleep. Nothing will come down from above now. And on the ground, the landmines should stop them. I've covered everything. Let's see them looting my spare parts again!

== Guide ==
The quest Simple Side Job from Lightkeeper will automatically fail if this quest is completed first.
This item will only appear in your next Woods raid after accepting this quest.

In this quest you have to find a KOSA UAV electronic jamming device on Woods. There are multiple spawns at a gravesite south of the dilapidated village in the north.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 당신은 꼬리 못 잡았던가요? 스키어는 확실히 무언가를 계획하고 있습니다. 나는 지금 BTR에서 잠을 자지도 두려워합니다! 하지만 지금은 뒤로 물러나지 못합니다. 나는 새로운 기지를 세우고 있습니다. 이번에는 견고한 방어기를 만들고 싶습니다. 누군가가 나에게 괜찮은 전자 제임 시스템을 제공하기를 기꺼이합니다. 우리는 이미 지불을 정했습니다. 그것은 단지 나에게 패키지를 배달하는 문제입니다. 그들은 이전을위한 특이한 장소를 선택했습니다. 숲의 묘지. 그것은 큰 것이 아닙니다. 그러나 당신은 그것을 찾을 수 없습니다. 그것은 근처에 렉터와 시체가 있습니다. 당신은 스텔에서 패키지를 얻을 수 있습니까? 오, 그러나 거기에서 가지 않습니다. 당신은 바로 거기에 가서 당신의 기지를 가져가, 그리고 그 다음으로, 새 스텔에서 구입할 수있는 사람을 찾을 수 없습니다.

quests.content:
Provide Viewership is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, gladiator! Judging by the fact that you're still in one piece, you've developed a good skill set. That's exactly what I need. Arena fights are thriving, but you know the human nature. The audience gets used to everything and will always ask for more! So I've come up with something more interesting. I want to broadcast the fights in real Tarkov conditions for a group of special customers. You need to set up a camera and then show them what you're made of. You can put the camera on some building near the construction site at customs. I don't care who's in your crosshairs. You yourself are the centerpiece of this show! People will cheer for you and pay good money for it. Of course, I've taken your commitment into account, so expect a reward.

== Objectives ==
Install the first WI-FI Camera Inside the industrial plant on Customs
Install the second WI-FI Camera Inside the industrial plant on Customs
Install the third WI-FI Camera Inside the industrial plant on Customs
Install the fourth WI-FI Camera Inside the industrial plant on Customs
Eliminate any 15 targets inside the industrial plant on Customs
Note: The "Eliminate" objective will appear after the "Install" objectives are completed.

== Rewards ==
+32,000 EXP
Ref Rep +0.02
45 GP coins
47 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
52 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Lone Star TX-15 DML 5.56x45 carbine
3× AR-15 5.56x45 HK 30 STANAG polymer 30-round magazine
3× 5.56x45mm M855A1 ammo pack (50 pcs)
There he is, a true Tarkov warrior! The audience loved it, so if you don't plan to drop out anytime soon, drop by often. Your talents deserve attention. And attention is expensive these days. Oh, by the way, here's your paycheck.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to install 4 WI-FI Cameras in the industrial plant on Customs. Afterwards you have to kill any 15 targets in and around it.

sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 성선수님! 당신이 아직 한 조각에 있다는 사실에 따라 판단하면, 당신은 좋은 기술 세트를 개발했습니다. 그것이 바로 제가 필요로 하는 것입니다. 아레나 전투는 번영하고 있지만, 당신은 인간의 본성을 알고 있습니다. 관객들은 모든 것에 익숙해져 항상 더 많은 것을 요구할 것입니다! 그래서 저는 더 흥미로운 것을 생각해 왔습니다. 저는 특별한 고객 그룹을 위해 실제 타르코프 조건에서 전투를 방송하고 싶습니다. 당신은 카메라를 설치하고 당신이 만든 것을 보여줘야 합니다. 당신은 커스텀에서 건설 현장 근처에 있는 어떤 건물에 카메라를 넣을 수 있습니다. 나는 당신의 눈앞에 누가 있는지 신경 쓰지 않습니다. 당신은 이 쇼의 중심입니다! 사람들은 당신을 응원하고 좋은 돈을 지불합니다. 물론, 나는 당신의 약속을 고려하고, 그래서 보상을 기대합니다.

quests.content:
Provocation is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Time is of the essence. My cleaner crew found evidence of Glukhar's connection to the arms development that took place under the aegis of TerraGroup. The next task for you is to provoke Glukhar's contacts into doing something foolish. They probably don't know yet that Glukhar is no longer available. Go to Ultra, TerraGroup has had a staging post there since the early days. Make a mess of it, make a show of it. Use the trophy you took from the bull's body. And for the particularly savvy, leave something humiliating in place to say hello, so to speak. The mutts must know their place.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 20 targets inside the ULTRA Mall with an ASH-12 assault rifle on Interchange
Stash a Salty Dog beef sausage inside the Kiba Arms store on Interchange
Stash a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine inside the Saferoom Exfil on Interchange
Stash a Toilet paper inside the secret container stash on Interchange

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.03
2× Virtex programmable processor
1× Lighthouse island stash key
Unlocks craft for FLIR RS-32 2.25-9x 35mm 60Hz thermal riflescope at Workbench level 3
Unlocks the Lightkeeper service "Rogue support"
So, you left a message for our friends, now we'll wait for a reaction. For now, you can go.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have kill any 20 targets with an ASh-12 12.7x55 assault rifle in the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange.

Afterwards you have to stash a Salty Dog beef sausage, a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine and Toilet paper in the designated locations.

== Sausage placement location ==
The Salty Dog beef sausage has to be placed at a wooden crate in the fenced off area inside the Kiba Arms store on the first floor of the mall. Power, Kiba Arms outer door key and Kiba Arms inner grate door key required.

objectivesKo: 15개의 목표물을 제거하고, 이용 총을 사용하면서 죽지 않고
quests.content:
Psycho Sniper is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. I had an acquaintance named Dima. He worked as a sniper in many hot zones. Once he told me: "Anyone can pull a trigger, but only a few can become a true Sniper". Even if that's true, knowing how to work with bolt-action rifles won't hurt in Tarkov. And I don't mind encouraging you to develop that skill. Take out your opponents, and I'll reward you for it.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 15 targets without dying while using a bolt-action rifle

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Bolt-action Rifles skill levels
+4 Troubleshooting skill levels
Mechanic Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks purchase of 4.6x30mm FMJ SX at Mechanic LL4
3× 4.6x30mm FMJ SX ammo pack (40 pcs)
Honestly, I even started to doubt my own idea a little, but you handled everything. Here's the reward I promised.

== Failure Dialogue ==
An experienced sniper will not give himself away like that. Catch your breath and try again.

== Guide ==
The kill objective can still fail through dying after completing it.

sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 용병. 디마라는 친구가 있었습니다. 그는 많은 뜨거운 지역에서 저격수로 일했습니다. 한 번 그는 제게 말했습니다. "누구나 발사기를 끌 수 있지만, 몇 명만이 진정한 저격수 될 수 있습니다". 사실이라면도, 타르코프에서 볼트 액션 총을 사용하는 방법을 아는 것은 해를 끼치지 않을 것입니다. 그리고 그 기술을 개발하도록 격려하는 것은 싫어요. 상대방을 제거하고, 나는 당신을 보상합니다.

quests.content:
Quality Standard is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon. I've learned that comrade Prapor has become nostalgic lately. Although I can't find time for such things myself, your and Prapor's affairs have brought me to a good idea. When the locals found out about TerraGroup's underground laboratory, there was quite a stir! It was a breakthrough for my business, the lab is where I got my unique equipment from. Well, there may still be some original American leftover LEDX from back then. Can you get me one of those? It would really help our cause.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the special version of the LEDX Skin Transilluminator in The Lab
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× Propital regenerative stimulant injector
5× eTG-change regenerative stimulant injector
My thanks to you. I don't know what we'd do if the lab wasn't accessible to people like you.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the LEDX Skin Transilluminator (US Version) in The Lab. It is located on top of a blue barrel inside the orange dome in the main working area (O11) on the first level.

Rat Hunting is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. You know, a few days ago I caught myself thinking that Tarkov had somehow become... quieter. At least for me. Then yesterday I realized that feeling was misleading. Someone's been deliberately jamming signals in my area of operation. I don't like it, but I don't want to scare them off just yet. You understand why, they could always come back with something more sophisticated. So first I'm going to try a little trick to work around the jammers without alerting whoever's behind them. To do that, I'll need a few components... Here's the list.

== Objectives ==

Hand over the item

Hand over the item

Hand over the item

+10,000 EXP

I'll put it together quickly. Though, of course, I'm no match for Elektronik.

quests.content:
Regulated Materials is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on in, warrior! Still breathing aye? Good to hear. Here's a task for you. There's this customer, showed up outta nowhere with an urgent order and the bitch wants specific equipment, the one our glorious mother Russia produced, and my heart aches that the good of the state has to be sold to whoever. Judging by the accent, the fucker is from abroad. But the cash is noble and the connections he provides are no joke. Anyway, you need one military battery, the heavy one, and several OFZ shells. I feel you'll have to sneak on the military base for it... The place is inhospitable, I know, but you won't regret it when the checkout time comes. Plus, I’ll provide you with a special gift for this. Will you take the risk?

== Objectives ==
Find 1 6-STEN-140-M military battery in raid
Hand over 1 military battery to Prapor
Find 3 OFZ 30x165mm shells in raid
Hand over the 3 OFZ shells to Prapor

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+2 Charisma skill levels
Prapor Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks craft for 6-STEN-140-M military battery at Workbench level 1
Now that's the good stuff! Heavy as hell, yeah? So anyway, I keep my word about the reward, check out the new rifles I have...

== Guide ==

The items required for this quest need to be found in raid. They can be found as Loose Loot on Lighthouse and Reserve, but can be found in containers elsewhere, as well as a small chance for a Scav to have it in their backpack. The 6-STEN-140-M military battery is a large 4x2 slot item that resembles a black/brown box. It can most commonly be found sitting on or near tanks. The OFZ 30x165mm shells can be found throughout the Reserve on tables, shelving and at the rear side of every tank on the map, on the ground. Both of the items required for this quest can also be obtained from the Scav Case in the Hideout.

A OFZ 30x165mm shell on a tank on Reserve
A 6-STEN-140-M military battery next to a tank on Reserve

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 와, 전사! 아직도 숨쉬는거야? 잘 들었어. 여기 네 임무가 있다. 이 고객이 갑자기 갑자기 급한 주문을 가지고 나타났고 그 개미는 특별한 장비가 필요하고 우리 영광스러운 어머니 러시아가 만든 것인데, 내 마음은 국가의 이익을 누구에게 팔아야 한다고 고통 받고 있습니다. 억양에 따라 판단하면, 이 망할 사람은 외국에서 온 것입니다. 하지만 현금은 귀한 것이고 그가 제공하는 연결은 농담이 아닙니다. 어쨌든, 당신은 한 군 배터리, 무거운 것, 그리고 몇 가지 OFZ 상탄이 필요합니다. 나는 당신이 그것을 위해 군 기지에 속삭여야 할 것 같습니다. 장소는 불대행한, 나는 알고 있지만 당신이 체크 아웃 시간 올 때 후회하지 않을 것입니다. 더 나아가, 나는 당신에게 특별한 선물을 제공 할 것입니다. 당신은 위험을 감수할 것인가?

sectionsKo.text: 이 탐사선에 필요한 물품은 습격에서 발견되어야 한다. 라이트하우스 및 리저브에서 Loose Loot으로 발견될 수 있지만 다른 곳에서 컨테이너에서 발견될 수 있으며, 스캐브의 허벅지에 있는 작은 기회도 있다. 6 STEN-140-M 군사 배터리는 검은색/갈색 상자와 비슷한 큰 4x2 슬롯이다. 가장 일반적으로 탱크 위에 또는 그 근처에 앉아있는 것을 발견할 수 있다. quests.content:
Return the Favor is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The whole thing is starting to become clearer. It seems that the customer is not from around here, as I initially assumed. The order came from the beyond the border. I have contacts who are willing to assist, but they will need a favor in return. They own a certain, shall we say, facility, located in the Priozersky Natural Reserve. You can see the facility from everywhere, but nobody has a clue what is hiding under the mountain. If you've been in those places, you must have seen the hill that towers over the entire forest. So, some curious tourists began to flock around that hill, and they are itching to open all the doors they see. As you know, curiosity killed the cat. Do the right thing and get rid of those cats. And while you're there, leave the documents for the USECs in their camp. Remember, these documents must not fall into the wrong hands.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 15 PMC operatives on Woods
Hide the TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials inside the black SUV in the USEC camp on Woods
Hide the TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials in the crates near the satellite antenna in the USEC camp on Woods
Note: The "Hide" objectives will appear after the "Eliminate" objective is completed.

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.03
1× Silicon Optoelectronic Integrated Circuits textbook
1× Lighthouse island stash key
You've done well, mercenary. You will be a useful asset. Come back later, there's still some unfinished business to take care of.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to kill 15 PMCs on Woods. Afterwards you have to hide 2 TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials in the "USEC camp" which is located in the northwest. The west and north-west approaches to the camp are covered with landmines. One has to be stashed on the passenger side of a black SUV in the south of the camp, and the second one has to be stashed at the wooden crates next to the satellite antenna in the north of the camp.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 모든 것이 점점 더 명확해지고 있습니다. 고객이 처음 생각했던 것처럼 여기 있는 것이 아닙니다. 주문은 국경 너머에서 왔습니다. 도움을 줄 준비가 된 연락처가 있습니다. 하지만 그들은 대가로 용의를 필요로 할 것입니다. 그들은 프리오저스키 자연 리저브에 위치한 특정 시설을 소유하고 있습니다. 당신은 모든 곳에서 시설을 볼 수 있지만 아무도 산 아래에서 숨겨져있는 것을 알 수 없습니다. 당신이 그 장소에서 있다면, 당신은 산을 솟아있는 언덕을 보았을 것입니다. 그래서, 일부 호기심있는 관광객이 그 언덕을 돌고 시작했고, 그들은 그들이 보는 모든 문을 열려고 노력합니다. 당신은 알고있는 것처럼, 호기심은 살해했습니다. 올바른 일을하고 그 고양이를 제거하십시오. 그리고 당신이있는 동안, 당신은 당신의 손에 서있는 동안, 문서를 USEC에 남겨두고 있습니다. 기억하십시오. 이 문서는 캠프에 떨어지지 않습니다.

quests.content:
Reverse Gear is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You haven't gone after any more of those guys in black, have you? We're in deep shit... As soon as I handed over their gear, I got a call. From the top brass. They told me to stay out of it, not to engage that unit, and to remove every observation point. And who's gonna answer for the men I lost, huh? You tell me, are those rear-echelon rats gonna step in and replace the dead? But there's nothing I can fucking do. If we keep digging, there'll be consequences. They made that crystal clear. They can wipe me out along with everything I've built, and they'll chew you up as an afterthought. Don't doubt that for a second. So the cameras have to come down. Can you handle it?

== Requirements ==

== Objectives ==

This turned into one hell of a mess, but it is what it is. Keep your head down and stay alive. Tarkov just became a whole lot more dangerous with these visitors around.

== Guide ==

Revision - Lighthouse is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Ah, mercenary, just when I needed you. You've probably already seen all the military machinery in the USEC operational base area? My clients are willing to provide a reward for materials extracted from those vehicles. According to our information, part of the vehicles should be inside the base itself, while other vehicles have been seen somewhere along the main road. I want you to identify the exact location of this machinery and mark it for my subordinates. We need at least one Stryker and one BRDM car. Have fun, mercenary.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark any of the BRDM cars with an MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse
Locate and mark any of the Stryker vehicles withan MS2000 Marker on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.75
1,900 Dollars
1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
Perfect, mercenary. We'll figure out the rest by ourselves, so your help in this matter will no longer be needed. See you later.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find and mark a BRDM and a Stryker vehicle with MS2000 Markers on Lighthouse. There are 3 possible locations for each.

Vehicle locations marked on map
First BRDM at the water treatment plant
Second BRDM at the water treatment plant
Third BRDM at the UN checkpoint
First Stryker on the road to the lighthouse peninsula territory
Second Stryker on the road to the blue (northern) chalet
Third Stryker at the shore northwest of water treatment plant building #3

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 아, 용병, 내가 당신을 필요로 할 때. 당신은 USEC 운영 기지 지역의 모든 군사 기계를 이미 보았을 것입니다. 제 고객은 그 차량에서 추출 된 재료에 대한 보상을 제공 할 준비가되어 있습니다. 우리 정보에 따르면, 차량의 일부가 기지 자체에 있어야 하며, 다른 차량은 주요 도로에서 어딘가에 보였습니다. 이 기계의 정확한 위치를 확인하고 제 하급자를 위해 표시하고 싶습니다. 우리는 적어도 한 스트라이커와 한 BRDM 자동차가 필요합니다. 재미있게, 용병.

Good day. As you know, the blue helmets are here to lower the level of aggression in the region. That is why I want you to assess the danger levels. Infiltrate the military base and search it for anything that could present military danger. After all, the blue helmets are supposed to keep the peace. Some knowledgeable people have provided me with a list of military machinery located in the military base area, which also includes NATO units. I think they want to safely dispose of it, or something else, I don't know. Anyway, you have to find the machinery and mark it with beacons. The clients offer good money for this, so don't let me down, mercenary.

In this quest you have to find 4 "BMP-2" vehicles and mark them with MS2000 Markers. To access the location of one of the BMPs, a RB-ST key is required.

quests.content:
Riding the Wave is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Heya, brother! I'm not even gonna ask if you've run into those black uniform "visitors". I figured you didn't come here by accident. You knew I'd have a job for you on this, didn't you? From every sample that's made its way to me, it's obvious these guys are the real deal. So it's no surprise I've been flooded with people asking for gear with the same features or at least the same camouflage... I'd be a fool to let an opportunity like this slip away. I need a complete inventory of everything they wear. Once I've got that, I can put together my own versions, or maybe even make an exact copy of their whole kit. And don't worry, you'll be the first one to get your hands on it! Just don't let me down, alright?

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the found in raid item: First Spear Siege-R Optimized M.A.S.S. Plate Carrier (Black Division)
Hand over the found in raid item: Spiritus Systems LV-119 Plate Carrier (Black Division V2)
Hand over the found in raid item: Ferro Concepts FCPC V5 Plate Carrier (Black Division)
Hand over the found in raid item: Spiritus Systems LV-119 Plate Carrier (Black Division V1)
Hand over the found in raid item: Tasmanian Tiger Modular Pack 45 Plus (MultiCam Black)
Hand over the found in raid item: Mystery Ranch 2 Day Assault Pack (Black)
Hand over the found in raid item: Mystery Ranch NICE Frame Load Sling
Hand over the found in raid item: Avon M53A1 gas mask
Hand over the found in raid item: Gentex Ops-Core SOTR respirator
Hand over the found in raid item: Gatorz Specter MILSPEC ballistic glasses

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× NPP KlASS Bagariy plate carrier (EMR)
3× Crye Precision AVS plate carrier (Ranger Green)
Now that's what I'm talking about! Although it's a bit strange the armor plates are missing... but that's just a minor detail. The important thing is you brought me everything I needed. Thanks! Now it's my turn to get to work. Drop by again later, and I'll have something new for you.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to hand over one of each piece of gear Black Division is wearing to Ragman.

Rigged Game is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey you, tough guy! C'mere, I have a job for you. I've heard Prapor sent you to get a supply of drugs from some Sanitar dude. Don't make that face! I ain't got no interest in those drugs, let Prapor collect it and put it up his ass, you have already received profit from him anyway, haven't you? You just need to put these smart little things in containers that are in Sanitar's stashes. Prapor won't get wind of anything, it's a two-minute job, but the profit is good. Just gotta do it fast, before they move those containers.

== Objectives ==
Mark the medical container at the Health Resort with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the medical container by cottages with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the medical container at the river pier with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP

1,650 Roubles
1,732 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,897 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Good stuff, good stuff! Finally, Prapor will get his caches exposed, there are probably whole mountains of loot. Guns, ammo, food, dope. Out fucking standing! We'll do this one ourselves though, without you. No offense. Thanks.

== Guide ==

Contrary to the quest objectives, in this quest you have to stash MS2000 Markers at 3 medical containers on Shoreline. They are located next to Sanitar's treatment locations from the quest Anesthesia. The markers can be stashed in any order over any number of raids.

quests.content:
Road Closed is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Mercenary, there is a task for you. There's been a large firefight in the city. Someone ambushed a convoy carrying critical cargo. I'm sure it's the treacherous BEARs, but we'll have to make sure. At this point, it's not as critical to eliminate these war criminals as it is to make sure the cargo is still intact. Go there and report back.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs

== Objectives ==
Locate the cargo convoy on Streets of Tarkov
Determine the ambush spot
Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
The cargo is in place, that's reassuring. If the attack was from a car dealership, then it wasn't the BEARs. So it's Kaban again... Thank you for your work.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to find the cargo convoy and the ambush spot on Streets of Tarkov. The convoy is located between the LexOs car dealership and the Pinewood hotel. The ambush spot is an area that reaches from the green container with the AGS-30 grenade launcher behind the car dealership to the northeastern part of the car dealership.

Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with Claymores.

Convoy and ambush spot with Claymores marked on map

The ambush spot

Rough Tarkov is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to locate the heavily mined area on Woods and the claymore mine on Ground Zero.

== Woods heavily mined area ==
The heavily mined area refers to the west and north-west approaches to the "USEC camp" which is located in the northwest. The safest way to fulfill the objective is to get inside the camp from the north, east or south and walk up to the sandbags between the big rocks in the west of the camp that block off a path to the mines.

== Ground Zero claymore mine ==
The claymore mine is located on the first floor of the Tarbank building, in the customer desk booth no. 3. To fulfill the objective you only have to get in front of the booth, there is no need to enter it.

objectivesKo: BTR에 MS2000 마커를 사용하여 붕괴된 크레인을 타르코프 시내에 표시하십시오

quests.content:
Route Deviation is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Yeah-yeah, your previous job was about the BTR driver. So what? It makes no difference to you. We made a deal, but the kid's still looking for ways around it. If I didn't know how to manage lads like him, I wouldn't have gotten on top myself. You need good intel to manage them so you can nail them in time. There are no issues in Priozersk, but in the city he often deviates from my routes. I need to know where the BTR goes and why. Mark all his stops with strobe markers, after that my lads will handle it.

== Objectives ==
Mark the Collapsed Crane BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the Old Scav Checkpoint BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the Pinewood Hotel BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the City Center BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the Tram BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the Rodina Cinema BTR stop with an MS2000 Marker on Streets of Tarkov

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Desert Tech MDR 5.56x45 assault rifle
3× AR-15 5.56x45 Magpul PMAG 40 GEN M3 STANAG 40-round magazine
3× 5.56x45mm M855A1 ammo pack (50 pcs)
You got all the spots, yeah? Cool. I'm gonna send my crew to check it out today, this rat's not going anywhere.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to mark all 6 BTR stops on Streets of Tarkov with MS2000 markers.

Stops marked on map
Collapsed Crane: At the cabin next to the concrete mixer
Old Scav Checkpoint: At the corner in front of the "Golden World" store
Pinewood Hotel: At the trash bags next to one of the pillars
City Center: At the traffic light on the corner of the Primorsky 49 building
Tram: At the barrier in front of the restaurant
Rodina Cinema: At the container under the stairs

== Trivia ==
You can buy additional MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.text: 네, 네, 네 이전 작업은 BTR 운전기사에 관한 것이었다. 그럼? 그건 당신에게는 아무런 차이가 없습니다. 우리는 거래를 했습니다. 하지만 그 아이는 여전히 그것을 돌아가는 방법을 찾고 있습니다. 내가 그와 같은 사람들을 어떻게 관리하는지 몰랐다면, 나는 스스로 정상에 올 수 없었을 것입니다. 당신은 그들을 관리하기 위해 좋은 정보가 필요합니다. 그래서 당신은 그들을 시간 안에 못잡을 수 있습니다. Priozersk에 문제가 없습니다. 하지만 도시에서 그는 종종 내 경로를 벗어나. 나는 BTR가 어디로 가고 있는지 알고 있어야합니다. 왜.

== Dialogue ==
Oh, there you are! Good timing, I could use your help. My lads tried to "borrow" a few supplies from the Reserve base, but things went to shit. Some serious bandits have dug in there. And I reckon we won't be able to search the place properly until someone gives them a proper scare. I couldn't care less about the whole base, but that underground storage? That's where my interest is. You fancy going over there and lending a hand? And if you can, bring me the keys to the underground section too.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Scavs in the underground storage warehouse on Reserve
Hand over any 3 found in raid keys for the underground storage warehouse (RB-PSP and RB-PSV)

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP

1,650 Euros

Already picked clean, you say? Fuck's sake!

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill 5 Scavs in the underground warehouse and the ramps leading down to it on Reserve. The wanted warehouse is located in the northwest and marked with "Д".

objectivesKo: 15 BNTI 주크 체 갑옷 (EMR) 건네기
12 Vulkan-5 LShZ-5 방탄성 헬멧 건네기

quests.content:
Safety Guarantee is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I've got an opportunity on the table right now, and it could be seriously profitable. But I need a reliable partner, and you could be just the bloke for it. I got talking with one commander, his squad is made up entirely of veterans. But the lads were abroad when all this kicked off. And they still want to work. They say they've got a lead on an abandoned USEC base somewhere in the region. The problem is, some bunch of nobodies have already taken over the place. To take the base back, the lads need proper protection. They won't risk it otherwise. Buying gear like that on the outside would attract way too much attention. If you're interested in growing our little enterprise, get me some Zhuk armor and Vulkan helmets. Luka also asked for something else... Says he needs a helmet just like Killa's. They need to take the base quickly before the military catches on. A bit of extra intimidation never hurts, and everyone in the criminal world has heard of Killa by now. If we convince them that Killa and his lads are operating in the region, they'll run for it straight away.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 15 BNTI Zhuk body armors (EMR)
Hand over 12 Vulkan-5 LShZ-5 bulletproof helmets
Hand over 3 Maska-1SCh face shields (Killa Edition)

== Rewards ==
+1 Stress Resistance skill level
+1 Perception skill level
+1 Attention skill level
+1 Aim Drills skill level
+1 Light Vests skill level
+1 Heavy Vests skill level
+1 Weapon Maintenance skill level
+1 Troubleshooting skill level
Good stuff. Getting a shipment like that across the border won't be easy, but I'll figure something out.

== Guide ==

quests.content:
Samples is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. Straight to the point. Yes. There is news about new stimulators. They make a person not feel any pain, give them strength. They are being sold somewhere on the shoreline, Sanitar, yes, that's the merchant's name. He sells medicine and stimulants to the local junkies... I mean residents. I need to get this medication. Developing new stimulants is expensive, especially difficult with testing on humans. But here, we can say that testing is already in progress and gives results. Many of my acquaintances will be interested in such results. Please bring me samples of these drugs. Make sure that they are sealed and untouched.

== Objectives ==

Hand over the injector
Find the item in raid: 1 Obdolbos cocktail injector
Hand over the injector

Hand over the injector
Find the item in raid: 1 AHF1-M stimulant injector

== Rewards ==

1× Ops-Core FAST MT Super High Cut helmet (Urban Tan)

Unlocks purchase of Ops-Core FAST MT Super High Cut helmet (Urban Tan) at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of Ops-Core FAST multi-hit ballistic face shield at Peacekeeper LL4
Good job. I've already received quite a few interesting offers. Something tells me that these meds are somehow related to TerraGroup.

== Guide ==

Crisis

The fastest way to acquire all these stimulants is using the Keycard with a blue marking in The Lab. Alternatively, you could kill Sanitar, although he is not guaranteed to have them.
Alternatively, either the two chalets or the rogue base on Lighthouse have multiple stimulants spawn which require no key.

quests.content:
Sanitary Standards is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, young man. I'm glad you were the one who came. I have an urgent and extremely important task for you. It concerns everyone still living in Tarkov. You know where the chemical plant is, don't you? I have strong reason to believe that something hazardous from that facility is seeping into the groundwater. This is a critical issue for us, especially since humanitarian aid deliveries are constantly being disrupted. We all rely on that water. Do you understand? Even filtration is no longer enough. If this isn't addressed soon, it could cost all of us our lives. To determine exactly what's happening, I need readings from a gas analyzer. You can find one at the plant. Leave the device in the laboratory there, and my people will retrieve it afterward.

== Objectives ==
Find 2 Gas analyzers in raid
Hand over the 2 Gas analyzers to Therapist
(Optional) Locate the room with the Gas analyzers on Factory
Stash a Gas analyzer in the med lab on Daytime Factory

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
About time. You did an important service to many, if not everyone.

== Guide ==

The Gas analyzer has to be stashed on the second floor of the laboratory on Daytime Factory, specifically at the window of the second room.

== Dialogue ==
You did pretty well helping with the Rogues, and the smugglers actually came to me themselves. One of their commanders is being held by those bastards over at the water treatment plant, and the guys want to get their own man back. But for that, they need a reliable route from Priozersk to the Rogue base. If you help with that, maybe we can talk about your request too. You'll need to go along the path from the nature reserve to the lighthouse and mark the start and end of the route.

== Guide ==

Saving the Mole is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. I've got a lot of work, so I'll be brief. TerraGroup sent a USEC task force after one of their employees. He was accused of leaking information and they wanted him removed. I don't know if they succeeded or not, which is why you need to investigate this. Check the TerraGroup complex in the city center, look for traces of both the squad and the employee. I used to work with him, so I want to know what happened in the end. He almost always carried a drive with his important data on it, so if you find it, bring it to me.

== Objectives ==
Access the lab scientist's office on Ground Zero
(Optional) Locate the USEC group at the parking lot of the TerraGroup complex
(Optional) Locate the lab scientist in the TerraGroup complex
Locate and obtain the scientist's hard drive
Hand over the hard drive

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
They killed him? Well, that's sad, but expected. TerraGroup was desperate to cover their tracks. You've done a good job. And thanks for the data drive.

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to locate the lab scientist in the main building of the TerraGroup building complex. He can be found in a hallway behind the big TerraGroup sign in the entrance hall, buried under rubble. Inside the body, a TerraGroup science office key can be found which unlocks office no. 4 on the second floor. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid, but can be taken by other players.

Afterwards you have to find a hard drive in the scientist's office (no. 4) on the second floor. The office can be unlocked with the TerraGroup science office key.

Once you are inside the office, the hard drive can be found at the only desk with turned on screens. It can be located on the desk top, or in the right side shelf.

sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 먼저 연구소 과학자를 테라그룹 건물 복합 건물의 주요 건물에서 찾을 수 있습니다. 그는 입구에서 큰 테라그룹 표지판 뒤에 있는 통로에서 발견 될 수 있습니다. 유적 아래 묻혀 있습니다. 몸 내부에서, 테라그룹 과학 사무실 열쇠를 찾을 수 있습니다. 두 번째 층에 사무실 번호 4를 열 수 있습니다. 한 열쇠가 모든 침습을 낳을 수 있지만 다른 플레이어들이 취할 수 있습니다. 테라그룹 건물 위치가 표시 된 테라그룹 건물 복합 건물로 입구에서 과학자에게로 이동합니다. 과학자 몸 후에 당신은 과학자의 사무실에서 하드 드라이브를 찾을 수 있습니다 (제2층 4) 두 번째 층에. 사무실은 ZXTERM0에 의해 열 수 있습니다. 그것은 단지 수면 상단에 위치하고 있습니다.

Scavenger is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Listen brother, I've got a job for you. You know I'm pretty much the only guy who deals in all kinds of nylon. Well, I was. Lately, some competition has started popping up... I can't afford to lose my edge. And wouldn't you know it, one of my shipments is fucking delayed! Can you go around Tarkov and bring me some stuff to sell? I really need this, brother! Don't worry, I'll pay you for the goods. Here's the list of what I need.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 15 any found in raid items from the Facecovers category
Hand over 15 any found in raid items from the Headgear category
Hand over 15 any found in raid items from the Headsets  category
Hand over 15 any found in raid items from the Eyewear category category

275,000 Roubles

You collected everything? Ah, that's what I like to see!

Scope the Clearing is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good thing you didn't disappear on me! I've got an idea how we can make sure we don't miss it when the smugglers start making a move on the lighthouse. You said yourself there's fuck-all going on there right now, but the train's still running, see? If the smugglers decide to build themselves a base at the treatment plant, or start moving fighters in there, they're gonna need the train. So all we need to do is hide some proper cameras there, and that's it. Then I won't miss anything important. You gonna set up surveillance. And put one by the road to the woods too, just in case. I heard some of your lot leaked that route to the smugglers.

== Objectives ==
Plant the first Wi-Fi Camera at the smuggler train platform on Lighthouse
Plant the second Wi-Fi Camera at the smuggler train platform on Lighthouse
Plant the third Wi-Fi Camera at the Woods transit on Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+15,000 EXP
1,800 Euros
1,890 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,070 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Custom Guns NL545 (GP) 5.45x39 assault rifle
3× AK-74 5.45x39 Magpul PMAG 30 GEN M3 30-round magazine (FDE)
1× 5.45x39mm 7N40 ammo pack (120 pcs)
Good work, the feed's already coming through. I'll keep an eye on the clearing myself, so I don't need you for now. If there's more work, I'll give you a shout.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to stash 3 WI-FI Cameras in the north of Lighthouse.

Stashing locations marked on map
First train platform stashing location at a package pile
Second train platform stashing location at a package pile
Woods transit stashing location at the turned over car

Scout is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Someday we will get rid of the invisible hand, which used to brand us with employee badges and now has caused this mess, and I think it leads us to a great war. At least, all current events look like preconditions to it. I worked here for the chemical plant, as an ordinary foreman. It was a good time, everyone thought so, including me. Now it’s full of Scavs and swarming with brigands and outlaws. I want to make use of some of the factory premises, find out what exits can still be used. Go there and check it out.

== Objectives ==
Locate the first Factory extraction
Locate the second Factory extraction
Locate the third Factory extraction

Survive and extract from the location

== Rewards ==

Good old Factory has sure changed, but you've brought good news. The sealed doors are still there...

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 어느 날 우리는 직원 표지판으로 우리를 표기하는 보이지 않는 손을 없애게 될 것이고, 이제 이 혼란을 일으켰습니다. 그리고 저는 그것이 우리를 큰 전쟁으로 이끌고 있다고 생각합니다. 적어도, 모든 현행 사건들은 그 전제 조건으로 보입니다. 저는 보통의 수장으로서 화학 공장에서 일했습니다. 그것은 좋은 시간이었습니다. 저를 포함한 모든 사람들이 그렇게 생각했습니다. 지금은 스캐브로 가득 차 있고 강도와 불법체제자들로 가득 차 있습니다. 저는 팩토리의 일부 시설을 이용하고, 어떤 출구들이 여전히 사용할 수 있는지 알아보고 싶습니다. 가서 확인하세요.

quests.title: Scrap Metal
objectivesKo: 첫 번째 T-90 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 쇼어라인로 표시하십시오
제 2차 T-90 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 표시하고
제3차 T-90 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 쇼어라인로 표시합니다
quests.content:
Scrap Metal is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day! As you can understand, the conflict here was rather serious and there is some heavy machinery left on the Shoreline. There are at least three T-90 of which I am aware, and I am sure there are many military devices remaining on them, such as laser rangefinders for example. Those models are not for export, and equipped with optics for domestic use. My customers would be very interested in comparing it to the samples owned by them. From the recon data, one of the tanks was left left on the small land bridge between the weather station and the hydroelectric power station, the other one must be somewhere near the north-west bunker at the Health Resort, and the last tank should be in the village on the dirt road at the collapsed tunnel. Mark the tanks with beacons, and my people will do the rest.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Mark the first T-90 tank with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the second T-90 tank with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline
Mark the third T-90 tank with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
Good, my people are receiving the signal. I hope the tanks are still intact.

== Guide ==

Note that you do not have to plant all markers in the same raid. As with previous quests, once you have survived the required amount of time after each plant, you can die and do the remaining objectives and extract in subsequent raids.

Tanks marked on map
The first tank is located next to the bunker northern of the resort, near the river.
The second tank is located on the road that goes from the tunnel extraction through the village.
The third tank is located on the bridge between the power station and the weather station. You can find it by following the dirt road.

== See also ==
Tigr Safari - The USEC counterpart quest

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 좋은 날! 이해하실 수 있듯이, 여기서 갈등은 상당히 심각했고 쇼어라인에 무거운 기계가 남아있다. 적어도 세 개의 T-90가 남아있는 것을 알고 있으며, 예를 들어 레이저 원격 탐지기가있는 많은 군사 장치가 남아있는 것을 확신합니다. 이러한 모델은 수출을 위해 아니며, 가정용 광학으로 장착되어 있습니다. 제 고객은 그것을 소유한 샘플과 비교하는 데 매우 관심이 있습니다. 재조명 데이터에 따르면, 탱크 중 하나는 기상역과 수력 발전소 사이의 작은 육지 다리 위에 남아있으며, 다른 하나는 헬스 리조트의 북서부 벙커 근처 어딘가에 있어야 하며, 마지막 탱크는 붕괴된 터널에서 흙 도로에 있는 마을에 있어야 합니다. 탱크를 비콘으로 표시하고, 내 사람들은 나머지는 수행합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: BEAR PMC만 수락할 수 있습니다.

첫 번째 T-90 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 쇼어라인로 표시하십시오
제 2차 T-90 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 표시하고
제3차 T-90 탱크를 MS2000 마커에 쇼어라인로 표시합니다

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +10,000 EXP 피스키퍼 평판 +0.25 1,100 달러 1,155 달러 정보 센터 레벨 1 1,265 달러 정보 센터 레벨 2

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 경우, 모든 기호를 같은 해격에 배치할 필요가 없다는 것을 참고하십시오. 이전 임무와 마찬가지로, 각 기호가 필요한 시간을 살아남은 후에는, 당신은 죽을 수 있고, 나머지 목표를 수행하고 다음 해격에서 추출 할 수 있습니다. 지도에 표시된 탱크 리조트 북쪽의 벙커 옆에 위치하고 있으며, 강 근처에 위치하고 있습니다. 두 번째 탱크는 마을을 통해 터널 추출에서 가는 도로에 위치하고 있습니다. 세 번째 탱크는 전력 발전소와 기상역 사이의 다리에 위치하고 있습니다. 당신은 흙 도로를 따라 찾을 수 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Trivia
sectionsKo.text: 필요하다면 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 MS2000 마커를 구입할 수 있습니다. 플레이어는 MS2000 마커를 특수 슬롯 또는 가방에 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 따라서 사망의 경우 손실되지 않습니다. MS2000 마커는 필요하면 자동으로 플레이어의 인벤토리에서 사용됩니다. 키가 작동하는 것과 비슷합니다.

quests.title: Search Mission
objectivesKo: 프라포르의 실종 열병 찾기
USEC의 임시 우즈 캠프 찾기
quests.content:
Search Mission is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, warrior! One of my squads has been radio silent for a while now. When all this mess started, I sent them out near the Priozersk forest to move an important shipment. I'm afraid they got hit: last time we managed to get through, they reported USECs closing in on them from the hills. Go check it out, see if anyone's still alive. The convoy definitely had a BRDM car, a Bukhanka, and some truck, can't remember which one. Chances are the USECs have dug in somewhere nearby, so keep your head on a swivel. Oh, and so you don't get yourself lost among the scary square kilometer of trees, I'm issuing you a compass. Dismissed.

== Objectives ==
Locate Prapor's missing convoy on Woods
Locate the temporary USEC camp on Woods

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to locate Prapor's missing convoy and the USEC camp on Woods.

== Convoy location ==
The convoy is located in the north, on the road between the lakes that leads to the "Scav Bunker" extraction. Make sure to get close to the vehicles for the objective to trigger.

Convoy location marked on map
The convoy

== USEC camp location ==
The USEC camp is located in the northwest. The west and north-west approaches to the camp are covered with landmines.

Camp and landmine locations marked on map
The USEC camp

Mined areas to avoid

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 전사님! 제 부대 중 하나는 잠시 동안 라디오 침묵을 유지했습니다. 이 모든 혼란이 시작되었을 때, 저는 그들을 프리오저스크 숲 근처에 보내서 중요한 물품을 옮겼습니다. 저는 그들이 타격을 받았다고 생각합니다. 우리가 마지막으로 통과할 수 있었던 때, 그들은 USEC가 언덕에서 그들을 향해 다가오고 있다고 보고했습니다. 가서 확인해 보세요, 누가 여전히 살아 있는지 확인하십시오. 이 열병대는 확실히 BRDM 자동차와 부칸카와 어떤 트럭이 있었고, 어느 하나를 기억하지 못합니다. USEC가 근처 어딘가에 파묻은 가능성이 있습니다. 그래서 머리를 돌고 રાખો. 오, 그리고 당신이 나무의 무서운 광장 킬로미터 사이에 길을 잃지 않도록, 나는 당신에게 콤파스를 발급합니다.

quests.content:
Secrets of Polikhim is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. You couldn't have shown up at a better time. I went through my list of contacts, and you're the best person for this job. Word reached me through my usual channels that someone found a rare ultrasonic thickness gauge at the customs territory, along with several other valuable pieces of equipment. You know how things are these days - opportunities like that can't be wasted. I need you to head to Customs, recover everything of value, and move it to Polikhim, where my people are waiting. One more thing. Back in peacetime, when I worked at Polikhim, we had a shortcut... Mostly for moving equipment onto the factory grounds that would've otherwise sat in customs for months. An old mushroom picker showed it to me years ago. See if you can find and use it. It may come in handy in the future.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the precision tools package in the laboratory on Customs
Use the transit from Customs to Factory (In one raid)
Stash the package at the laboratory storage room on Factory

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles

2× Metal spare parts
Unlocks purchase of 5.7x28mm R37.F at Mechanic LL3
Unlocks purchase of AK GP-25 accessory kit recoil pad at Prapor LL2

quests.content:
Seizing the Initiative is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The operational situation in the city is ever-changing, meaning I always have to stay on top of what is happening. My people have reported that some operatives have started using the new path from the customs terminal to the gulf coast. Previously the passage was inaccessible there, but I've already had two targets evade my groups in that area. I have to see what is going on at that passage. If you accept this task, you will have to travel all the way from the customs terminal to the coast and extract from there. You can count on an appropriate reward!

== Objectives ==
Use the transit from Customs to Shoreline

== Rewards ==

This will help us cut off the escape routes of those who prevent us from conducting our business. Everyone needs resources to operate in Tarkov, and the Blue Helmets are no exception.

quests.content:
Semiconductor Crisis is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Yesterday, while I was mounting a red dot on an M4, I noticed someone on one of my monitors who looked like he was praying. He had covered the walls with strange symbols, drawn a circle on the floor, and started placing weapons inside it. Oddly enough... it made sense to me. That's how religion works, isn't it? You offer your gods the things that matter most to you. Seems those cultists think the same way. You've probably run into them already. Anyway, back to business. I've got enough electrical capacity for now. Go find me some more graphics cards and cooling fans.

quests.content:
Sensory Analysis - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello my brother! Okay, okay, not so loud, I'm hung over as shit. Don't know how the BTR guy's still driving after last night. The engine is surely screeching louder than fucking generators! By the way, you came at a really good time, almost like you knew I'm gonna need help. So, about the meeting we had yesterday. I have a moonshine supplier, he makes legit good stuff! We've been working together for six months now, everything was fine. And now, customers started complaining that I was selling them fake stuff. So, I had to check the product quality, and no one in our region knows as much about liquor as the BTR driver. So I invited him over for... let's call it sampling, hehe. And there he was, saying that no one starts with hard hitters right off the bat, he needed a warm-up. Then another. Then another... So after all that, I checked the moonshine in the morning, and we didn't even open it! Long story short, the driver didn't finish the job. I'm not gonna live through this kind of sampling party a second time, so I'll let him taste everything by himself. Can you pass him this bottle? Don't lose it, alright?

== Objectives ==
Obtain the item: Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Go to Woods, Lighthouse or Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to BTR Driver

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Safariland Liberator HP 2.0 Hearing Protection Headset (FDE)
2× ECLiPSE RBAV-AF plate carrier (Ranger Green)
So, did'ya deliver the bottle? Huh? Man, this driver guy's such a prick. I love him! Hey, easy there, man, I get it. Listen, some things just shouldn't be talked about right off the bat, the Labyrinth is one of them. I have to consider all the risks that come with this info, so sit tight for a little while.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to hand over a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to the BTR Driver. Ragman provides one via in-game mail.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text:
안녕하세요, 제 형제! 좋아요, 그렇게 소리치세요, 난 똥처럼 걸려있어요. 어제 밤 이후 BTR의 남자가 어떻게 운전하는지 모르겠어요. 엔진은 확실히 발전기보다 더 큰 소리를 질러요! 그건 그렇고, 정말 좋은 시간에 왔어요. 거의 당신이 도움이 필요할 것이라는 것을 알고 있었습니다. 그래서 어제 회의에 대해. 나는 한 달빛 공급자가 있습니다. 그는 합법적인 좋은 물건을 만듭니다. 우리는 지금 6 개월 동안 함께 일하고 있습니다, 모든 것이 괜찮았습니다. 그리고 이제 고객은 내가 그들에게 가짜 물건을 판매하고 있다고 불평하기 시작했습니다. 그래서, 나는 제품의 품질을 확인해야했습니다. 그리고 우리 지역에서 아무도 BTR 운전기사만큼 술을 알고 있습니다. 그래서 나는 그를 초청했습니다. 그래서 샘플링을 할 것입니다. 그리고 그는, 그는, 한 번은 타자를 때려서 다른 것을 때려서, 그는 다른 것을 따뜻하게 할 필요가 있습니다.
그래서 그 모든 것 이후, 아침에 달빛을 확인했는데, 우리는 그것을 열지도 못했습니다. 긴 이야기로, 운전자는 일을 끝내지 않았습니다. 저는 이런 샘플링 파티를 두 번째도 겪지 않을 것입니다. 그래서 저는 그에게 모든 것을 직접 맛볼게 할 것입니다. 당신은 그에게 이 병을 보낼 수 있습니까? 그것을 잃지 마십시오, 알았어요?

Sensory Analysis - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I miscalculated my abilities yesterday at a friendly get-together. Don't worry, we've sailed in worse storms than this. One time I was so wasted I couldn't find the gearbox in this thing. So I tied my hand to the lever with a bandage! Inventiveness is the main principle for a machinist! Ragman needed to check some goods, and I'm a veteran in this field. Except I can't remember, for the life of me, whether we finally got to his test sample or not. Well, whatever. If it's so important, we can get together again. Such an evening is a sin not to do again, I know you'd like it too! But still, if you need to visit Ragman, ask him about the moonshine, I promised I'd help him. And now I don't even know if I did help him or not.

== Notes ==
This quest gets automatically added to the quest list upon accepting Sensory Analysis - Part 1.

== Objectives ==
Find a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine
Hand over a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine

== Rewards ==
Are you sure this is it? Okay, I can smell it, that's definitely the one! Ragman told me about the health resort's cellars yesterday, I even had to fucking get him wasted so we could finally change the subject. Anyway, there was a Soviet bomb shelter under the health resort, and Ref was going to organize a new arena there, for VIP audiences. I think it also involved Tagilla somehow... No, it was something else... Anyway, for this arena, Ref organized a big gear acquisition from Ragman, everything was almost ready. And then our host guy suddenly backed out. Why? Who the fuck knows. Ragman was really upset that the idea had fallen through. But he'd already delivered some of the gear, and he definitely used those keycards you're looking for. You better ask him yourself, I don't remember much from yesterday. Thanks for the drink, by the way.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to hand over a Bottle of Fierce Hatchling moonshine to the BTR Driver and ask him about the facility under the health resort and the keycards to access it.

quests.content:
Serious Allegations is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey! Remember the client with the game magazine? I have a new order. I need a data disk, it's all related to the same game. Some scam artist said that the people who created the game had stolen user data from 2 million accounts! And as proof he showed a hard drive to everyone, allegedly with this leak. But the publishers are serious guys, they would not allow such bullshit. So the client is looking for the drive to clarify the situation. My guys said the drive should be in an old wooden house near the health resort, there is a toilet on the left and a rag above the entrance.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the hard drive at the old house on Shoreline
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1,650 Euros
1,732 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,897 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× L3Harris AN/PVS-14 night vision monocular
1× AN/PVS-14 Norotos Dual Dovetail Mount
1× Norotos Titanium Advanced Tactical Mount
Lemme see. Ha, it's a blank! Yeah, the publishers turned out to be smooth guys, and trust me, this allegations kid will be forgotten by everyone.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a hard drive on Shoreline. This item has 13 spawn locations: 9 spawns across 5 houses in the north-western swamp village, 3 spawns in a house west of the cottages, and 1 spawn on a rock in the south-eastern part of the map.

== Trivia ==
The quest dialogue is referencing an incident that happened in 2018 between the content creator Eroktic and Battlestate Games. Eroktic uploaded a YouTube video in which he talked about an alleged user data leak from 1,900,000 game accounts, without providing any actual evidence. In response, Battlestate Games issued 47 DMCA strikes on his YouTube channel to stop the spread of misinformation, which were later removed. Battlestate Games commented on the allegations in a Facebook post.

sectionsKo.text: 퀘스트 대화는 콘텐츠 제작자 에로크틱과 배틀스테이트 게임즈 사이에 2018년에 일어난 사건을 언급하고 있다. 에로크틱은 실제 증거를 제시하지 않고, 1,900,000 게임 계정에서 유저 데이터 유출이 발생한 것으로 추정되는 YouTube 비디오를 업로드했다. 이에 대응하여 배틀스테이트 게임은 잘못된 정보의 확산을 막기 위해 자신의 YouTube 채널에서 47 개의 DMCA 공격을 발표했으며, 나중에 삭제되었다. 배틀스테이트 게임은 페이스북 게시물에서 혐의에 대해 언급했다.

quests.title: Setting Priorities
objectivesKo: PMC의 10명의 임무를 수행하는 장갑을 착용하지 않고 활성 헤드셋을 사용하면서 제거하십시오.
TSh-4M-L 소프트 탱크 승무원 헬멧을 착용하면서 어떤 활성 헤드셋도 착용하지 않고 10명의 PMC 요원을 제거하십시오.
quests.content:
Setting Priorities is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. One of your people stopped by recently and tried to convince me that the most important part of a fighter's gear is armor, and that situational awareness doesn't matter nearly as much. Frankly, I don't share that view. Sure, you can't see or hear absolutely everything. But armor will never give you complete protection either, especially if you walk into an ambush. Personally, I'd take a good headset over heavy, reinforced armor any day. Fortunately, I don't have to make that choice myself. So what would you choose? You've got enough experience to test this properly in the field. Better yet, let's try this: you gather some real statistics using two different loadouts, and in return I'll arrange a supply of some unique items from Peacekeeper. He owes me a favor, you see. Try neutralizing PMC operatives while wearing a headset but no armor. Then do the opposite, say... using a tank crew helmet. That should put you at a serious information disadvantage.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives while using an active headset without wearing any armor
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives while wearing the TSh-4M-L soft tank crew helmet without wearing any active headset

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Intellect skill levels
Mechanic Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Ballistic plate case
Unlocks purchase of Ballistic plate case at Mechanic LL2
Unlocks purchase of DevTac Ronin Reinforced Crown Plate at Mechanic LL4
Unlocks purchase of DevTac Ronin Mandible at Mechanic LL4
So, how did it go? You're saying you need both gear and good hearing? Yes, that's exactly what I expected. Still, the research was useful, so you've earned your reward. Those headsets are usually custom-made, but Peacekeeper should be able to supply models that fit you properly.

== Guide ==

For the first objective you must wear an earpiece while not wearing any armor vest, armored chest rig, armored headwear or armored face cover.

For the second objective you must wear the TSh-4M-L soft tank crew helmet while not wearing any earpiece.
