sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 여러분 중 한 명이 최근에 와서 전투기의 장비를 가장 중요하게 생각하는 부분이 장갑이라는 것을 설득하려고 노력했습니다. 그리고 상황 인식은 거의 중요하지 않습니다. 솔직히, 저는 그런 관점을 공유하지 않습니다. 물론, 당신은 절대 모든 것을 볼 수도 없습니다. 하지만 장갑은 절대적으로 당신을 보호하지 않을 것입니다. 특히 함정에 걸리면. 개인적으로, 나는 무거운 강화 장갑에 대한 좋은 헤드셋을 매일 가져갈 것입니다. 다행히도, 내가 그 선택을 직접하지 않을 것입니다. 그래서 당신은 무엇을 선택할 것입니다? 당신은 현장에서 이것을 제대로 테스트 할 충분한 경험이 있습니다. 더 나은, 우리는 이것을 시도하자: 당신은 두 가지 다른 보장을 사용하여 몇 가지 실제 통계 수집, 그리고 대가로 나는 몇 가지 독특한 아이템을 공급 할 것입니다. 당신은 ZTERMX0X.ZX.ZX에 대해 빚을 져야 합니다. 당신은 ZTERMX.ZX를 착용하고 있습니다. 당신은 ZTERMX73을 사용하지만, 당신은 심각한 단점을 가지고 있습니다.

objectivesKo: PMC에 지정된 장비를 착용하면서 스캐브 무기로 8명의 PMC 요원을 제거한다
quests.content:
Setup is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, mater. Heard what the Scav are arguing about lately? Proper war going on between them. Wouldn't be a problem, except my lads keep getting caught in the middle of it. They ain't exactly helpless, but a bit of backup wouldn't hurt. Here's what I came up with: those idiots have their own dress code. The big shots walk around showing off in ushankas, Scav vests, and those bloody JayPC carriers. What a bunch of clowns, eh? You dress up like one of them, grab their weapons, and start dropping PMCs left and right. Doesn't matter who exactly, just make sure they end up blaming those idiots. You get what I'm saying, yeah?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 8 PMC operatives with Scav weapons while wearing the specified gear on Customs

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.25
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× Xenomorph sealing foam
My guys are saying that Customs is at World War 3 right now, BEARs and USECs are dropping Scavs left and right! Good shit, nice work. Here's your prize, as promised.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill 8 PMCs with any of the following guns while wearing one of the above hats and chest rigs:
ADAR 2-15 5.56x45 carbine
MP-133 12ga pump-action shotgun
MP-153 12ga semi-automatic shotgun

sectionsKo.text: 자, 엄마. 최근 스캐브가 논쟁하는 걸 들었어? 그들 사이에 제대로 된 전쟁이 벌어지고 있어요. 문제가 되지 않을 겁니다. 제 친구들이 그 중간에 계속 잡히면 말이죠. 그들은 전혀 무력하지 않지만, 약간의 부대가 해치지 않을 겁니다. 여기 제가 생각해낸 것은 다음과 같습니다. 이 멍청이들은 자신만의 드레스 코드가 있습니다. 큰 샷은 우산카, 스캐브 자켓, 그리고 저 피의 JayPC 운반으로 돌아다니고 있습니다. 무슨 괴짜들이죠?

quests.content:
Shady Contractor is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey. You may be aware that TerraGroup's aggressive expansion in Tarkov has raised quite a few questions in its time, no doubt? Back then, they were buying out properties and companies left and right in the Norvinsk region, and some of the deals were clearly shady in nature... TerraGroup has had a particularly interesting contractor, a company called Knossos. Officially they build amusement parks, playgrounds, and other family entertainment venues. But tell me, what possible connection can TerraGroup's scientific research and playgrounds have? That's exactly why this smells fishy to me. Knossos could be hiding TerraGroup documents or equipment. Yet to know for certain, we'd have to examine their facilities. And to do that, we'd have to find some kind of record... Knossos definitely had managers overseeing the facilities. You should check out the vehicles in the city center and look for any internal records there.

== Objectives ==
Locate the Knossos LLC senior manager's car on Ground Zero
Locate and obtain the manager's diary
Hand over the diary

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Steiner LAS/TAC 2 tactical flashlight
A manager's diary, huh? Even though it's not official documentation, there might be something useful in there. I'll get back to you in a bit, right now I need to examine these records carefully.

== Guide ==

The manager's car can be found next to the car dealership on Ground Zero. There are multiple diary spawns throughout the car.

Car location marked on map
The car

Spawn #2 on the driver seat

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 아시다시피 타르코프에 테라그룹의 공격적인 확장은 그 당시에도 여러 가지 의문을 제기했었는지도 모릅니다. 그 당시 노르빈스크 지역에서 좌우 좌우 부동산과 회사를 구입하고 있었고, 거래는 분명하게 그림자 같은 성격이었습니다. 테라그룹는 특히 흥미로운 계약자를 가지고 있었습니다. Knossos라는 회사입니다. 공식적으로 그들은 놀이공원, 놀이공원 및 다른 가족 놀이공간을 건설합니다. 하지만 말해주세요. 테라그룹의 과학 연구와 놀이공간은 어떤 연결을 가질 수 있습니까? 그것이 바로 이것이 나에게 악취를 내는 이유입니다. Knossos는 테라그룹 문서 또는 장비를 숨기고 있을 수 있습니다. 그러나 확인하기 위해 우리는 그들의 시설을 조사해야합니다. 그리고 그렇게하려면 우리는 확실히 Knossos의 내부 시설을 확인해야 합니다. 당신은 어떤 종류의 차량을 확인하고, Knossos의 관리자가 있어야 합니다.

quests.content:
Shaking Up the Teller is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hail, the knave of axe and gun. Some curious info came up recently. Smells like solid profit without running around too much. Ready? Look. There was that wisecrack who ran the stores, lived in a dorm by the factory. And, as usual, sidelined some cash. He lived in room 214. But that's not the point. I don’t think you will find much there if anything at all. Though he swore there’s something. Something else has surfaced: In the same dorm, he owned one more room, 203, but wasn’t babbling about it and, as a matter of fact, used it for storage. Now that’s where he had something of value for sure, more than one of his errand runners perished there. Also, he had a garage. Don’t know the number, but it was certainly two-digit - I have a listing of owners starting with 100, and his name is not there.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the valuable item in dorm room 203 on Customs
(Optional) Gain access to dorm room 214 on Customs
Hand over the valuable item

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
1× Electric motor
Unlocks purchase of 9x21mm BT gzh at Prapor LL3
Impressive indeed! It's almost a nuclear suitcase! No surprise he spared no people trying to pull this out.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a bank case on Customs. It can be found under the bed in room 203 on the second floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 203 key is required to enter it.

3 story dorms and room 203 marked on map
The bank case under the bed

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 도끼와 총의 이. 최근 몇 가지 호기심 있는 정보가 나왔어요. 너무 많이 뛰지 않고 확실한 수익을 냄새 맡고 있습니다. 준비되어 있습니까? 보세요. 가게를 운영하고 팩토리 근처의 기숙사에서 살았던 이 지독이 있었습니다. 그리고 평소와 같이 약간의 현금을 소외했습니다. 214 방에 살았습니다. 하지만 그 의미는 아닙니다. 당신은 거기에 아무것도 발견하지 못할 것이라고 생각합니다. 그는 어떤 것을 맹세했지만, 다른 것이 나타났습니다. 같은 기숙사에서 그는 다른 한 방, 203 방을 소유하고 있었지만 그것에 대해 말하지 않았습니다. 사실, 그것을 저장용으로 사용했습니다. 이제 그는 확실히 가치가있는 것을 가지고있는 곳입니다. 그의 일꾼 중 한 명이 더 많이 죽었습니다. 또한, 그는 차고리를 가지고있었습니다. 그러나 그것은 확실히 두 개의 소유자 목록이 있습니다. 그리고 나는 그것을 알고 있습니다.

quests.content:
Sheep in Wolf's Clothing is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Time for some serious work. I've managed to pinpoint the location of one of the sites nobody knows about except these operators. And if my calculations are right, they haven't been there themselves yet. I'm sending my own people to that site. You didn't really think I'd let you inside my operation, did you? Don't worry, I've still got a job for you. Take it, and you won't regret it. For my boys to get in and out cleanly, we need to keep those operators distracted and stir up some chaos. I figure you've collected a fair bit of their gear by now? Use it to throw their operation into disarray.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 8 Black Division operatives while wearing a Black Division plate carrier

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks purchase of Norinco QBZ-191 5.8x42 assault rifle at Skier LL3
1x Money case
1x Norinco QBZ-191 5.8x42 assault rifle
That's exactly what I needed. My people are already on the move, but I set your share aside in advance, so go ahead and collect it. One more thing. My guys might need someone watching their backs, so you'd better stay in touch.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to kill 8 Black Division operatives while wearing one of their plate carriers.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 진지한 작업이 필요한 시간입니다. 이 운영자 외에는 아무도 모르는 사이트 중 한 곳의 위치를 정확하게 파악할 수 있었습니다. 그리고 만약 제 계산이 옳다면, 그들은 아직 그곳에 있지 않았습니다. 저는 제 사람들을 그 사이트에 보내고 있습니다. 당신은 정말로 당신이 제 운영에 들어갈 수 있다고 생각하지 않았습니까? 걱정하지 마세요. 저는 여전히 당신을 위해 일을 가지고 있습니다. 그것을 받아보세요. 그리고 당신은 후회하지 않을 것입니다.

== Dialogue ==
My people haven't been able to access the cargo yet. However, if there's anything of value-- I mean of danger, we can't waste any time. All shipments had to be documented one way or another. Perhaps an itinerary or a cargo manifest would shed more light on the situation. You need to locate that piece of information. Look in the offices of key persons at the customs: directors, supervisors. If there is anything we might find, it should be there.

== Objectives ==

Hand over the found information

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles

It will take some time for me to study these documents. Nevertheless, we will soon discover everything that is wrong with this shipment and what it contains. Along with a report from my specialists, we will receive comprehensive details.

In this quest you have to find the TerraGroup shipment lists on Customs. They can be found in the director's room on the second floor of the boiler building. A Company director's room key is required to enter it. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.

objectivesKo: 우즈에 있는 저장소에서 온 패키지 건네기
quests.content:
Shipping Delay - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, do you know the BTR driver who's driving around Tarkov? I ordered an important delivery from him, but he just vanished somewhere. If I had a soldier like that at my disposal, I'd teach him a lesson real quick. How can you delay military cargo shipments?! He was supposed to meet with my men yesterday. I need to find that bastard and show him what responsibility means. But the package is more important at the moment. Go find it and hand it over to me. We'll deal with the driver later.

== Objectives ==
Hand over the package from the depot on Woods

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× 7.62x54mm R PS gzh ammo pack (20 pcs)
3× 5.45x39mm 7N40 ammo pack (30 pcs)
You talked with the driver, huh? His base was attacked? If you ask me, those couriers will always make excuses for being late. But the guy did a good job hiring you. I've been dying to get this little package.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Prapor's package on Woods. It can be found in 1 of 2 locations in the northwest building of the train depot. The depot can only be accessed via the BTR Driver's taxi service.

Building marked on map
The wanted building
First spawn under the table next to the bed
Second spawn on the desk in the back office

It is also possible to leave the depot through walking on top of the western train. When walking on top of the train it is important to stick to the center to not get hit by snipers or mines.

Way to the train
The train

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 타르코프 주위를 운전하는 BTR 운전기사를 아십니까? 저는 그에게 중요한 배달을 주문했지만, 그는 그냥 어딘가에 사라졌습니다. 만약 제가 그런 군인을 가지고 있다면, 저는 그에게 매우 빨리 교훈을 가르쳐 주었을 것입니다. 어떻게 군용 화물 운송을 지연할 수 있습니까? 그는 어제 제 사람들과 만나야 했습니다. 저는 그 새끼를 찾아서 책임의 의미를 보여줘야 합니다. 하지만 패키지는 지금보다 더 중요합니다. 가서 그것을 찾아서 나에게 넘겨주십시오. 우리는 운전자와 나중에 처리 할 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 우즈에 있는 저장소에서 온 패키지 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +10,000 EXP 165,000 루블 173,250 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 189,750 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 3×7.62x54mm R PS gzh 탄약 패키지 (20PC) 3×5.45x39mm 7N40 탄약 패키지 (30PC) 운전자와 이야기 했습니까? 그의 기지는 공격당했습니까?

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 프라포르의 패키지를 우즈에서 찾아야 합니다. 기차 저장소의 북서쪽 건물의 2 장소 중 1곳에서 찾을 수 있습니다. 저장소는 BTR 운전기사의 택시 서비스를 통해만 액세스 할 수 있습니다. 지도에 표시 된 건물 수색 건물 침대의 옆에 테이블 아래에서 먼저 자생합니다. 뒷 사무실의 책상에서 두번째 자생합니다. 서부 열차의 꼭대기에 걸어 다니면서도 저장소를 떠날 수 있습니다. 열차의 꼭대기에 걸어 다니는 동안 중간에 붙어있는 것이 중요합니다. 포격자와 미인에 의해 공격되지 않도록 열차로 이동합니다.

quests.title: Shipping Delay - Part 2
objectivesKo: 그리고 우즈에 있는 창고에 있는 창고들을 탐구합니다 찾기
그리고 우즈에 있는 창고에서 사무실을 찾아 찾기

‘도움의 손길’ 퀘스트 완료하기
quests.content:
Shipping Delay - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So Mechanic sent you, huh? Cool. So I used to have a base, with a hangar, spare parts, cargo shipments even. Then some assholes thought they could just clean the place out! I'm gonna find those bastards. But while I'm at it, all the deliveries are messing up! The most important one is a package for Prapor, he's really anxious for it, and the box is still at the depot near the sawmill in Priozersk. If you're down to help me, look for this package and deliver it to Prapor. I can give you a ride to the depot, but I ain't leaving the BTR. I don't like it outside, it's more comforting inside this armor.

== Objectives ==
Locate and scout the warehouses at the depot on Woods
Locate and scout the office at the depot on Woods
Locate and scout the garages at the depot on Woods
Complete the task A Helping Hand

== Rewards ==
+11,500 EXP
84,000 Roubles
1× RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Blue)
1× Tetriz portable game console
So, was Prapor pissed? Well shit, it's an emergency over here! But hey, thanks for helping me out. Now I might go and check out what's left of the base. You're a good guy, so stay in touch, yeah? When I find these shitheads, I'll need your help again.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to scout the 3 specified locations at the train depot on Woods. The depot can only be accessed via the BTR Driver's taxi service. After scouting, the quest A Helping Hand must also be completed to hand in this one.

Locations marked on map
1. The warehouse
2. The office
3. The garages

It is also possible to leave the depot through walking on top of the western train. When walking on top of the train it is important to stick to the center to not get hit by snipers or mines.

Way to the train
The train

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 정비사가 보내신거 맞죠? 멋지네요. 그래서 저는 한가르, 부품, 화물 운송까지 있는 기지를 가지고 있었습니다. 그리고 몇몇 멍청이들은 그냥 그 장소를 청소할 수 있다고 생각했습니다. 저는 그 망할 놈들을 찾아갈 것입니다. 하지만 제가 지금 이 자리에 있을 때, 모든 배달이 엉망이 됩니다. 가장 중요한 것은 프라포르에 대한 패키지입니다. 그는 정말 그것을 위해 고군분열하고 있습니다. 그리고 상자는 여전히 프리오저스크에 있는 세이 공장 근처에 있는 창고에 있습니다. 당신이 나를 돕기 위해 내려가면 이 패키지를 찾아 프라포르에 배달하십시오. 저는 당신을 창고로 데려갈 수 있습니다. 하지만 저는 BTR를 떠나지 않습니다. 저는 그것을 밖으로 떠나지 않습니다. 이 장갑 안에 더 편안한 것입니다.

sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 우즈의 기차 창고에서 지정된 3 개의 위치를 탐구해야 합니다. BTR 운전기사의 택시 서비스를 통해만 수납할 수 있습니다. 탐구 후, 탐구를 A Helping Hand도 완료해야합니다. 이 지도에 표시 된 장소 1. 창고 2. 사무실 3. 차고 서부 기차 상단에 걸어 다니면서 창고를 떠날 수도 있습니다. 기차 상단에 걸어 다니는 동안 포격자 또는 광뢰에 의해 타격을 받지 않도록 중심에 붙는 것이 중요합니다.

Shooter Born in Heaven is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You know what separates a professional sniper from an amateur? The ability to approach a task from the right angle. Take eliminating several highly trained fighters in an unconventional situation, for example... It's not just about the choice of weapon and attachments, there are other factors to consider as well. My friend Dima thinks you could become a capable sniper. He just wants to make sure. If you're not afraid, complete his assignment.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a headshot while using a bolt-action rifle on Customs or Lighthouse
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a headshot while using a bolt-action rifle on Streets of Tarkov or Shoreline
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a headshot while using a bolt-action rifle on Interchange or Ground Zero
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a headshot while using a bolt-action rifle on Woods or Reserve

== Rewards ==

+4 Intellect skill levels

400,000 Roubles
422,200 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
440,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

Unlocks barter for T H I C C Weapon case at Mechanic LL4
What can I say, you surprised me. Though I can't deny it, you're a sharp one.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 전문격수와 아마추어의 차이점은 무엇인지를 아십니까? 직선 각도로 작업에 접근하는 능력입니다. 예를 들어, 비정상적인 상황에서 고도로 훈련된 전투기를 제거하는 것... 무기와 부착장치를 선택하는 것뿐만 아니라 다른 요인들도 고려해야 합니다. 제 친구 디마는 당신이 능숙한격수 될 수 있다고 생각합니다. 그는 단지 확신하고 싶어합니다. 당신이 두려워하지 않는다면, 그의 임무를 완료하십시오.

Shooting Cans is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings! I hear you're looking for a little extra cash. That's perfect, because I have a job for you... I know that the city center is where AGSs and KORDs were deployed during the hottest fights. Find me one of each and report back. Also, sweep the area around them, make sure no one gets to the firing positions before my guys do. I think five bodies will be enough. Scavs, PMCs, whatever. Less trespassers, less chance of an ambush, you know?

== Objectives ==
Locate the Utyos machine gun on Ground Zero
Locate the AGS grenade launcher on Ground Zero
Eliminate any 5 targets on Ground Zero

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
You did it? Well done! Maybe you could really be useful.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to find the Utyos machine gun and the AGS grenade launcher on Ground Zero, as well as kill any 5 entities on the location.

== Utyos ==
The Utyos machine gun is located in an office on the third floor (labeled 5) of the Tarbank building.

Location marked on map
The Tarbank building

== AGS ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요! 당신은 약간의 추가 돈을 찾고 있다고 들었습니다. 그것은 완벽합니다. 왜냐하면 내가 당신을 위해 일을 가지고 있기 때문입니다. 나는 도시의 중심에 AGS와 KORD가 가장 뜨거운 전투에서 배치되었다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 나에게 각각 하나를 찾아보고. 또한, 그들을 둘러싼 지역을 스캔, 내 사람들이 전에 아무도 발사 위치에 도달하지 않도록 확인. 나는 다섯 개의 시체가 충분할 것 같습니다. 스캐브, PMCs, 무엇이든.

quests.content:
Shootout Picnic is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Still alive, soldier? Atta boy. Means you know a thing or two if you haven't gotten yourself killed yet. I've got another job for you. Some important people have business to take care of in certain parts of Tarkov. Trouble is, the local scum's getting in their way. Can you believe those bastards actually think they own the place? According to my intel, there are around a dozen of them, maybe more. Take care of enough, and the rest will scatter on their own. A seasoned soldier like you shouldn't have any trouble handling a job like this. Get to work.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 15 targets on Woods, Ground Zero, Customs, or Interchange

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence center Level 2
How'd it go? Ah, don't bother, I already know it went well. You're standing here in one piece, aren't you? Those people I mentioned sent word that everything worked out on their end, too. So here's a double reward: one part from me and one from them.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill any 15 targets on Woods, Ground Zero, Customs or Interchange.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 아직 살아있어요? 아타 소년. 아직 죽이지 않았다면 한두 가지 알고 있다는 뜻이죠. 내가 당신을 위해 다른 일을 가지고 있습니다. 타르코프의 특정 지역에서 중요한 사람들이 일을 처리해야 합니다. 문제는 지역 쓰레기가 그들의 길을 방해하고 있다는 것입니다. 당신은 그 bastards가 실제로 그 장소를 소유한다고 생각한다고 믿을 수 있습니까? 내 정보에 따르면, 그들은 약 12 명, 어쩌면 더 많은 것입니다. 충분한 것을 돌봐, 나머지는 그들 스스로 흩어질 것입니다. 당신 같은 경험이 있는 군인은 이런 일을 처리하는 데 아무런 문제가 없어야합니다. 일하러 가십시오.

quests.content:
Shortage is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. Are you interested in a little part-time work? It's not a difficult task, but it's quite lucrative. Don't forget, you can get both food and drink from me, as well as expert medical care. But first, let's talk about the job. I require three emergency medical kits. They're called Salewa - the red western ones. I need you to obtain them yourself, not buy them off someone else. Just to prove that we're serious about this. We may know each other, but not enough for me to trust you yet. Are you up for the job?

== Objectives ==
Find 3 Salewa first aid kit in raid
Hand over the 3 first aid kits

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

Thank you, young man. The first aid kits will be put to good use. I won't tell you any more than that, though.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Salewa first aid kit at Medstation level 1.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 용병. 조금의 파트타임 작업에 관심이 있습니까? 어려운 작업이 아니지만 꽤 수익성이 있습니다. 잊지 마세요, 당신은 나에게서 음식과 음료 양을 얻을 수 있고, 전문가 의료서비스를 받을 수도 있습니다. 하지만 먼저, 직업에 대해 이야기 해 봅시다. 저는 세 가지 응급 의료 키트를 필요로 합니다. 그들은 Salewa라고 불립니다. 빨간 서양. 당신은 다른 사람에게서 구입하지 않고 직접 구입해야 합니다. 우리는 이것을 진지하게 알고 있음을 증명하기 위해. 우리는 서로를 알고 있지만 아직 당신을 믿을 수 있을 만큼은 아닙니다. 당신은 그 일에 준비가 되었습니까?

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
레이드에서 3 살레바 초상급품 찾기
3개의 초상급 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards

quests.content:
Silent Caliber is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, how's life treating ya? You know, sometimes you have to come in and shoot the shit out of someone in CQC, and you have to do it quietly and efficiently. I prefer 12 gauge for example, and I got no clue why the hell BEARs and USECs don't appreciate it, it's a straight caliber, you know? You just gotta get as close as possible, and if you have silencer, man, you can drop people and the guy on other side of the wall wouldn't flinch. It hits silently and it hits hard. You gotta master this, while I figure out what fish we could pull out with your "talent".

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 30 targets with a suppressed 12 gauge shotgun on Reserve, Lighthouse, Ground Zero, or The Lab

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Shotguns skill levels
+4 Attention skill levels
Skier Rep +1.5
2,400 Euros
2,520 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,760 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× MP-155 12ga semi-automatic shotgun (variant Ultima)
Unlocks purchase of AK Custom Arms AGS-74 PRO + Sniper Kit pistol grip at Skier LL4
Unlocks barter for Miller Bros. Blades M-2 Tactical Sword at Skier LL4
Unlocks barter for Kiba Arms Titan ballistic plate at Skier LL3
You did good, now you got my respect! I'll keep you in mind if I have something interesting.

== Guide ==
This quest can be done with any shotgun that uses 12/70 ammunition.

quests.content:
Simple Side Job is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I am not interested in localized conflicts and I am not going to help either side. But since you are already here, I have a job for you. The task is simple: pick up one cargo from the roof of the military hospital at the reserve base and deliver it to the transfer point. Be careful with the cargo and do not open the crate. This shipment might be of interest to certain people, so I need a man with special skills. Someone like you.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain Lightkeeper's cargo crate on the roof of the military hospital on Reserve
Stash the cargo at the Scav house on Woods

== Rewards ==
+56,700 EXP
Lightkeeper Rep +0.02
4,000 Dollars
1× Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter
1× UHF RFID Reader
1× Virtex programmable processor
Well done. The reward will not disappoint you.

== Failure Dialogue ==
You shouldn't have taken so long to complete my task. I've already found another merc who works faster.

== Guide ==
Completing the quest Protect the Sky from the BTR Driver automatically fails this quest.

In this quest you first have to pick up Lightkeeper's case from the roof of the hospital building (White Bishop) on Reserve. There are multiple spawns. Afterwards you have to stash it in the Scav house on Woods. The house can be found near the "Outskirts" extraction in the southwest of the location.

== Reserve Case location ==

Hospital location marked on map
First case spawn on the ground facing north
Second case spawn in the circular sandbag fortification
Third case spawn on the table facing north
Fourth case spawn on the ground facing east

== Woods Stashing location ==

The Scav house

quests.content:
Sisyphus is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
How's your physical shape, ahper? I've got one deal that's still hanging over my head, and I could really use some help. But I'll tell you right now, you can throw your back out in no time doing this! So, I've made contact with the smugglers. Wouldn't exactly call it a partnership, but they've got a decent job for me. We need to deliver some armor plates to their boys. Everything's already packed up and waiting at the drop-off points, so all that's left is getting it to the recipients. You in? Both cases with the armor plates are in Priozersk right now. One's in the bunker, and the other's at the abandoned USEC checkpoint. One case needs to be hauled to the guardhouse at the military base. You want the one next to the trail leading to Woods. The second case is supposed to go in the railcar with the Ural truck at the train station near the water treatment plant. Once you've left both cases at the right spots, let the armored train engineer know.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the first smuggler case in the ZB-014 bunker on Woods
Stash the first case in the guard booth near the Woods transit on Reserve
Locate and obtain the second smuggler case behind the shack at the USEC checkpoint on Woods
Stash the second case in the railcar with the Ural truck at the train platform on Lighthouse
Extract from Lighthouse or Reserve through the Armored Train
Note: The "Extract" objective will appear after the "Stash" objectives are completed.

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Ballistic plate case
2× Power cord
After a job like that, you oughta spend at least a couple days lying down, brother! You really bailed me out. I didn't have anyone else who could handle a job that damn monumental. I've got a special reward ready for you. Here, take it. It'll give you an excuse to hang around the hideout and put those plates in the case properly.

== Guide ==

== First case ==
The first case can be found in the ZB-014 bunker on Woods. It has to be stashed at wooden planks next to the guard booth west of the train depot on Reserve.

== Second case ==
The second case can be found next to the portable toilets at the USEC checkpoint on Woods. It has to be stashed in the railcar with the Ural truck at the train platform in the north of Lighthouse.

Well, hello there, mercenary. Come to see the old man? Sit down, would you like some tea? No? All right, then. Listen, a gang of looters showed up in the area again. Can you do that? I don't think any bastard's gonna dare get into that bloodbath afterwards.

quests.content:
Small Business - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You remember my "entrepreneur"? I found him, he's one of the local gang bosses. Who? You don't need to know that. Your job is to go to each of them and remind them that my trade routes are mine alone. Don't touch the chiefs themselves, they're more useful alive. But their guards should be cut down for a clear show of force.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 Boss guards without killing the Bosses

== Rewards ==
+36,800 EXP
Fence Rep +0.04
2,200 Euros
2,310 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,530 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Physical Bitcoin
Done? Good, now everyone will think twice before getting into my sales network.

== Failure Dialogue ==
I told you not to touch the bosses themselves! I need to intimidate them, not take them out.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 10 boss guards without killing any bosses. Killing any boss will fail the quest.

Refer to the respective boss pages for their behavior and strategy to eliminate their guards.

A relatively risk-free way to complete this quest is, to kill Kaban's sniper guards on the roof of the LexOs car dealership on Streets of Tarkov from a distance.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 내 "기업가"를 기억하시나요? 내가 그를 찾았어요. 그는 지역 갱의 상장 중 한 명입니다. 누가? 당신은 그걸 알아야 할 필요가 없습니다. 당신의 임무는 그들 각자에게 가서 내 무역 경로가 내 유일한 것임을 상기시켜주는 것입니다.

== Dialogue ==
The "entrepreneur" was dealt with, but there are still people in town who bought my product bypassing me. Remember the toxin cultists? That's them. Leave the fanatics a message from me. Let them know there's only one Fence in this city. You do that, and I'll make sure you receive something special.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to stash 4 Cultist knives at the specified locations on Shoreline and Woods.

The knives can be obtained by killing Cultists or purchasing them on the flea market.

The second stashing spot is located in the pig room (East wing room 321) on the third floor of the health resort. The room is easily identified by candles and numerous markings on the door.

Small Things, Big Help is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Howdy, brother! How you been? Alright, we'll chat later. Business first! I found out there are some fuel stashes in the forest, not far from the cliffs. At the very least, there are barrels out there. Worth checking! Fuel is never a bad thing to have, especially with a buyer as hungry as Mechanic. He bought my entire last shipment. So, go look for those barrels and mark them with beacons. I heard about three stashes. That'll be enough for me.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first fuel stash with an MS2000 Marker on Woods
Locate and mark the second fuel stash with an MS2000 Marker on Woods
Locate and mark the third fuel stash with an MS2000 Marker on Woods

+3,000 EXP
Ragman Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles

Signal's coming through, my guys are ready to move out!

== Initial Equipment ==

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

quests.content:
Snatch is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're here, good. Now listen carefully. My men went to the meeting place, their job was to replace the folder these snakes were so diligently preparing with the one I had arranged, but it's already been several hours since my group stopped responding. The last time they contacted me, they reported seeing a group of Rogues. Knight and his men are not aware of this operation, perhaps one of them interfered with the delivery. The first thing you must do is to check the Rogues' base and find the lost data, but don't go to them right away, or they'll figure out I'm involved and will start asking questions. Then you'll have to deliver it to the federal reserve base, a meeting place has been set up at the machinery and equipment repair center. Find that folder and leave at the base, and bring the real one to me. It's crucial to deliver this information to me. It's time to find out who these suicidal moles are.

== Objectives ==
Extract from Lighthouse
Obtain the forged intelligence at the Rogue base on Lighthouse
Obtain the original intelligence in the repair station on Reserve
Stash the forged intelligence under the BMP-2 in place of the original
Bring the original intelligence to Lightkeeper

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.01
3× VPX Flash Storage Module
1× Substation marked key
Unlocks purchase of Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Black) at Ragman LL4
Unlocks craft for UHF RFID Reader at Intelligence Center level 2
Unlocks the Lightkeeper service "Sacred Amulet"
Welcome back. Now, let's see what they're up to.

== Guide ==
This item will only appear in your next Lighthouse raid after accepting this quest.

In this quest you have to obtain the forged intelligence on Lighthouse and exchange it with the original intelligence on Reserve. Afterwards you have to bring the original intelligence to Lightkeeper.

== Forged intelligence locations on Lighthouse ==

quests.content:
Special Comms is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Salutations! An important assignment has just come from the high-ups. Top priority and all that jazz. There's a path from Priozersk to the Reserve base, and our guys need communication in those parts urgently. The path? Ah well, I'll share it with you, but make sure nobody else knows about it! When the Contract Wars were in full swing, some artisan managed to lay a path parallel to our road. We tracked the guy down and started interrogating him on who he was working for, what kind of mission he was on, you know the drill. We thought we'd captured a spy! Yet he kept calling himself a mushroom picker and grinning like a moron. We wanted to send him to headquarters. But at night our mushroom picker disappeared, no one saw him again after that. So, with your help, we'll build a communication line along this path, and you'll be responsible for the equipment. You'll deliver a part of it to the place, go to the Reserve base, and leave the second part there.

== Objectives ==
Stash a Military cable at the boulder next to RUAF gate on Woods
Use the transit from Woods to Reserve
Stash a Bulbex cable cutter at the sandbags next to LAV III above the storage warehouse on Reserve

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Your country will be proud of you, soldier! But the fact that the Scavs started roaming around this path worries me a bit... Someone must be scouting for all the forgotten shortcut routes on Tarkov's map.

sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요! 중요한 임무가 방금 하이업에서 왔습니다. 최우선 과제와 모든 재즈. 프리오저스크에서 리저브 기지로 가는 길이 있습니다. 우리 사람들은 그 부분에서 긴급하게 통신이 필요합니다. 경로? 아, 내가 여러분과 공유 할 것이지만, 다른 사람이 그것에 대해 알 수 있는지 확인하십시오! 계약 전쟁이 전개되면서 어떤 공예가 우리 도로와 병렬로 길을 놓을 수 있었습니다. 우리는 그 남자를 추적하고 그가 누구에 대해 일하고 있는지, 어떤 임무에 대해 질문을 시작했습니다. 당신은 연습을 알고 있습니다. 우리는 스파이를 잡았다고 생각했습니다. 그럼에도 불구하고 그는 자신을 버섯 채집자라고 불렀고 바보처럼 미소했습니다. 우리는 그를 본부로 데려가고 싶었습니다. 그러나 밤에는 우리의 버섯 채집자 사라졌습니다. 그 후에 아무도 다시 보지 못했습니다. 그래서 우리는 그와 함께, 우리가 ZX47의 책임있는 부품을 만들 수 있도록 도와줍니다. 당신은 ZX47X의 다른 부분을 보냅니다. 그리고 당신은 그 길을 따라 이동합니다.

Special Order is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, soldier! Got a job for you that I wouldn't trust to just anyone. Special order, you could say. I need an ice axe. Wipe that look off your face! And keep your mouth shut about this job, or we'll both catch hell. So don't go checking the Flea Market or asking the other traders. You need to find one yourself, quietly. No unnecessary witnesses. Got it? Word is Shturman was seen carrying the right kind of ice axe. The Cultists might've stashed one away in their hideouts, too... But that's unconfirmed. Either way, that's your problem now, not mine! Get this done, and I'll arrange access to a very special weapon, just for you. Ever since the Contract Wars, these things have become almost impossible to get. I'm giving you a one-of-a-kind opportunity here. Don't waste it.

sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 군인! 난 당신을 위해 누구에게도 신뢰하지 않을 일을 가지고 있습니다. 특별한 명령, 당신은 말할 수 있습니다. 나는 얼음 도끼가 필요. 당신의 얼굴에서 그 눈을 지워! 그리고 이 일을 위해 두 가지 입을 닫아 두 번이나 지옥을 잡을 것입니다. 그래서 플러시장을 확인하지 마십시오. 또는 다른 상인들에게 물어. 당신은 자신을 찾아야 합니다, 조용히. 불필요한 증인 없습니다. 이해? 보도는 Shturman의 얼음 도끼의 올바른 종류를 들고 보였습니다. 광신도 또한 그들의 은신처에서 숨은 것 같습니다. 하지만 그것은 확인되지 않습니다. 어느 쪽이든, 그것은 지금 당신의 문제, 내뿐만 아니라! 이 얻으십시오, 그리고 나는 당신을 위해 매우 특별한 무기를 얻을 수 있습니다. 계약 전쟁 이후, 이러한 것들이 거의 불가능해졌습니다. 나는 당신에게 한 종류의 기회를 제공하지 않습니다.

Spotter is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The situation takes an interesting turn. The data you delivered to me suggests that these moles were involved in the attack on the government convoy in the city, at the intersection of Nikitskaya Street and Primorsky Avenue, which means that from time to time they inhabit those parts. Your job is to scout the area, prepare and equip some good positions to monitor the area. Nothing more than that for now. I already have a marksman for the job. You will need a silencer for .338 from AI and a Trijicon thermal imager.

== Dialogue ==
I told you the driver knows the right paths! That's where I'll send the shipment, although I don't have time for that at present. First I have to deal with those who killed my couriers. I already found the culprits, so now it's for Ragman to send his regards. I can't do anything to help the driver until this matter is handled. That's why I suggest you take care of it. Quicker you start, quicker you finish.

That's great! Now there is nothing to interfere with my operations, and we can think about expansion. For now, I need to figure out how to prepare for the BTR coming under my roof. Just be patient for a little longer.

quests.content:
Stay Clear of Blast Zone is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come on, have a seat, no point standing around... You didn't run into those black-clad soldiers on your way here, did you? Good. Partisan crossed paths with them while pulling back not long ago, barely made it out alive. Something has to be done about them, or this will end badly. And I'm not talking about pillaging like the Scavs do. This is a far more serious threat. Those fsoldiers are more dangerous than anyone else we've dealt with. Which is exactly why meeting them head-on would be a mistake. Hunters set traps instead of charging wolves with a knife for a reason. These soldiers keep searching around our local health resort. That's where we'll hit them. I need you to plant TNT charges at every entrance to the grounds. Partisan will take up a position in the nearby forest and finish off the group once the explosions have done their work.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Plant a TP-200 TNT brick at the Health Resort west side fence breach on Shoreline
Plant a TP-200 TNT brick at the Health Resort north side fence breach on Shoreline
Plant a TP-200 TNT brick at the Health Resort east side fence breach on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× HK G28 7.62x51 marksman rifle
3× HK417/G28 7.62x51 10-round magazine
2× 7.62x51mm M62 Tracer ammo pack (20 pcs)
Think I heard a couple of those blasts myself. Sounds like Partisan settled the score with the ones who jumped him last time. You need to know your enemy, and you need to know your own limits. It worked this time, but this won't be the end of it. So watch yourself, and don't go looking for trouble.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 자, 앉으세요, 여기 서 있는 건 의미가 없어요... 여기 가는 길에 검은 옷을 입은 군인들을 만나지 않았나요? 괜찮아요. 반려동물들이 얼마 전 물러나서면서 그들과 길을 건너가서 겨우 살아서 나왔어요. 뭔가 해야만 합니다. 아니면 이렇게 나쁜 일이 일어날 겁니다. 그리고 저는 스캐브처럼 약탈을 말하는 게 아닙니다. 이것은 훨씬 더 심각한 위협입니다. 그 군인들은 우리가 처리한 누구보다 훨씬 위험합니다. 그래서 그들을 직접 만나면 실수일 것입니다. 사냥꾼들은 왜서도 늑대를 칼로 충전하는 대신 함정을 세우고 있습니다. 이 군인들은 우리의 건강 휴양지 주변을 계속 검색합니다. 우리가 그들을 할 것입니다.

Steady Signal is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings. I have a job for you. There are several weather stations scattered throughout the Priozersk forest. Back when things were still normal, they monitored atmospheric conditions. To keep them running continuously, they were equipped with independent power supplies. Now they're just sitting there, rusting away. I doubt anyone will object if I put those power supplies to better use. There's just one problem: nobody knows exactly where all the stations are. You spend plenty of time in that forest, so find one and mark it with a strobe marker. I'll pay you for the work, don't worry.

== Objectives ==

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles

The signals are already coming through. My people are on their way to the forest. Here's your payment.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요. 제가 여러분에게 일을 하고 있습니다. 프리오저스크 숲에 여러 기상역이 흩어져 있습니다. 일이 정상이었을 때, 그들은 대기 조건을 모니터링했습니다. 계속 작동하기 위해 독립적인 전력 공급 장치가 장착되었습니다. 지금은 그냥 앉아 있고, 노화됩니다. 저는 그 전력 공급 장치들을 더 잘 사용할 수 있다면 누구라도 반대할 것 같지 않습니다. 단 하나의 문제가 있습니다. 모든 역이 정확히 어디에 있는지 아무도 모릅니다. 당신은 그 숲에서 많은 시간을 보내고, 그래서 하나를 찾아서 스트로브 마크로 표시합니다. 나는 일을 위해 돈을 지불 할 것입니다, 걱정하지 마십시오.

sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 우즈에 있는 모든 기상역을 MS2000 마커로 표시해야 합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Trivia
sectionsKo.text: 필요하다면 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 MS2000 마커를 구입할 수 있습니다. 플레이어는 MS2000 마커를 특수 슬롯 또는 가방에 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 따라서 사망의 경우 손실되지 않습니다. MS2000 마커는 필요하면 자동으로 플레이어의 인벤토리에서 사용됩니다. 키가 작동하는 것과 비슷합니다.

quests.title: Stick in the Wheel
objectivesKo: 어떤 장소에서든 30개의 목표를 제거하라
quests.content:
Stick in the Wheel is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Here about the BTR driver again? Listen, it's not that simple. But things are slowly progressing, thanks to you. By the way, the Scavs are really coming down on my soldiers right now. I don't know if it's Skier who has learned something about our plans, or if someone is actively recruiting new bandits, but it's impossible to do business like this, that's for sure. If you want your comrade and I to work together, you have to remove this hindrance.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 30 targets on any location

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1× AS VAL 9x39 special assault rifle
3× VSS/VAL 9x39 6L25 20-round magazine (Plum)
4× 9x39mm PAB-9 gs ammo pack (20 pcs)
No more sticks in the wheels now. Thank you. You can tell your friend that I will soon prepare everything for him to come under our protection.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to eliminate any 30 targets on any location.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: BTR 운전기사에 대해 다시 말씀드리겠습니다. 이 말은 그렇게 간단하지는 않습니다. 하지만 여러분 덕분에 상황이 천천히 진행되고 있습니다. 그건 그렇고, 스캐브은 지금 제 병사들에게 정말 떨어지고 있습니다. 우리가 계획하는 것에 대해 배운 스키어인지 모르겠어요. 아니면 누군가가 적극적으로 새로운 강도들을 모집하고 있다면, 하지만 이런 사업을 하는 것은 불가능합니다.

objectivesKo: 30 로그를 제거하십시오
quests.content:
Stick to It is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I already told you everything in the car. But if you really wanna get the smugglers to put in a more comfortable transport option to Icebreaker, you'll need to help them out with their fight against the Rogues first. Looks like things between them are pretty serious, and honestly I have no idea where it's going worst. So you can take initiative anywhere you want, just make sure there are fewer Rogue fighters left. Otherwise the smugglers won't even listen to you, they've got bigger problems right now.

== Requirements ==
To gain access to this quest, you must first do the following on Icebreaker:
Talk to the scientist on level 1 via the intercom.

Intercom location marked on map

100,000 Roubles

Didn't think you'd do it this well. Good work, man.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 전 이미 차에서 모든 것을 말씀드렸어요. 하지만 밀수자들이 아이스 브레이커에 더 편안한 교통 옵션을 넣을 수 있다면, 먼저 로그에 대한 싸움에 도움을 주어야 합니다. 그들 사이의 상황은 상당히 심각해 보입니다. 솔직히 저는 그것이 최악의 곳으로 가는 것을 전혀 모릅니다. 그래서 당신은 원하는 곳마다 주도권을 취할 수 있습니다. 단지 로그 전투기가 남아 있는지 확인하십시오. 그렇지 않으면 밀수자들은 당신을 듣지 않을 것입니다. 그들은 지금 더 큰 문제를 가지고 있습니다.

로그의 라이트하우스의 차렛에서 화물 패키지 찾아 확보하기

quests.content:
Stimulating Demand is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey. Got a little number for ya. One of Knight's lads got in touch with me recently, so I was already gearing up for a new supply line... Keeping the Rogues stocked with gear's only gonna do me good, specially if them smugglers are starting to get a bit too fucking big for their boots! But after the first order of basic supplies and ammo, the whole thing went quiet. Reckon the Rogues think they're all sorted now and have properly dug in at the chalets. So I'm thinking, why not give 'em a little nudge to start buying again, eh? Just make bloody sure none of 'em cottons on that I'm behind it, got me? Heard some important package turned up for them recently. That's what we're after. We need to make it look like Prapor's lot came calling, and we need to put on a proper show. So grab something unmistakably Russian and carry out a textbook raid on the chalets, then relieve 'em of their little box! Bring the box to me, mind. Never know when something like that might come in handy.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Rogues or The Goons with 7.62x54R caliber weapons on Lighthouse
Locate and obtain the cargo package at the Rogue chalets on Lighthouse
Hand over the package

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.75
1,650 Euros
1,732 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,897 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Golden neck chain
2× Glock .45 ACP KRISS G30 MagEx 30-round magazine
2× .45 ACP RIP ammo pack (50 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 .45 ACP submachine gun at Skier LL3
Fucking beautiful! So, you didn't look inside the box, did ya? Good lad, that's exactly what I wanted! Now hand it over. I'll have a look myself.

== Guide ==

The cargo package can be found in the black (southern) chalet on Lighthouse. It is located in the basement under a green metal table.

Chalet location marked on map
The package under the table

objectivesKo: 팩토리에 총기들을 사용하여 10개의 목표물을 제거하십시오.
quests.content:
Stirrup is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Ah, it's you again. Decided to stick around and do more business with me, eh? Fair enough, mate. I've got a bit of a situation I need sorted out around the region. There's always some random lot getting in the way, firing shots, taking valuable gear off my lads, and putting them down without a second thought. Doesn't exactly fit with my, let's say, business model. So I need them to understand they've stepped into something serious. Thin their numbers out with pistols and let them know there's professionals working around here. I'll pay you for every head you bring down.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 target with pistols on Factory

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.25
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Ah-hah, now that was a stirrup if I ever seen one! I got word from all channels that some devil is at large and grounded quite a bunch of people. You rock, get your reward.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 아, 다시 당신입니다. 제 곁에 머물러서 더 많은 사업을 하기로 결정했습니다. 꽤 괜찮아요, 친구. 저는 지역 곳곳에서 해결해야 할 약간의 상황을 가지고 있습니다. 항상 무작위로 많은 사람들이 방해를 받고, 총을 쏴, 소중한 장비들을 내 친구들에게 가져와 두 번 생각하지 않고 내려놓습니다.

quests.content:
Stray Dogs is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day to you, soldier. Though what's so good about it? You know what a wise man once said? "People were made to torment one another". When I first read that, I thought it couldn't be true. Now I remember those words, and my heart aches. We've got a new gang stirring up trouble in the city. I sent one of my men to talk to them, to try and bring them to their senses. They sent his head back to me. The letter I had asked him to deliver, they stuffed it into his mouth... They're not from around here. All of them came out of USEC, though they've long since turned their backs on their own. They need to be tracked down and wiped out, every last one of them. This is our land. There'll be no more talking with them.

== Objectives ==
Locate and eliminate Knight (in one raid)
Locate and eliminate Big Pipe (in one raid)
Locate and eliminate Birdeye (in one raid)

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Covert Movement skill levels
Jaeger Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× S I C C organizational pouch
Don't think about your hands getting bloody again, soldier. Think that you have cleared this land of the wicked.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill Knight, Big Pipe and Birdeye.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 군인님. 이 모든 게 좋은데? 지혜로운 사람이 한 번 말했듯이 "사람들은 서로 고문을 당하도록 만들어졌다". 제가 처음 읽었을 때, 그것이 사실이 아닐 수 없다고 생각했습니다. 이제 그 말을 기억하고, 내 마음이 아프습니다. 우리는 새로운 갱이와 함께 도시에서 문제를 일으켰습니다. 저는 제 사람들을 보내서 그들과 이야기하고, 그들을 상식에 끌어들일려고 했습니다. 그들은 그의 머리를 내게 돌려 보냈습니다. 내가 그에게 전달하라고 요청했던 편지를 입에 넣었습니다. 그들은 여기 있는 것이 아닙니다. 그들은 모두 USEC에서 나왔지만, 오래 전에 그들 스스로 등을 돌렸습니다. 그들은 추적되고 지워져야합니다. 그들 각자는. 이것은 우리의 땅입니다. 더 이상 그들과 이야기 할 것이 없습니다.

Superhuman is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

== Dialogue ==
Hey, fighter. I won't waste time, let's get straight to it. We've got a very, very important sponsor. The guy's a bit of a nut, but he pours in serious money. I take his requests extremely seriously, and I don't just hire anyone for these things. Recently, he pitched me an unusual idea, and, well you get the picture, it needs to happen. You're perfect for the job.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate an enemy with a melee weapon while wearing a Ghoul mask

== Rewards ==
Ref Rep +0.05
222,222 Roubles
99 GP coins
1× Lega Medal
Unlocks Crash Axe in the Armory
Unlocks achievement Legend of the Arena

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: , 시간 낭비하지 않겠습니다. 바로 가자. 우리는 매우, 매우 중요한 스폰서를 가지고 있습니다. 그 남자는 약간 미친 사람이지만, 그는 심각한 돈을 쏟아붓습니다. 나는 그의 요청을 매우 심각하게 받아들이고, 이런 일에 대해 누군가를 고용하지 않습니다. 최근에 그는 나에게 특이한 아이디어를 제시했습니다. 그리고, 당신은 그림을 이해, 그것은 일어나야 합니다. 당신은 작업에 완벽합니다.

== Dialogue ==
Good day, brother! I've got a job for you. Have you seen how many cash registers at Ultra are locked up? You can't just break into them. I've got a feeling there's still something valuable left inside. If you can help me get the keys, I'll give you access to some better gear. And of course, I'll share the loot. Look for the keys somewhere near the cash registers, they might've been left behind there. My guys are too busy right now to dig around themselves. Leave those keys somewhere nearby, please.

== Objectives ==
Stash the Goshan cash register key at the BIZARRO store fitting rooms on Interchange
(Optional) Obtain the Goshan cash register key
Stash the IDEA cash register key at Register #9 on Interchange

quests.content:
Supplements is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, tourist, you're here at the right time. Got a sixth sense or something? Never mind, listen up. Word on the street is there's some new merchandise making the rounds. Some weird stuff in these fancy-looking chemical containers. Looks a bit like your gun suppressor, just bigger. No clue what's inside: some new narcotic, or bloody Omega-3 or something. That's what we need to find out. The containers showed up at Customs, in the med lab. Get them for me. I've already got a couple of eggheads lined up to examine them. Oh, and one more thing: they asked me to throw in a few respirators and some blood transfusion kits.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the chemical vial on Customs
Hand over the container
Find 4 Respirators in raid
Hand over 4 Respirators to Skier
Find 3 Medical bloodsets in raid
Hand over 3 Medical bloodsets to Skier

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.25
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Oh, you actually brought them? Nice one! Hands still attached after all that chemical nonsense? Good. I'll get the eggheads on it and see what they can dig up.

== Guide ==

The chemical vial can be found in the experiments area on the second floor of the laboratory on Customs.

== Dialogue ==
What'chu want, merc? A job? Ha! Looking for a good net salary and a full social package? Alright then, I'll give you a job. I still barely know you, so let's see what you can do. I'll give you this: find me a white body armor, the one that looks like paper, and one Toz shotty. Gonna gear up my guys a little. But make sure to get the fresh ones, got it? Don't need no haggler shit. So anyway, if you do fine, we can talk further about your employment, mister "operator".

Hello, young man. Truly glad to see you. I have a very important assignment, not for everybody to take on. Will you take it? Then listen. Do you know the sawmill in the Woods? So, during the Contract Wars period, it was used as one of the makeshift backup supply bases for TerraGroup. And I am very interested in TerraGroup supply plans in this region. I think they should be somewhere on the territory as well. Try to search for the temporary quarters for workers - there should be a secure case for documents with a special symbol.

Surplus Goods is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello. I've decided to get involved with military electronics, it's quite a promising business, and I've got interested people for that. And the army, as you know, has the most secure communication: digital encryptions, GPS, GLONASS and all kinds of other things. So anyway, I've got info about some device on Reserve, usually seen in workshops in the service and repair centers, I think it's used in machinery, it's some kind of control and navigation block. I want you to find this block and bring it to me. Would be interesting to see what it has inside of it. I'll reward you of course.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the MBT Integrated Navigation System on Reserve
Hand over the navigation system to Mechanic

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
So that's how it looks! Great. Thank you, I'll study it more thoroughly later. Here's your reward, as promised.

== Guide ==

In this quest you need to pick up and extract with an MBT Integrated Navigation System. It can be found inside a locked room in the bigger of the two garage buildings at the repair center (white knight) on Reserve. A RB-ST key is required to open the door.

The item can be found inside a wooden crate in the back left of the room.

quests.content:
Surveillance is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, friend... You know, I wasn't always alone. Loneliness does not bother me, of course, especially since I have a neural net if I want to talk to someone really intelligent... Still, lately it's been weighing on me to think about my relatives. My brother and his wife and kids - will you look them up? The Samoylovs, they lived in Concordia. My brother drove a very recognizable car with a tiger aerography... It might be easier to find them through his car.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the data on vehicle movement at the Concordia residential complex parking lot on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the information

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
So, this is a recording of the first hour after the events began... There, you see his car? And there's him. Okay, they're getting in the car, driving away... They should have left before the shelling started. What a relief!

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a hard drive on Streets of Tarkov. It can be found inside the Concordia security room which is located in the basement parking garage of the Concordia building. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.

objectivesKo: 우즈에 장갑이나 헬멧을 착용하지 않고 10개의 목표물을 제거하십시오.
quests.content:
Swift is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We've come a long way, haven't we? You've learned a great deal. Now you can teach the newcomers of Tarkov a thing or two yourself. Show them that without armor, they shouldn't even think about stepping outside their hiding place.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 10 targets without wearing any armor or helmets on Woods

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
You made the old man proud. Carry the lessons forward.

== Guide ==
This quest takes place on Woods. You are required to kill any 10 targets without wearing any armor vest, armored chest rig, armored headwear or armored face cover. Armored eyewear is allowed.

Bug: The ANA Tactical Alpha chest rig (MultiCam) is currently considered armored for this quest even when it's not.

If you want to protect yourself during this quest, you can choose to still wear armor, but unequip it before killing a PMC.

objectivesKo: 쇼어라인에 있는 Sanitar의 수술 키트 찾아 확보하기
테라피스트에게 샌타르의 수술 장비 건네기
쇼어라인에 있는 Sanitar의 안경경 찾아 확보하기
테라피스트에게 산타르의 안경경 건네기
quests.content:
Tarkov-Style Diplomacy is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good afternoon, young man. Let's get straight to the point. I recently lost some of my people on the Shoreline. Naturally, that was unfortunate, but there is still a new source of medical supplies operating there. I've decided we need to approach this source from a different angle. No more attempts to take anything by force. I learned from one of the locals that this source is known as Sanitar. He is a doctor who performs surgeries out in the open and leaves his instruments nearby, inside buildings. Retrieve his medical tools for me. I believe he will be much more willing to discuss future supplies once he understands that we can reach him at any moment without him even noticing.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain Sanitar's surgery kit on Shoreline
Hand over Sanitar's surgery kit to Therapist
Locate and obtain Sanitar's ophthalmoscope on Shoreline
Hand over Sanitar's ophthalmoscope to Therapist

== Rewards ==
+28,200 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Thank you. I will handle things from here. I'll return his instruments along with a letter. This way, Sanitar will understand what we expect from him.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find Sanitar's Surgery kit marked with a blue symbol and his Marked Ophthalmoscope on Shoreline.

The surgery kit can be found on the second floor of the office building at the pier, located on top of a wardrobe.

Office building marked on map
The wanted building
Surgery kit on top of the wardrobe

The ophthalmoscope can be found inside the locked villa in the western part of the map, near the swamp. You need a Cottage back door key to unlock the back door to enter the villa. The ophthalmoscope can be found in the left hand room on the second floor, inside a potted plant on the table.

The wanted villa marked on map
The wanted villa from the backside with back door
Ophthalmoscope inside the potted plant

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 젊은 사람. 이 문제에 바로 들어가자. 저는 최근에 쇼어라인에서 제 사람들을 잃었습니다. 물론, 불행한 일이었지만, 여전히 새로운 의료 공급원이 그곳에 운영되고 있습니다. 저는 이 소스를 다른 각도에서 접근해야 한다고 결정했습니다. 더 이상 어떤 것도 강제로 취하려는 시도가 없습니다. 이 소스를 '산타르'라고 부르는 지역 주민 한 명으로부터 알게 되었습니다. 그는 야외에서 수술을 수행하고 그의 도구를 건물 안쪽에 남겨두고 있는 의사입니다. 그의 의료 도구를 내게 가져오십시오. 그는 그가 알아차리지 않고도 언제든지 그를 만날 수 있다는 것을 이해하면 미래의 공급에 대해 논의 할 준비가 될 것이라고 믿습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 당신은 쇼어라인에 파란색 상징으로 표시된 Sanitar의 수술 키트와 그의 표시된 오프탈모스코프를 찾아야 합니다. 수술 키트는 문에 있는 사무실 건물의 두 번째 층에 발견 될 수 있습니다. 옷장 위에 위치하고 있습니다. 사무실 건물 지도에 표시된 바둑 건물 옷장 위에 표시된 바둑 건물 수술 키트 바둑 지도의 서쪽 부분에서 바둑 근처에 잠금 된 빌라 내부에서 볼 수 있습니다. 당신은 빌라 내부에 뒷문 잠금 잠금 하기 위해 코티지 뒷문 열쇠가 필요합니다. 안쪽 방에는 왼쪽 방에서 볼 수 있습니다. 두 번째 층에, 냄비 식물이 테이블에 있습니다. 바둑 안에 있는 뒷문으로 원하는 빌라 내부에서 볼 수 있습니다.

quests.content:
TerraGroup Employee is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Good day to you, mercenary. Because the day is actually good. I was right, the new stimulants are connected to TerraGroup. Mechanic found information about Sanitar. Not too much, and it was very expensive for us, but it's better than nothing. Sanitar worked for TerraGroup, and not as an ordinary employee. Graduated in medicine, specialist in infectious diseases, divorced... Well, that's all the information we have on him. Give me more, my friend, I'm very interested in where he got access to such resources. Find his workplace and find out more.

== Objectives ==
Locate Sanitar's workplace in the Lab
Locate and obtain any information about Sanitar's work
Hand over the found intel

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Submachine Guns skill levels
+2 Stress Resistance skill levels
Peacekeeper Rep +1.5
2,750 Dollars
2,888 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
3,162 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Mesa Tactical Crosshair Hydraulic buffer tube
1× AR-15 Magpul ACS Carbine stock
1× AR-15 Magpul ACS Carbine stock (FDE)
Unlocks purchase of Mesa Tactical Crosshair Hydraulic buffer tube at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Magpul ACS Carbine stock at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Magpul ACS Carbine stock (FDE) at Peacekeeper LL4
We have decoded that flash drive. There's a lot of important information there, but I can't tell you everything. It's classified. I can tell you about Sanitar though, he's a scientist. He studied and developed drugs, and then tested them on people. Very... bold, or, as they sometimes say, unethical research.

== Guide ==

The Flash drive marked with blue tape can be found in Sanitar's room in The Lab. The room is located on the second floor, directly across from the laboratory block (G22) and requires a Keycard with a blue marking to enter.

In Sanitar's room, the Flash drive marked with blue tape is stuck into the laptop that is located on the left desk after you enter.

quests.content:
Textile - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Notes ==
Depending on the faction of the player there will be a different dialogue and reward.

== Dialogue ==
== BEAR Exclusive ==
Oh, brother, come in. Wanna get something cool? I have some new clothes in store for you, but it's rare and not cheap. Bring me these things, and make sure they're pristine, no traders. My supplies are completely out and I'm overwhelmed with orders. You can check Ultra, they used to sell those materials there back in the day, but the looters probably took it all over Tarkov. Let me make a list for you, I need a lot of stuff.

== USEC Exclusive ==
Come on in, no need to stand in the doorway. I have a job for you. I'm all busy with orders, and I'm almost out of materials. Can you find me some? I'll be able to offer you something new in return. It won't be cheap though. Made in.. well, you know where. And yeah, make sure that those materials are pristine, get them yourself, without traders' help. Anyway, bring them in as soon as you get them. Find them wherever you want, but I think there was a big supply of them in the Ultra mall. Lemme make a list for you.

== Objectives ==
Find 5 Aramid fabrics in raid
Hand over 5 Aramid fabrics to Ragman
Find 10 Ripstop fabrics in raid
Hand over 10 Ripstop fabrics to Ragman
Find 3 Paracords in raid
Hand over 3 Paracords to Ragman

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× Mystery Ranch Blackjack 50 backpack (MultiCam)
1× Peltor ComTac IV Hybrid headset (Coyote Brown)
Unlocks barter for Mystery Ranch Blackjack 50 backpack (MultiCam) at Ragman LL4

== BEAR Exclusive ==
Unlocks purchase of BEAR TIGR lower clothing at Ragman LL3
You got it? Nice. Come back soon, I'll tell you what else I need. There will be something special for you. In the meantime, go on and try on the new clothes.

== USEC Exclusive ==
Unlocks purchase of USEC Commando lower clothing at Ragman LL3
Unlocks purchase of IOTV Gen4 body armor (Assault Kit, MultiCam) at Ragman LL4
You got it? Good work. Come back a bit later, I will have another task for you. You can try on the new clothes, by the way.

== Guide ==

Aramid fiber fabric can commonly be found in clothing stores on Interchange. Ripstop fabric can be found in the same locations, though more rarely. They can also be found inside of Sport bags, Buried barrel caches, and Ground caches.
Paracord can be found in Sport bags. They can also be found spawning on the map Reserve. For more specific spawn locations visit the Paracord page.

quests.content:
Textile - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Notes ==
Depending on the faction of the player there will be a different dialogue and reward.

== Dialogue ==

== BEAR Exclusive ==
So, here's another list of the stuff I need. As soon as you have it - bring it here, and make sure it's in good condition. No traders and all, well, you know the deal. I'm thinking about some new outfits for you, something recognizable, warming the Russian heart. I have no idea what's the business between you and the yanks, but these days your life is as shitty as theirs. Shit happens. Anyway, good luck to you.

== USEC Exclusive ==
Come on in, I was just thinking about you. Alright, so listen, I need more of these items listed here, and they have to be brand new, no traders. Come on, don't make faces too early! I'll get you some cool news clothes for this, the Kansas spirit and all or whatever. Just imagine that, running and gunning here in a foreign country in clothes like from the ranch! Well anyway, I'm waiting for the listed items, the reward is generous.

== Objectives ==
Find 10 Fleece fabrics in raid
Hand over 10 Fleece fabrics to Ragman
Find 10 Cordura polyamide fabrics in raid
Hand over 10 Cordura polyamide fabrics to Ragman
Find 5 KEKTAPE duct tapes in raid
Hand over 5 KEKTAPE duct tapes to Ragman

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× 6Sh118 raid backpack (EMR)
1× Safariland Liberator HP 2.0 Hearing Protection Headset (FDE)
Unlocks barter for 6Sh118 raid backpack (EMR) at Prapor LL4

== BEAR Exclusive ==
Unlocks purchase of BEAR TIGR upper clothing at Ragman LL3
That's exactly what I need! Put it all over there. Lemme measure you... Well, it's gonna be a tough one. Don't worry, you'll love the result, bro.

== USEC Exclusive ==
Unlocks purchase of USEC TIER2 upper clothing at Ragman LL3
C'mon, so you have everything? Leave 'em somewhere in the corner and come here, I need to measure you. This stuff is quite a rarity in our current conditions, so don't get mad about the price. But at least the American spirit won't abandon you, he-he.

== Guide ==

The Cordura polyamide fabric and Fleece fabric can commonly be found in clothing stores on Interchange. They can also be found inside of Sport bags, Buried barrel caches, and Ground caches.
KEKTAPE duct tape can be found anywhere construction supplies spawns, drawers, and inside of toolboxes.

quests.content:
The Art of Explosion is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, soldier! I recently worked out a deal to get my hands on a new kind of weapon. Same family as grenades, only a whole lot nastier. This isn't the sort of thing you hand out to just anyone. It takes discipline, good judgment. Plus the stock's limited.So if you want to buy this kind of serious hardware from me, prove you know how to put explosives on target. No shortcuts. I'd rather not have you blowing yourself up or turning one of your own into a casualty.Use whatever gets the job done. Underbarrel launchers, homemade grenades, doesn't matter to me. I only care about the results.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 20 PMC operatives with grenades or grenade launchers

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Grenade Launchers skill levels
+4 Underbarrel Launchers skill levels
Prapor Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher
1× Granit 4 ballistic plate (Front)
Unlocks purchase of RShG-2 72.5mm rocket launcher at Prapor LL4
Unlocks purchase of Granit 4 ballistic plate (Front) at Prapor LL4
Yup, I've already heard about your handiwork. In your hands, an RShG's more of an asset than a liability. Like I said, these things are hard to come by, but I'll set one aside for you whenever I get a shipment.When you use it, make sure you've got plenty of space around you and nobody standing behind you. Oh, and read the instructions printed on the launcher. Don't be an idiot.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 20 PMC Operatives with grenades, underbarrel grenade launchers, grenade launchers or rocket launchers. Kills with the stationary AGS-30 grenade launcher do not count.

Note: The 40x46mm M576 (MP-APERS) grenade does not work for this quest, because it is a buckshot cartridge instead of an actual grenade.

== Trivia ==
This quest was released together with the video "Art of Explosion"

The Bunker is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, warrior. I'll get straight to the point. Word is they've uncovered an entrance to an underground bunker beneath our reserve military base. Where the hell it came from, I've got no idea, but the place ought to be interesting. I'm not sending my own boys into the unknown, they're more useful to me alive. So head over there and take a look around, search for entrances and exits as well. If it turns out this bunker wasn't built for grunts, but for the top brass, report back to me.

== Objectives ==
Locate the underground bunker on Reserve
Locate the control room in the underground bunker on Reserve
Locate the hermetic door leading to the hospital (White Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of the two hermetic doors leading to the academy building (Black Bishop) on Reserve
Locate one of the two hermetic doors leading to barracks #1 (Black Pawn) on Reserve
Locate one of the two hermetic doors leading to barracks #2 (White Pawn) on Reserve
Locate the hermetic door leading to the air control center building (King) on Reserve

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Alright don't be shy, mark those entrances right on this map. I'll get your reward in the meantime.

== Guide ==
The underground bunker on Reserve can be reached by using any staircase. The hermetic doors are the entry doors to the bunker. The control room is located in the center of the bunker. All objectives have to be completed in the same raid.

objectivesKo: [보안 컨테이너 엡실론] 건네주기
quests.content:
The Choice is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, mercenary. As I see, you are not wasting your time and have achieved a lot on your way. Sometimes in life, you know, we have to lose something to achieve something bigger in the end? Not everyone is ready for this. Many aren't willing to take risks in their entire life, they are afraid, they don't believe in themselves. What about you, are you ready for this yourself? Are you ready to sacrifice something of value to achieve a bigger goal?

== Objectives ==
Handover Secure container Epsilon

== Rewards ==
+433,333 EXP
+2 Hideout Management skill levels
Fence Rep +1.1
1,000,000 Roubles
1,050,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2

A brave decision, mercenary.

quests.content:
The Cleaner is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You know, I have foreign partners who are working on evacuating important assets from Tarkov. They are especially interested in Reserve and the laboratory beneath the city. But recently, they have encountered some competition... Can you help and eliminate these obstacles?

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 Raiders or Black Division operatives on Reserve or The Lab

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.75
1,900 Euros
1,995 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,185 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
4× Power supply unit
Unlocks purchase of 7.62x51mm M80 at Peacekeeper LL4
Excellent work! Now my partners will be able to operate on these locations much more easily.

== Guide ==
Scav Raiders may sometimes be found in the command area of the underground tunnel system at the start of a raid, and additional ones may appear after the "D-2" extraction power switch has been activated. The arrival of the train may also spawn them at the train yard. Additionally, pulling the "Bunker hermetic door" extraction lever may spawn them at the train yard.

sectionsKo.title: Guide

Hello. I have a client who urgently needs a new optic, but all my usual couriers are tied up with other jobs. If you can deliver the package to the designated location, I'll make it worth your while. Here, take the optic. Head to the newer gas station on the customs territory. You'll find a set of dumpsters there - leave it there. Once you're done, come back for your payment.

== Dialogue ==
You know, I don't work only with you. I have one very useful and resourceful informant, but he has not checked in for quite some time. The last information I received from him mentioned a strange glow and mysterious voices near the old village. He said he would investigate what was happening, and then disappeared. Find him, or at least find out what may have happened to him.

Survive and extract from the location

Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1

Kurwa! This is far too strange... I will continue looking into it myself. Thanks!

== Guide ==
The informant is located in a ruined house in the swamps of Shoreline. You can find it by locating the church and following a blood trail.

The Delicious Sausage is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Оh! Come on in, I've got a job for you! Listen, how long ago have you been in town? Well, I got a job for you. Run through the supermarkets, see if they've been looted. And do the old man a favor and look for the Salt Dog sausage or something like that. Mechanic kindly introduced it to me, and now I'm craving it. It's killing me!

== Objectives ==
Scout the Shestyorochka store at Nikitskaya street
Scout the Sparja store at Primorsky ave
Scout the Sparja store in Pinewood hotel
Scout the Goshan store in Concordia
Hand over 1 found in raid Salty Dog beef sausage

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
So, how's the situation out there? Nothing left? Bloody looters! But did you find the sausage? Haha, what a miracle! But what about the expiration date?

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to visit the 4 the stores listed in the quest objective on Streets of Tarkov and hand over a found in raid Salty Dog beef sausage. The stores can be visited in different raids, and progress is saved upon death. For the store objectives to register, walk up to the center of them. The beef sausage can be found at any food spawn.

quests.content:
The Door is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hi, I have a delicate matter. I'm a man of science and I'm used to always find an explanation for everything. As you know, I'm interested in all sorts of signals coming from the territory of our beautiful city. There is a strange place where all my scans are strangely muffled, as if there is nothing there, empty, which is impossible from a scientific point of view. The source itself is in the second or third floor of a certain building. Why don't you go check it out, see if there's some kind of equipment? Set up a couple cameras for me for surveillance. The reference point will be the house with the astronaut mural on the wall.

== Objectives ==
Locate the cause of the signal interference on Streets of Tarkov
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the door
Install a WI-FI Camera to watch the stairwell
Note: The "Install" objectives will appear after the "Locate" objective is completed.

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.75
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Oh, it's you. The signal went through, but it didn't clear up the situation - there are random looters and curious people wandering around, but still at some moments the signal goes blank, and the cameras go crazy. And then there's this weird door... I don't personally believe in the supernatural. I'll keep an eye out, stay in touch. Thanks for your work.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to place two WI-FI Cameras in the Klimova 16A building on Streets of Tarkov. A Rusted bloody key is required. One has to be placed in the staircase in front of the locked door on the fourth floor, and the other one has to be placed at the heater next to the chained door in the area behind the locked door.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 저는 섬세한 문제입니다. 저는 과학자이고 항상 모든 것에 대한 설명을 찾는 데 익숙합니다. 여러분들이 아시다시피, 우리 아름다운 도시의 영토에서 오는 모든 종류의 신호에 관심이 있습니다. 모든 스캔들이 이상하게 소화되어 있는 이상한 장소가 있습니다. 마치 아무것도 없는 것처럼, 빈 공간입니다. 과학적인 관점에서 볼 때 불가능합니다. 그 원천은 특정 건물의 두 번째 또는 세 번째 층에 있습니다. 왜 가서 그것을 확인하지 않는가? 어떤 장비가 있는지 확인하십시오. 감시용 카메라 몇 개를 설치하세요. 참고 포인트는 벽에 우주비행사 벽화 있는 집입니다.

계단 기구를 감시하기 위해 와이파이 카메라를 설치

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +28,000 EXP 정비사 평판 +0.75 275,000 루블 288,750 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 316,250 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 오, 당신입니다. 신호가 통과했지만 상황을 명확히 하지 않았습니다. 무작위로 약탈자와 호기심이 있는 사람들이 돌아다니고 있지만, 여전히 어떤 순간 신호가 빈색되고 카메라가 미쳤습니다. 그리고 이 이상한 문이 있습니다. 저는 초자연적인 것을 믿지 않습니다. 저는 눈을 뜨지 않을 것입니다. 연락을 계속 유지합니다. 작업에 대해 감사합니다.

objectivesKo: 커스텀에 숨겨진 귀중한 화물 찾아 확보하기
(선택) 커스텀에서 사신의 시체가 찾기
(선택) 사신자가 커스텀에 화물을 숨긴 장소 찾기
가치 있는 화물 건네기
quests.content:
The Extortionist is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Kinda busy right now! Although... Hang on a sec. There is an urgent matter. There was a firefight about an hour ago in the garages across the river. Just where my errand boy was headed. To hell with him, he was a total moron anyway. But he had with him one particular key. A mighty complex key, I might add. To the door that can be freaking anywhere, you know? This clown was delivering one very valuable thing to me. The bastard hid it somewhere and locked it with this arsetormenting key and came to me to talk up the price. What a bitch! I even raised the pay a little for the smart move, but this wanker still hasn’t told me where it was and went to get it for himself. And I’m almost sure he’s got done in there. Find the key, and then find me that package even if you have to check all doors from the center to the port.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the hidden valuable cargo on Customs
(Optional) Locate the messenger's body on Customs
(Optional) Locate the place where the messenger hid the cargo on Customs
Hand over the valuable cargo

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.1
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
You’re a damn Pinkerton! Helped me out big time! So, you found my idiot errand boy? Well, screw him. If you do something similar, you'll get smoked like him too. Go on, buzz off, I've got some stuff to do.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to pick up a folder from a locked cabin on Customs. The required Unknown key can be found on a dead Scav that is also located on Customs. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid, regardless of whether or not a player in the raid has this quest active.

Dead Scav and cabin marked on map
The dead Scav is located in a bush behind garages
The cabin that is opened with the key
The folder is located under a jacket on the floor

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 지금 좀 바쁘네요! 하지만... 잠깐만요. 긴급한 일이 있어요. 한 시간 전쯤은 강 건너 차고에서 총격이 벌어졌어요. 바로 제가 간편한 게놈이 가고 있던 곳으로. 어쨌든, 그는 완전히 바보였어요. 하지만, 그는 한 가지 특별한 열쇠를 가지고 있었습니다. 아주 복잡한 열쇠, 제가 덧붙일 수 있습니다. 어느 곳에도 삐걱거리는 문을, 이 badut이 제게 매우 소중한 물건을 배달하고 있었습니다. 이 악당은 어딘가에 숨기고, 이 악당 열쇠로 잠겼고, 그 가격을 이야기하기 위해 제게 왔습니다. 얼마나 좆까! 나는 똑똑한 센터에 대한 돈을 조금 지불하기도 했습니다. 하지만 이 악당은 여전히 그 열쇠가 어디에 있는지 말하지 않고, 그것을 스스로 가져갈 것입니다. 그리고 저는 거의 확신합니다. 그는 열쇠를 가지고 있었다. 그리고 그 다음, 저를 찾아, 당신이 모든 포트에서 패키지를 확인해야 할 수 있습니다.
