quests.title: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 1
objectivesKo: 철목을 가진 동동력 총을 사용하면서 40m 이상 떨어진 곳에서 5 스캐브를 제거하십시오
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Here you are. Only you and Sniper can survive that long in the field, raid after raid, it looks like. He was recently looking for a reliable guy, who can be entrusted with a task and won't let him down. He says the best way to test a person for his task is to check their skills with bolt-action rifles. He's a serious man, so I think he needs a fighter for something important. What do you think, can I recommend you? Try yourself in as the "Tarkov Shooter". if you pass all Sniper's tests, I’ll arrange you a contact with him. So, here's the first task he prepared: we need to test your accuracy with iron sights from a medium distance, let's say 40 meters.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Scavs from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle with iron sights

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports MNG rail mount
2× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports MNG rail mount at Jaeger LL1
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Recoil Pad at Jaeger LL1
So, do you feel like Zaitsev yet? Sniper is satisfied with the first test results and has already prepared the next task.

== Guide ==
To do this task, grab a bolt-action rifle or an MP-18 and do not attach any scopes or sights. Use only the iron sights. Factory is not recommended for this quest as there are not many places where you can effectively engage at 40m or further. Only Scavs count towards this quest, not PMCs. Woods, Shoreline, and Customs are good maps because of the sniper Scavs that can be spotted from a far distance.

== Trivia ==
The success dialogue refers to Vasily Zaitsev, a famous Soviet sniper during World War II.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 여기 계신 분. 저나 스나이퍼만 이 시공에서 그렇게 오래 살아남을 수 있습니다. 래드 후 레이드. 그는 최근에 신뢰할 수 있는 사람을 찾고 있었는데, 그는 어떤 일을 맡기고 실망시키지 않을 것입니다. 그는 자신의 임무에 사람을 테스트하는 가장 좋은 방법은 볼트 액션 총으로 그들의 기술을 확인하는 것이라고 말합니다. 그는 진지한 사람이기 때문에 중요한 일에 전투기가 필요하다고 생각합니다. 어떻게 생각하십니까, 내가 추천 할 수 있습니까? "타르코프 슈팅"으로 자신을 시도하십시오. 당신이 스나이퍼의 모든 테스트를 통과하면, 나는 당신과 연락을 할 것입니다. 그래서, 그가 준비한 첫 번째 작업은 다음과 같습니다. 우리는 중간 거리에서 철의 시야를 테스트해야합니다. 40 미터라고 가정해보겠습니다.

objectivesKo: 발에 있는 목표물을 40m 이상에서 발에 쏘는 동안 3번
40m 이상에서 어떤 목표물을 두 번이나 발사기를 사용하면서 머리를 쏴
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
My friend, Shabelsky was his last name, used to write stories about the war. Even I had a fun time reading them sometimes. So recently he sold the rights to the entire series of books, and they made a movie after them in the West. But now he wants more money from the movie company, he hit the hard times, apparently. Even messaged me to look up some decent fighters here in Tarkov. It seems the whole world has forgotten about our city... They only remember us when they need a hired gun, and while things are going good they prefer to not notice our situation at all. Anyway, I digress. Are you ready for the second task from Sniper? You have to shoot at heads and legs from the same distance, 40 meters.

== Objectives ==
Shoot any target in the legs from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle 3 times
Shoot any target in the head from over 40 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle 2 times

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake
2× Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Tri-Rail mount
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle AIM Sports Tri-Rail mount at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Tacfire Tanker Style 7.62x54R muzzle brake at Jaeger LL2
Not bad, not bad. Even I wouldn't be so accurate with my shots, I'm way too old now. While you were shooting, Sniper has prepared the next test for you.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to use a bolt-action rifle or MP-18 to land 3 hits on any entities legs, and 2 hits on any entities heads from over 40 meters away. The leg hits can all be done on the same target. Hits on group members don't count.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 제 친구 샤벨스키는 그의 가사명이었는데 전쟁에 관한 이야기를 썼습니다. 저도 가끔씩 재미있게 읽었습니다. 그래서 최근 그는 전체 책 시리즈의 권리를 팔고 서양에서 영화를 만들었고요. 하지만 이제 그는 영화 회사로부터 더 많은 돈을 원하고, 그는 어려운 시간을 보냈습니다. 심지어 타르코프에서 괜찮은 전투기를 찾아달라고 메시지를 보냈습니다. 전 세계가 우리 도시를 잊은 것 같습니다. 그들은 우리를 기억하는 것은 고용 총이 필요할 때만, 그리고 모든 것이 잘 진행되는 동안 우리의 상황을 전혀 알아보지 않는 것을 선호합니다. 어쨌든, 나는 돌아갑니다. 당신은 스나이퍼에서 두 번째 작업에 준비가 되셨습니까? 당신은 같은 거리에서 머리와 다리를 촬영해야합니다. 40m.

quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I see you're quite a good shot, kid. Sniper said he wants to test your reaction time. The faster one wins, as he says. As in that film, remember, "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly", only with a bolt-action rifle instead of a revolver. Life here certainly isn’t a movie, but the reaction and the choice of position are very important in the firefight, especially in urban conditions. If you survive this, help yourself to my cowboy hat, I have one around here somewhere. You choose yourself, who you want to be: the good, the bad, or the ugly.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 3 PMCs from less than 25 meters away while using a bolt-action rifle

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Mosin Rifle Tacfire pistol grip
Unlocks purchase of Mosin Rifle Tacfire pistol grip at Jaeger LL2
Unlocks craft for .366 TKM AP-M at Workbench level 1
Unlocks Colored Hideout shooting range target style
You have got a good reaction time since you're still standing here. Grab your new hat, as promised! Go on, shooter, new tests await you.

== Guide ==
To do this quest, grab a bolt-action rifle or an MP-18. Factory is a recommended location for this quest, as there are ample opportunities to engage PMC's at 25m or closer.

You can use the M7290 grenade, the Zarya grenade or a KS-23M with the Zvezda flashbang round to flash and stun PMC'S and make them easier targets.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 난 네가 꽤 좋은 촬영자인 걸 본다. 스나이퍼는 너의 반응 시간을 테스트하고 싶어한다고 말했다. 그가 말하는 대로 더 빨리 승리하는 사람이 더 빨리 승리한다. 그 영화처럼, "좋은, 나쁜, 못생긴"을 기억하라. 단지 권총 대신 빗발이 있는 총을 사용한다. 여기서 삶은 확실히 영화가 아니다. 하지만 반응과 위치 선택은 불투기에서 매우 중요합니다. 특히 도시 조건에서. 이 일을 살아남으면, 내 카우보이 모자를 가지고 있다. 여기 어딘가 어딘가에서. 당신은 자신을 선택, 당신은 되고 싶은 사람: 좋은, 나쁜, 또는 못생긴.

quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
As Sniper likes to say: "The best tool against a sniper is another sniper". It is not a rare case in combat, but you have to keep in mind that the enemy is a well-trained and well-prepared shooter. They are smart, will take up tricky positions, and try to deceive you. Even if they're not a professional military man, but a former gamekeeper or so. You need to "tie down" the enemy sniper, make them show themself - then, they're all yours. Well, these are recommendations I was asked to give you. Scavs just find rifles with scopes and climb up on the roofs or rocks, thinking they're actual snipers. Those are the ones you have to eliminate.

quests.title: The Tarkov Shooter - Part 7
objectivesKo: 5명의 PMC 요원을 죽이지 않고 동포총으로 제거해
quests.content:
The Tarkov Shooter - Part 7 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Do you like classic literature? Why do you think Dostoevsky is so popular with those who've never been to Russia? I've been wondering about it for a while until this TerraGroup scandal emerged. Its executives, I assume, were very familiar with classics and what they do to us. Such a situation can only be pulled in a society where people can combine both lies and betrayal and irrational, unexplainable self-sacrifice, which are more abundant in Tarkov than in any other place. Dostoevsky wrote about it, these people can live with the highest commitment to other people and at the same time be the best at killing. Sometimes we forget about this. The next task from Sniper is your personal count, and not in cash, obviously.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 PMC operatives with a bolt-action rifle without dying

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
1× SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle
1× Mk-18 .338 LM 10-round magazine
1× .338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of SWORD International Mk-18 .338 LM marksman rifle at Jaeger LL4
It seems that sometimes being smart isn’t enough to act smart. Well, a good old bolty can be of help with this. Sniper is silent for now, so let's wait for a little before your next tasks. I will let you know when there are new tests for you.

== Failure Dialogue ==
This is not an easy task. Try again.

== Guide ==
The kills can be done over multiple raids, but dying at any point before actually handing in the completed quest will fail it.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 당신은 고전 문학을 좋아합니까? 왜 도스토예프스키가 러시아에 온 적이 없는 사람들에게 그렇게 인기가 있다고 생각하십니까? 나는 테라그룹 스캔들이 등장하기 전까지는 잠시 동안 그것에 대해 궁금해했습니다. 그 경영자들은 고전과 그들이 우리에게 무엇을 하는지 매우 알고 있었다고 가정합니다. 그러한 상황은 사람들이 거짓말과 배신과 타르코프에서 다른 곳보다 더 풍부하고 설명할 수없는 부지런한 자부심을 결합 할 수있는 사회에서만 얻을 수 있습니다. 도스토예프스키는 그것에 대해 썼습니다. 이 사람들은 다른 사람들에게 가장 높은 헌신으로 살 수 있으며 동시에 가장 잘 살 수 있습니다. 때로는 우리는 이것을 잊습니다. 스나이퍼의 다음 임무는 분명히 현금으로 계산하지 않고 개인으로 계산하는 것입니다.

Thirsty - Breadwinner is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
The Thirsty dude? You too?! Why are you all bringing him up all of a sudden? Yeah, I worked with this guy. Сouldn't last five minutes without a drink. We made some good money with him back then. Always brought good loot, that guy. My respect to him. But he's been out of the game for a long time, at least in Tarkov. I can give you a tip on where he dumped his extra supplies, but not for free. I'm looking for two tanks of propane right now. Why don't you find it for me, and then we'll talk about your guy?

== Objectives ==
Find 2 Propane tanks (5L) in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Expeditionary fuel tank
You got it? That's a good start. Now we can talk about Thirsty.

== Guide ==

The easiest way to complete this task is via utilizing your Scav character on Interchange to loot the OLI store, as propane tanks are commonly found on the shelving in the area.

Thirsty - Delivery is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, I keep my word. Before you, Sanitar was sniffing around that guy, too. But his business proposition was shite, so I didn't tell him anything. I'll tell you, but a bit later. Here are some nice propane tanks for you. Yeah, the ones you brought. Now you have to stash them. One in the nature reserve, in the Scav bunker with the radio tower. The other at the Customs area, in the little store by the crossroads. Just make sure to not shoot the tanks, okay? If you finish the job, you'll get more info.

Locate the specified stash spot on Customs
Stash the first Propane tank (5L)

+10,000 EXP

You done? Very well. I'll give you a bonus for not bitching about the job. So, anyway, Thirsty used to hang around in the west wing of the Health Resort, in the basement. That was a long time ago, before the junkies got there. We cleaned that place out a long time ago, but maybe there's something left, I don't know. Check it out for yourself.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

Thirsty - Echo is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Thank you for reaching out. I know you're investigating a certain person called Thirsty. Sanitar is investigating him as well, for a specific reason. He's always hunting for any information on TerraGroup's activities. Surely it's all connected. If you can intercept the data first, bring it to me, I'll pay you handsomely. Besides, in my hands, it won't cause another disaster.

== Objectives ==
Locate any information about Thirsty on Shoreline
Obtain the information in Thirsty's hideout
Hand over the found information

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
4× Aquamari water bottle with filter
2× M.U.L.E. stimulant injector
Just a diary, nothing but that? Well, it could still prove valuable... That handwriting is terrible! It'll take a while to read it. Here's your reward.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to obtain Thirsty's battered diary in the basement of the health resort west wing on Shoreline. It can be found in a room near the pool. There are multiple spawns throughout the room.

== Dialogue ==
We need to talk. Sanitar's goons have been prowling the shore area at nights. Obviously looking for something. Can't let it go unchecked. Scare them off while I try to find out what they're up to.

== Requirements ==
Reach Loyalty Level 2 with Jaeger, Skier and Therapist.

Eliminate 12 Scavs in the time period of 22:00-7:00 on Shoreline

+10,000 EXP

You fought them off? Excellent! I found out they're looking for Thirsty's hideout. He was the guy who used to always bring a double supply of water with him. I haven't seen him in a while, right after he mixed up with Skier. I guess it led to a bad end for him.

== Guide ==
Head to Shoreline between 22:00 and 7:00. It is recommended to go into the raid by at latest 5:00, so you have time to advance the quest before 7:00.

objectivesKo: 미궁 내부의 고문실 찾기

quests.content:
This Tape Sucks is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello again. I received a patient who was recently wounded in the resort cellars and barely escaped from this monster in a bull mask... Obvious mental trauma, perhaps more than one. But besides the stories about this Minotaur, the patient also mentioned many confinement and even torture chambers. You surely recognize the unacceptable nature of such human confinement, even under wartime conditions, so I am counting on your cooperation. We must get to the bottom of what is or was going on in these cellars. Explore those jail rooms and try to uncover any information or evidence that will help us find out who is responsible for what happened. And most importantly, what was the purpose of all these "experiments".

== Objectives ==
Locate the torture room inside The Labyrinth
Locate and obtain any evidence of torture
Hand over the found information

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× SJ12 TGLabs combat stimulant injector
2× Meldonin injector
2× 3-(b-TG) stimulant injector
1× Taurus poster
A video tape... You haven't watched it yet, have you? Now I know what is happening. I was wrong before. The resort was one of the evacuation points when it all started, and its cellars could have been used for, uh, different purposes... The situation wasn't so severe yet at that time, and they tried to isolate the deceased bodies from crowded places. This tape is definitely not a cause for concern... However, I would refrain from visiting these cellars if I were you. Ventilation in bomb shelters has always been a weak point, and humidity only contributes to possible intoxication...

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to find the torture room inside The Labyrinth. Afterwards you have to obtain evidence of the torture in form of a videotape. There are multiple spawn locations near the room.

Torture room location marked on map
The torture room
Spawn 1: Under the door
Spawn 2: In the wall opposite the room
Spawn 3: In the hand of a dead Scav on the ground under the arch opposite the roomNote: The body doesn't always spawn, but the tape can still be there
Spawn 4: On top of bloody barrels adjacent to the arch opposite the room

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 다시 안녕하세요. 저는 최근에 휴양지 기저장에서 부상당하고 황소 마스크를 입고 이 괴물에서 겨우 탈출한 환자를 받았습니다. 명백한 정신적 외상, 아마도 하나 이상입니다. 하지만 이 미노타우르에 대한 이야기 외에도 환자는 또한 많은 수감과 심지어 고문 방을 언급했습니다. 전쟁 상황에서도 그러한 인간 수감의 수용성이 불가피하다는 것을 확실히 인식하고 있습니다. 그래서 저는 여러분의 협력을 기대합니다. 우리는 이 기저장에서 무슨 일이 일어나고 있는지에 대해 깊이 알아야합니다. 그 감옥 방들을 탐구하고 어떤 정보나 증거를 발견하려고 노력합니다. 무엇이 일어났는지에 대해 누가 책임있는지 알아낼 수 있도록 도와줄 것입니다. 그리고 가장 중요한 것은, 이 모든 "실험"의 목적은 무엇이었는지에 대한 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 먼저 미궁 내부의 고문실을 찾아야 한다. 그 후 비디오 테이프 형태로 고문 증거를 얻어야 한다. 방 근처에 여러 개의 자생 장소가 있다. 지도에 표시된 고문실 위치: 고문실 Spawn 1: 문 아래 Spawn 2: 방 반대편의 벽에 Spawn 3: 방 반대편의 아치 아래 바닥에 죽은 스캐브의 손에

quests.title: Tigr Safari
objectivesKo: 그리고 UN Tigr 차량에 MS2000 마커를 커스텀에 표시합니다. 찾기
quests.content:
Tigr Safari is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Okay, here's the next deal. Russia kindly supplied the UN peacekeeping mission with several Tigr vehicles. The mission has now been almost completely withdrawn, and those vehicles have been left sitting idle. I need you to find any one of them on Customs and mark it with a beacon. There are still plenty of valuable components left inside that can be removed and sold to American intelligence. I suggest searching along the main road. Unfortunately, I do not have any beacons available at the moment, so you will have to sort that out yourself.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by USEC PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark any UN Tigr vehicle with an MS2000 Marker on Customs

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.1
550 Dollars
578 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
632 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
I trust you did not discuss this operation with the local authorities? Great. Here is your reward.

== Guide ==

MS2000 Markers can be bought from Prapor or Ragman.

Vehicle locations marked on map
First Tigr vehicle
Second Tigr vehicle
Third Tigr vehicle

== See also ==
Scrap Metal - The BEAR counterpart quest

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 다음 거래는 이렇습니다. 러시아는 UN 평화 유지 임무에 여러 개의 티그르 차량을 제공했습니다. 임무는 거의 완전히 철수되었고, 그 차량들은 무작위로 남아 있습니다. 커스텀에서 그 중 하나를 찾아 번호와 표시해야 합니다. 여전히 많은 귀중한 부품이 남아 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: USEC PMC만 수락할 수 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 그리고 UN Tigr 차량에 MS2000 마커를 커스텀에 표시합니다. 찾기

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: MS2000 마크는 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 구입할 수 있습니다. 지도에 표시된 차량 위치

sectionsKo.text: 필요하다면 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 MS2000 마커를 구입할 수 있습니다. 플레이어는 MS2000 마커를 특수 슬롯 또는 가방에 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 따라서 사망의 경우 손실되지 않습니다. MS2000 마커는 필요하면 자동으로 플레이어의 인벤토리에서 사용됩니다. 키가 작동하는 것과 비슷합니다.

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 1
objectivesKo: 체크포인트 또는 라스트헤로 모드에서 경기에서 승리
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Well-well, you've finished your first assessment. I think it's right about time for a new champion of the Arena to rise. And it's going to be you. By consent, of course. We don't practice cruelty here, haha! I can help you reach heights and riches beyond your wildest dreams. You just have to take me up on my offer. But, you know, actions always trump words. So go ahead, enter the Arena and win. That's how I will know you're ready to push forward.

== Objectives ==
Win a match in CheckPoint or LastHero mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+2,800 EXP
Ref Rep +0.02
55 GP coins
58 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
63 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
I never doubted you for a second, brother! But remember, we're here to entertain people. We need a bigger show! Sometimes it looks like you're just shooting cans, you know.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 네, 네 첫 평가도 끝났어. 아레나의 새로운 챔피언이 떠오르는 때가 됐다고 생각합니다. 그리고 네 것이 될 것입니다. 동의를 얻어, 물론. 우리는 여기서 잔인함을 실천하지 않습니다. 하하! 내가 너의 가장 야만적인 꿈을 넘어 높은 곳과 부를 도달하는 데 도움을 줄 수 있습니다. 너는 단지 내 제안을 받아들여야 합니다. 하지만, 당신은 알고 있습니다. 행동들은 항상 말을 trump. 그래서 앞으로, 아레나에 들어가서 승리. 그렇게 내가 당신이 앞으로 추진할 준비가 되어 있다는 것을 알 수 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 체크포인트 또는 라스트헤로 모드에서 경기에서 승리

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +2,800 EXP 레프 Rep +0.02 55 GP 동전 58 GP 동전 정보 센터 레벨 1 63 GP 동전 정보 센터 레벨 2 난 당신을 의심 한 번도 안 했어, 형제! 하지만 기억, 우리는 사람들을 즐겁게 하기 위해 여기 왔어요. 우리는 더 큰 쇼가 필요해요! 때때로 당신은 그냥 캔을 촬영하는 것처럼 보입니다, 당신은 알고 있습니다.

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 2
objectivesKo: 팀 파이트, 블래스트게임, 또는 아레나에서 체크포인트 모드에서 경기를 승리
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're under my wing from now on, brother. I'll make sure you get progress good, but you're gonna have to get your ass in gear more often. Let's start with the basics. The Arena's in Tarkov, but the biggest sponsors are overseas. They watch every game, place bets, throw money at the favorites. And you need to get some of those big shots interested. Get their attention, show them you're worthy. Make a name for yourself. One win alone isn't enough to do it. Show them you can make a thrilling performance!

== Objectives ==
Win a match in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+3,500 EXP
Ref Rep +0.02
32 GP coins
34 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
37 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Weapon crate (Rare)
I see the progress you're making! They're starting to talk about you overseas. People are interested. It's a sign that you're doing the right thing!

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 이제부터 내 아날 아래 있어, 형제. 내가 잘 진전을 이루도록 하겠다. 하지만 더 자주 엉덩이를 움직여야 한다. 기본적인 것부터 시작하자. 아레나는 타르코프에 있고, 하지만 가장 큰 스폰서가 해외에 있다. 그들은 모든 경기를 보고, 베팅을 하고, 좋아하는 사람들에게 돈을 던지죠. 그리고 당신은 그 큰 샷들을 흥미롭게 만들 필요가 있습니다. 그들의 관심을 끌고, 당신이 가치가 있다는 것을 보여주십시오. 자신을 위해 이름을 만들어보세요. 한 승리가만으로는 그것을 할 수는 없습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 팀 파이트, 블래스트게임, 또는 아레나에서 체크포인트 모드에서 경기를 승리

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +3,500 EXP 레프 Rep +0.02 32 GP 동전 34 GP 동전 정보 센터 레벨 1 37 GP 동전 정보 센터 레벨 2 1× 무기 칸 ( 희귀) 당신이 하는 발전을 보고 있습니다! 그들은 해외에 당신을 이야기하기 시작. 사람들은 관심이 있습니다. 그것은 당신이 옳은 일을 하는 신호입니다!

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 3
objectivesKo: 팀 파이트, 블래스트 갱 또는 아레나에서 체크포인트 모드에서 최소 3위를 차지하면서 2 경기에 승리
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You're doing great! But it's too early to stop. Shine your face more often, impress the audience. Stand out. Become the one they talk about, the one they come to see. Then the cash will come, and then other goodies: cars, girls... Although Tarkov is a little short on the latter. Anyway, the Arena is a great career opportunity right now, ha!

== Objectives ==
Win 2 matches while claiming at least 3rd place in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+4,500 EXP
Ref Rep +0.03
28 GP coins
29 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
32 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Valuables crate (Rare)
Unlocks the Arena item transfer service on Ref for main characters
And now you're one step closer to the big leagues! Respect, brother.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 잘하고 있어요! 하지만 그만두기엔 너무 일찍입니다. 얼굴 좀 더 자주 밝게 하고, 관객들에게 감명을 주세요. 눈에 띄세요. 그들이 말하는 사람이 되고, 그들이 보는 사람이 되세요. 그러면 돈이 올 것이고, 그리고 다른 물건들도 올 것입니다. 자동차, 여자들...

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 4
objectivesKo: 팀 파이트, 블래스트 갱 또는 체크포인트 모드에서 6 경기 중 3 경기에서 승리
실패 조건: 4경기 패
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
How's the mood? Battle-ready? Ready to shine in the Arena once more? Ready to shred some motherfuckers? The crowd is betting on you, so don't let the audience down! Speaking of that. You got some money? You gotta bet on yourself and then win a few times. You'll make tons of cash, and you'll be famous. Bring the money, I'll organize everything. Just be warned: if keep losing too often, you start again.

== Objectives ==
Hand over 1,000,000 Roubles
Win three out of six matches in TeamFight, BlastGang or CheckPoint mode in Arena
Failure condition: Lose 4 matches

== Rewards ==
+5,600 EXP
Ref Rep +0.05
35 GP coins
37 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
40 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
2,500,000 Roubles
2,625,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,875,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Supply crate (Rare)
Here's your paycheck. I deducted all my services from it straight away: bribing opponents, fees, and all that. What, you thought I work for free?

== Failure Dialogue ==
Oh man, you almost did it. Try again, the audience still seems to favor you.

== Guide ==

The 1,000,000 Roubles can be handed over from both the main game and the Arena stash. If 4 out of 6 matches are lost, the quest fails and the Roubles need to be handed over again for a new try.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 기분은 어때요? 전투 준비? 아레나에서 다시 빛나는 준비가 되셨습니까? 몇 명의 새끼들을 쪼개려고 준비하십니까? 군중은 여러분을 상대로 베팅하고 있습니다. 그래서 관객을 실망시키지 마십시오! 그런 말을 할 때. 당신은 돈을 가지고 있습니다. 당신은 자신을 상대로 베팅하고 몇 번 승리해야합니다. 당신은 많은 돈을 벌고 유명해질 것입니다. 돈을 가져와, 나는 모든 것을 정리할 것입니다. 그냥 경고: 너무 자주 잃으면, 당신은 다시 시작됩니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
1,000,000 루블 건네기
팀 파이트, 블래스트 갱 또는 체크포인트 모드에서 6 경기 중 3 경기에서 승리
실패 조건: 4경기 패

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +5,600 EXP 레프 Rep +0,05 35 GP 동전 37 GP 동전 정보 센터 레벨 1 40 GP 동전 정보 센터 레벨 2 2,500,000 루블 2,625,000 루블 레벨 1 2,875,000 루블 레벨 2 1 × 공급 상자 (罕见) 여기 당신의 보급표입니다. 나는 즉시 모든 서비스를 빼 내: 대립자 뇌물, 수수료, 그리고 그 모든.

sectionsKo.title: Failure Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 다시 한번 해봐도 시청자들은 여전히 당신을 선호하는 것 같군

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 1,000,000 루블는 메인 게임과 아레나 스텔에서 모두 전달될 수 있습니다. 6 경기 중 4 개 경기가 패하면 퀘스트가 실패하고 루블는 다시 시도를 위해 다시 전달되어야합니다.

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 5
objectivesKo: 팀 파이팅, 블라스트 갱 또는 아레나에서 체크포인트 모드에서 팀에서 2위 이상으로 승부를 가하는 경기
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I have good news! Excellent news, in fact! I hope you've already picked out a little apartment in Tarkov's elite neighborhood, because you'll have it soon with all this money! Kidding. All the houses in those neighborhoods are soon gonna collapse anyway. Anyway, some very powerful people from across the border are interested in you. Powerful and wealthy. I can't tell you their names, it's a business secret, and I'm not violating what I signed. So, these people are ready to take you under their wing and sponsor you heavily, but first they want guarantees. You need to become the champion. Fly high, soar above the rest. You're gonna have to spend more time in the Arena. I can see it in your eyes that you're ready.

== Objectives ==
Win a match claiming at least 2nd place in the team in TeamFight, BlastGang, or CheckPoint mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+6,900 EXP
Ref Rep +0.04
40 GP coins
42 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
46 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
You're really good. A very famous French man — I won't tell you his name for privacy — is interested in you. Lispy as hell, but he's offering good money. I've already arranged for your sponsorship.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 좋은 소식이 있어요! 정말 좋은 소식이 있어요! 저는 타르코프의 엘리트 이웃에 작은 아파트를 이미 선택했었으면 좋겠습니다. 왜냐하면 이 모든 돈으로 곧 그것을 가질 수 있으니까요! 농담입니다. 그 이웃의 모든 집은 곧 붕괴될 것입니다. 어쨌든, 국경 너머에서 아주 강력한 사람들이 당신을 관심이 있습니다. 강력하고 부유합니다. 그들의 이름을 말할 수 없습니다. 그것은 비즈니스 비밀입니다. 그리고 저는 서명한 것을 위반하지 않습니다. 그래서, 이 사람들은 당신을 그들의 날개 아래로 데려가고, 당신을 강하게 받고 싶어합니다. 하지만 먼저 그들은 보증이 필요합니다. 당신은 챔피언이 되어야 합니다. 높은 비행, 다른 사람들 위에 날아. 당신은 아레나에서 더 많은 시간을 보내야 할 것입니다. 당신은 준비가되어 있다는 것을 당신의 눈으로 볼 수 있습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text: 팀 파이팅, 블라스트 갱 또는 아레나에서 체크포인트 모드에서 팀에서 2위 이상으로 승부를 가하는 경기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +6,900 EXP 레프 Rep +0.04 40 GP 동전 42 GP 동전 정보 센터 레벨 1 46 GP 동전 정보 센터 레벨 2 당신은 정말 좋은. 매우 유명한 프랑스인  사생활을 위해 그의 이름을 말하지 않을  당신을 관심이 있습니다. Lispy는 지옥, 하지만 그는 좋은 돈을 제공하고 있습니다. 나는 이미 당신의 후원자를 위해 준비했습니다.

quests.title: To Great Heights! - Part 6
objectivesKo: 팀 파이트, 블래스트 갱 또는 체크포인트 모드에서 2경기 연속 승리
quests.content:
To Great Heights! - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So, you thought that was it, that you'd reached the top? Think again. Yeah, people are betting on you, but you've got to make sure they don't forget about you. Otherwise they'll wave goodbye and start tossing money at someone else. And we don't want that. I've got a solution for you. People remember victories best — especially a streak of them. Set up a streak like that for yourself, and you can relax after.

== Objectives ==
Win 2 matches in a row in TeamFight, BlastGang or CheckPoint mode in Arena

== Rewards ==
+7,700 EXP
Ref Rep +0.04
55 GP coins
58 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
63 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks barter for APOK Tactical Wasteland Gladius at Ref LL2

quests.content:
To the Light - False Call is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Lightkeeper contacted me again. And for this task, he specifically requested the same person who handled the previous job. Meaning you. Our little trick worked, but that doesn't make the whole situation any clearer. I can only assume that, for some reason, Lightkeeper wants to keep all these jobs secret even from his own people. Could he be looking for a mole among them? Either way, this is our only chance to establish a working relationship, so all we can do is carry out the tasks and avoid asking unnecessary questions. Now, the instructions. Lightkeeper wants you to go to the intersection in the Customs area, discreetly install a camera in the little shop, and then send an RSP signal at the road crossing toward the coast. And yes, the entire area around it needs to be cleared of any potential observers beforehand. Once you've sent the signal, get out of there. Whoever comes to the rendezvous point mustn't see you.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 5 Scavs during 21:00-06:00 on Customs (In one raid)
Eliminate 1 PMC operative during 21:00-06:00 on Customs (In one raid)
Hide a Wi-Fi camera at the AC unit at the convenience store near the bridge on Customs (In one raid)
Launch a yellow signal flare at the Shoreline transit on Customs (In one raid)

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
So, did you notice anything suspicious? No? Alright. Let's sum up what we know. First, we planted a hard drive containing disinformation at the Lab. Then Lightkeeper sent his group after the drive, and now he's used you to call someone out for a meeting. Obviously, he wants to find out who's going to show up at the rendezvous point. And if he doesn't know that yet, then according to the original plan, someone else was supposed to show up for the meeting. Which means the information about how to arrange the meeting belonged to that person, and Lightkeeper stole it from them. Could it have been our potential mole, the one he identified with the help of that disinformation drive? I think the pieces are starting to fall into place.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to do the following in one raid on Customs: Kill 1 PMC and 5 Scavs in the time period of 21:00-06:00, stash a WI-FI Camera at the kiosk near the main bridge and launch a yellow flare at the Shoreline transit.

== Shoreline transit ==
The transit is located behind the roadblock south of the main crossroad. Shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being near the bus. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 라이트키퍼는 다시 연락했습니다. 그리고 이 작업에 대해 그는 특별히 이전 작업을 처리했던 사람과 같은 사람을 요청했습니다. 당신을 의미합니다. 우리의 작은 트릭은 효과가 있었지만, 그것이 전체 상황을 더 명확하게 해주지 않습니다. 나는 어떤 이유로 라이트키퍼이 자신의 사람들로부터도 이 모든 직업을 비밀로 유지하기를 원한다고 가정 할 수 있습니다. 그는 그들 중 돌미를 찾고 있습니까? 어쨌든, 이것은 우리의 유일한 기회입니다. 그래서 우리가 할 수있는 것은 작업을 수행하고 불필요한 질문을 피하는 것입니다. 이제 지침입니다. 라이트키퍼는 당신이 커스텀 지역의 교차로 가서 작은 가게에서 카메라를 차분하게하고, 그리고 RSP 신호를 보내면 해안으로 건너가는 길에 신호를 보내야합니다. 네, 모든 영역을 통해 관찰자가 나올 수있는 신호를 확인하고, 당신은 거기에 도착하면 모든 잠재적인 신호를 확인해야합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +30,000 EXP 그래서 의심스러운 것을 알아냈나요? 아니? 좋아요. 우리가 알고 있는 것을 정리해 봅시다. 먼저 연구소에 잘못된 정보를 담은 하드디스크를 설치했습니다. 라이트키퍼는 드라이브 후 그룹을 보내었고, 이제 그는 당신을 사용하여 누군가를 회의에 초대했습니다. 분명히, 그는 회의점에 누가 나타날지 알고 싶어합니다. 그리고 아직 그것을 알지 못한다면, 원래 계획에 따라 다른 사람이 회의에 참석해야했습니다. 즉 회의를 어떻게 정리해야 하는지에 대한 정보는 그 사람에게서 라이트키퍼는 그것을 훔쳤다는 것입니다. 아마도 그는 그 잘못된 정보 드라이브의 도움으로 식별한 분을 찾을 수 있었습니까?

sectionsKo.text: 이 탐사선에서 당신은 커스텀에 대한 한 번의 습격에서 다음을 수행해야합니다. 21:00-06:00 시간 동안 1 PMC와 5 스캐브을 죽이고, 주요 다리 근처 키오스크에 Wi-Fi 카메라를 숨기고, 쇼어라인 트랜지트에 노란색 플라어를 발사합니다.

To the Light - Getting Acquainted is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Congratulations. Lightkeeper is ready to let you onto the lighthouse and has provided instructions for your visit. The bridge to the lighthouse is heavily mined, and all approaches are monitored by Lightkeeper's personal guards. They won't let you inside unless you're carrying a transponder encoded in a specific way. I've already assembled the transmitter, and I got the access codes from the lighthouse as well. But in its current state, the transponder will transmit a weak and unstable signal with poor encryption. It's too risky. I know how to improve it, and you can do it yourself. You'll need a flash drive containing USEC encryption codes marked "V3". You should be able to find it around the upper chalet near the lighthouse. Be sure to search the house itself, but don't overlook the surrounding area. Keep an eye out for places with equipment, laptops, and radios. Once you've reprogrammed the transponder, everything should work perfectly. But before you head onto the bridge, inspect the transmitter and make sure the indicator light is green. And remember, Lightkeeper has only approved a personal meeting. You'll really have to prove yourself to build a reputation and earn his trust. Good luck.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the V3 Flash drive on Lighthouse
Reflash the Radio transmitter using the V3 Flash drive
Hand over the flash drive
Visit the Lighthouse building

== Rewards ==
+32,000 EXP
You've already met him? How'd it go? So he's just as mysterious and shady in person... Well, I'm still glad we managed to pull this off. Now the important thing is not to make any mistakes when dealing with him, because no one has ever managed to regain his favor after a serious failure.

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks craft for Digital secure DSP radio transmitter at Intelligence Center level 2.

== Guide ==

There are multiple spawns for the V3 flash drive at the black (southern) chalet on Lighthouse. After obtaining it, you have to reflash the transmitter at the Intelligence Center level 2 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted. After the reflashing is done, the transmitter is fully functional and can be used to bypass the Claymores and Zryachiy guarding the bridge to the lighthouse peninsula, allowing you to visit the lighthouse building and meet Lightkeeper.

Note: If not all members of your lobby-made group have an encoded transmitter, it will have the "blocked" state and the bridge can't be passed.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text:
축하합니다. 라이트키퍼는 라이트하우스에 당신을 데려갈 준비가되어 있으며 방문에 대한 지침을 제공했습니다. 라이트하우스의 다리는 많이 채굴되어 있으며, 모든 접근은 라이트키퍼의 개인 경비자가 모니터링합니다. 특정 방식으로 암호화 된 트랜스포더를 가지고 있지 않으면 당신을 안으로 내보내지 않습니다. 전기는 이미 집착했으며, 라이트하우스에서 액세스 코드를 얻었습니다. 그러나 현재 상태에서, 트랜스포더는 약하고 불안정한 신호를 전송합니다. 암호화가 좋지 않습니다. 너무 위험합니다. 그것을 개선하는 방법을 알고, 당신은 그것을 스스로 할 수 있습니다. 당신은 ZXTERM0XVX 코드를 포함하는 플래시 디스크를 필요로합니다. "ZXTERM0XVX"는 집 근처에 있는 레이디오에 표시되어있는 것을 확인해야합니다. 그러나, 당신은 ZXTERM0XVX와 함께 라디오에 대해 검색 할 수 있습니다.
일단 트랜스폰더를 재프로그램하면 모든 것이 완벽하게 작동해야 합니다. 하지만 다리로 가기 전에 송신기를 검사하고 지표 빛이 녹색인지 확인하세요. 그리고 기억하세요, 라이트키퍼는 개인적인 만남만을 승인했습니다.

objectivesKo: 은신처 로 돌아
quests.content:
To the Light - Someone Called? is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Lightkeeper contacted me again. And for this task, he specifically requested the same person who handled the previous job. Meaning you. Our little trick worked, but that doesn't make the whole situation any clearer.I can only assume that, for some reason, Lightkeeper wants to keep all these jobs secret even from his own people. Could he be looking for a mole among them? Either way, this is our only chance to establish a working relationship, so all we can do is carry out the tasks and avoid asking unnecessary questions. Now, the instructions. Lightkeeper wants you to go to the intersection in the Customs area, discreetly install a camera in the little shop, and then send an RSP signal at the road crossing toward the coast. And yes, the entire area around it needs to be cleared of any potential observers beforehand. Once you've sent the signal, get out of there. Whoever comes to the rendezvous point mustn't see you.

== Objectives ==
Return to the Hideout

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× TDI KRISS Vector Gen.2 9x19 submachine gun
3× Glock 9x19 17-round magazine
2× 9x19mm AP 6.3 ammo pack (50 pcs)
3× RSP-30 reactive signal cartridge (Red)
So, did you notice anything suspicious? No? Alright. Let's sum up what we know. First, we planted a hard drive containing disinformation at the Lab. Then Lightkeeper sent his group after the drive, and now he's used you to call someone out for a meeting. Obviously, he wants to find out who's going to show up at the rendezvous point. And if he doesn't know that yet, then according to the original plan, someone else was supposed to show up for the meeting. Which means the information about how to arrange the meeting belonged to that person, and Lightkeeper stole it from them. Could it have been our potential mole, the one he identified with the help of that disinformation drive? I think the pieces are starting to fall into place.

== Guide ==
Returning to the game menu completes the objective.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 라이트키퍼는 다시 연락했습니다. 그리고 이 작업에 대해 그는 특별히 이전 작업을 처리했던 사람과 같은 사람을 요청했습니다. 당신을 의미합니다. 우리의 작은 트릭은 효과가 있었지만, 그것이 전체 상황을 더 명확하게 해주지 않습니다. 나는 라이트키퍼이 어떤 이유로도 자신의 사람들로부터도 이 모든 직업을 비밀로 유지하기를 원한다고 가정 할 수 있습니다. 그는 그들 중 돌미를 찾고 있습니까? 어쨌든, 이것은 우리의 유일한 기회입니다. 그래서 우리가 할 수있는 것은 작업을 수행하고 불필요한 질문을 피하는 것입니다. 이제 지침입니다. 라이트키퍼는 당신이 커스텀 지역의 교차로 가서 작은 가게에서 카메라를 간밀하게하고, 그리고 RSP를 보내면 해안으로 건너가는 길에 신호를 보내야합니다. 그리고 해안으로 가는 길에 신호를 보내십시오. 예, 모든 영역을 통해 관찰자가 나올 수있는 신호를 확인하고, 당신은 그 곳에서 신호를 설치해야 합니다.

sectionsKo.text: +10,000 EXP 300,000 루블 315,000 루블 루블 레벨 1 345,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 1× TDI KRISS 벡터 Gen.2 9x19 소총 3× Glock 9x19 17 라운드 잡지 2× 9x19mm AP 6.3 탄도 배지 (50 PC) 3× RSP-30 반응 신호 카트리지 (붉은) 그래서 의심스러운 것을 알아냈습니까? 아니? 좋습니다. 우리가 알고있는 것을 요약하자. 먼저, 우리는 연구소에 잘못된 정보를 포함 한 단체를 심었습니다. 라이트키퍼는 드라이브 후 자신의 그룹을 보냈습니다. 그리고 이제 그는 당신을 사용하여 누군가와 만남을 위해 사용했습니다. 명백한 것을 발견 할 수 있습니다. 그는 RSP-30 반응 신호 카트리지 (50 PC) 3× RSP-30에 속해있는 것을 발견했을까요? 아니? 좋습니다. 우리가 알고있는 것을 정리하자.

quests.content:
To the Light - Trust but Verify is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
I received a request from the lighthouse. The request itself is rather unusual, though. I still don't understand exactly what he's planning, but I remembered your interest and decided to involve you in carrying out the task. You wanted to get in touch with Lightkeeper, didn't you? He gave me a hard drive containing data that needed some... modifications. The drive now needs to be left at the Lab, in one of the server rooms in the testing area. But there are a couple of important conditions. First: the drive needs to be disguised so that whoever finds it believes it's been sitting in the Lab since the evacuation. Setting up a decoy like that will take longer than usual. And if the deception is discovered, we can't expect any future cooperation from Lightkeeper. Second: activating the Lab's internal systems would arouse suspicion from the group that's supposed to take Lightkeeper's bait. So you'll need a quiet way out, such as a ventilation shaft.

== Requirements ==
Ask Mechanic about the possibility of working with Lightkeeper after learning about the Terminal situation in the Tour story chapter.
Reach Loyalty Level 3 with Therapist, Skier, Peacekeeper, Mechanic, Ragman and Jaeger.

== Objectives ==
Stash the Hard drive with false data in the server room near the weapon testing area in The Lab (In one raid)
(Optional) After that, extract through the Ventilation Shaft
Extract from The Lab through the Ventilation Shaft (In one raid)

== Rewards ==
+35,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× TerraGroup Labs access keycard
Did you disguise the drive well enough? You're sure? Good. Then I'll inform Lightkeeper that everything is done. While you were gone, I had some time to think about this... I could understand if Lightkeeper wanted to plant disinformation on one of his enemies. But if I'm not mistaken, he's going to send his own people after the hard drive. So what was the point of all our work altering the data and disguising the drive? And why involve outsiders like us instead of using his own resources?

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to stash the hard drive provided in your off-raid quest inventory at the servers within the main working area (O11) on the first level of The Lab. It is not lost upon death. Afterwards you have to extract through the "Ventilation Shaft" extraction in the same raid. It can only be used without a backpack equipped.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 등대에서 요청이 들어왔습니다. 내용이 상당히 특이하더군요. 그가 정확히 무슨 계획을 세우는지는 아직 모르겠지만, 당신이 관심을 보였던 게 생각나 이번 일에 참여시키기로 했습니다. 라이트키퍼와 접촉하고 싶다고 했죠? 그가 수정이 필요한 데이터가 담긴 하드 드라이브를 제게 맡겼습니다. 이 드라이브를 실험 구역에 있는 연구소 서버실 중 한 곳에 두고 와야 합니다. 다만 중요한 조건이 두 가지 있습니다. 첫째, 발견한 사람이 대피 전부터 연구소에 있던 물건이라고 믿도록 드라이브를 위장해야 합니다. 미끼를 준비하느라 평소보다 시간이 더 걸릴 겁니다. 속임수가 들통나면 라이트키퍼와 다시 협력하기 어려워질 수 있습니다. 둘째, 연구소 내부 시스템을 작동시키면 라이트키퍼의 미끼를 물 예정인 집단이 의심할 겁니다. 그러니 환기구처럼 조용히 빠져나갈 방법을 찾아야 합니다.

드라이브를 충분히 잘 위장했나요? 확실하죠? 좋습니다. 라이트키퍼에게 모든 일이 끝났다고 알리겠습니다. 당신이 없는 동안 이 일에 대해 생각해봤습니다… 라이트키퍼가 적에게 가짜 정보를 흘리려 한다면 이해할 수 있습니다. 하지만 제 생각이 맞다면, 하드 드라이브를 회수하러 자기 사람들을 보낼 겁니다. 그렇다면 우리가 데이터를 바꾸고 드라이브를 위장한 이유가 뭘까요? 왜 자기 자원을 쓰지 않고 우리 같은 외부인을 끌어들였을까요?

quests.content:
Top Secret is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Now look who we have here. Do you even know what's going on in the city right now? Relax, nobody knows. But you and I are gonna start investigating. First, we gotta find out what air deliveries were made and by whom, things like air deployments before the chaos emerged. Also, that plane that got shot down in the woods is still bugging me. Find me the intel of this kind. I'll hook you up with a general direction so you don't hit a dead end. There was an active radar station at the Lighthouse island. It must have all the intel we need. After that, I'll take the lead. Oh, also, not a word to anyone about this, okay? It's shady stuff, you know what I mean.

== Objectives ==
Locate the radar station commandant's office on Lighthouse
Locate and obtain the military HDD with archived flight routes
Hand over the drive

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.75
1,650 Euros
1,732 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,897 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Golden neck chain
1× Lone Star TX-15 DML 5.56x45 carbine
1× 5.56x45mm M856A1 ammo pack (50 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of Lone Star TX-15 DML 5.56x45 carbine at Skier LL3
Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Magpul MOE Carbine stock (Black) at Skier LL3
Fuck's sake, it's all encrypted. Need to call the four-eyes again. Alright, you've done your part of the deal as agreed. I'll figure something out what to do with this crap.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a HDD which can be found in the radar station commandant's office on Lighthouse. A Radar station commandant room key is needed to enter it. The radar station is located at the lighthouse peninsula territory. The commandant's office is located on the first floor, recognizable by a red sign. The HDD is located on a desk in the back of the room. Note: The bridge that leads to the peninsula is guarded by Zryachiy and full of Claymores. To safely pass the bridge, an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter is required.

quests.content:
Trouble in the Big City is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
So much for Primorsky Avenue. What other secrets does this city hold? It turns out that these wretches have decided to make an attempt on my humble person because I could get my hands on the cargo which was carried by this very convoy. The simple-minded snakes don't even realize that they're the ones who led me to this cargo with their own hands. Did they really think they could scare me with some cheap blackmail? Me?! All right, listen to me, your job is to secure the area around the intersection and mark the location of the cargo with a beacon. My men will do the rest.

== Objectives ==
Locate the armored convoy holding the cargo on Streets of Tarkov
(Optional) Bring an MS2000 Marker Marker into raid
(Optional) Bring a yellow signal flare into raid
Eliminate 10 PMC operatives on Streets of Tarkov
Locate and neutralize any Boss or their guards for 20 kills total on Streets of Tarkov
Mark the cargo area with an MS2000 Marker
Launch a yellow flare near the armored convoy

== Rewards ==
Lightkeeper Rep +0.05
1× Advanced current converter
1× Substation marked key
Unlocks purchase of SIG MCX-SPEAR 6.8x51 assault rifle at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of AR-10 7.62x51 Lancer L7AWM 25-round magazine at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks purchase of 6.8x51mm SIG Hybrid at Peacekeeper LL4
Unlocks barter for Advanced current converter at Mechanic LL4
The positions for Zryachy that you recently prepared have come in handy. He successfully eliminated several conspirators. Now, after you've cleaned up the area and marked the cargo, it's just a matter of opening the secured door and finding out what was it that they were transporting that was so valuable. Judging by the people involved in this conspiracy, there may be something in there that could blow the heads off not only of the corporation, but of some very high-ranking people as well. Looks like we're in for some great business, mercenary. Keep in touch.

== Guide ==

When placed, the item is removed from the players' inventory.

In this quest you first have to locate the armored convoy and kill 10 PMCs on Streets of Tarkov. Next you have to kill any bosses or their guards for 20 kills total on Streets of Tarkov. Afterwards you have to place a MS2000 Marker at the grate door inside the cargo truck trailer from the convoy. Finally you have to shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being in the convoy area. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구는 먼저 장갑 운반을 찾아 타르코프 시내에서 10명의 PMC를 죽여야 합니다. 다음으로 타르코프 시내에서 총 20명의 사살을 위해 모든 상사나 경호자를 죽여야 합니다. 이후에는 용인차 트레일러의 내면  grate 문에 MS2000 마커를 배치해야 합니다. 마지막으로, 당신은 랩터 지역에서있을 때 하늘로 노란색 플라어를 발사해야 합니다. 플라어가 특정 높이에 도달하지 않으면 탐구는 완료되지 않습니다. 당신은 프라포르 LL1에서 구입할 수 있는 손잡이 RSP-30 노란색 플라어를 사용하거나 26x75mm 랩터리 카트리지를 사용해야 합니다. 포스터마켓 랩터리 ZXTERM05Z1에 발사 할 수 있습니다. 그리고 마켓 랩터리 지표와 함께 마켓 랩터리 30에 도착합니다. 그러나 당신은 너무 많은 랩터리 표시를 가지고, 랩터리 30에 도착합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Trivia
sectionsKo.text: 필요하다면 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 MS2000 마커를 구입할 수 있습니다. 플레이어는 MS2000 마커를 특수 슬롯 또는 가방에 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 따라서 사망의 경우 손실되지 않습니다. MS2000 마커는 필요하면 자동으로 플레이어의 인벤토리에서 사용됩니다. 키가 작동하는 것과 비슷합니다.

quests.title: Unanswered Calls
objectivesKo: 테라피스트의 편지를 그라운드 제로의 테라그룹 사무실의 2층의 수신기에서 보관하십시오 (하나의 압수수색)
나카타니 지하 계단 또는 에머콤 체크포인트에서 추출 (하나의 습격)
quests.content:
Unanswered Calls is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Young man. I'm sure you have heard that a team of specialists from an unknown PMC has begun operating in Tarkov. According to my information, they aren't affiliated with any of the local factions, which makes them potentially useful. I would like to establish contact with them regarding a certain matter. I cannot disclose the details, and I won't ask you to negotiate. All I need is for you to deliver a letter containing my proposal. Leave the letter at the reception desk on the second floor of the TerraGroup headquarters. Try not to attract any attention. Under no circumstances should you use any signal flares or cross paths with Skier's driver! Your best option is to leave through the underground passage beneath the nearby high-rise or via the former Emercom checkpoint. And naturally, the contents of the letter are confidential. I will know if you try to open it.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Stash Therapist's letter at the reception desk on the second floor of the TerraGroup office on Ground Zero (in one raid)
Extract from the location through the Nakatani Basement Stairs or Emercom Checkpoint exfil (in one raid)

== Rewards ==
+11,000 EXP
180,000 Roubles
189,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
207,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Grizzly medical kit
3× CMS surgical kit
You left the letter in the right place, correct? No one has contacted me yet... But that is no longer your concern. Here is your reward.

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you first have to stash a letter behind the reception desk on the second floor of the TerraGroup main building on Ground Zero. Afterwards you have to extract through the "Emercom Checkpoint" or "Nakatani Basement Stairs" extraction. Both objectives have to be completed in the same raid.

TerraGroup building location marked on map
The TerraGroup building complex
Stashing location behind the reception desk on the second floor

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 젊은 사람. 나는 당신이 모르는 PMC의 전문가 팀이 타르코프에서 활동하기 시작했다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 내 정보에 따르면, 그들은 지역 단파와 관련이 없으며, 이는 그들을 잠재적으로 유용하게 만듭니다. 나는 특정 문제에 대해 그들과 연락을 취하고 싶습니다. 나는 세부 사항을 공개 할 수 없으며 협상하지 않을 것입니다. 내가 필요로하는 것은 당신이 내 제안을 포함하는 편지를 전달하는 것입니다. 편지를 테라그룹 본부 2층의 수신 책상에서 남겨두고 있습니다. 관심을 끌지 않도록 노력하십시오. 어떤 상황에서도 스키어의 신호와 어떤 화사나 경로를 교차해서는 안됩니다. 당신의 옵션은 높은 층 아래 또는 전적 체크포인트를 통해 가까운 지하에서 출발하는 것입니다. 그리고 나는 자연스럽게 편지를 공개합니다. 당신이 그것을 알고 있다면, 나는 편지를 공개합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: 시즌 모드로 플레이 중이어야 합니다.

sectionsKo.text:
테라피스트의 편지를 그라운드 제로의 테라그룹 사무실의 2층의 수신기에서 보관하십시오 (하나의 압수수색)
나카타니 지하 계단 또는 에머콤 체크포인트에서 추출 (하나의 습격)

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +11000 EXP 180,000 루블 189,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 207,000 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 2 × Grizzly 의료 키트 3 × CMS 수술 키트 당신은 올바른 장소에 편지를 남겼습니다, 맞습니까? 아무도 아직 연락하지 않았습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 먼저 테라그룹의 2층 주 건물의 수신기 뒤에 편지를 숨기야 합니다. 그 후 "Emercom 체크포인트" 또는 "Nakatani 베들먼트 계단"을 통해 추출해야 합니다. 두 가지 목표는 같은 탐사에서 완료되어야 합니다. 테라그룹 건물 위치 지도에 표시됩니다.

objectivesKo: 군용 장비가 든 케이스 찾기 및 확보하기
(선택) 쇼어라인 소르디 타워 옆 오두막 조사하기
(선택) 쇼어라인 기상 관측소 건물 2층 조사하기

quests.content:
Uninvited Guests - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Ah, it's you. Good to see you're still alive... Someone's been taking out my men, whole squads at a time, you get me? They just drop off the grid. And nobody's made any demands! I'll find the bastards responsible, no doubt about that. But right now I've got business that can't wait. Can you help me out? The most urgen thing is a piece of technical equipment I was supposed to get from the coast to a client up north. The plan was for my boys to pick it up from a contact at the port and hand it off to the BTR driver. But we've heard nothing from them! Can you look for my men, or at least the package? I figure they were hit somewhere along the shore, so that's where you should start looking.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.
Reach 0.2 reputation with Prapor.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the case with military equipment
(Optional) Investigate the shack next to the sordi tower on Shoreline
(Optional) Investigate the second floor of the weather station building on Shoreline
(Optional) Investigate the hydroelectric power station on Shoreline
Bring the case with military equipment to the BTR Driver

== Rewards ==
+6,000 EXP
18,000 Roubles
18,900 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
20,700 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× RPK-16 5.45x39 light machine gun
3× AK-74 5.45x39 6L23 30-round magazine
1× 5.45x39mm PP gs ammo pack (120 pcs)
Thanks for finishing the job. The client had been waiting on that equipment. Now we can move on to the second part of this mess and find whoever's hunting my boys.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to obtain a case with military equipment on Shoreline

Location of the case spawns on the map.

The case is located at one of the 3 locations.

The case inside the sordi tower bunkhouse
The case on the second floor of the weather station in a corner next to drawers
The case inside the hydroelectric power station next to HEP station storage room key door

After picking up the case, it will be placed in your quest items inventory. You must successfully extract with the case to hand it in. If you die before reaching the BTR Driver, you will have to retrieve it again. Hand the case over to the BTR Driver in Uninvited Guests - Part 2 to complete the quest.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 아, 당신이군. 아직 살아 있어서 다행이야… 누군가 내 부하들을 한 번에 한 분대씩 없애고 있어. 갑자기 자취를 감춘다고. 요구 조건을 내건 것도 아니야! 범인은 반드시 찾아내겠어. 하지만 지금은 급한 일이 있어. 도와줄 수 있나? 가장 급한 건 해안에서 북쪽의 의뢰인에게 보내기로 한 장비야. 부하들이 항구에서 연락책을 만나 물건을 받아 BTR 운전기사에게 넘기기로 했는데, 아무 소식이 없어! 부하들을 찾아봐 줄래? 아니면 적어도 물건이라도 찾아줘. 해안 어딘가에서 습격당했을 테니 그 근처부터 살펴봐.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text:
시즌 모드로 플레이 중이어야 합니다.
프라포르 평판 0.2 이상을 달성해야 합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:

(선택) 쇼어라인 소르디 타워 옆 오두막 조사하기

(선택) 쇼어라인 수력 발전소 조사하기
군용 장비가 든 케이스를 BTR 운전기사에게 가져가기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text:
+6,000 경험치
18,000 루블
정보 센터 1레벨일 때 18,900 루블
정보 센터 2레벨일 때 20,700 루블
RPK-16 5.45×39 경기관총 1정
AK-74 5.45×39 6L23 30발 탄창 3개
5.45×39mm PP gs 탄약 묶음(120발) 1개

일을 마쳐줘서 고맙네. 의뢰인은 그 장비를 기다리고 있었어. 이제 이 일의 두 번째 단계로 넘어가 내 부하들을 쫓는 놈들이 누군지 알아낼 수 있겠군.

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text:
쇼어라인에서 군용 장비 케이스를 확보해야 합니다.

지도에 표시된 케이스 생성 위치
케이스는 다음 세 장소 중 한 곳에서 생성됩니다.
소르디 타워 숙소 안의 케이스
기상 관측소 2층 서랍장 옆 구석에 있는 케이스
HEP 변전소 보관실 열쇠가 필요한 문 옆, 수력 발전소 내부의 케이스

케이스를 집으면 퀘스트 아이템 인벤토리에 들어갑니다. 전달하려면 케이스를 가진 채 생존 탈출해야 합니다. BTR 운전기사에게 도착하기 전에 사망하면 다시 찾아야 합니다. 퀘스트를 완료하려면 ‘불청객 - 파트 2’에서 케이스를 BTR 운전기사에게 건네세요.

== Dialogue ==
Prapor already filled you in. Heard plenty of gunfire coming from the shore, so I wouldn't count on his guys making it out. I'm waiting on you with that crate. It's an important delivery!

+5,000 EXP
Thanks for the help. If it weren't for you, I'd still be trying to patch things up with the client...

In this quest you have to obtain and hand over to the BTR Driver a case with military equipment found on Shoreline.

Location of the cases marked on map.

The case is located at one of the 3 locations.

The case inside the sordi tower bunkhouse
The case on the second floor of the weather station
The case inside the hydroelectric power station

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 프라포르가 이미 당신을 채웠어요. 해변에서 총이 많이 발사되었어요. 그래서 그의 사람들이 탈출할 수 있을 거라고는 생각하지 않을 겁니다.

sectionsKo.title: Requirements
sectionsKo.text: 시즌 모드로 플레이 중이어야 합니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 BTR 운전기사에 발견된 군사 장비의 케이스를 획득하고 쇼어라인에 넘겨야 합니다. 지도에 표시된 케이스의 위치. 케이스는 3 개의 위치 중 하나에 위치하고 있습니다.

quests.title: Unique Experience
objectivesKo: 라이트하우스 또는 연구소에 있는 Aklys 방어 펠로시라포터로 30개의 목표물을 제거하십시오.
quests.content:
Unique Experience is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Soldier! I've got a new job that's right up your alley.I've come across something interesting. A new piece of weaponry. Nobody in Tarkov has seen anything like it before! How'd I get it? Trade secret.But I'll tell you this: the weapon definitely has potential. Still, you know as well as I do that all those specs and proving-ground reports don't mean shit until the thing gets tested in the field.So if you're interested in getting your hands on a truly unique weapon, we can help each other out. We'll sort out the payment. I won't leave you hanging.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate any 30 targets with an Aklys Defense Velociraptor on Lighthouse or The Lab

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
+4 Light Machine Guns skill levels
+4 Heavy Machine Guns skill levels
Prapor Rep +1.5
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle
1× 5.45x39mm BP gs ammo pack (120 pcs)
Unlocks barter for Kalashnikov AK-12 5.45x39 assault rifle at Prapor LL4
Unlocks craft for 5.45x39mm BP gs at Workbench level 3
So, it's good, you say? Well then, maybe I can raise the price a little, what do you think?

== Initial Equipment ==
Unlocks barter for .300 Blackout CBJ ammo pack (50 pcs) at Mechanic LL3.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 군인! 당신 거리에 새로운 직업이 있습니다. 흥미로운 것을 발견했습니다. 새로운 무기를 발견했습니다. 타르코프에 아무도 전에 그런 것을 본 적이 없습니다. 어떻게 얻었습니까? 상용 비밀. 하지만 제가 여러분에게 이렇게 말씀드리겠습니다. 무기는 확실히 잠재력을 가지고 있습니다. 그럼에도 불구하고, 당신은 그 모든 스펙과 증거지 보고서는 현장에서 테스트 될 때까지 아무것도 의미하지 않습니다. 그래서 당신이 정말로 독특한 무기를 손에 넣고 싶다면, 우리는 서로를 도울 수 있습니다. 우리는 지불을 정립 할 것입니다. 나는 당신을 매달려 두지 않을 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives

quests.content:
Urban Medicine is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Greetings, mercenary. The hospital continues to receive more intoxicated patients. Each day there are more and more of them, and that worries me. It feels like if you destroy one drug den, two new ones appear. We should go another route, try to cure those who are already addicted. In order to do that, I need a sample of the drug for analysis.

== Objectives ==
Locate the chemical laboratory on Streets of Tarkov
Obtain the container with drug samples
Hand over the container

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Therapist Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Thank you for a job well done. Take your reward over there.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find the chemical laboratory and a sample container on Streets of Tarkov. The laboratory can be found inside a garage at the LexOs car workshop. There are multiple container spawns throughout the garage.

Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with Claymores.

quests.content:
Vacate the Premises is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
That whole health resort thing went massive, didn't it? Thing is, as I told you, I had business there with Ref, in those cellars. I used to think Ref took all the equipment outta there, but now it turns out there's still tons of tech still down there. So I figured, what's the harm in taking some of it? Nah, you don't have to bring me those TVs and cameras, don't worry. Those need careful inspection and good packing. I got my own people for that. But I can't just send them out there right now! They're good with tech, but they're dogshit with guns. If a real professional, wink-wink, would make it down there and chase all the other mercs out of there, then we'd be in business. So just when I thought of that, I remembered you, brother! You ready to help with a good cause? Obviously, if you do the job properly, I'll give you some goodies in return!

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 24 PMC operatives inside The Labyrinth
Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate any 36 targets in The Labyrinth instead.

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
275,000 Roubles
288,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
316,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
3× Atomic Defense CQCM ballistic mask (Black)
1× Last Breath poster
Good thing I asked you to do this. Alrighty then, I'll pass it on to my guys. If we're lucky, we'll be swimming in tech sales for a long time. Here's your share, Ragman always rewards good deeds!

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to kill 24 PMСs in The Labyrinth.

Note: The objective in the PvE mode is to eliminate any 36 targets in The Labyrinth instead.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 이 건강 휴양지 일 전체가 엄청나게 됐죠? 제가 말했듯이, 저 곳에는 레프와 협업을 했습니다. 그 기저장들에서요. 전 레프가 모든 장비를 가져갔다고 생각했었는데, 지금은 여전히 수많은 기술이 남아있다는 것을 알았습니다. 그래서 저는, 그 중 일부를 가져가는 데 무슨 해가 있을까요? 아니, 걱정 마세요. 그 TV와 카메라를 가져오지 않아도 됩니다. 조심스럽게 검사하고 잘 포장해야 합니다. 저는 제 사람들을 가지고 있습니다. 하지만 지금 당장 그들을 보내지 않을 수 없습니다. 그들은 기술에 잘 알고 있지만, 총에 잘 어울리는 개똥입니다. 진짜 전문가가 눈을 깜빡하면, 거기에 내려가서 다른 모든 매커를 쫓아낼 수 있다면, 우리는 다시 생각됩니다. 그래서 우리가 사업에 잘 할 때, 나는 당신이 좋은 일을 할 수 있도록 준비되어있는 것을 기억합니다.

참고: PvE 모드에서 목표는 미궁의 36개의 타겟을 제거하는 것입니다.

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +28만 EXP 27만 루블 28만750 루블 정보 센터 레벨 1 316,250 루블 정보 센터 레벨 2 3× 핵 방어 CQCM 탄도 마스크 (검은) 1× 마지막 호흡 포스터 좋은 일이에요. 잘 됐어요, 그럼, 내가 그것을 제 친구들에게 전달할 것입니다. 우리가 운이 좋다면, 우리는 오랫동안 기술 판매에 수영 할 것입니다. 여기 당신의 몫이 있습니다. 레그맨는 항상 좋은 일을 보상합니다!

quests.content:
Viewer is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, soldier. I've met some rookies recently, here in Tarkov. They say people don't watch everything on tape anymore, they watch it live! Programs, stories, and some even show their everyday life non-stop. They even said a bunch of civilians are watching Tarkov's activities live! It seems that the whole world is interested in our city! I don't understand how they organized the broadcast to the outside world, but I wouldn't mind a second pair of eyes. It's a simple task - organize surveillance in some spots, and I'll return the favor.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

== Objectives ==
Install a WI-FI Camera on the mountain ledge on Woods
Install a WI-FI Camera at the pier tower on Shoreline
Install a WI-FI Camera at the office corridor on Factory

== Rewards ==
+65,000 EXP
400,000 Roubles
420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× Bottle of Pevko Light beer
5× Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka
I think I'm beginning to understand why people watch these "live streams". It's addictive!

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to place 1 WI-FI Camera each on Woods, Shoreline and Factory.

On Woods it has to be placed at a rock ledge with a tree on the mountain.

Location marked on map
Placement location surroundings
Placement location

On Shoreline it has to be placed at the top of the lighthouse near the pier.

Lighthouse location marked on map
The lighthouse

On Factory it has to be placed at the top of the office area stairs that are on the "Gate 3" extraction side, on the wall next to a broken chair. Note: Can not be completed at night at the current time.

Placement location

== Trivia ==
The quest dialogue and success message are referencing the rapidly increasing popularity of the game on the streaming platform Twitch, likely directly relating to the first "Drops" campaign, which was available from December 30, 2019 till January 5, 2020.

quests.content:
Vitamins is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Alright, you're here at the right time. Got a sixth sense or something? Never mind, listen up. Word on the street is there's some new merchandise making the rounds. Some weird stuff in these fancy-looking chemical containers. Looks a bit like your gun suppressor, just bigger. No clue what's inside: some new narcotic, or bloody vitamin B or something. That's what we need to find out. The containers showed up at the Factory. Get them for me. I've already got a couple of eggheads lined up to examine them. Oh, and one more thing: they asked me to throw in a few respirators and some blood transfusion kits.

== Requirements ==
This quest is only obtainable by BEAR PMCs.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the chemical container on Factory
Hand over the container
Find 4 Respirators in raid
Hand over 4 Respirators to Skier
Find 3 Medical bloodsets in raid
Hand over 3 Medical bloodsets to Skier

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.25
1,000 Euros
1,050 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,150 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
Oh, you actually brought them? Nice one! Hands still attached after all that chemical nonsense? Good. I'll get the eggheads on it and see what they can dig up.

The chemical container can be found on the second floor of the laboratory on Factory.

항목 건네기
quests.content:
War Never Changes is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, mercenary. In field conditions it is extremely important to anticipate any potential hazards in advance. Once a patient is already on the operating table, you can only work with whatever is available at hand. That is why I would like you to bring me high-dose potassium iodide tablets. Yes, these are used in cases of severe radiation exposure. And no, we have not recorded any leaks recently. I must ask you not to spread information about this order. You do not realize how severely panic among the population can complicate the work of my department. I am simply preparing for any incidents that may occur in the future. The issue is that in Tarkov itself we have never found this dosage. Such preparations are typically stored at nuclear facilities, as they are only relevant there. I hope your search proves more successful than that of my staff.

== Requirements ==
Hand over the hard drives from compartment C-1 on Icebreaker to Mechanic in the Boreas story chapter.

== Objectives ==
Find 10 Nooby Shield potassium iodide tablets in raid
Hand over the items

== Rewards ==
+27,000 EXP
250,000 Roubles
262,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
287,500 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× Trimadol stimulant injector
2× Surv12 field surgical kit
Where did you manage to obtain so many? I was not even expecting five packs… The Icebreaker? Such a find could be extremely important for supporting our work. I need to check something in the department, and then I will return to you with a new task. We cannot afford to miss an opportunity of this value.

== Guide ==

To complete this quest you need to gather 10 Nooby Shield potassium iodide tablets found in raid on Icebreaker. There are two guaranteed spawns on location on level 1 located in the middle of the infirmary. They can also be found in loose medical spawn locations or in Sports bags on the map.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 용병. 현장 조건에서 잠재적 인 위험을 미리 예측하는 것이 매우 중요합니다. 환자가 이미 수술 테이블에있을 때, 당신은 손에있는 모든 것을 사용할 수 있습니다. 그래서 나는 당신이 나에게 높은 양의 칼륨 요오다이드 태블릿을 가져오기를 바랍니다. 예, 이러한 경우 심각한 방사능 노출에 사용됩니다. 그리고 아니, 우리는 최근 누출을 기록하지 않았습니다. 나는 당신에게 이 명령에 대한 정보를 퍼뜨리지 않도록 요청해야합니다. 당신은 얼마나 심각한 공포에 대해 인구가 내 부서 작업을 복잡하게 만들 수 있는지 깨닫지 않습니다. 나는 단순히 미래에 발생할 수있는 모든 사건에 대비하고 있습니다. 문제는 Tarkov 자체에서 우리는 이 복용량을 발견하지 않았다는 것입니다. 그러한 준비는 일반적으로 핵 시설에 저장됩니다. 그들은 단지 관련한 검색을 증명하는 것으로 나타납니다. 나는 당신의 직원보다 더 성공적 인 것을 희망합니다.

sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구를 완료하려면 아이스 브레이커에 대한 공격에서 발견된 10개의 노비 쉴드 칼륨 요오다이드 태블릿을 수집해야 합니다. 병원을 중심에 위치한 레벨 1에 두 개의 보증 스파운이 있습니다. 그들은 또한 느슨한 의료 스파운 장소 또는 지도에 있는 스포츠 가방에서 찾을 수 있습니다.

quests.content:
Watching You is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Friend, there is another task, an unusual one. One of my clients was living in the area of the hotel when the events began. And he had reason to believe he was being watched. He saw a couple of leaked photos from the hotel courtyard. We need to find the room where the rat is sitting. Most likely, you'll find something if you look for tech: cameras, bugs... Anything you find, give it to me. It'll come in handy.

== Objectives ==
Locate the surveillance spot on Streets of Tarkov
Obtain the observation results
Hand over the data

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Mechanic Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Yeah, I don't usually do this kind of thing, but this customer orders lots of weapons from me, so I didn't want to lose him... Thanks, friend.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a surveillance spot and obtain a flash drive on Streets of Tarkov. It can be found in room 215 on the second floor of the northern Pinewood hotel building. A Pinewood hotel room 215 key is required to enter it. The flash drive has multiple spawns throughout the room.

quests.content:
Weapons Circulation is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Recently, my men came across some strange occult symbols. After conducting a small investigation, we discovered that this cult is sacrificing weapons to their own deities. You know, in Tarkov, weapons are almost as valuable as oil. My people are currently occupied with other assignments. Can you locate these cultist circles and mark them for us?

== Objectives ==
Locate and mark the first ritual spot with an MS2000 Marker on Woods
Locate and mark the second ritual spot with an MS2000 Marker on Woods
Locate and mark the ritual spot with an MS2000 Marker on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Military flash drive
Unlocks purchase of HK 416A5 5.56x45 assault rifle at Peacekeeper LL3
Great. Now we know more and will be able to better monitor the flow of weapons.

== Guide ==

== Woods ==
One can be found in the woods west of the sawmill near the checkpoint. This spot can easily be located when you go to the checkpoint, stay at the barrier and line your view up with a big stone south of it. See pictures below.

Location marked on map (bottom)
View from the checkpoint towards the ritual spot
View from the ritual spot towards the checkpoint
The marked circle
The other one is located at the dilapidated village in the north. The circle itself is north of the church in the backyard of a house.

Location marked on map (top)
The second ritual spot in the dilapidated village

== Shoreline ==
Located in the pig room (East wing room 321) on the third floor of the health resort on Shoreline. Like on Customs, the room is easily identified by candles and numerous markings on the door. Inside the room are multiple slaughtered pigs and a Dead Scav with a pig's head. The spot to plant the MS2000 Marker surrounds the bathtub with the Dead Scav.

Health resort east wing location marked on map
Room location marked on east wing map
The ritual spot where the marker needs to be placed

== Trivia ==
You can buy MS2000 Markers from Prapor or Ragman if needed.
It is recommended that the player keeps the MS2000 Markers in their special slots or pouch so they are not lost in the event of their death.
The MS2000 Markers will automatically be used out of the players' inventory when needed, similar to how keys work

quests.content:
Wet Job - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, good to see you! It is good to see you are still alive, haha. As you can see, my men and I have established the strongest presence on the coast. This is also where we communicate with our partners and buyers. We have managed to use the local meteorological equipment to transmit signals. However, scavengers, and not only them, keep trying to damage or destroy our antennas. We regularly deal with communication issues, and we even had to install surveillance cameras. But, as we know, vandals only understand force. Make it clear that the weather station and the entire shore are not places where people can damage our property without consequences. Show them exactly who they are interfering with. Use Blue Helmet equipment.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 10 Scavs with an M4A1, M16, ADAR, or TX-15 on Shoreline

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
1,100 Dollars

1× 5.7x28mm L191 ammo pack (50 pcs)
Unlocks purchase of FN Five-seveN MK2 5.7x28 pistol (FDE) at Peacekeeper LL2
Scav raids have stopped almost completely. It seems they finally understood the situation.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 당신을 보고 좋네요. 당신이 아직 살아있다는 것을 보고 좋네요. 하하. 당신이 볼 수 있듯이, 내 사람들과 나는 해안에서 가장 강한 존재감을 확립했습니다. 이것은 우리가 파트너와 구매자들과 소통하는 곳이기도 합니다. 우리는 신호를 전송하기 위해 지역 기상 장비들을 사용했습니다. 그러나, 배수꾼들뿐만 아니라 그들은 우리의 안테나를 손상시키거나 파괴하려고 계속합니다. 우리는 정기적으로 통신 문제를 다루고 감시 카메라를 설치해야합니다. 그러나, 우리가 알고있는 것처럼, 달은 힘만을 이해합니다. 날씨역과 해안 전체는 사람들이 우리의 재산을 결과를없이 손상시킬 수있는 장소가 아니라는 것을 분명히하십시오. 그들이 누가 개입하는지 정확하게 보여주십시오. 블루 헬멧 장비를 사용하십시오.

sectionsKo.text: 필요하다면 프라포르 또는 레그맨에서 MS2000 마커를 구입할 수 있습니다. 플레이어는 MS2000 마커를 특수 슬롯 또는 가방에 보관하는 것이 좋습니다. 따라서 사망의 경우 손실되지 않습니다. MS2000 마커는 필요하면 자동으로 플레이어의 인벤토리에서 사용됩니다. 키가 작동하는 것과 비슷합니다.

quests.title: Wet Job - Part 3
objectivesKo: 아티오મના 차 쇼어라인 찾기
마크 아티오름의 차 MS2000 마커
quests.content:
Wet Job - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
My partners are very interested in our new venture. The Blue Helmets inspected the location you mentioned and discovered that some kind of fisherman lived there. It appears he has been dead for quite some time, and the people with the cameras were his friends. We know he was acquainted with someone named Artyom, who was often seen driving a yellow sedan. Their shared activities were somehow connected to the Russian military. Now you understand why this could be interesting? Most likely, Artyom's vehicle is still somewhere on the road along the shore. Search for it based on the description and mark it. The Blue Helmets will immediately search the area. This way, we can find out who Artyom really is.

== Objectives ==
Locate Artyom's car on Shoreline
Mark Artyom's car with MS2000 Marker

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1,900 Dollars
1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× NcSTAR ADO P4 Sniper 3-9x42 riflescope
2× .300 Blackout M62 Tracer ammo pack (50 pcs)
Unlocks craft for .300 Blackout M62 Tracer at Workbench level 2
So, the vehicle was intact? No signs of an attack, correct? We'll investigate further. I believe there is still much more to discover.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to find Artyom's car on Shoreline. The car is yellow and located on the main road along the shore. It can be found next to a yellow bus and a police car.

Car location marked on map
The wanted car

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 제 파트너들은 우리의 새로운 사업에 매우 관심이 있습니다. 블루 헬멧은 당신이 언급한 장소를 검사하고 어떤 종류의 어부가 그곳에서 살았다는 것을 발견했습니다. 그는 꽤 오랫동안 죽은 것으로 보입니다. 카메라를 가진 사람들은 그의 친구였습니다. 우리는 그가 아티오姆라는 사람을 알고 있었다는 것을 알고 있습니다. 그는 자주 노란색 세단을 운전하는 것으로 보였습니다. 그들의 공동 활동은 어떻게든 러시아 군과 관련이있었습니다. 이제 이것이 왜 흥미있을 수 있는지 이해합니다. 가장 가능성이있는 것은 아티오ムの 차량은 여전히 해변가에 따라 어딘가에 있습니다. 설명에 따라 검색하고 표시합니다. 블루 헬멧은 즉시 지역을 검색합니다. 이렇게, 우리는 아르티오ムの 진짜 누구인지 알 수 있습니다.

sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 당신은 쇼어라인에서 Artyom의 차를 찾아야 합니다. 차는 노란색이고 해안에있는 주요 도로에 위치하고 있습니다. 그것은 노란색 버스와 경찰 차 옆에 찾을 수 있습니다. 차 위치 지도에 표시 됩니다

quests.title: Wet Job - Part 4
objectivesKo: 쇼어라인에 있는 리조트의 임차자 목록 찾아 확보하기
이 항목 건네기
quests.content:
Wet Job - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
We have run this Artyom through our database. It seems he lived in the health resort after the conflict and may have been connected to TerraGroup, but it is unconfirmed, no precise info yet. The nature of their joint operation with the fisherman is also not completely clear, but, considering how secretive their meetings were, I'm pretty sure it's some kind of military tech. We need to find where exactly Artyom’s quarters were, the info could be in the list of Health Resort tenants, which has to be in the administration office, if it is still intact, of course. Find those documents and bring them to me.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the list of the resort's tenants on Shoreline
Hand over the item

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
1,900 Dollars
1,995 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
2,185 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
5× 7.62x51mm M80A1 ammo pack (20 pcs)
5× M67 hand grenade
Unlocks craft for 7.62x51mm M80A1 at Workbench level 3
The documents are intact? Good work, my friend. We will check the data for the information we need. Your reward.

== Guide ==

The flash drive with the information can be found in the administration part (theatre wing) of the resort, on a desk in an office on the eastern side on the top floor.

Map showing the location of the office
The office (middle room)
The desk where the flash drive is located
The flash drive

sectionsKo.text: 우리는 이 아티움을 데이터베이스에서 실행했습니다. 그는 분쟁 후 건강 리조트에서 살았고 테라그룹에 연결되었을 수도 있지만 확인되지 않았으며 아직 정확한 정보가 없습니다. 어업자와의 공동 운영의 성격도 완전히 명확하지 않습니다. 그러나 그들의 만남이 얼마나 비밀이었는지 고려하면, 나는 일종의 군사 기술이라고 확신합니다. 우리는 정확히 아티움의 방이 어디에 있는지 찾아야합니다. 정보는 건강 리조트 임대자의 목록에있을 수 있습니다.

A job well done gets well rewarded. From the documents we've learned that Artyom lived in room 328. I presume, he worked there as well. Find a way to get into his room and if there’s anything left of his records, bring it to me. I'm waiting to hear from you, mercenary.

objectivesKo: 쇼어라인 또는 라이트하우스에서 50m 이상에서 7.62x51 DMR를 가진 15개의 목표를 제거하십시오.
quests.content:
Wet Job - Part 6 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, my dear friend. It seems we really are close to an interesting deal. On the drive, we found part of the blueprints for a submarine missile engine from the Akula class, which supposedly is no longer being produced. There was also a detailed dossier on a sailor who served in the Baltic Fleet. He is currently somewhere in Tarkov and has connections to the naval command. According to the data, he occasionally trades with Scavs. We cannot approach him directly. We will have to operate covertly, from an ambush position. We only have one opportunity. It is important not to make a mistake and lose such a chance. You cannot imagine how important this is. You are an excellent fighter, but I want to be certain that you are equally capable in stealth operations. I need a sniper, and a sufficiently experienced one. Prove your skills.

== Objectives ==
Eliminate 15 targets with any 7.62x51 DMR from over 50 meters away on Shoreline or Lighthouse

== Rewards ==
+28,000 EXP
2,750 Dollars
2,888 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
3,162 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× FN40GL Mk2 40mm grenade launcher
6× 40x46mm M386 (HE) grenade
1× Lobaev Arms DVL-10 7.62x51 bolt-action sniper rifle (variant Saboteur)
3× 7.62x51mm M61 ammo pack (20 pcs)
Unlocks barter for FN40GL Mk2 40mm grenade launcher at Peacekeeper LL4
With all due respect, I did not expect you to be this advanced in this field, my friend. I will contact you when your services are required.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 내 사랑하는 친구. 우리는 정말 흥미로운 거래에 가깝다고 보입니다. 드라이브에서 우리는 Akula 클래스의 잠수함 미사일 엔진의 플루프라인의 일부를 발견했습니다. 더 이상 생산되지 않는 것으로 추정됩니다. 또한 발트 해군에서 복무한 해병자에 대한 상세한 문서도 있습니다. 그는 현재 타르코프에서 어딘가에 있으며 해군 지휘관과 연결을 가지고 있습니다. 데이터에 따르면, 그는 때때로 스캐브와 거래합니다. 우리는 직접 접근 할 수 없습니다. 우리는 잠수함 위치에서 비밀리에 작동해야합니다. 우리는 한 가지 기회가 있습니다. 실수를 하지 않고 그러한 기회를 잃는 것이 중요합니다. 당신은 이 얼마나 중요한지 상상할 수 없습니다. 당신은 훌륭한 전투기입니다. 그러나 당신은 스텔스 기술에 똑같이 능숙하다는 것을 확신하고 싶습니다. 나는 스티어프와 충분히 경험이 풍부한 한 사람을 필요로합니다. 당신의 기회를 증명하십시오.
