quests.title: What's in the Bag?
objectivesKo: 서류를 담은 가방 찾아 확보하기
발견된 항목 건네기
quests.content:
What's in the Bag? is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Your codes turned out to be useful, so you've earned yourself a little reward. Their radio operators picked up the unauthorized signal pretty quickly and went radio silent. Still, at least we've got something to work with now. That unit carries out several operations a day. Every one we intercepted involved extracting TerraGroup documents and materials. They also discussed destroying a couple of sites I didn't even know existed. Then again, maybe they'd already found the wiretap by then and were feeding us bullshit.Either way, now I need a sample of the materials they're trying to get out of the city. We need to figure out whether it's even worth spending resources over this data. Bring me something valuable, and you won't be disappointed with the reward.

== Requirements ==
Must be playing in the Seasonal mode.

== Objectives ==
Locate and obtain the Briefcase with documents
Hand over the found item

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
300,000 Roubles
315,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
345,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
1× Intelligence folder
1× Topographic survey maps
So this is the kind of bag they're using to move classified documents? Looks like they're hauling out so much material that even secure containers aren't enough anymore. Or maybe they figure these bags give them a better chance of slipping some of the data across the border. Fuck if I know. Don't disappear. There'll be plenty more work for you.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find and hand over a Briefcase with documents to Fence. The briefcase can be found on Black Division outside of The Lab.

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 당신의 코드는 유용하게 사용되었기 때문에 약간의 보상을 얻었습니다. 그들의 라디오 사업자들은 무단 신호를 꽤 빨리 잡았고 라디오가 침묵했습니다. 그럼에도 불구하고 적어도 우리는 이제 일을 할 수 있는 것이 있습니다. 그 단위는 하루에 여러 작업을 수행합니다. 우리가 가로막는 모든 것은 테라그룹 문서와 자료를 추출하는 것을 포함합니다. 그들은 또한 존재한다는 것을 알지 못했던 몇 개의 사이트를 파괴하는 것에 대해 논의했습니다. 다시, 아마도 그들은 이미 그 시간까지 이어폰을 잡았을 수도 있고 우리에게 헛소리를 먹여있었습니다. 어쨌든, 이제 그들이 도시에서 빠져나가고자 하는 자료의 샘플이 필요합니다. 우리는 이 데이터에 대한 자원을 지출하는 가치가 있는지 알아내야합니다. 가치있는 무언가를 가져오십시오. 당신은 심지어 보상도 받을 수 없을 것입니다.

objectivesKo: 2개의 항목이 침공: 보안 플래시 드라이브 찾기
2 항목 건네기
quests.content:
What’s on the Flash Drive? is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hey there, mister operator, come here. I got a little something for you. I'm not saying it's a real sure bet, but it might be interesting. One drunken punk's been blabbing that back during the Contract Wars, he guided a few groups of some VIPs who didn't want to be caught by our soldiers or cops. And I agree with the latter. You can still make deals with war dogs as there are many decent people there, but cops are no damn good! Anyway, he guided several such groups. Oh and a fool as he is, he managed to steal everything he could during their camping breaks. Now that deadbeat swears on his mom's name that he snatched two thumb drives on his latest run. What was on them - if anything at all - he's got no clue. And he's been permanently shit-faced for so long that he can't remember anything at all - no location, no landmarks, nothing. Yet he says those VIP were some big enough to even bring security with them, so this might be worth a while. Check any campsite you find. I know that these paths have been beaten through and through since, but what if, you know?

== Objectives ==
Find 2 items in raid: Secure Flash drive
Hand over 2 items

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Skier Rep +0.1
450 Euros
472 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
518 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
And you said they weren't there! Although they might be empty. Need to check. In any case, here's your cut.

quests.content:
Wiring the Vessel is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
It looks like you will have to return to the Icebreaker after all. The data from the nuclear power plant logbook was not sufficient. Our partners need real-time readings from the power unit, so I've purchased a special device from Mechanic for remote connection to the central control station. Before you install it, however, you must ensure that all equipment in the technical areas is functioning properly. Take tools with you and restore the circuit breakers that have been taken offline, then install this device in the control room. I have been informed that the damaged breakers are likely located in three areas. One is directly on the way to the engine room, near the locker rooms with coats. The second is directly beneath that section. The third is somewhere in the corridors running along the engine compartment. Once you have restored all breakers, return to the central control station. Install the device there and report back.

== Objectives ==
Repair the equipment in the automation room leading to the engine room on Icebreaker
Repair the equipment in the automation room under the engine room on Icebreaker
Repair the equipment in the automation room near the storage room on Icebreaker
Install the hacking device in the central control station room on Icebreaker
Note: The "Install" objective will appear after the "Repair" objectives are completed.

== Rewards ==
+30,000 EXP
5,400 Dollars
5,670 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
6,210 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
Unlocks barter for S I C C organizational pouch at Peacekeeper LL1
It seems Mechanic’s device is functioning properly. I hope you managed to avoid contact with the special unit I warned you about. My recommendation remains the same: if you want to survive, it would be best not to return to that site.

== Guide ==

sectionsKo.text: 결국 얼음절차기에는 다시 돌아가야 할 것 같습니다. 원자력 발전소 로그북의 데이터는 충분하지 않았습니다. 우리의 파트너는 전력 단위에서 실시간 판독을 필요로 하기 때문에 중앙 제어역과 원격 연결을 위해 정비사에서 특별한 장치를 구입했습니다. 그러나 설치하기 전에, 당신은 기술 영역의 모든 장비가 제대로 작동하는지 확인해야합니다. 도구를 가지고 오프라인으로 가져와 끊어진 회로 차단기를 복구하고, 다음 제어실에 이 장치를 설치하십시오. 손상된 브레이커가 세 영역에 위치할 가능성이 있다고 알려졌습니다. 하나는 바로 모트러룸 근처에 있는 기계실로 가는 길입니다. 두 번째는 바로 그 섹션 아래에 있습니다. 세 번째는 엔진 방에서 실행되는 코디언트 어딘가에 있습니다. 당신은 모든 브레이커를 복구하고, 제어역으로 돌아가도록 장치가 복원되었습니다. 그리고 중앙 설치된 후에 보고서를 제공합니다.

quests.content:
Work Smarter is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
You know how heated it can be at the safe exits around here. Many die on the road back, not on the actual trip. That's why for a true hunter, it's important to always have something prepared, like a personal escape plan. Times are tough right now, so I don't advise taking unnecessary risks. Take customs for example. I heard that some of the exits are now under someone's control, and they're only letting in their own kind. Which means no more outsiders will be allowed in. You might want to find a way to secure those exits for yourself. It may take some finesse, but for a true warrior, such obstacles shouldn't be a problem.

== Objectives ==
Locate the secret exfil on Customs
(Optional) Obtain the special item to extract through the secret exfil

== Rewards ==
+3,000 EXP
Jaeger Rep +0.1
80,000 Roubles
84,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
92,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Corrugated hose
You've learned your lesson. Make sure you don't forget it. Always be prepared for your return path to be cut short. No matter which part of Tarkov you find yourself in. Your knowledge of the terrain, the paths between the areas and safe escape routes is your strength.

== Guide ==
In this quest you have to visit either of the 2 hidden extractions on Customs. The hidden ones are "Smugglers' Boat" and "Smugglers' Bunker (ZB-1012)". Extracting through them is not required.

sectionsKo.text: 여기 안전한 출구에서 얼마나 뜨겁게 보일지 아시죠. 실제 여행에서 아닌 돌아가는 길에 많은 사람들이 죽습니다. 그래서 진정한 사냥꾼은 항상 개인적인 탈출 계획을 준비하는 것이 중요합니다. 지금 이 순간은 힘든 시간이기 때문에 불필요한 위험을 감수하는 것이 좋습니다. 예를 들어 커스텀를 보세요. 어떤 출구들은 이제 누군가의 통제 아래 있고, 그들은 단지 자신의 종류의 것을 허용하고 있습니다. 즉 더 이상 외부인들이 들어갈 수 없습니다. 당신은 자신을 위해 그러한 출구들을 확보하는 방법을 찾고 싶을 수도 있습니다. 그것은 약간의 미련을 필요로 할 수 있습니다. 그러나 진정한 전사, 그러한 장애물이 문제가 되지 않아야합니다.

== Dialogue ==
Hello mercenary! You know, the job of a peacekeeper is a very difficult one. Peacekeepers are expected to strike a strict balance between the warring parties, and often we find ourselves in the worst kinds of situations. In general, the UN is as interested in a speedy resolution of the conflict as the local authorities. But the local criminal elements are making it difficult. So my superiors require me to achieve new results in the fight against the looters. But how can I do it without casualties among the UN forces? Do you see where I'm going with this?

Eliminate any 30 targets with AR-15 weapons from over 100 meters away on Reserve, Lighthouse, Shoreline, or Ground Zero

quests.content:
You've Got Mail is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Come in, come in! I've got something for you to do. It's a personal matter. I sent a letter just before all this mess started in Tarkov. And now I don't think it's worth it to stir it all up. Not the time. Would you look in the post office and see if my letter is still there?

== Objectives ==
Obtain the registered mail on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the letter

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Prapor Rep +0.25
165,000 Roubles
173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
Did you find it? Phew, that's a load off my mind. You haven't read it, have you? Better not.

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a letter in the post office on Streets of Tarkov. There are multiple spawns throughout the building.

Post office marked on map
The post office

== First spawn ==
In the top left slightly opened drawer of the right cabinet behind the counter.

== Second spawn ==
On the ground behind the counter between the sport bag and the dead Scav.

== Third spawn ==
In the bottom right compartment of the right shelf below the counter.

== Fourth spawn ==
In the adjacent storage room on the bottom of a shelf between packages.

sectionsKo.text: 들어와, 들어와, 내가 너에게 할 일이 있어. 그건 개인적인 문제야. 난 타르코프에서 이 모든 혼란이 시작되기 직전에 편지를 보냈어. 그리고 지금은 모든 것을 혼란스럽게 하는 것이 가치가 없다고 생각합니다. 시간도 없습니다. 우편국에 가서 내 편지를 아직 있는지 확인해 주시겠습니까?

저장 장치 건네기
quests.content:
Your Car Needs a Service is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

== Dialogue ==
Hello, soldier! He who has the information is the victor. You want peace to win, don't you? So it's time to find some information for the good guys. A company was laundering money in the car dealership. Find any data on them that might be useful. My man managed to get a copy of the key to the office. Here you go. The problem, though, is that the entrance to the section itself is also locked, and we haven't been able to find that second key.

== Objectives ==
Obtain the digital storage device from the car dealership manager's office on Streets of Tarkov
Hand over the storage device

== Rewards ==
+10,000 EXP
Peacekeeper Rep +0.25
1,100 Dollars
1,155 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
1,265 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
2× Military flash drive
Unlocks purchase of M67 hand grenade at Peacekeeper LL3
This information would be good leverage in the negotiations. It turns out that someone with the nickname Kaban was operating there during the attack. A sincere thank you from the Blue Helmets!

== Initial Equipment ==

== Guide ==

In this quest you have to find a flash drive on Streets of Tarkov. It can be found on a desk inside the LexOs car dealership director's office, which is located in the closed section on the second floor. A Car dealership closed section key is required to access the office, and the Car dealership director's office room key provided by Peacekeeper via in-game mail is required to open it.

Be aware that the premises of the LexOs car dealership are riddled with Claymores.

Car dealership marked on map
LexOs complex overview

sectionsKo.title: Dialogue
sectionsKo.text: 안녕하세요, 군인! 정보를 가진 사람이 승리자입니다. 평화가 승리하기를 원하십니까? 좋은 사람들을 위한 정보를 찾아볼 때가 왔군요. 자동차 딜러에서 회사가 돈을 세탁하고 있었습니다. 유용한 자료를 찾아보세요. 제 남자는 사무실 열쇠의 복사본을 얻을 수 있었습니다. 여기 있습니다. 문제는 섹션의 입구도 잠겨있어서, 우리는 두번째 열쇠를 찾을 수 없었습니다.

sectionsKo.title: Objectives
sectionsKo.text:
타르코프 시내에서 자동차 딜러 관리자의 사무실에서 디지털 저장 장치 찾아 확보하기
저장 장치 건네기

sectionsKo.title: Rewards
sectionsKo.text: +10,000 EXP 피스키퍼 평판 +0.25 1,100 달러 1,155 달러 정보 센터 레벨 1 1,265 달러 정보 센터 레벨 2 2 × 군사 플래시 드라이브 피스키퍼 LL3에서 M67 핸드 그레나드를 구입 해제합니다 이 정보는 협상에서 좋은 레버리지가 될 것입니다. 공격 당시 카반이라는 별명으로 불리는 사람이 활동하고 있었던 것으로 밝혀졌습니다. 청색 헬멧으로부터 진심으로 감사합니다!

sectionsKo.title: Guide
sectionsKo.text: 이 탐구에서 타르코프 시내에 대한 플래시 드라이브를 찾아야 합니다. 이 드라이브는 2층의 폐쇄된 섹션에 위치한 LexOs 자동차 딜러 디렉터 사무실 내의 책상에서 찾을 수 있습니다. 사무실에 액세스하려면 자동차 딜러 폐쇄된 섹션 키가 필요합니다. 게임 내 메일로 피스키퍼에 의해 제공된 자동차 딜러 디렉터 사무실 방 키가 필요합니다. 이 레이크소 자동차 딜러 사무실의 시설은 클레임러로 가득 차 있음을 알고 있습니다.
